timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Submits OpenMDW-1.1 on behalf of steward The Linux Foundation for OSI approval as a new license — a permissive instrument covering model materials across IP regimes, with no restrictions on outputs.
timeline.point_zh: 代表许可管理方 The Linux Foundation 提交 OpenMDW-1.1 供 OSI 审批——该宽松许可覆盖跨知识产权制度的模型材料，且不限制输出。
timeline.point: Submits OpenMDW-1.1 on behalf of steward The Linux Foundation for OSI approval as a new license — a permissive instrument covering model materials across IP regimes, with no restrictions on outputs.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues OpenMDW-1.1's defensive termination provision departs from the restrained approach of Apache-2.0, MPL-2.0, and EPL-2.0 by extending to copyright litigation and covering seemingly unrelated materials — a novel, potentially problematic departure the OSI should specifically deliberate.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OpenMDW-1.1 的防御性终止条款扩展至版权诉讼并波及看似无关的材料,偏离 Apache-2.0、MPL-2.0、EPL-2.0 的克制做法,这一新颖且有潜在问题的设计需 OSI 专门审议。
timeline.point: Argues OpenMDW-1.1's defensive termination provision departs from the restrained approach of Apache-2.0, MPL-2.0, and EPL-2.0 by extending to copyright litigation and covering seemingly unrelated materials — a novel, potentially problematic departure the OSI should specifically deliberate.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Opposes normalizing a clause that could penalize legitimate copyright claims against AI projects and questions whether it fits the Open Source Definition.
timeline.point_zh: 反对将可能惩罚针对 AI 项目的正当版权主张之条款常态化，并质疑其是否符合开源定义。
timeline.point: Opposes normalizing a clause that could penalize legitimate copyright claims against AI projects and questions whether it fits the Open Source Definition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Asks for historical context on why open-source licenses moved away from terminating copyright grants in response to patent infringement claims.
timeline.point_zh: 询问开源许可证为何在历史上不再因专利侵权主张而终止版权授权。
timeline.point: Asks for historical context on why open-source licenses moved away from terminating copyright grants in response to patent infringement claims.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether GPLv3 treats initiating patent litigation as a separate prohibited act that terminates the license, rather than merely an example of a further restriction.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 GPLv3 是否把发起专利诉讼视为会终止许可证的独立禁止行为，而不只是“进一步限制”的示例。
timeline.point: Questions whether GPLv3 treats initiating patent litigation as a separate prohibited act that terminates the license, rather than merely an example of a further restriction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: The defensive-termination concern rests on OSD 9: terminating over a claim against one item kills rights across the conceptually distinct 'Model Materials', may restrict other software and thus possibly violate OSD 9 — masked by one license for everything by design.
timeline.point_zh: 防御性终止的担忧基于OSD 9:针对一项的索赔会终止概念上独立的'Model Materials'全部权利,或限制其他软件而可能违反OSD 9,并以对一切采用单一许可来掩盖。
timeline.point: The defensive-termination concern rests on OSD 9: terminating over a claim against one item kills rights across the conceptually distinct 'Model Materials', may restrict other software and thus possibly violate OSD 9 — masked by one license for everything by design.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Cites specification-license precedents where defensive termination ends both patent and copyright grants, supporting treatment of overlapping IP rights as one licensing bargain.
timeline.point_zh: 援引规范许可证中防御性终止同时结束专利和版权授权的先例，支持将重叠知识产权视为一项整体许可交易。
timeline.point: Cites specification-license precedents where defensive termination ends both patent and copyright grants, supporting treatment of overlapping IP rights as one licensing bargain.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Explains that MPL 2.0 intentionally terminates copyright grants because terminating only the patent grant can be an ineffective deterrent.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 MPL 2.0 有意终止版权授权，因为仅终止专利授权可能缺乏实际威慑力。
timeline.point: Explains that MPL 2.0 intentionally terminates copyright grants because terminating only the patent grant can be an ineffective deterrent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Corrects the earlier reading of MPL 2.0: patent assertions trigger termination of both copyright and patent grants, while EPL 2.0 appears narrower.
timeline.point_zh: 更正此前对 MPL 2.0 的解读：专利主张会触发版权与专利授权同时终止，而 EPL 2.0 的范围似乎更窄。
timeline.point: Corrects the earlier reading of MPL 2.0: patent assertions trigger termination of both copyright and patent grants, while EPL 2.0 appears narrower.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Welcomes the feedback and defends OpenMDW-1.1's copyright-trigger termination, citing precedent in MPL 1.1, CDDL 1.0 and OSL 3.0, arguing the trigger covers only the Model Materials, preserves licensor-licensee symmetry, excludes outputs, and raises no OSD 9 problem.
timeline.point_zh: 为 OpenMDW-1.1 的版权触发终止条款辩护,援引 MPL 1.1、CDDL 1.0、OSL 3.0 先例,主张触发仅限 Model Materials、维持对称、不及于输出,且无 OSD 9 问题。
timeline.point: Welcomes the feedback and defends OpenMDW-1.1's copyright-trigger termination, citing precedent in MPL 1.1, CDDL 1.0 and OSL 3.0, arguing the trigger covers only the Model Materials, preserves licensor-licensee symmetry, excludes outputs, and raises no OSD 9 problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Warns that copyright-triggered termination could prevent creators from enforcing their rights against widely used models and effectively shield large-scale infringement.
timeline.point_zh: 警告由版权诉讼触发的终止条款可能阻碍创作者对广泛使用的模型维权，实质上为大规模侵权提供保护。
timeline.point: Warns that copyright-triggered termination could prevent creators from enforcing their rights against widely used models and effectively shield large-scale infringement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Asks how patent litigation interacts with GPLv3 Sections 7 and 8 and whether similar termination logic would also apply under GPLv2.
timeline.point_zh: 询问专利诉讼如何与 GPLv3 第 7、8 节衔接，以及类似的终止逻辑是否也适用于 GPLv2。
timeline.point: Asks how patent litigation interacts with GPLv3 Sections 7 and 8 and whether similar termination logic would also apply under GPLv2.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees that terminating only patent grants is not a credible deterrent.
timeline.point_zh: 认同仅终止专利授权不足以形成可信的威慑。
timeline.point: Agrees that terminating only patent grants is not a credible deterrent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the MPL 2.0 explanation was not an endorsement of OpenMDW 1.1 and that the rationale may operate differently for AI model materials.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清对 MPL 2.0 的解释并非支持 OpenMDW 1.1，且同一理由在 AI 模型材料场景下可能产生不同效果。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the MPL 2.0 explanation was not an endorsement of OpenMDW 1.1 and that the rationale may operate differently for AI model materials.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the termination provision clashes with the open source definition by preventing forks and creating a 'Too Big To Sue' custodian, and questions whether the license could ever be enforced without terminating its own rights to the material.
timeline.point_zh: 主张该终止条款妨碍分叉、造就"大到不可被诉"的特殊持有者,违背开源定义,并质疑许可证若会终止自身权利是否根本无法被执行。
timeline.point: Argues the termination provision clashes with the open source definition by preventing forks and creating a 'Too Big To Sue' custodian, and questions whether the license could ever be enforced without terminating its own rights to the material.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Provides historical context on patent retaliation clauses in MPL 2, noting they were designed for inter-corporate warfare and later extended to copyright defense.
timeline.point_zh: 介绍 MPL 2 中专利报复条款的历史背景,指出其最初为公司间斗争而设计,后扩展至版权防御。
timeline.point: Provides historical context on patent retaliation clauses in MPL 2, noting they were designed for inter-corporate warfare and later extended to copyright defense.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Raises a practical concern: unlike code, models cannot be inspected to test an infringement claim, so a copyright claimant loses the permission needed to run the model and generate evidence after suing.
timeline.point_zh: 提出实际顾虑:模型无法像代码那样通过检视验证侵权主张,版权索赔方起诉后将失去运行模型以生成证据所需的许可。
timeline.point: Raises a practical concern: unlike code, models cannot be inspected to test an infringement claim, so a copyright claimant loses the permission needed to run the model and generate evidence after suing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Quotes the GPLv3 Third Discussion Draft Rationale to show that GPLv3's sections 8, 10 and 11 were revised so a patent assertion can terminate copyright as well as patent permissions, disputing the alternative reading of the 'further restriction' example.
timeline.point_zh: 援引 GPLv3 第三讨论稿理由书,说明第8、10、11条经修订后专利主张可同时终止版权与专利许可,并反驳对"进一步限制"例子的另一种解读。
timeline.point: Quotes the GPLv3 Third Discussion Draft Rationale to show that GPLv3's sections 8, 10 and 11 were revised so a patent assertion can terminate copyright as well as patent permissions, disputing the alternative reading of the 'further restriction' example.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that GPLv3 section 10 does not specify if a copyright assertion constitutes a 'further restriction' beyond financial charges.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 GPLv3 第10条未说明除财务收费外，版权主张是否构成"further restriction"。
timeline.point: Clarifies that GPLv3 section 10 does not specify if a copyright assertion constitutes a 'further restriction' beyond financial charges.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Corrects the date mentioned in the previous message.
timeline.point_zh: 更正上一条消息中提到的日期。
timeline.point: Corrects the date mentioned in the previous message.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the defensive termination provision discriminates against open source developers enforcing their licenses, a possible OSD 5/6 violation, and warns approval would signal OSI siding against licensors pursuing legitimate copyright claims.
timeline.point_zh: 主张防御性终止条款歧视执行开源许可证的开发者,可能违反 OSD 5/6,并警告批准即意味着 OSI 站在追究正当版权主张的许可方对立面。
timeline.point: Argues the defensive termination provision discriminates against open source developers enforcing their licenses, a possible OSD 5/6 violation, and warns approval would signal OSI siding against licensors pursuing legitimate copyright claims.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the license improperly imposes its terms on included third-party materials, potentially causing an external MIT licensor to lose their rights if they sue for infringement.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证不当将自身条款强加于所含第三方材料，可能导致外部 MIT 许可人因起诉侵权而丧失权利。
timeline.point: Argues the license improperly imposes its terms on included third-party materials, potentially causing an external MIT licensor to lose their rights if they sue for infringement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions why termination applies only to patent and copyright suits when the grant covers database and trade secret rights, and warns the 'solely responsible for clearing rights' clause creates a positive duty whose breach could terminate the license at the licensor's whim.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑授权涵盖数据库与商业秘密权利而终止仅针对专利与版权诉讼,并警告"自行清理权利"条款构成积极义务,违反即可能被许可方任意终止许可。
timeline.point: Questions why termination applies only to patent and copyright suits when the grant covers database and trade secret rights, and warns the 'solely responsible for clearing rights' clause creates a positive duty whose breach could terminate the license at the licensor's whim.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Considers submitting OpenMDW to OSI appropriate and open to reviewing 1.0 as well, but argues the undefined scope of 'Model Materials' across split repositories creates an OSD 9 problem and suggests scoping termination to model parameters.
timeline.point_zh: 认为向 OSI 提交 OpenMDW 是合适的、亦可考虑评审 1.0 版,但主张 Model Materials 范围不明、跨仓库拆分会引发 OSD 9 问题,建议将终止范围限于模型参数。
timeline.point: Considers submitting OpenMDW to OSI appropriate and open to reviewing 1.0 as well, but argues the undefined scope of 'Model Materials' across split repositories creates an OSD 9 problem and suggests scoping termination to model parameters.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the license never defines a 'release' nor requires Model Materials be released together, so a claim against one model could terminate licenses to unrelated models, leaving the meaning of Model Materials unclear and in need of clarification.
timeline.point_zh: 主张许可证未定义"发布"、也未要求 Model Materials 一同发布,针对一个模型的诉讼可能终止无关模型的许可;Model Materials 含义不明,应予澄清。
timeline.point: Argues the license never defines a 'release' nor requires Model Materials be released together, so a claim against one model could terminate licenses to unrelated models, leaving the meaning of Model Materials unclear and in need of clarification.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Finds some merit in the concern that the rights-clearance language could impose a positive obligation, notes the FAQ frames it as risk allocation, and proposes a clarifying sentence stating no independent clearance duty exists.
timeline.point_zh: 认为权利清理语言可能构成积极义务的担忧有一定道理,并指出 FAQ 将其定位为风险分配,建议增补一句澄清本协议不独立要求获取第三方授权。
timeline.point: Finds some merit in the concern that the rights-clearance language could impose a positive obligation, notes the FAQ frames it as risk allocation, and proposes a clarifying sentence stating no independent clearance duty exists.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees that treating a single model release as a unit is reasonable but notes the text lacks this definition, suggesting the Model Materials scope be limited to a specific release for clarity.
timeline.point_zh: 认同将单次模型发布视为一个单元是合理的，但指出文本缺少该定义，建议为清晰起见将 Model Materials 范围限于特定发布。
timeline.point: Agrees that treating a single model release as a unit is reasonable but notes the text lacks this definition, suggesting the Model Materials scope be limited to a specific release for clarity.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Notes that GPLv3, MPLv2, and CDDLv1.1 allow for termination of copyright rights upon patent assertions, concluding such clauses are not anomalous.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 GPLv3、MPLv2 和 CDDLv1.1 允许因专利主张而终止版权权利，结论是此类条款并不反常。
timeline.point: Notes that GPLv3, MPLv2, and CDDLv1.1 allow for termination of copyright rights upon patent assertions, concluding such clauses are not anomalous.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that no OSI-approved license terminates rights for copyright assertions, asserting that revoking Freedom 0 based on copyright claims fundamentally undermines software freedom.
timeline.point_zh: 认为没有 OSI 批准的许可证会因版权主张而终止权利，并主张基于版权主张撤销 Freedom 0 从根本上破坏软件自由。
timeline.point: Argues that no OSI-approved license terminates rights for copyright assertions, asserting that revoking Freedom 0 based on copyright claims fundamentally undermines software freedom.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: States that a termination clause triggered by a copyright assertion is problematic.
timeline.point_zh: 表示由版权主张触发的终止条款存在问题。
timeline.point: States that a termination clause triggered by a copyright assertion is problematic.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Defends OpenMDW-1.1 against the objections raised; open to parallel review of OpenMDW-1.0 but expects 1.1 to be the path forward.
timeline.point_zh: 维护 OpenMDW-1.1 以回应各项质疑；可并行评审 OpenMDW-1.0，但预期 1.1 才是前进方向。
timeline.point: Defends OpenMDW-1.1 against the objections raised; open to parallel review of OpenMDW-1.0 but expects 1.1 to be the path forward.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Copyright and patent are categorically different — copyrights arise automatically, patents require deliberate filing. This license shields someone violating half a million copyrights at once from suit, and seeking OSI approval of it as 'open source' is laughable.
timeline.point_zh: 版权与专利有本质区别——版权自动产生，专利须主动申请。该许可证意在保护一次侵犯五十万项版权者免于被诉，还指望OSI批准其为“开源”，实属可笑。
timeline.point: Copyright and patent are categorically different — copyrights arise automatically, patents require deliberate filing. This license shields someone violating half a million copyrights at once from suit, and seeking OSI approval of it as 'open source' is laughable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Finds Dolan's response largely persuasive but remains concerned that the "solely responsible" clearance language could be read as a license condition, citing EPL-2.0 §2(c) as precedent; suggests adding a clarifying sentence to remove the ambiguity if no such condition is intended.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Dolan 的回应大体有说服力,但"solely responsible"清理权利条款仍可能被解读为许可条件(引 EPL-2.0 §2(c) 为例),若非本意,建议增补一句话以消除歧义。
timeline.point: Finds Dolan's response largely persuasive but remains concerned that the "solely responsible" clearance language could be read as a license condition, citing EPL-2.0 §2(c) as precedent; suggests adding a clarifying sentence to remove the ambiguity if no such condition is intended.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Accepts the explanation regarding Model Materials scope but strongly recommends OpenMDW guidance explicitly enumerate them to clarify termination rights.
timeline.point_zh: 接受关于 Model Materials 范围的解释，但强烈建议 OpenMDW 指南明确列举其内容，以澄清终止权利。
timeline.point: Accepts the explanation regarding Model Materials scope but strongly recommends OpenMDW guidance explicitly enumerate them to clarify termination rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Opposes v1.1: terminating licenses upon copyright infringement claims forces innocent rights holders to forgo claims against intentional infringers — antithetical to open source. Could approve v1.0 if the rights-clearance paragraph is clarified as a recommendation, not an obligation.
timeline.point_zh: 反对1.1版：因版权侵权主张即终止许可证，会迫使无辜权利人放弃对故意侵权者的索赔，与开源原则背道而驰。若1.0版将权利清理段落明确为建议而非义务，可予批准。
timeline.point: Opposes v1.1: terminating licenses upon copyright infringement claims forces innocent rights holders to forgo claims against intentional infringers — antithetical to open source. Could approve v1.0 if the rights-clearance paragraph is clarified as a recommendation, not an obligation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: OpenMDW-1.1's termination clause bars only a suitor who keeps exploiting the accused work (the SCO analogy), not infringement claims themselves. OSD text and approval precedent accept termination triggers; policy objections belong in a future OSD amendment, not this review.
timeline.point_zh: OpenMDW-1.1的终止条款仅针对继续利用被诉作品的起诉方（SCO类比），并非禁止侵权主张；OSD文本与先例均接受终止机制，政策异议应留待修订OSD而非本次评审。
timeline.point: OpenMDW-1.1's termination clause bars only a suitor who keeps exploiting the accused work (the SCO analogy), not infringement claims themselves. OSD text and approval precedent accept termination triggers; policy objections belong in a future OSD amendment, not this review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Rejects the CAL-1.0 precedent analogy as a patent-only trigger and notes past approvals don't bind the OSI. Argues the published requirements allow rejection when consensus finds the license fails to ensure software freedom, which underlies his and others' concerns about OpenMDW-1.1.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CAL-1.0 先例类比不成立（仅涉专利触发），过往批准不约束 OSI；共识认定许可未保障软件自由即可否决，此为其对 OpenMDW-1.1 担忧的依据。
timeline.point: Rejects the CAL-1.0 precedent analogy as a patent-only trigger and notes past approvals don't bind the OSI. Argues the published requirements allow rejection when consensus finds the license fails to ensure software freedom, which underlies his and others' concerns about OpenMDW-1.1.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions the conclusion that all training data must be explicitly licensed, arguing the license protects developers and that policy dilemmas regarding AI and open source should not encumber the license evaluation.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑所有训练数据必须获得明确许可的结论，认为该许可证保护开发者，AI 与开源的政策困境不应阻碍许可证评估。
timeline.point: Questions the conclusion that all training data must be explicitly licensed, arguing the license protects developers and that policy dilemmas regarding AI and open source should not encumber the license evaluation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: States that viewing the license as a regular FOSS license reveals tensions that weigh against approval and emphasizes the OSI's role in protecting the open source community's interests.
timeline.point_zh: 表示将许可证视为普通 FOSS 许可证会显现不利于批准的张力，并强调 OSI 在保护开源社区利益方面的角色。
timeline.point: States that viewing the license as a regular FOSS license reveals tensions that weigh against approval and emphasizes the OSI's role in protecting the open source community's interests.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Says he still doesn't see how OpenMDW-1.1's termination clause would harm the open source ecosystem: Dolan clarified there is no blanket immunity, and the SCO analogy suggests the clause may be a net positive. Asks critics what he is missing.
timeline.point_zh: 称仍看不出 OpenMDW-1.1 终止条款如何危害开源生态：Dolan 已澄清无全面豁免，SCO 类比甚至显示其可能是净收益；请反对者指出自己遗漏了什么。
timeline.point: Says he still doesn't see how OpenMDW-1.1's termination clause would harm the open source ecosystem: Dolan clarified there is no blanket immunity, and the SCO analogy suggests the clause may be a net positive. Asks critics what he is missing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Still opposed: at scale the termination trigger makes FOSS developers choose between AI use and infringement claims, pushing them toward proprietary models; the NVIDIA-inspired trigger seems aimed at blunting AI litigation and hurts the ecosystem more than it helps.
timeline.point_zh: 反对：终止条款广泛采用将迫使 FOSS 开发者在用 AI 与保留侵权索赔间二选一，倒向专有模式；受 NVIDIA 启发的条款疑似意在削弱 AI 诉讼，对生态弊大于利。
timeline.point: Still opposed: at scale the termination trigger makes FOSS developers choose between AI use and infringement claims, pushing them toward proprietary models; the NVIDIA-inspired trigger seems aimed at blunting AI litigation and hurts the ecosystem more than it helps.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Disputes the premise that every FOSS line is in every LLM: models seem to retain mainly high-abstraction content, code claims hit idea/expression limits, and authors may only have claims over training copies, unrelated to the model's license — awaiting Ross Intelligence.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑每行 FOSS 代码都进了每个 LLM 的前提：模型只留存高抽象内容，代码受思想/表达限制，作者或仅能就训练副本索赔；结果待 Ross Intelligence 案。
timeline.point: Disputes the premise that every FOSS line is in every LLM: models seem to retain mainly high-abstraction content, code claims hit idea/expression limits, and authors may only have claims over training copies, unrelated to the model's license — awaiting Ross Intelligence.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions if the inclusion of "associated software" in model materials allows bad actors to hide infringing code, preventing users from suing for infringement without forfeiting the right to use the software.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑模型材料中纳入"associated software"是否使恶意者得以隐藏侵权代码，令用户须放弃软件使用权方可起诉侵权。
timeline.point: Questions if the inclusion of "associated software" in model materials allows bad actors to hide infringing code, preventing users from suing for infringement without forfeiting the right to use the software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Rejects the comparison between copyright and patent burdens, asserting the license would unfairly penalize employees required to use AI tools by restricting participation in class action lawsuits.
timeline.point_zh: 反对将版权与专利负担相比，主张该许可通过限制参与集体诉讼，不公平地惩罚被要求使用AI工具的员工。
timeline.point: Rejects the comparison between copyright and patent burdens, asserting the license would unfairly penalize employees required to use AI tools by restricting participation in class action lawsuits.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the license applies where no license is needed while including a termination provision that walls out users if challenged.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可在本无需许可的情形下适用，且包含一项在受质疑时将用户排除在外的终止条款。
timeline.point: Argues the license applies where no license is needed while including a termination provision that walls out users if challenged.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Claims the OpenMDW review is tainted by anti-AI ideological bias: letting tiny copyright holders block open-weight AI starves the data commons and favors OpenAI/Anthropic/Google; model expropriation should be fought politically, not contractually.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OpenMDW 评审被反 AI 意识形态偏见污染：小版权方阻挡开放权重 AI 会饿死数据公地、利好 OpenAI/Anthropic/Google；对策应靠政治而非合同。
timeline.point: Claims the OpenMDW review is tainted by anti-AI ideological bias: letting tiny copyright holders block open-weight AI starves the data commons and favors OpenAI/Anthropic/Google; model expropriation should be fought politically, not contractually.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that terminating the license in response to a copyright infringement assertion is incompatible with the OSD and amounts to blanket permission to infringe; questions the license's timing right after the Anthropic settlement and highlights its abuse potential.
timeline.point_zh: 认为因主张版权侵权即终止授权违反 OSD,等同纵容侵权;并质疑该许可证紧随 Anthropic 和解后提交,凸显滥用风险。
timeline.point: Argues that terminating the license in response to a copyright infringement assertion is incompatible with the OSD and amounts to blanket permission to infringe; questions the license's timing right after the Anthropic settlement and highlights its abuse potential.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Asks what distinguishes copyright termination for patent assertions (accepted under GPLv3 and MPLv2) from termination for copyright assertions, and how that squares with Freedom Zero and the OSD, noting OSI must define the metes and bounds of any 'software freedom' gestalt.
timeline.point_zh: 追问对专利诉讼终止授权(GPLv3、MPLv2 允许)与对版权诉讼终止授权有何区别、如何与 Freedom Zero 及 OSD 相容,并指出 OSI 需厘清"软件自由"原则的边界。
timeline.point: Asks what distinguishes copyright termination for patent assertions (accepted under GPLv3 and MPLv2) from termination for copyright assertions, and how that squares with Freedom Zero and the OSD, noting OSI must define the metes and bounds of any 'software freedom' gestalt.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Defends OpenMDW-1.1's termination clause, arguing proprietary alternatives like the NVIDIA and Llama licenses are worse for developers, that bright-line rules are fairer than after-the-fact equity, and that small publishers otherwise cannot underwrite litigation and simply won't publish openly.
timeline.point_zh: 为 OpenMDW-1.1 的终止条款辩护,指 NVIDIA 与 Llama 等专有许可证对开发者更不利,明确规则优于事后衡平,否则小型发布者无力承担诉讼风险、只能放弃开放发布。
timeline.point: Defends OpenMDW-1.1's termination clause, arguing proprietary alternatives like the NVIDIA and Llama licenses are worse for developers, that bright-line rules are fairer than after-the-fact equity, and that small publishers otherwise cannot underwrite litigation and simply won't publish openly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Urges the OSI to treat OpenMDW-1.1 as a standard software license subject to strict OSD review rather than a looser AI-specific standard.
timeline.point_zh: 敦促OSI将OpenMDW-1.1作为标准软件许可接受严格的OSD审查，而非较宽松的AI专用标准。
timeline.point: Urges the OSI to treat OpenMDW-1.1 as a standard software license subject to strict OSD review rather than a looser AI-specific standard.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that OpenMDW-1.1 was submitted as a standard software license designed for code reuse and does not seek special AI classification.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清OpenMDW-1.1是以面向代码复用的标准软件许可身份提交，并未寻求特殊的AI分类。
timeline.point: Clarifies that OpenMDW-1.1 was submitted as a standard software license designed for code reuse and does not seek special AI classification.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that AI licenses are evaluated against the OSD and OSAID like any other license, and invites specific proposals for additional evaluation tests.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清AI许可与其他许可一样按OSD和OSAID评估，并欢迎就增加评估测试提出具体建议。
timeline.point: Clarifies that AI licenses are evaluated against the OSD and OSAID like any other license, and invites specific proposals for additional evaluation tests.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the OSI review process already considers 'software freedom' alongside the OSD, allowing rejection of licenses that lack software freedom even if OSD-compliant.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清OSI审查流程已将"software freedom"与OSD一并考量，故即使许可符合OSD，若缺乏software freedom仍可拒绝。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the OSI review process already considers 'software freedom' alongside the OSD, allowing rejection of licenses that lack software freedom even if OSD-compliant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that the undefined "software freedom" test invites endless arguments because the term lacks a clear definition or articulated criteria.
timeline.point_zh: 认为未定义的"software freedom"测试会引发无休止的争论，因为该术语缺乏明确定义或表述清晰的标准。
timeline.point: Argues that the undefined "software freedom" test invites endless arguments because the term lacks a clear definition or articulated criteria.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Thanks Luis for flagging the term "Lebensraum" and reminds participants to keep discussions respectful and focused on the substance of the issues.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢Luis指出"Lebensraum"一词，并提醒参与者保持讨论相互尊重、聚焦问题实质。
timeline.point: Thanks Luis for flagging the term "Lebensraum" and reminds participants to keep discussions respectful and focused on the substance of the issues.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Suggests OSI build a body of precedent by explaining how 'software freedom' applies in specific decisions rather than defining it rigidly upfront.
timeline.point_zh: 建议OSI通过在具体裁决中解释"software freedom"的适用方式来积累先例，而非预先僵硬地定义。
timeline.point: Suggests OSI build a body of precedent by explaining how 'software freedom' applies in specific decisions rather than defining it rigidly upfront.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues copyright and patent are fundamentally different — copyrights are ubiquitous, patents rare and domain-specific — so patent-termination precedent doesn't justify copyright termination, citing his BusyBox enforcement suits to show the clause would let defendants terminate the licensor's rights.
timeline.point_zh: 论证版权与专利根本不同——版权人人皆有,专利稀少且领域特定——并以 BusyBox 维权诉讼为例,说明此类条款会让被告终止许可方权利,专利先例并不适用。
timeline.point: Argues copyright and patent are fundamentally different — copyrights are ubiquitous, patents rare and domain-specific — so patent-termination precedent doesn't justify copyright termination, citing his BusyBox enforcement suits to show the clause would let defendants terminate the licensor's rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Identifies additional uses of OpenMDW since submission and shares a link to track the license in public models.
timeline.point_zh: 列出自提交以来OpenMDW的更多使用实例，并分享一个追踪该许可在公开模型中使用的链接。
timeline.point: Identifies additional uses of OpenMDW since submission and shares a link to track the license in public models.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the copyright antisuit clause is fair and uncontroversial: suing one model's distributor terminates rights only to that model, not all OpenMDW models, and the provision parallels accepted patent retaliation clauses.
timeline.point_zh: 认为版权反诉讼条款公平且无争议:起诉某一模型的发行方只会终止对该模型的授权,而非所有 OpenMDW 模型,且该条款类似已被接受的专利报复条款。
timeline.point: Argues the copyright antisuit clause is fair and uncontroversial: suing one model's distributor terminates rights only to that model, not all OpenMDW models, and the provision parallels accepted patent retaliation clauses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Asserts that patent law does include a first sale doctrine called patent exhaustion and urges participants to avoid misstating legal facts when making their case.
timeline.point_zh: 断言专利法确有称为patent exhaustion的首次销售原则，并敦促参与者在论证时避免误述法律事实。
timeline.point: Asserts that patent law does include a first sale doctrine called patent exhaustion and urges participants to avoid misstating legal facts when making their case.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Disputes that an identical clause would have been approved 10 years ago, arguing the forum would have flagged it as a novel policy issue and given it a hostile reception, given the era's skepticism toward litigation-triggered termination provisions.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳十年前相同条款会获批的说法,认为鉴于当时对诉讼触发终止条款的怀疑与警惕,论坛会视其为新颖政策问题并持敌对态度。
timeline.point: Disputes that an identical clause would have been approved 10 years ago, arguing the forum would have flagged it as a novel policy issue and given it a hostile reception, given the era's skepticism toward litigation-triggered termination provisions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Suggests considering OpenMDW-1.0 for approval to defer the controversial copyright trigger question and asks if this scope reduction resolves sufficient concerns.
timeline.point_zh: 建议考虑批准OpenMDW-1.0以搁置有争议的版权触发问题，并询问此缩减范围是否足以化解疑虑。
timeline.point: Suggests considering OpenMDW-1.0 for approval to defer the controversial copyright trigger question and asks if this scope reduction resolves sufficient concerns.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the 'Model Materials' concept raises a deeper problem—whether patent-assertion-triggered termination of thing A can extend to unrelated thing B, a concern grounded in OSD 9—and OpenMDW-1.0 should not be approved without explicitly addressing it.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 "Model Materials" 概念引出更深问题——针对 A 的专利诉讼触发终止能否波及无关的 B(涉及 OSD 9),不应未明确解决该问题便批准 OpenMDW-1.0。
timeline.point: Argues the 'Model Materials' concept raises a deeper problem—whether patent-assertion-triggered termination of thing A can extend to unrelated thing B, a concern grounded in OSD 9—and OpenMDW-1.0 should not be approved without explicitly addressing it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Questions if the patent termination clause creates an OSD9 violation by causing the model license to terminate due to suits against separate, third-party inference code.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑专利终止条款是否因针对独立的第三方推理代码的诉讼导致模型许可终止，从而违反OSD9。
timeline.point: Questions if the patent termination clause creates an OSD9 violation by causing the model license to terminate due to suits against separate, third-party inference code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Uses an NVIDIA OpenMDW-1.1 repository containing an unrelated latex2html.py script to argue the termination provision restricts other software distributed alongside the model, illustrating an OSD 9 problem that is likely not atypical.
timeline.point_zh: 以 NVIDIA 的 OpenMDW-1.1 仓库中无关的 latex2html.py 脚本为例,论证终止条款限制了随模型一并分发的其他软件,这很可能并非个例的 OSD 9 问题。
timeline.point: Uses an NVIDIA OpenMDW-1.1 repository containing an unrelated latex2html.py script to argue the termination provision restricts other software distributed alongside the model, illustrating an OSD 9 problem that is likely not atypical.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, 	versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues OpenMDW cannot work as an open source license: models likely lack copyrightability and any reasonable source code, the license disclaims the vendor's ownership of the model, and the anti-lawsuit clause is overbroad without a definition of "participate".
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OpenMDW 无法作为开源许可证成立:模型很可能不具版权、无合理的源代码,许可推卸发行方对模型的所有权,反诉讼条款因未定义 "participate" 而过宽。
timeline.point: Argues OpenMDW cannot work as an open source license: models likely lack copyrightability and any reasonable source code, the license disclaims the vendor's ownership of the model, and the anti-lawsuit clause is overbroad without a definition of "participate".

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Counters that the criticism targets how this particular licensor expressed the license, not the license text itself; notes the ModelGo licenses define licensed materials similarly and asks whether the same concern applies to them and, if not, why not.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称批评针对该发行方表达许可证的方式而非许可文本本身;指出 ModelGo 许可证对授权材料的定义类似,并询问同样的担忧是否也适用以及为何不适用。
timeline.point: Counters that the criticism targets how this particular licensor expressed the license, not the license text itself; notes the ModelGo licenses define licensed materials similarly and asks whether the same concern applies to them and, if not, why not.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Prevailing AI publisher practices will fill OpenMDW repositories with items hard to fit into a single clear "Model Materials" set, obscuring the termination provision's reach — possibly the license's basic practical flaw. ModelGo's "Complimentary Materials" raises a similar issue.
timeline.point_zh: 主流AI发布惯例将令OpenMDW仓库充满难归入单一“Model Materials”的条目，模糊终止条款适用范围，或为该许可的根本缺陷；ModelGo的“Complimentary Materials”同理。
timeline.point: Prevailing AI publisher practices will fill OpenMDW repositories with items hard to fit into a single clear "Model Materials" set, obscuring the termination provision's reach — possibly the license's basic practical flaw. ModelGo's "Complimentary Materials" raises a similar issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies MG license scope and withdraws MG-BY-SA over unverifiable distillation, and warns that OpenMDW-1.1's copyright-termination clause would erode API users' trust in models released under it.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清MG许可范围，并因蒸馏无法验证而撤回MG-BY-SA，同时警告OpenMDW-1.1的版权终止条款会削弱API用户对依其发布模型的信任。
timeline.point: Clarifies MG license scope and withdraws MG-BY-SA over unverifiable distillation, and warns that OpenMDW-1.1's copyright-termination clause would erode API users' trust in models released under it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: The example fails because latex2html.py is actually used in post-processing; bundling heterogeneous artifacts has precedent (SIL OFL 1.1, IPA Font License), so guidance should require licensors to explicitly enumerate Model Materials so that OpenMDW 1.0 can be evaluated first.
timeline.point_zh: 示例不成立：latex2html.py 实际用于后处理；将异构产物作为一个许可单元有先例（SIL OFL 1.1、IPA Font License）；应要求许可方明确列举 Model Materials，以便先行评估 OpenMDW 1.0。
timeline.point: The example fails because latex2html.py is actually used in post-processing; bundling heterogeneous artifacts has precedent (SIL OFL 1.1, IPA Font License), so guidance should require licensors to explicitly enumerate Model Materials so that OpenMDW 1.0 can be evaluated first.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: The OpenMDW licenses shouldn't be dismissed merely because enforcement may not rest on copyright; the paragraph-level objections mostly fail, though OpenMDW-1.1's litigation-trigger wording is atypical.
timeline.point_zh: OpenMDW 许可证不应因执行机制可能不依赖版权而被否定；各段落层面的反对意见大多不成立，但 OpenMDW-1.1 的诉讼触发措辞确属非典型。
timeline.point: The OpenMDW licenses shouldn't be dismissed merely because enforcement may not rest on copyright; the paragraph-level objections mostly fail, though OpenMDW-1.1's litigation-trigger wording is atypical.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Defines "software freedom" as freedom to do anything with software under limited commons-growing conditions; argues the OSD lacks a "providing software freedom" requirement to catch licenses that formally comply yet favor one entity or discourage use.
timeline.point_zh: 将"软件自由"定义为在有限的、壮大公共资源的条件下对软件任意使用;认为OSD缺少"提供软件自由"要求,以识别形式合规却偏袒单方或劝退使用的许可证。
timeline.point: Defines "software freedom" as freedom to do anything with software under limited commons-growing conditions; argues the OSD lacks a "providing software freedom" requirement to catch licenses that formally comply yet favor one entity or discourage use.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Challenges the "software freedom" test as unworkable for license drafters versus the OSD; rebuts the objection to OpenMDW-1.1's copyright-assertion termination by analogy to accepted patent-termination triggers; asks that all perceived anti-freedom conditions be stated before any Board decision.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑"软件自由"测试相较OSD对起草者不可行;类比公认专利终止条款,反驳对OpenMDW-1.1版权主张终止的异议;要求董事会决策前先列明所有被视为反自由的条件。
timeline.point: Challenges the "software freedom" test as unworkable for license drafters versus the OSD; rebuts the objection to OpenMDW-1.1's copyright-assertion termination by analogy to accepted patent-termination triggers; asks that all perceived anti-freedom conditions be stated before any Board decision.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Traces the 'voluntarily participate' language to Microsoft's Open Specification Promise and Community Promise and to OWFa 1.0, doubts John's suggested interpretation of it, and questions what the term is specifically supposed to cover.
timeline.point_zh: 将'voluntarily participate'措辞追溯至Microsoft的Open Specification Promise和Community Promise及OWFa 1.0，怀疑John建议的解释，并质疑该术语究竟应涵盖什么。
timeline.point: Traces the 'voluntarily participate' language to Microsoft's Open Specification Promise and Community Promise and to OWFa 1.0, doubts John's suggested interpretation of it, and questions what the term is specifically supposed to cover.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the termination clause differs from the patent retaliation clauses it borrows from: users cannot know in advance whether their work ended up in the model materials, and the warranty disclaimer does not cover it, so it deters copyright holders who had no way to check first.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该终止条款不同于其借鉴的专利条款:用户无法事先得知自己的作品是否进入模型材料,保修免责声明也不覆盖此情形,它威慑的是无从核查的普通版权持有人。
timeline.point: Argues the termination clause differs from the patent retaliation clauses it borrows from: users cannot know in advance whether their work ended up in the model materials, and the warranty disclaimer does not cover it, so it deters copyright holders who had no way to check first.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Defends the termination clause by comparing it to standard copyright retaliation clauses, arguing it is logical to lose the license if suing the developer for infringement.
timeline.point_zh: 将该终止条款比作标准版权报复条款来辩护，认为若起诉开发者侵权则丧失许可是合理的。
timeline.point: Defends the termination clause by comparing it to standard copyright retaliation clauses, arguing it is logical to lose the license if suing the developer for infringement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies the concern is RAG, not training data: RAG databases likely count as associated data, so claiming copyright in stored work terminates the license under Paragraph 5. Says 1.1 looks more aggressive than MIT as an Open model license and prefers data to keep its own license.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清其担忧在于 RAG 而非训练数据:RAG 数据库很可能属关联数据,依 Paragraph 5 对存储作品主张版权即终止许可。认为作为开放模型许可证 1.1 比 MIT 更激进,倾向数据保留独立许可。
timeline.point: Clarifies the concern is RAG, not training data: RAG databases likely count as associated data, so claiming copyright in stored work terminates the license under Paragraph 5. Says 1.1 looks more aggressive than MIT as an Open model license and prefers data to keep its own license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the license prevents using the model to gather evidence for a copyright claim, forcing users to produce all necessary proof before filing any lawsuit.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可阻止使用模型收集版权主张的证据，迫使用户在提起任何诉讼前备齐所有必要证明。
timeline.point: Argues the license prevents using the model to gather evidence for a copyright claim, forcing users to produce all necessary proof before filing any lawsuit.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Partially disagrees that the software test suffices: litigation retaliation must be proportionate, not a general waiver of claims against the licensor.
timeline.point_zh: 部分不同意软件测试即足够：诉讼报复必须相称，而非对针对许可人索赔的一般性放弃。
timeline.point: Partially disagrees that the software test suffices: litigation retaliation must be proportionate, not a general waiver of claims against the licensor.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Suggests modifying the license to address OSD 9 issues and questions the legitimacy of terminating licenses for copyright litigation regarding model weights.
timeline.point_zh: 建议修改许可以解决OSD 9问题，并质疑因涉及模型权重的版权诉讼而终止许可的正当性。
timeline.point: Suggests modifying the license to address OSD 9 issues and questions the legitimacy of terminating licenses for copyright litigation regarding model weights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees a plain software test is insufficient — OpenMDW fits the Special Purpose category — and reframes the issue as proportionality over the licensed unit, with software freedom a backstop rather than a free-standing test.
timeline.point_zh: 同意单纯软件测试不足，OpenMDW 应属 Special Purpose 类，问题应按许可单元相称性衡量，软件自由仅为兜底而非独立标准。
timeline.point: Agrees a plain software test is insufficient — OpenMDW fits the Special Purpose category — and reframes the issue as proportionality over the licensed unit, with software freedom a backstop rather than a free-standing test.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Rejects the argument that users wouldn't agree to restrictive terms, noting people are routinely forced to accept unwanted contract terms to access services.
timeline.point_zh: 驳斥用户不会接受限制性条款的说法，指出人们为获取服务而被迫接受不想要的合同条款是常态。
timeline.point: Rejects the argument that users wouldn't agree to restrictive terms, noting people are routinely forced to accept unwanted contract terms to access services.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that remarks on retaliation were generic to define where clauses become unacceptable for essential facilities, rather than specific to OpenMDW.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清关于报复的言论是泛指，旨在界定条款何时对必需设施而言不可接受，而非专门针对OpenMDW。
timeline.point: Clarifies that remarks on retaliation were generic to define where clauses become unacceptable for essential facilities, rather than specific to OpenMDW.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Finds the copyright-only termination rationale unconvincing — if deterrence is the goal, any lawsuit should trigger it. Argues the fair-use status of training is unsettled, so the clause presupposes a legal outcome, and asks whether it would still sound reasonable if training required licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 认为仅针对版权诉讼终止的理由不成立——若为威慑,任何诉讼都应触发终止;训练是否构成合理使用尚无定论,该条款等于预设法律结论,并质疑若日后训练需获许可,该条款是否仍站得住。
timeline.point: Finds the copyright-only termination rationale unconvincing — if deterrence is the goal, any lawsuit should trigger it. Argues the fair-use status of training is unsettled, so the clause presupposes a legal outcome, and asks whether it would still sound reasonable if training required licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1       (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Expresses concern that models cannot be copyrighted and that the 'corresponding lawsuit' exception undermines the license's premise, arguing unclear definitions leave rights to vendor discretion so no one could rely on the license.
timeline.point_zh: 担忧模型无法获得版权,质疑 "corresponding lawsuit" 例外破坏许可证前提,并认为定义不清使权利取决于供应商裁量,这样的许可证无人敢依赖。
timeline.point: Expresses concern that models cannot be copyrighted and that the 'corresponding lawsuit' exception undermines the license's premise, arguing unclear definitions leave rights to vendor discretion so no one could rely on the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Notes that the term "corresponding" in the termination clause is ambiguous and questions its necessity, speculating it was intended to mean "another."
timeline.point_zh: 指出终止条款中"corresponding"一词含义模糊并质疑其必要性，推测其本意是"another"。
timeline.point: Notes that the term "corresponding" in the termination clause is ambiguous and questions its necessity, speculating it was intended to mean "another."

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Suggests replacing 'providing software freedom' with clearer alternatives like 'encouraging sharing of software' or 'protecting the open software ecosystem' to avoid conceptual ambiguity and baggage.
timeline.point_zh: 建议用更清晰的表述（如「鼓励软件共享」或「保护开放软件生态」）替换「提供软件自由」，以避免概念歧义和语义包袱。
timeline.point: Suggests replacing 'providing software freedom' with clearer alternatives like 'encouraging sharing of software' or 'protecting the open software ecosystem' to avoid conceptual ambiguity and baggage.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: As steward, responds point-by-point to criticisms of OpenMDW-1.1, explaining the 'voluntarily participate' and 'corresponding lawsuit' provisions, Model Materials scope, and downstream grants, and requests a fair evaluation comparable to other licenses in use.
timeline.point_zh: 作为管理方逐点回应批评,解释 "voluntarily participate"、"corresponding lawsuit" 条款及 Model Materials 范围与下游授权,请求对 OpenMDW-1.1 给予与其他在用许可证同等的公平评审。
timeline.point: As steward, responds point-by-point to criticisms of OpenMDW-1.1, explaining the 'voluntarily participate' and 'corresponding lawsuit' provisions, Model Materials scope, and downstream grants, and requests a fair evaluation comparable to other licenses in use.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Summarizes understanding of the reply: API users are not licensees, 'provided to you' means a copy of Model Materials was transferred, and a shipped RAG vector database counts as provided — so claiming work stored in it would trigger Paragraph 5; asks for correction if wrong.
timeline.point_zh: 总结自己的理解:API 用户不是被许可方;"provided to you" 指 Model Materials 副本已转移;随模型发布的 RAG 向量数据库属于已提供,对其存储内容主张权利将触发第 5 段;如有误请指正。
timeline.point: Summarizes understanding of the reply: API users are not licensees, 'provided to you' means a copy of Model Materials was transferred, and a shipped RAG vector database counts as provided — so claiming work stored in it would trigger Paragraph 5; asks for correction if wrong.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Contends that the submitter's interpretation reflects intent rather than legal operation, and argues that FAQs cannot prevent unintended legal interpretations.
timeline.point_zh: 认为提交者的解读反映的是意图而非法律运作，并主张FAQ无法阻止非预期的法律解读。
timeline.point: Contends that the submitter's interpretation reflects intent rather than legal operation, and argues that FAQs cannot prevent unintended legal interpretations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Corrects Pam's characterization of the steward's positions, arguing the grant is consistent on dual licensing and third-party code, the clearance disclaimer is not an implicit condition, and a 'prove a negative' standard would doom any license, as with Apache-2.0 and EPL.
timeline.point_zh: 纠正 Pam 对管理方立场的表述:授权在双许可与第三方代码问题上无矛盾,免责条款并非隐含条件;要求"证明否定"的标准任何许可证都无法满足,Apache-2.0 与 EPL 亦然。
timeline.point: Corrects Pam's characterization of the steward's positions, arguing the grant is consistent on dual licensing and third-party code, the clearance disclaimer is not an implicit condition, and a 'prove a negative' standard would doom any license, as with Apache-2.0 and EPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that arguments against copyright antisuit provisions apply equally to patent ones, warning that rejecting the former would require revisiting many existing licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 认为反对版权禁诉条款的论据同样适用于专利条款，并警告否定前者将需重新审视许多现有许可。
timeline.point: Argues that arguments against copyright antisuit provisions apply equally to patent ones, warning that rejecting the former would require revisiting many existing licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the OSI must resolve whether a copyright-based litigation termination trigger is acceptable, dismissing the OCLC precedent as early inattention, and suggests that a copyright trigger mirroring the IBM Public License's patent clause would surely not be okay.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSI 必须解决版权诉讼触发终止条款是否可接受的问题,指 OCLC 先例只是当年考虑不周;若照 IBM Public License 专利条款换成版权触发,肯定不可接受。
timeline.point: Argues the OSI must resolve whether a copyright-based litigation termination trigger is acceptable, dismissing the OCLC precedent as early inattention, and suggests that a copyright trigger mirroring the IBM Public License's patent clause would surely not be okay.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Warns that copyright-based termination clauses impact every contributor and risk enabling dark patterns to chill complaints about corporate behavior.
timeline.point_zh: 警告基于版权的终止条款影响每一位贡献者,并有可能助长“黑暗模式”以压制对企业行为的投诉。
timeline.point: Warns that copyright-based termination clauses impact every contributor and risk enabling dark patterns to chill complaints about corporate behavior.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Asks for clarification on what "indirectly infringe" in Section 5 is intended to cover — whether it means secondary liability such as contributory, vicarious, or induced infringement, or more broadly claims based on infringement occurring during training.
timeline.point_zh: 要求澄清第5节中“indirectly infringe”拟涵盖的范围——是指帮助侵权、替代责任或诱导侵权等次级责任，还是更宽泛地指基于训练期间发生侵权的主张。
timeline.point: Asks for clarification on what "indirectly infringe" in Section 5 is intended to cover — whether it means secondary liability such as contributory, vicarious, or induced infringement, or more broadly claims based on infringement occurring during training.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the IPL's and ModelGo-Attribution-2.0's litigation-termination triggers are too broad, but defends OpenMDW-1.1's trigger as limited to reciprocal patent/copyright claims against the Model Materials.
timeline.point_zh: 认为IPL与ModelGo-Attribution-2.0的诉讼终止触发过宽;为OpenMDW-1.1辩护,称其触发仅限针对Model Materials的互惠专利/版权索赔。
timeline.point: Argues the IPL's and ModelGo-Attribution-2.0's litigation-termination triggers are too broad, but defends OpenMDW-1.1's trigger as limited to reciprocal patent/copyright claims against the Model Materials.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: This is a philosophical divide: extending termination triggers to any claim (fairness) vs. treating patents as a special case — which is better? Only patent/copyright infringement triggers OpenMDW termination, and the ModelGo Derivative Works issue is irrelevant.
timeline.point_zh: 这是哲学分歧：终止触发扩至任何主张还是专利属特例？哪条更好？仅专利/版权侵权触发 OpenMDW 终止，ModelGo Derivative Works 问题无关。
timeline.point: This is a philosophical divide: extending termination triggers to any claim (fairness) vs. treating patents as a special case — which is better? Only patent/copyright infringement triggers OpenMDW termination, and the ModelGo Derivative Works issue is irrelevant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Asks what principle limits OpenMDW-1.1's litigation termination trigger to patent and copyright claims: would database-right or trade-secret claims concerning the Model Materials leave the grants intact, and is the asymmetry with the broad rights grant deliberate?
timeline.point_zh: 询问 OpenMDW-1.1 诉讼终止触发为何仅限专利和版权主张:涉及 Model Materials 的数据库权利或商业秘密主张是否不影响授权,这种与宽泛授权的不对称是否有意为之?
timeline.point: Asks what principle limits OpenMDW-1.1's litigation termination trigger to patent and copyright claims: would database-right or trade-secret claims concerning the Model Materials leave the grants intact, and is the asymmetry with the broad rights grant deliberate?

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the historical record shows the OSI community has always seen patents as a unique open source problem deserving unique (if any) treatment, though opinions on how licenses should properly deal with patents have shifted over time.
timeline.point_zh: 认为历史记录表明 OSI 社区一直视专利为开源的独特问题、值得独特对待,尽管关于许可证应如何恰当处理专利的看法随时间有所变化。
timeline.point: Argues the historical record shows the OSI community has always seen patents as a unique open source problem deserving unique (if any) treatment, though opinions on how licenses should properly deal with patents have shifted over time.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Answers questions on the OpenMDW-1.1 termination trigger: 'directly or indirectly infringe' covers secondary liability, matching Apache-2.0's style, and only patent or copyright claims trigger termination — not database rights or trade secrets — because the trigger targets realistic litigation threats rather than matching the grant scope.
timeline.point_zh: 解答 OpenMDW-1.1 终止触发问题：“直接或间接侵权”涵盖次级责任，同 Apache-2.0；仅专利或版权主张触发终止，数据库权利与商业秘密不触发，因触发条款针对现实诉讼威胁而非匹配授权范围。
timeline.point: Answers questions on the OpenMDW-1.1 termination trigger: 'directly or indirectly infringe' covers secondary liability, matching Apache-2.0's style, and only patent or copyright claims trigger termination — not database rights or trade secrets — because the trigger targets realistic litigation threats rather than matching the grant scope.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: OpenMDW License Agreement, versions 1.1 (OpenMDW-1.1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that Mike's clarification narrows the Section 5 termination trigger to claims against the Model Materials themselves rather than training-data disputes, and proposes a general principle: defensive termination may be acceptable where the assertion targets the licensed subject matter and the termination is proportionate.
timeline.point_zh: 认为经 Mike 澄清,Section 5 触发条款限于针对 Model Materials 本身的主张,并提出原则:防御性终止在指向被许可标的且范围相称时可接受。
timeline.point: Argues that Mike's clarification narrows the Section 5 termination trigger to claims against the Model Materials themselves rather than training-data disputes, and proposes a general principle: defensive termination may be acceptable where the assertion targets the licensed subject matter and the termination is proportionate.

status_review.rationale: The license was submitted for review on 2026-08-13 and discussion is ongoing through 2026-09-03 with feedback, questions, and support, but there is no board vote, board decision, rejection, withdrawal, or superseding submission in the evidence. The curated status is pending and the timeline summary confirms no withdrawal or board decision, so the final status is pending.

evidence_refs.quote: Submits OpenMDW-1.1 on behalf of steward The Linux Foundation for OSI approval as a new license
proposes a general principle: defensive termination may be acceptable where the assertion targets the licensed subject matter and the termination is proportionate.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The BOS Public License v1.0
timeline.snippet: Submits the BOS Public License v1.0, a permissive MIT-based license adding two conditions — a visible link back to the original repository for public forks, and preservation of CREDITS.txt — for OSI approval.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 BOS Public License v1.0——一款基于 MIT 的宽松许可证,新增公开 fork 须显著回链原始仓库并完整保留 CREDITS.txt 两项条件——供 OSI 审批。
timeline.point: Submits the BOS Public License v1.0, a permissive MIT-based license adding two conditions — a visible link back to the original repository for public forks, and preservation of CREDITS.txt — for OSI approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The BOS Public License v1.0
timeline.snippet: Questions the license's utility and raises edge cases: what counts as the 'original repository', deletion/hijacking, partial copying, and cross-imports; argues the CREDITS.txt clause wrongly bars crediting downstream work and ignores modern OSS distribution realities.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑该许可证的实用性并提出多种边界情形:何为"原始仓库"、其被删除或劫持怎么办、仅复制单个模块、项目互相引入等;指出 CREDITS.txt 条款使下游贡献无法署名,忽视现代 OSS 分发现实。
timeline.point: Questions the license's utility and raises edge cases: what counts as the 'original repository', deletion/hijacking, partial copying, and cross-imports; argues the CREDITS.txt clause wrongly bars crediting downstream work and ignores modern OSS distribution realities.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The BOS Public License v1.0
timeline.snippet: Requested the required review-process information, especially whether the license had legal review or was drafted by a lawyer.
timeline.point_zh: 要求补齐许可证审查流程所需信息，尤其是法律审查情况以及是否由律师起草。
timeline.point: Requested the required review-process information, especially whether the license had legal review or was drafted by a lawyer.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The BOS Public License v1.0
timeline.snippet: Agreed the submission lacked required text and information, and questioned the need for a new backlink condition that may add compliance friction.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该提交缺少必要文本和信息，并质疑新增原项目链接条件的必要性，认为可能增加合规摩擦。
timeline.point: Agreed the submission lacked required text and information, and questioned the need for a new backlink condition that may add compliance friction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Mutualist License (MutuaL) v1.2
timeline.snippet: Submits the Mutualist License v1.2 (MutuaL-1.2) for formal OSI approval, presenting it as a plain-language strong network copyleft license with FOSS cooperation and modern patent terms.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 Mutualist License v1.2（MutuaL-1.2）供 OSI 正式审批，称其为采用通俗语言的强网络 copyleft 许可证，兼顾 FOSS 协作和现代专利条款。
timeline.point: Submits the Mutualist License v1.2 (MutuaL-1.2) for formal OSI approval, presenting it as a plain-language strong network copyleft license with FOSS cooperation and modern patent terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Mutualist License (MutuaL) v1.2
timeline.snippet: Argues the draft license has numerous serious drafting problems — ambiguous terms, unconventional headings, no paragraph numbering, an unclear grant — and fails the OSD because it does not unquestionably grant all necessary rights.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该草案存在大量严重起草问题——术语含糊、标题不合惯例、无段落编号、授予条款不清晰——且未能毫无疑问地授予全部必要权利，不符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Argues the draft license has numerous serious drafting problems — ambiguous terms, unconventional headings, no paragraph numbering, an unclear grant — and fails the OSD because it does not unquestionably grant all necessary rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Mutualist License (MutuaL) v1.2
timeline.snippet: Warns that drafting a reliable open source license requires jurisdiction-specific legal expertise and review, comparing licenses to cryptographic code that fails without domain scrutiny.
timeline.point_zh: 提醒可靠开源许可证需要针对不同法域的法律专业知识和审查，并把许可证类比为缺乏领域审查就会失效的密码学代码。
timeline.point: Warns that drafting a reliable open source license requires jurisdiction-specific legal expertise and review, comparing licenses to cryptographic code that fails without domain scrutiny.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Mutualist License (MutuaL) v1.2
timeline.snippet: Defends the license against the drafting criticisms: concedes paragraph numbering, but argues "break copyright" is plain English for infringement, the headings and Clarity definitions resolve ambiguity, and the grant covers the full bundle of rights, meeting the OSD.
timeline.point_zh: 为许可证辩护：同意添加段落编号，但认为 "break copyright" 是指侵权的通俗英语，标题与 Clarity 定义已消除歧义，授予条款涵盖全部权利，符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Defends the license against the drafting criticisms: concedes paragraph numbering, but argues "break copyright" is plain English for infringement, the headings and Clarity definitions resolve ambiguity, and the grant covers the full bundle of rights, meeting the OSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] The Mutualist License (MutuaL) v1.2
timeline.snippet: Explains the OSI reviews licenses to ensure courts will interpret them in ways that protect the open source ecosystem, and argues this license is too poorly drafted to assure that, so it should not be approved — the problem is inexact drafting, not plain language.
timeline.point_zh: 阐明 OSI 审查许可证是为了确保法院以保护开源生态的方式解释它们，认为该许可证起草太差无法保证这一点，不应获批；问题在于起草不严谨，而非通俗语言。
timeline.point: Explains the OSI reviews licenses to ensure courts will interpret them in ways that protect the open source ecosystem, and argues this license is too poorly drafted to assure that, so it should not be approved — the problem is inexact drafting, not plain language.

timeline.snippet: Argues the Milenium License fills no gap — strict copyleft is covered by GNU GPL/AGPL and the lineage requirement is unnecessary — and its language is vague and imprecise; concludes it does not make the cut unless the submission is withdrawn or improved.

timeline.point: Argues the Milenium License fills no gap — strict copyleft is covered by GNU GPL/AGPL and the lineage requirement is unnecessary — and its language is vague and imprecise; concludes it does not make the cut unless the submission is withdrawn or improved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License Submission: Milenium License 1.0
timeline.snippet: Argues Section 4's ambiguous 'proprietary' likely violates OSD 6, and Section 6's copyright credit for independent projects violates OSD 9 and the license-reusability approval standard; also notes 'millennium' is misspelled.

license_texts.text:
CompanioNation Public Licence, version 1.0
Proposed SPDX identifier: CNPL-1.0

Note: I am aware that CPL-1.0 is already registered (IBM Common Public
License). CNPL-1.0 is intentionally distinct.

---



## 2. OSD compliance affirmations


I affirm that CNPL-1.0 complies with the Open Source Definition.
Specifically:

- OSD §3 (Derived Works): Section 2 grants unrestricted rights to prepare
and distribute derivative works. ✓
- OSD §5 (No Discrimination Against Persons or Groups): The license places
no restrictions on any person or group. ✓
- OSD §6 (No Discrimination Against Fields of Endeavor): The license
explicitly permits commercial use, SaaS deployment, and any other purpose. ✓
- OSD §9 (License Must Not Restrict Other Software): The license contains
no such restriction. ✓

Full OSD mapping:

§1 Free Redistribution — Sections 2 and 3 grant unconditional
redistribution rights with no royalty. ✓
§2 Source Code — The license imposes no source-withholding restriction. ✓
§3 Derived Works — See above. ✓
§4 Integrity of Author's Source Code — No patch-file or name-change
restriction is imposed. ✓
§5 No Discrimination — See above. ✓
§6 No Field Restriction — See above. ✓
§7 Distribution of License — Rights apply to all downstream recipients
automatically. ✓
§8 Not Specific to a Product — Section 1 defines "Software" generically; no
product dependency. ✓
§9 No Restriction on Other Software — See above. ✓
§10 Technology Neutral — No technology-specific provision exists. ✓

---



## 3. Projects using this license


CNPL-1.0 is a new license. It is currently in use by one project:

  CompanioNation™ — an open-source online dating platform
  https://github.com/CompanioNation/Core

---



## 4. Gap not filled by existing licenses


CNPL-1.0 is a simple permissive license with two features not combined in
any single currently approved license:

a) An explicit, broad patent grant (as in Apache 2.0) combined with
permissive, copyleft-free terms (as in MIT). The MIT License contains no
patent grant. Apache 2.0 contains one, but also imposes a NOTICE file
requirement and has considerably more complexity.

b) A redistribution condition requiring the complete license text (not
merely a copyright notice) to be retained. This ensures downstream
recipients always receive the full grant of rights — including the patent
licence — rather than just a copyright attribution line that may be
stripped of legal context.

The intent is a license that is as simple as MIT, but legally complete:
explicit patent grant, full-text redistribution, and no overhead.

---



## 5. Comparison to similar approved licenses


Most similar: MIT License
- Both are permissive, copyleft-free, and impose minimal conditions.
- MIT requires retention of the copyright notice and permission notice
only. CNPL-1.0 requires retention of the complete license text.
- MIT contains no patent grant. CNPL-1.0 includes an explicit patent grant
with a litigation termination clause.

Also comparable: Apache License 2.0
- Both include explicit patent grants with litigation termination.
- Apache 2.0 requires a NOTICE file, tracks modifications, and is
substantially longer. CNPL-1.0 imposes none of those requirements.
- Apache 2.0 is permissive but complex. CNPL-1.0 is intentionally minimal.

In short: CNPL-1.0 occupies the space between MIT (no patent grant,
notice-only) and Apache 2.0 (patent grant, significant overhead).

---



## 6. Legal review


The license was drafted by the submitter, who is not a lawyer. No formal
legal review has been conducted. I welcome scrutiny of the text on this
list.

---



## 7. Proposed tags


Permissive, Patent-Grant, Simple

---

The license text is attached. I have subscribed to license-review and will
be attentive and responsive to discussion.

Thank you for your consideration.

Drew McPherson
License Steward, CNPL-1.0
drew.mcpherson at gmail.com
https://github.com/CompanioNation/Core

timeline.snippet: Calls the draft straightforward and clear from a developer perspective, but reserves judgment on the patent clause and questions whether an existing approved license already covers the same conditions.
