timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Introduces the ModelGo Licenses, a CC-style nine-variant framework for model publishing, and asks whether to submit all variations, whether OSD-incompatible ones like MG-BY-NC can be submitted as complementary materials, and how to handle MG-BY-OS's open-source requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 介绍含九个变体的 CC 风格模型许可框架 ModelGo Licenses，并询问是否需提交全部变体、MG-BY-NC 等不符 OSD 者可否作补充材料，以及 MG-BY-OS 的开源要求如何处理。
timeline.point: Introduces the ModelGo Licenses, a CC-style nine-variant framework for model publishing, and asks whether to submit all variations, whether OSD-incompatible ones like MG-BY-NC can be submitted as complementary materials, and how to handle MG-BY-OS's open-source requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Warns that licenses with -NC terms should not be submitted because they do not meet OSD and says MG-BY-OS is likely non-compliant when it allows only open weights without requiring open source code.
timeline.point_zh: 警告任何带 -NC 条款的许可不应提交，因为不符合 OSD，并指出仅公开权重而未要求开源代码的 MG-BY-OS 也可能不合规。
timeline.point: Warns that licenses with -NC terms should not be submitted because they do not meet OSD and says MG-BY-OS is likely non-compliant when it allows only open weights without requiring open source code.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the response, clarifies MG-*-OS only requires code delivery without mandatory OSI-approved terms, and asks whether OSAID applies to AI systems and whether model licenses should compel code and data to be under OSI-approved terms.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢回复并澄清 MG-*-OS 仅要求提供代码副本但未强制采用 OSI 批准条款，进而询问 OSAID 是否适用于 AI 系统，以及模型许可是否应强制代码与数据都遵循 OSI 批准许可。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the response, clarifies MG-*-OS only requires code delivery without mandatory OSI-approved terms, and asks whether OSAID applies to AI systems and whether model licenses should compel code and data to be under OSI-approved terms.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Explains that OSAID is based on an AI-system definition from the OECD, ties open source “source code” expectations to that mapping, and withholds personal opinions while inviting additional discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 OSAID 已包含 AI 系统定义，强调在 AI 场景中需先明确“程序”对应的 AI 系统才可界定源代码含义，并表示保留个人意见不公开同时邀请继续讨论。
timeline.point: Explains that OSAID is based on an AI-system definition from the OECD, ties open source “source code” expectations to that mapping, and withholds personal opinions while inviting additional discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Warns that open source users should avoid code without explicit licenses and states that, in at least the UK context, copying machine code can require permission even before it is copied into working memory.
timeline.point_zh: 强调负责任的开源实践应避免使用无明确许可的代码，并表示至少在英国情形下，复制机器码甚至在进入工作内存前可能已需许可证授权。
timeline.point: Warns that open source users should avoid code without explicit licenses and states that, in at least the UK context, copying machine code can require permission even before it is copied into working memory.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Thanks for the clarification, says copyleft-style terms may hurt broad software compatibility, notes model training data often already has free-content licensing, and says he will move forward with OSI review submission materials.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢反馈后指出共用权（copyleft）风格条款可能损害软件生态兼容性，认为模型训练数据常被免费内容许可覆盖且可能不需要 OSI 许可，并表示将继续推进 OSI 审核材料准备。
timeline.point: Thanks for the clarification, says copyleft-style terms may hurt broad software compatibility, notes model training data often already has free-content licensing, and says he will move forward with OSI review submission materials.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits ModelGo Zero License 2.0 (MG0-2.0) for OSI review — the most permissive ModelGo family variant, requiring only that the original license accompany distribution — arguing it fills the gap in model publishing left by OSS, OpenRAIL, proprietary, and CC licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 ModelGo Zero License 2.0（MG0-2.0）供 OSI 审查——ModelGo 家族中最宽松的变体，仅要求分发时附上原许可证——并论证其填补 OSS、OpenRAIL、专有及 CC 许可证在模型发布上的空白。
timeline.point: Submits ModelGo Zero License 2.0 (MG0-2.0) for OSI review — the most permissive ModelGo family variant, requiring only that the original license accompany distribution — arguing it fills the gap in model publishing left by OSS, OpenRAIL, proprietary, and CC licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License 2.0 (MG-BY-OS-2.0) for OSI review, a model license requiring preservation of the license and attribution, same-term licensing of Derivative Materials, and source code provision, intended as an open-source model license.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License 2.0（MG-BY-OS-2.0）供 OSI 审查，该模型许可证要求保留原许可证与署名、衍生材料以相同条款许可并提供源代码，旨在成为开源模型许可证。
timeline.point: Submits ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License 2.0 (MG-BY-OS-2.0) for OSI review, a model license requiring preservation of the license and attribution, same-term licensing of Derivative Materials, and source code provision, intended as an open-source model license.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Says the thread is a useful OS AI Definition test case, says MG-BY-OS could be OSD-compatible depending on final text, and warns that this first AI-license evaluation will likely require extended internal discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 表示该讨论可作为 OS AI 定义的实测案例，认为 MG-BY-OS 在文本充分时可能兼容 OSD，同时提醒这是首个 AI 许可评审，可能需要更长时间与更多内部讨论。
timeline.point: Says the thread is a useful OS AI Definition test case, says MG-BY-OS could be OSD-compatible depending on final text, and warns that this first AI-license evaluation will likely require extended internal discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submitting the ModelGo Attribution License 2.0 (MG-BY-2.0), a new permissive license designed for publishing AI models, for OSI review, arguing it fills a gap left by OSS, OpenRAIL, and proprietary model licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 ModelGo Attribution License 2.0（MG-BY-2.0）——一个面向 AI 模型发布的新型宽松许可证——供 OSI 审阅，称其填补 OSS、OpenRAIL 与专有许可证之间的空白。
timeline.point: Submitting the ModelGo Attribution License 2.0 (MG-BY-2.0), a new permissive license designed for publishing AI models, for OSI review, arguing it fills a gap left by OSS, OpenRAIL, and proprietary model licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Raises two principal objections: unspecified annex mechanisms may allow unapproved right toggles, and licensor-based jurisdiction clauses are ambiguous across releases, litigation stages, and derivative disputes, so recommends removing such provisions.
timeline.point_zh: 提出两项主要反对意见：未定义附件体系可能导致未审批的权利勾选变更，以及以许可人所在地/主营地为准的管辖与争议条款在不同时间点和衍生许可争议中含糊不清，建议移除。
timeline.point: Raises two principal objections: unspecified annex mechanisms may allow unapproved right toggles, and licensor-based jurisdiction clauses are ambiguous across releases, litigation stages, and derivative disputes, so recommends removing such provisions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Explains Annex A (Model Sheet) is a non-binding summary to aid understanding and programmatic compliance analysis, clarifies RAI restrictions belong only to non-submitted variants, and proposes adopting AFL-3.0's governing-law clause instead of Singapore law.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 Annex A（Model Sheet）是帮助理解与合规分析的非约束性摘要，说明 RAI 限制仅属未提交的变体，并建议改用 AFL-3.0 的管辖法律条款。
timeline.point: Explains Annex A (Model Sheet) is a non-binding summary to aid understanding and programmatic compliance analysis, clarifies RAI restrictions belong only to non-submitted variants, and proposes adopting AFL-3.0's governing-law clause instead of Singapore law.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Pre-Advice for ModelGo Licenses Review
timeline.snippet: Argues no OSD-compatible model license exists while 1.4 million models on Hugging Face lack proper licensing, and advocates the ModelGo License family to promote a more open AI ecosystem.
timeline.point_zh: 指出目前没有 OSD 兼容的模型许可证，而 Hugging Face 上 140 万模型缺乏规范许可，倡导 ModelGo License 家族以促进更开放的 AI 生态。
timeline.point: Argues no OSD-compatible model license exists while 1.4 million models on Hugging Face lack proper licensing, and advocates the ModelGo License family to promote a more open AI ecosystem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Flags the clause requiring compliance with all applicable laws before use as potentially conflicting with OSD 5 and 6, argues that state law already governs legality, and disagrees with treating source data as mandatory for open-source AI status.
timeline.point_zh: 指出“所有使用必须符合法律”条款可能与 OSD 5 与 6 冲突，认为合法性由国家法制执行，不应写入许可约束，并对“必须公开源数据才算开源 AI”结论表示异议。
timeline.point: Flags the clause requiring compliance with all applicable laws before use as potentially conflicting with OSD 5 and 6, argues that state law already governs legality, and disagrees with treating source data as mandatory for open-source AI status.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Defends retaining 2.3(a)(i) by arguing it is not person-group discrimination and that licensors need not guarantee against illegal use, then says model licenses need not cover dataset terms beyond their own scope and should keep output usages open.
timeline.point_zh: 为保留 2.3(a)(i) 条款辩护，认为其并非对特定人群歧视且许可人不应对非法用途担责，同时主张开源模型无需扩展到数据层条款且不应封锁模型输出用途。
timeline.point: Defends retaining 2.3(a)(i) by arguing it is not person-group discrimination and that licensors need not guarantee against illegal use, then says model licenses need not cover dataset terms beyond their own scope and should keep output usages open.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Warns the OSI is unlikely to approve the license's use restriction, flags the jurisdiction clause as disfavored, and objects that Annex A makes the license mutable and not self-contained.
timeline.point_zh: 警告 OSI 不太可能批准该使用限制，指出管辖权条款不受青睐，并反对 Annex A 使许可证可被改动且不自足。
timeline.point: Warns the OSI is unlikely to approve the license's use restriction, flags the jurisdiction clause as disfavored, and objects that Annex A makes the license mutable and not self-contained.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: States jurisdiction-style provisions are usually unnecessary and discouraged, yet not necessarily OSD-violating by themselves; signals only a specific-country compliance obligation could make the clause problematic.
timeline.point_zh: 表示此类管辖条款通常不必要且被建议避免，但单独出现未必构成 OSD 违规；只有强制遵循特定国家法域才可能使其成为问题。
timeline.point: States jurisdiction-style provisions are usually unnecessary and discouraged, yet not necessarily OSD-violating by themselves; signals only a specific-country compliance obligation could make the clause problematic.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Warns output labeling requirements may be treated as use restrictions, then objects to the phrase “non-transferable, sublicensable” as legally ambiguous and potentially unworkable in cross-jurisdiction transfer scenarios.
timeline.point_zh: 警告对模型输出强制标注可能被认定为使用限制，并反对“不可转让、可分许可”表述存在法律歧义，在企业转让等跨法域情境下可能难以执行。
timeline.point: Warns output labeling requirements may be treated as use restrictions, then objects to the phrase “non-transferable, sublicensable” as legally ambiguous and potentially unworkable in cross-jurisdiction transfer scenarios.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the concerns and offers to remove the offending clause and tighten modification terms, but argues the Annex A table helps reduce interpretation divergences and makes licensing more user-friendly.
timeline.point_zh: 承认相关顾虑并愿意删除问题条款、收紧修改限制，但认为 Annex A 表格有助于减少解释分歧、使许可更易用。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the concerns and offers to remove the offending clause and tighten modification terms, but argues the Annex A table helps reduce interpretation divergences and makes licensing more user-friendly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Responds that the AI-generated-content notice is intended as attribution rather than field-of-use restriction, says watermarking is not planned, and says potential wording issues will be corrected with lawyer review.
timeline.point_zh: 回应关切认为 AI 生成内容提示用于标识而非限定使用领域，不打算强制输出水印，并称相关表述问题将与律师确认后修订。
timeline.point: Responds that the AI-generated-content notice is intended as attribution rather than field-of-use restriction, says watermarking is not planned, and says potential wording issues will be corrected with lawyer review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits a request to re-open review discussion for the MG-BY-OS variant before amending, while reporting that some MG0 clauses appear non-compliant and the current submission will be revised after consolidating comments.
timeline.point_zh: 提交在重提修订前先启动MG-BY-OS版本评审讨论，说明MG0有若干条款可能不符合OSD并计划汇总意见后提交修订版。
timeline.point: Submits a request to re-open review discussion for the MG-BY-OS variant before amending, while reporting that some MG0 clauses appear non-compliant and the current submission will be revised after consolidating comments.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Flags that three ModelGo licenses (Zero, BY, BY-OS) were submitted and asks that feedback focus first on BY-OS, noting it adds section 2.3(ii) through (vi).
timeline.point_zh: 提示作者已提交Zero、BY、BY-OS三版许可证，要求先审阅BY-OS，并指出其与Zero差异是新增2.3(ii)至(vi)部分。
timeline.point: Flags that three ModelGo licenses (Zero, BY, BY-OS) were submitted and asks that feedback focus first on BY-OS, noting it adds section 2.3(ii) through (vi).

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Suggests deleting Section 2.2 because derivative copyright arises by operation of law and cannot be conditioned by a grant, and strongly advises removing Section 5.1 since a time-based "term" conflicts with the irrevocability of an open source license.
timeline.point_zh: 建议删除 Section 2.2，因衍生作品版权依法律自动产生、许可授予无法附加此类条件；并强烈建议删除 Section 5.1，因基于期限的 "term" 有违开源许可证的不可撤销性。
timeline.point: Suggests deleting Section 2.2 because derivative copyright arises by operation of law and cannot be conditioned by a grant, and strongly advises removing Section 5.1 since a time-based "term" conflicts with the irrevocability of an open source license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Revises a prior comment by clarifying section 2.2 again, reiterating that copyright cannot be created in another subject through grant and apologizing for earlier drafting artifacts.
timeline.point_zh: 修正先前对2.2条的说明，重申许可无法令他人获得衍生作品著作权主体，随后说明早先表述有瑕疵并致歉。
timeline.point: Revises a prior comment by clarifying section 2.2 again, reiterating that copyright cannot be created in another subject through grant and apologizing for earlier drafting artifacts.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Defends Clause 2.2 as a voluntary abandonment of IP claims in derivatives meant to reduce ownership ambiguity in model reuse, and agrees to remove Clause 5.1 and retitle Section 5.
timeline.point_zh: 辩称 Clause 2.2 是对衍生材料 IP 权利的自愿放弃，旨在减少模型复用中的归属歧义，并同意删除 Clause 5.1 并更改 Section 5 标题。
timeline.point: Defends Clause 2.2 as a voluntary abandonment of IP claims in derivatives meant to reduce ownership ambiguity in model reuse, and agrees to remove Clause 5.1 and retitle Section 5.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Detailed layman review of MG A-OS License 2.0: flags the 'all applicable laws' and Singapore governing-law clauses as probable OSD 5 violations, questions the novel output-notice requirement, and calls it a good start on a copyleft model license needing fixes.
timeline.point_zh: 详细评审 MG A-OS License 2.0：指出 all applicable laws 与新加坡管辖条款可能违反 OSD5，质疑新颖的输出通知要求，认为是不错的 copyleft 模型许可证起点但需修改。
timeline.point: Detailed layman review of MG A-OS License 2.0: flags the 'all applicable laws' and Singapore governing-law clauses as probable OSD 5 violations, questions the novel output-notice requirement, and calls it a good start on a copyleft model license needing fixes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Argues it is unwise to approve a license requiring compliance with 'all applicable law', as it lets a private entity enforce its ethics via infringement suits and likely violates OSD 5 and 6; warns that approving it as the first OSAID license would normalize the clause.
timeline.point_zh: 认为批准要求遵守 all applicable law 的许可证并不明智，会让私人实体借侵权诉讼推行自身伦理，可能违反 OSD5 和 OSD6；作为首个 OSAID 许可证通过将使该条款成为常态。
timeline.point: Argues it is unwise to approve a license requiring compliance with 'all applicable law', as it lets a private entity enforce its ethics via infringement suits and likely violates OSD 5 and 6; warns that approving it as the first OSAID license would normalize the clause.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Supports Eric's objection to the law-compliance condition and shares a linked article arguing against embedding mandatory legal-behavior controls into open-source licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 支持Eric对“遵守所有适用法律”反对意见，并提供相关文章，说明该类法律行为限制不应进入开源许可。
timeline.point: Supports Eric's objection to the law-compliance condition and shares a linked article arguing against embedding mandatory legal-behavior controls into open-source licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Confirms agreement that the criticized clause is unnecessary and problematic, and commits to removing it in resubmission while crediting prior input on the long-term impact of that pattern.
timeline.point_zh: 确认该争议条款不妥且会被移除于后续修订稿，感谢此前反馈其长期影响。
timeline.point: Confirms agreement that the criticized clause is unnecessary and problematic, and commits to removing it in resubmission while crediting prior input on the long-term impact of that pattern.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Forwards Moming's replies to the license-review list as responses to many earlier questions, helping the thread progress with a consolidated reply context.
timeline.point_zh: 将Moming对先前多项问题的回复转发到许可证审查邮件列表，便于讨论在同一上下文下继续。
timeline.point: Forwards Moming's replies to the license-review list as responses to many earlier questions, helping the thread progress with a consolidated reply context.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the output-disclosure clause is intended as AI assistance attribution to reduce misinformation, offers practical compliance examples, and asks whether this common requirement is OSD-compliant.
timeline.point_zh: 说明该输出披露条款旨在标明AI辅助生成并降低误导风险，给出可行执行示例，并继续询问其是否兼容OSD。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the output-disclosure clause is intended as AI assistance attribution to reduce misinformation, offers practical compliance examples, and asks whether this common requirement is OSD-compliant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Notes that in research, AI use should be declared in publications, while the specific AI system used is unnecessary as long as purpose of usage is stated.
timeline.point_zh: 指出学术研究需披露AI使用行为，但无须声明具体AI模型，只要说明用途即可。
timeline.point: Notes that in research, AI use should be declared in publications, while the specific AI system used is unnecessary as long as purpose of usage is stated.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Opposes the provision as overbroad and value-laden, arguing it mainly serves public labeling rather than licensor benefit and adds friction inconsistent with streamlined open-source licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 反对该披露条款过宽且带价值判断，认为其更偏公共标签化目的而非许可人利益，且会增加不必要摩擦。
timeline.point: Opposes the provision as overbroad and value-laden, arguing it mainly serves public labeling rather than licensor benefit and adds friction inconsistent with streamlined open-source licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the notice requirement may increase friction but argues removing it risks open-source model reuse issues, proposing a narrower scope limited to output collections with original model and license disclosure.
timeline.point_zh: 承认披露要求可能带来摩擦，但认为缺少该规定会影响开源模型复用治理，并建议仅在输出集合分发时披露原模型和许可证信息以缩窄适用范围。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the notice requirement may increase friction but argues removing it risks open-source model reuse issues, proposing a narrower scope limited to output collections with original model and license disclosure.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Opposes requiring AI-origin labels across all output types as overinclusive and hard to operationalize, arguing the clause is public-spirited but low value, low enforceability, and high friction.
timeline.point_zh: 反对将AI来源声明扩展到全部输出类型且难以判定执行，认为该条更多服务公共目的但对许可人和许可人益处有限，且难强制、摩擦很高。
timeline.point: Opposes requiring AI-origin labels across all output types as overinclusive and hard to operationalize, arguing the clause is public-spirited but low value, low enforceability, and high friction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Concludes the notice condition looks like a use restriction rather than a license condition and therefore not open source.
timeline.point_zh: 认定该条款更像对单纯使用的限制而非对下游许可条件，进而否定其开源属性。
timeline.point: Concludes the notice condition looks like a use restriction rather than a license condition and therefore not open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Notes that another participant is analogizing the clause to an attribution-like condition.
timeline.point_zh: 表示该争议条款被另一位参与者类比为归属披露型义务。
timeline.point: Notes that another participant is analogizing the clause to an attribution-like condition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Affirms agreement that output should remain user-controlled and distinguishes policy, watermarking, and licensing, arguing this clause is a misplaced advertisement-like control akin to restricting output itself.
timeline.point_zh: 表示同意输出应由用户控制并区分政策水印与许可条款，指出该规定实质上是对输出本身的附加控制，类同错位的广告式义务。
timeline.point: Affirms agreement that output should remain user-controlled and distinguishes policy, watermarking, and licensing, arguing this clause is a misplaced advertisement-like control akin to restricting output itself.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: States no current opinion on whether the clause is OSD-compliant and withholds judgment for now.
timeline.point_zh: 暂未就该条款是否符合OSD作出意见，先暂缓定论。
timeline.point: States no current opinion on whether the clause is OSD-compliant and withholds judgment for now.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Echoes opposition to the notice approach by citing the Kyle Mitchell proposal precedent and likening it to a forbidden attribution requirement on all outputs of a tool.
timeline.point_zh: 重申反对该通知式条款，引用Kyle Mitchell先例并比拟要求编辑器输出全部文件附署声明，认为此类要求不应获批。
timeline.point: Echoes opposition to the notice approach by citing the Kyle Mitchell proposal precedent and likening it to a forbidden attribution requirement on all outputs of a tool.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Provides extensive drafting comments on the BY-OS license as a teaching exercise, arguing its commercial-style terms and ambiguities—over 'Licensed Materials', the IP grants, and reserved database rights—are fatal to approval as drafted.
timeline.point_zh: 以教学为目的对 BY-OS 许可证提出大量起草意见，认为其商业式条款及 'Licensed Materials'、IP 授权、保留数据库权利等方面的歧义按现稿是致命的、不应批准。
timeline.point: Provides extensive drafting comments on the BY-OS license as a teaching exercise, arguing its commercial-style terms and ambiguities—over 'Licensed Materials', the IP grants, and reserved database rights—are fatal to approval as drafted.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Argues that model-output clauses should preserve open-source usefulness rather than enforce legal compliance, frames models like editors that export reusable code fragments, and says attribution is meant only when output is repackaged as datasets.
timeline.point_zh: 强调模型输出条款不应被当作法律合规强制工具，而是要维持开源价值，类比模型更像会输出代码片段的编辑器，并将归属要求限定在将输出打包为数据集时。
timeline.point: Argues that model-output clauses should preserve open-source usefulness rather than enforce legal compliance, frames models like editors that export reusable code fragments, and says attribution is meant only when output is repackaged as datasets.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Highlights that the current language only asks for an AI-notice, not attribution or licensing conditions, says the notice obligation is not automatically inherited by derivative training, and questions enforceability where copyrightability of output is uncertain.
timeline.point_zh: 指出当前条文仅要求声明为AI生成，不是署名或许可条件，且该告知义务不会随派生训练自动传递，并质疑若输出版权属性不明确则强制执行基础薄弱。
timeline.point: Highlights that the current language only asks for an AI-notice, not attribution or licensing conditions, says the notice obligation is not automatically inherited by derivative training, and questions enforceability where copyrightability of output is uncertain.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Notes that some jurisdictions like the UK treat AI outputs as potentially copyrightable, so obligations on outputs may be feasible there, while warning that U.S. legal treatment remains debated.
timeline.point_zh: 提醒部分法域（如英国）将AI输出视为可受版权约束对象，因此输出义务可能成立，但指出美国法上是否构成版权客体仍在争议中。
timeline.point: Notes that some jurisdictions like the UK treat AI outputs as potentially copyrightable, so obligations on outputs may be feasible there, while warning that U.S. legal treatment remains debated.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the review comments, requests additional time, and indicates legal interpretation is still pending while committing to clarify the open questions with outside legal support.
timeline.point_zh: 承认已收到意见并请求更多时间，表示相关问题仍需进一步法务解读，计划借助外部法律支持后再逐项澄清。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the review comments, requests additional time, and indicates legal interpretation is still pending while committing to clarify the open questions with outside legal support.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Responds to Pamela's critique of the output-notice clause: concedes it somewhat oversteps but explains it signals downstream users to check upstream conditions and preserves MG-BY-OS copyleft inheritance when outputs become training datasets.
timeline.point_zh: 回应 Pamela 对输出通知条款的批评：承认条款略有越界，但解释其可提示下游用户检查上游许可条件，并在输出被用作训练数据集时保障 MG-BY-OS 的 copyleft 继承。
timeline.point: Responds to Pamela's critique of the output-notice clause: concedes it somewhat oversteps but explains it signals downstream users to check upstream conditions and preserves MG-BY-OS copyleft inheritance when outputs become training datasets.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Identifies a drafting flaw: because the license is sublicensable, sublicensees are not 'You' and can lawfully create unlabeled Output, so the copyleft and notice obligations may fail—model obligations are enforceable only through contract.
timeline.point_zh: 指出起草缺陷：许可证允许再许可（sublicensable），再许可对象不属于 'You'，可合法生成未标注的 Output，copyleft 与通知义务可能失效，因模型相关义务仅能靠合同约束。
timeline.point: Identifies a drafting flaw: because the license is sublicensable, sublicensees are not 'You' and can lawfully create unlabeled Output, so the copyleft and notice obligations may fail—model obligations are enforceable only through contract.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Appreciates the legal explanation, agrees that the flaw was missed initially, identifies GPL auto-licensing versus sublicensing distinction, and commits to continued legal verification for unresolved licensing defects.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢解释并承认此前遗漏该缺陷，区分GPL自动授权与转授机制，表示将继续与法务核对并修正尚待确认的条款问题。
timeline.point: Appreciates the legal explanation, agrees that the flaw was missed initially, identifies GPL auto-licensing versus sublicensing distinction, and commits to continued legal verification for unresolved licensing defects.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Notice requirement for model output: OSD-compliant or not? (ModelGo)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the legal view is presented from a U.S. perspective, acknowledges cross-jurisdiction variation, and states interpretation is expected to follow likely U.S. outcomes.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清其意见主要基于美国法理，承认不同法域可能存在差异，并表示当前理解应以美国法律体系下的解释为主要判断。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the legal view is presented from a U.S. perspective, acknowledges cross-jurisdiction variation, and states interpretation is expected to follow likely U.S. outcomes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Author acknowledges some ModelGo License clauses are poorly drafted or not OSD-compliant, explains the intended 'and/or' scope for Complementary Materials, and is seeking legal experts to amend the license for resubmission.
timeline.point_zh: 作者承认 ModelGo License 部分条款起草不佳或不符合 OSD，解释 'and/or' 对 Complementary Materials 的本意，正寻找法律专家协助修改以便重新提交。
timeline.point: Author acknowledges some ModelGo License clauses are poorly drafted or not OSD-compliant, explains the intended 'and/or' scope for Complementary Materials, and is seeking legal experts to amend the license for resubmission.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits the revised ModelGo Zero License 2.0 (MG0-2.0), the most permissive variant of the ModelGo family, for OSI review, with updates including output-dataset distribution conditions, removal of the Third-Party Material and Governing Law sections, and clarified definitions.
timeline.point_zh: 提交修订后的 ModelGo Zero License 2.0(MG0-2.0)——ModelGo 家族中最宽松的变体——供 OSI 审阅,更新含输出数据集分发条件、删除第三方材料与管辖法章节及澄清定义。
timeline.point: Submits the revised ModelGo Zero License 2.0 (MG0-2.0), the most permissive variant of the ModelGo family, for OSI review, with updates including output-dataset distribution conditions, removal of the Third-Party Material and Governing Law sections, and clarified definitions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits the revised ModelGo Attribution License 2.0 (MG-BY-2.0), the permissive variant requiring license notice and attribution, for OSI review, with updates including output-dataset distribution conditions, removal of several sections, and clarified definitions.
timeline.point_zh: 提交修订后的 ModelGo Attribution License 2.0(MG-BY-2.0)——要求保留许可与署名的宽松变体——供 OSI 审阅,更新含输出数据集分发条件、删除部分章节及澄清定义。
timeline.point: Submits the revised ModelGo Attribution License 2.0 (MG-BY-2.0), the permissive variant requiring license notice and attribution, for OSI review, with updates including output-dataset distribution conditions, removal of several sections, and clarified definitions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits the revised ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License 2.0 (MG-BY-OS-2.0), the copyleft variant requiring same-license derivatives with source code, for OSI review, with updates including output-dataset distribution conditions, removed sections, and clarified definitions.
timeline.point_zh: 提交修订后的 ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License 2.0(MG-BY-OS-2.0)——要求衍生作品同许可并提供源码的 copyleft 变体——供 OSI 审阅,更新含输出数据集分发条件及澄清定义。
timeline.point: Submits the revised ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License 2.0 (MG-BY-OS-2.0), the copyleft variant requiring same-license derivatives with source code, for OSI review, with updates including output-dataset distribution conditions, removed sections, and clarified definitions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Reasserts that the updated output conditions appear to still impose OSD-incompatible limits on model outputs, and states the reviewer remains confused about how this addresses the earlier restriction concern.
timeline.point_zh: 再次强调新版本仍像是在模型输出上加限制且偏离OSD方向，表达仍不清楚修订为何能消解先前指出的问题。
timeline.point: Reasserts that the updated output conditions appear to still impose OSD-incompatible limits on model outputs, and states the reviewer remains confused about how this addresses the earlier restriction concern.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Defends the output-dataset notice clause 2.2(b) in MG-BY-2.0 and MG-BY-OS-2.0, arguing that knowledge transferred from a model is akin to its source code, and that the clause requires attribution notice for datasets rather than restricting output use, while conceding further discussion is needed.
timeline.point_zh: 为 MG-BY-2.0 与 MG-BY-OS-2.0 的 2.2(b) 输出数据集通知条款辩护,称模型间转移的知识类似源代码,该条款仅要求数据集署名通知而非限制输出使用,并同意仍需进一步讨论。
timeline.point: Defends the output-dataset notice clause 2.2(b) in MG-BY-2.0 and MG-BY-OS-2.0, arguing that knowledge transferred from a model is akin to its source code, and that the clause requires attribution notice for datasets rather than restricting output use, while conceding further discussion is needed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Questions the 'Zero' nomenclature since Section 2.2(a)(i) still imposes a distribution obligation, criticizes the incomplete articulation of copyright and patent grants, and flags the broad patent-termination clause covering Derivative Works; suggests renaming the license or removing the obligation.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 "Zero" 命名与 Section 2.2(a)(i) 的分发义务不符;批评版权与专利授权表述不全,专利终止条款过宽;建议改名或删除该义务。
timeline.point: Questions the 'Zero' nomenclature since Section 2.2(a)(i) still imposes a distribution obligation, criticizes the incomplete articulation of copyright and patent grants, and flags the broad patent-termination clause covering Derivative Works; suggests renaming the license or removing the obligation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Reiterates his MG0 comments for this license: the grant leaves out several copyright and patent permissions, and the patent-termination provision covering Derivative Works is overbroad — not an OSD violation, but it may deter uptake among patent holders.
timeline.point_zh: 重申其对 MG0 的意见同样适用于本许可证:授权遗漏多项版权与专利权利,及于 Derivative Works 的专利终止条款过宽,虽不违反 OSD,但恐影响专利权人采用。
timeline.point: Reiterates his MG0 comments for this license: the grant leaves out several copyright and patent permissions, and the patent-termination provision covering Derivative Works is overbroad — not an OSD violation, but it may deter uptake among patent holders.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Reiterates his MG0 and MG-BY drafting comments here, argues 'BY-OS' is confusing since all ModelGo versions are open source and 'MG-BY-SA' would fit better, and suggests the output-attribution obligation may violate OSD 9 and bears on OSAID's Data Information requirement.
timeline.point_zh: 重申 MG0 与 MG-BY 的意见;认为 "BY-OS" 命名易混淆、MG-BY-SA 更贴切;并指出输出署名义务或违反 OSD 9,值得结合 OSAID 数据信息要求思考。
timeline.point: Reiterates his MG0 and MG-BY drafting comments here, argues 'BY-OS' is confusing since all ModelGo versions are open source and 'MG-BY-SA' would fit better, and suggests the output-attribution obligation may violate OSD 9 and bears on OSAID's Data Information requirement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Critiques the update as a distillation-focused restriction on output, accepts good intent, but argues output-level limits are inconsistent with open-source principles and impractical once outputs are reused through multiple generations.
timeline.point_zh: 认为新版本倾向于压缩蒸馏或合成数据场景，对目标本意表示认可，但称输出层限制不符开源原则且多代重用后无法追踪，难以执行。
timeline.point: Critiques the update as a distillation-focused restriction on output, accepts good intent, but argues output-level limits are inconsistent with open-source principles and impractical once outputs are reused through multiple generations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Defends the ModelGo licenses: Section 2.2(b) requires attribution only when generated datasets are Distributed, a lightweight obligation easy to satisfy (e.g. dataset README credit) that does not force generated datasets onto the same license.
timeline.point_zh: 为 ModelGo 许可证辩护:Section 2.2(b) 的署名义务仅适用于已分发的生成数据集,负担轻、易满足(如在 README 中注明),且不要求生成数据集采用同一许可证。
timeline.point: Defends the ModelGo licenses: Section 2.2(b) requires attribution only when generated datasets are Distributed, a lightweight obligation easy to satisfy (e.g. dataset README credit) that does not force generated datasets onto the same license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Supports the current ModelGo Zero submission direction, aligning with the discussed review direction and indicating acceptance of existing feedback without adding new technical conditions.
timeline.point_zh: 支持当前 ModelGo Zero 重申提案方向，认可本轮讨论结论并表示与现有反馈保持一致，未再提出新的技术性条件。
timeline.point: Supports the current ModelGo Zero submission direction, aligning with the discussed review direction and indicating acceptance of existing feedback without adding new technical conditions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Responds to OSI feedback: open to making MG0 less burdensome, argues 'Distribution' already covers key permissions and the patent-termination clause guards against 'patent traps', and says patent-holder uptake is not decisive for general-purpose licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 回应反馈:不反对减轻 MG0 负担,认为 "Distribution" 定义已覆盖相关权限,专利终止条款是防范 "patent trap" 的保障,且通用许可证无需过分在意专利权人是否采用。
timeline.point: Responds to OSI feedback: open to making MG0 less burdensome, argues 'Distribution' already covers key permissions and the patent-termination clause guards against 'patent traps', and says patent-holder uptake is not decisive for general-purpose licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Disagrees with mandatory enumeration of grants, arguing cross-jurisdiction rights are easier to preserve when interpreted broadly, accepts some interpretive uncertainty, and asks whether any known license already includes derivative works in patent termination.
timeline.point_zh: 不同意必须把各项授权逐项枚举，认为跨法域下统一理解更能避免误差；虽承认存在解释不确定性，但仍追问是否已有许可文本已将衍生作品纳入专利终止。
timeline.point: Disagrees with mandatory enumeration of grants, arguing cross-jurisdiction rights are easier to preserve when interpreted broadly, accepts some interpretive uncertainty, and asks whether any known license already includes derivative works in patent termination.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution-OpenSource License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Offers editorial fixes across the licenses (e.g. 'marking' vs 'making', duplicate non-infringement disclaimer, ambiguous 'third party'), warns Section 6 creates an unintended copyleft effect on Derivative Materials, and is skeptical copyleft is workable for models.
timeline.point_zh: 提出多处编辑性修改建议,警告 Section 6 会对 Derivative Materials 产生意外的 copyleft 效果,并怀疑 copyleft 用于模型是否可行、容易失控。
timeline.point: Offers editorial fixes across the licenses (e.g. 'marking' vs 'making', duplicate non-infringement disclaimer, ambiguous 'third party'), warns Section 6 creates an unintended copyleft effect on Derivative Materials, and is skeptical copyleft is workable for models.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Argues the output provision imposes obligations beyond copyright's reach to derivatives — including unenforceable ones like "do no harm" — and that this single provision would make the license non-Open Source; the other provisions look unproblematic.
timeline.point_zh: 认为输出条款把义务施加到超出版权对衍生品控制范围，属过度扩张，仅此一项就使许可证不符合开源要求；其余条款则没有明显问题。
timeline.point: Argues the output provision imposes obligations beyond copyright's reach to derivatives — including unenforceable ones like "do no harm" — and that this single provision would make the license non-Open Source; the other provisions look unproblematic.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Objects that the obligation running with the output has never been acceptable in an open source license; questions its justification, is concerned about burdens on individual generated works, and warns the ambiguity invites opportunistic breach claims.
timeline.point_zh: 反对随输出延续的义务，认为这从未被开源许可证接受；质问其正当性，担忧对单个生成作品的负担，并警告模糊性会招致投机性违约诉讼。
timeline.point: Objects that the obligation running with the output has never been acceptable in an open source license; questions its justification, is concerned about burdens on individual generated works, and warns the ambiguity invites opportunistic breach claims.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that distilled data differs from pre-training data because it improves generalization; explains the output provision aims to remind first-generation users to respect attribution; and says no specific OSD clause violated by it has been identified.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清蒸馏数据不同于预训练数据，因其能提升泛化能力；说明输出条款旨在提醒第一代使用者尊重归属；并表示尚未发现其直接违反哪条 OSD 条款。
timeline.point: Clarifies that distilled data differs from pre-training data because it improves generalization; explains the output provision aims to remind first-generation users to respect attribution; and says no specific OSD clause violated by it has been identified.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that under non-sublicensable grants every downstream user is effectively a first-generation licensee, and notes that a user of a model trained on output may under US contract law be deemed to have accepted the original license, though low probability.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清非可再授权许可下所有下游接收者原则上属于第一代许可使用者，并说明以输出训练而来的模型用户在美国法下可能被视为已接受原许可，但其发生概率较低。
timeline.point: Clarifies that under non-sublicensable grants every downstream user is effectively a first-generation licensee, and notes that a user of a model trained on output may under US contract law be deemed to have accepted the original license, though low probability.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: States that no specific OSD section is likely breached, but emphasizes OSI can reject a license for broader software-freedom reasons; cites review-process precedent where a license may fail for issues not explicitly named in OSD text.
timeline.point_zh: 指出该条款未必直接违背具体 OSD 条文，但强调 OSI 可基于更广泛的软件自由性判断拒绝某许可证，并援引审核流程的先例说明并非必须逐条对应到 OSD 条款。
timeline.point: States that no specific OSD section is likely breached, but emphasizes OSI can reject a license for broader software-freedom reasons; cites review-process precedent where a license may fail for issues not explicitly named in OSD text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Licenses, review
timeline.snippet: Reports the committee is 58 days into a 60-day review window, finds discussion indicates further revisions are still needed before voting, and invites another revision cycle instead of moving to final approval.
timeline.point_zh: 说明委员会距 60 天时限还剩 2 天，讨论表明仍需进一步修订后才能进入表决，提议进入下一轮讨论而非立即提交审批。
timeline.point: Reports the committee is 58 days into a 60-day review window, finds discussion indicates further revisions are still needed before voting, and invites another revision cycle instead of moving to final approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Shares his legal teammate's analysis defending the license: imposing conditions on output use does not violate the 10 OSD criteria, copyleft for models is difficult but should be included, and the hard-to-trace attribution obligation only catches egregious violators.
timeline.point_zh: 转述法律队友的分析为许可证辩护：对输出使用施加条件不违反十项 OSD 准则，模型的 copyleft 虽难实现仍应保留，难以追溯的归属义务只会约束最严重的违规者。
timeline.point: Shares his legal teammate's analysis defending the license: imposing conditions on output use does not violate the 10 OSD criteria, copyleft for models is difficult but should be included, and the hard-to-trace attribution obligation only catches egregious violators.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Converts a message to text-only formatting for accessibility and requests avoiding color tags in responses, criticizing color-based answer markers as poor UX and hard to read on bright backgrounds.
timeline.point_zh: 将消息改为纯文本以便可读，要求回复不要使用彩色标记，并批评颜色标注答案在明亮界面下可读性差、属于糟糕的交互习惯。
timeline.point: Converts a message to text-only formatting for accessibility and requests avoiding color tags in responses, criticizing color-based answer markers as poor UX and hard to read on bright backgrounds.

timeline.subject: [License-review] ModelGo Licenses, review
timeline.snippet: States willingness to submit revised ModelGo licenses after reflecting on discussion, commits to careful amendments, and expresses appreciation for all contributors who helped improve the draft.
timeline.point_zh: 表示经过充分讨论后将认真修订并再次提交许可证，承诺进行细致修改，并感谢所有参与者对改进文本的贡献。
timeline.point: States willingness to submit revised ModelGo licenses after reflecting on discussion, commits to careful amendments, and expresses appreciation for all contributors who helped improve the draft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the earlier display issue, agrees that attribution-on-dataset requirements are misaligned with open-source freedoms, and confirms preparation of another resubmission after further internal stakeholder discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 承认显示问题后认同“对模型生成数据集强制署名”与开源自由背离，并确认将继续与团队讨论后推进下一版提交。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the earlier display issue, agrees that attribution-on-dataset requirements are misaligned with open-source freedoms, and confirms preparation of another resubmission after further internal stakeholder discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Argues a provision expected to be ignored harms compliance and policy, that unknowable copyleft scope sets up a troll and may violate OSD 6, and that no adequate justification has been given for the output condition; agrees with Carlo.
timeline.point_zh: 认为预期被违反的条款损害合规与政策，范围不可知的 copyleft 会纵容投机者并可能违反 OSD 6，且输出条件缺乏充分正当理由；同意 Carlo 的观点。
timeline.point: Argues a provision expected to be ignored harms compliance and policy, that unknowable copyleft scope sets up a troll and may violate OSD 6, and that no adequate justification has been given for the output condition; agrees with Carlo.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Please review revised ModelGo licenses
timeline.snippet: Concedes the output condition may be ambiguous and low in practical value when knowledge boundaries are unclear, says unclear clauses reduce clarity, and says further work may remove the rule if a clean distinction between outputs cannot be made.
timeline.point_zh: 承认输出条款在“知识边界”不清下可能不明确且收益有限，认为含糊条款不利于清晰合规，并表示若无法清晰区分输出类型，将考虑移除该条款。
timeline.point: Concedes the output condition may be ambiguous and low in practical value when knowledge boundaries are unclear, says unclear clauses reduce clarity, and says further work may remove the rule if a clean distinction between outputs cannot be made.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Explains the difference between non-sublicensable licenses, where downstream users hold the original license, and sublicensing, where the sublicensor chooses which rights to grant; notes contract privity concerns and why the GPL licenses are not sublicensable.
timeline.point_zh: 解释不可转授许可与转授许可的区别：前者下游用户持有原许可证，后者转授者可选择授予哪些权利；并指出合同相对性问题及 GPL 不可转授的原因。
timeline.point: Explains the difference between non-sublicensable licenses, where downstream users hold the original license, and sublicensing, where the sublicensor chooses which rights to grant; notes contract privity concerns and why the GPL licenses are not sublicensable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Thanks the legal/privity explanation and says it substantially clarifies the earlier concerns about how sublicense structures and licensing obligations should be interpreted.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢该解释，表示对再授权结构及许可义务解释的先前疑问已被明显澄清。
timeline.point: Thanks the legal/privity explanation and says it substantially clarifies the earlier concerns about how sublicense structures and licensing obligations should be interpreted.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits the revised ModelGo Attribution License (MG-BY-2.0) for OSI review, highlighting removal of model-output restrictions, automatic termination, and a narrowed Derivative Materials definition.
timeline.point_zh: 提交修订后的 ModelGo Attribution License（MG-BY-2.0）供 OSI 审查，主要更新包括移除模型输出限制、自动终止条款及收窄 Derivative Materials 定义。
timeline.point: Submits the revised ModelGo Attribution License (MG-BY-2.0) for OSI review, highlighting removal of model-output restrictions, automatic termination, and a narrowed Derivative Materials definition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits the revised ModelGo Zero License (MG0-2.0) for OSI review, removing model-output restrictions and the license-copy requirement to make it free of obligations or conditions.
timeline.point_zh: 提交修订后的 ModelGo Zero License（MG0-2.0）供 OSI 审查，移除模型输出限制与提供许可证副本的要求，使其真正无义务无条件。
timeline.point: Submits the revised ModelGo Zero License (MG0-2.0) for OSI review, removing model-output restrictions and the license-copy requirement to make it free of obligations or conditions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution-ShareAlike License, Version 2.0

timeline.point_zh: 提交更名后的 ModelGo Attribution-ShareAlike License（MG-BY-SA-2.0）供 OSI 审查，澄清源代码提供要求并收窄 Derivative Materials 定义。
timeline.point: Submits the renamed ModelGo Attribution-ShareAlike License (MG-BY-SA-2.0, formerly MG-BY-OS-2.0) for OSI review, clarifying the source-code provision requirement and narrowing the Derivative Materials definition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Suggests replacing the dataset sentence so it clearly states that pretraining and evaluation datasets are excluded from Licensed Materials, may be separately licensed, and are not governed by this license.
timeline.point_zh: 建议修订表述以更明确说明训练与评估用数据集不属于授权材料，并可由其他许可单独规定，强调本许可不主张数据集的许可关系。
timeline.point: Suggests replacing the dataset sentence so it clearly states that pretraining and evaluation datasets are excluded from Licensed Materials, may be separately licensed, and are not governed by this license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0

timeline.point_zh: 确认已收到反馈，并表示将先与法务核对，当前未发布进一步文本修改，仅安排后续跟进。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the wording feedback and says legal review will be consulted, indicating follow-up is needed before finalizing edits and no further changes are announced yet.

timeline.point_zh: 表示将按 Josh 的建议对授权材料定义做一次快速修订并提交版本。

timeline.point: Thanks for review, clarifies which resubmission text is being referenced, cites GPL-3.0 for source definitions, and expresses uncertainty that MG-BY-SA satisfies approval criteria or copyleft behavior in ML.

timeline.point_zh: 重申反对 Attribution 与 Attribution-ShareAlike 两版，认为与输出相关的范围扩展超出著作权衍生作品定义且可能违反 OSD9，因此不应批准。
timeline.point: Renews objections to Attribution and Attribution-ShareAlike, arguing output-related derivative language exceeds copyright derivative scope and likely violates OSD9, and concludes both versions should not be approved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that Derivative Materials are not intended to include direct model output, but warns output-derived-model scope may over-restrict innovation, and requests discussion on possibly removing it.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清导出材料定义不直接包含模型输出，但担心“基于输出迁移产生的衍生模型”会过度限制创新，提议讨论是否移除该项。
timeline.point: Clarifies that Derivative Materials are not intended to include direct model output, but warns output-derived-model scope may over-restrict innovation, and requests discussion on possibly removing it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Adopts all-caps styling for disclaimers to match recent model licenses, checks with legal, and reiterates MG0/MG-BY as non-copyleft, with the original license retained so downstream users better understand rights.
timeline.point_zh: 采用全大写免责声明与最新模型许可保持一致，并与法务确认；说明 MG0 与 MG-BY 为非传染性许可，同时保留原始许可证便于下游用户理解使用权限。
timeline.point: Adopts all-caps styling for disclaimers to match recent model licenses, checks with legal, and reiterates MG0/MG-BY as non-copyleft, with the original license retained so downstream users better understand rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: States that, based on current drafting, derivative materials already do not include AI agents produced from model output; notes limited legal uncertainty and offers to remove output-related definition if ambiguity appears.
timeline.point_zh: 表示依据当前定义，AI 代理由模型与输出生成的情形不在 derivative materials 范围；虽然认为理解清晰，但保留法律解释不确定性，并承诺如有更大歧义将删除相关 output 规定。
timeline.point: States that, based on current drafting, derivative materials already do not include AI agents produced from model output; notes limited legal uncertainty and offers to remove output-related definition if ambiguity appears.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Argues output-control language overreaches because model output is generally not copyright-protected and the definition already reaches agents; recommends tying scope to copyright exclusive rights and says approval requires removing non-derivative output control.
timeline.point_zh: 指出试图控制 output 的做法范围过宽：模型输出通常难以构成版权衍生物，且该定义会延伸到代理（agent）；主张以作者专有权范围界定许可范围，并强调仅去除对非衍生 output 的控制才可能接受。
timeline.point: Argues output-control language overreaches because model output is generally not copyright-protected and the definition already reaches agents; recommends tying scope to copyright exclusive rights and says approval requires removing non-derivative output control.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Questions whether agents should be excluded from derivative-material transfers by probing whether they are models, transfer parameters/weights, create distillations or approximations, and warns AI vocabulary may shift so that agents later resemble models.
timeline.point_zh: 质询代理（agent）为何不属于“由权重模式转移而形成衍生模型”定义，逐项追问其模型属性与参数迁移特征，并提醒 AI 词汇在持续变化，未来“agent”可能具模型特征。
timeline.point: Questions whether agents should be excluded from derivative-material transfers by probing whether they are models, transfer parameters/weights, create distillations or approximations, and warns AI vocabulary may shift so that agents later resemble models.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Agrees to remove the distillation-based Derivative Materials definition from MG0 and MG-BY, will apply McCoy's suggested updates, and withdraws MG-BY-SA, citing the lack of a critical gap and doubts that ShareAlike-style copyleft can function for models.
timeline.point_zh: 同意移除 MG0 和 MG-BY 中蒸馏相关的 Derivative Materials 定义并按 McCoy 意见更新，同时撤回 MG-BY-SA，理由是缺乏关键空白且 ShareAlike 式 copyleft 对模型难以奏效。
timeline.point: Agrees to remove the distillation-based Derivative Materials definition from MG0 and MG-BY, will apply McCoy's suggested updates, and withdraws MG-BY-SA, citing the lack of a critical gap and doubts that ShareAlike-style copyleft can function for models.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Reports rapid MG0 and MG-BY updates that remove distillation-based derivative coverage, shares revision diff links, and asks for comments while confirming MG-BY-SA withdrawal due lack of clear gap and prior preferred-form concerns.
timeline.point_zh: 汇报已快速更新 MG0 与 MG-BY，去除基于蒸馏的衍生材料定义，并提供版本对照链接；同时因缺少明确定位且担忧 preferred form，确认本次暂不推进 MG-BY-SA。
timeline.point: Reports rapid MG0 and MG-BY updates that remove distillation-based derivative coverage, shares revision diff links, and asks for comments while confirming MG-BY-SA withdrawal due lack of clear gap and prior preferred-form concerns.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Requests that the latest revised submissions be moved to a new thread to avoid further delay, indicating a moderation preference rather than substantive legal feedback.
timeline.point_zh: 要求将本次修订版单独另开新讨论线程以避免进一步拖延，主要是程序性安排，并未对许可证实质条款表达支持或反对。
timeline.point: Requests that the latest revised submissions be moved to a new thread to avoid further delay, indicating a moderation preference rather than substantive legal feedback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [3rd Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License (MG0-2.0) AND ModelGo Attribution License (MG-BY-2.0)
timeline.snippet: Starts the new thread for MG0-2.0 and MG-BY-2.0 resubmission, highlights the main change excluding distillation from derivative materials, and invites review comments with updated texts and diffs.
timeline.point_zh: 开设新的 3rd resubmission 线程提交 MG0-2.0 与 MG-BY-2.0，强调核心修改为移除蒸馏模型纳入衍生材料，并随附新旧对照供审阅。
timeline.point: Starts the new thread for MG0-2.0 and MG-BY-2.0 resubmission, highlights the main change excluding distillation from derivative materials, and invites review comments with updated texts and diffs.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Agrees with Pam that expanding the Derivative Materials definition to reach attempts at achieving equivalent functionality is inappropriate and should be rejected; concludes the two more restrictive licenses do not pass the test.
timeline.point_zh: 附和 Pam：将许可条件延伸至追求等效功能的尝试并不恰当、应予拒绝；认为两份更严格的许可证未通过测试。
timeline.point: Agrees with Pam that expanding the Derivative Materials definition to reach attempts at achieving equivalent functionality is inappropriate and should be rejected; concludes the two more restrictive licenses do not pass the test.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [2nd Resubmission] ModelGo Attribution License, Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Concedes Pam’s concerns and removes output-related derivative language in MG0 and MG-BY, applies additional McCoy suggestions, and withdraws MG-BY-SA while agreeing the distillation gap still needs broader discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 回应 Pamela 的意见后移除 MG0 与 MG-BY 中 output 相关衍生材料表述，并采纳 McCoy 的补充修改；同时暂时撤回 MG-BY-SA，并承认蒸馏议题需与 Josh 等进一步讨论。
timeline.point: Concedes Pam’s concerns and removes output-related derivative language in MG0 and MG-BY, applies additional McCoy suggestions, and withdraws MG-BY-SA while agreeing the distillation gap still needs broader discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [3rd Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License (MG0-2.0) AND ModelGo Attribution License (MG-BY-2.0)
timeline.snippet: Warns that mentioning Output can imply uncertainty over Output rights, says output-related liability protection is limited, and recommends omitting Output because the trade-off is not worthwhile, though not framing this as sole rejection reason.
timeline.point_zh: 警告在许可中提及 output 可能引发输出权授予的歧义，指出该条款主要只规避版权层面风险且对其他损害并无充分免责，建议直接移除 output 虽不以此否决许可。
timeline.point: Warns that mentioning Output can imply uncertainty over Output rights, says output-related liability protection is limited, and recommends omitting Output because the trade-off is not worthwhile, though not framing this as sole rejection reason.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [3rd Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License (MG0-2.0) AND ModelGo Attribution License (MG-BY-2.0)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether a discussion or voting schedule exists after a month of no new comments, and offers additional information while stating readiness to move to the next steps.
timeline.point_zh: 在超过一个月无进一步意见后，询问是否已有讨论或表决安排，并表示愿意补充信息，随时准备进入下一步。
timeline.point: Asks whether a discussion or voting schedule exists after a month of no new comments, and offers additional information while stating readiness to move to the next steps.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [3rd Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License (MG0-2.0) AND ModelGo Attribution License (MG-BY-2.0)
timeline.snippet: Asks for the latest review status and main outstanding concerns on the ModelGo licenses; argues for keeping Output in the warranty disclaimer and limitation of liability given AI-agent risks, citing similar language in Llama and Gemma.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 ModelGo 两份许可证的最新审查状态与主要顾虑；主张在免责与责任限制条款中保留 Output，并以 Llama、Gemma 的类似做法为据。
timeline.point: Asks for the latest review status and main outstanding concerns on the ModelGo licenses; argues for keeping Output in the warranty disclaimer and limitation of liability given AI-agent risks, citing similar language in Llama and Gemma.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [3rd Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License (MG0-2.0) AND ModelGo Attribution License (MG-BY-2.0)
timeline.snippet: Follows up on the review status of the ModelGo Zero (MG0-2.0) and ModelGo Attribution (MG-BY-2.0) licenses, asking OSI for an answer — approval or rejection — rather than continued silence, and offering clarifications or revisions if concerns remain.
timeline.point_zh: 跟进 ModelGo Zero (MG0-2.0) 与 ModelGo Attribution (MG-BY-2.0) 的审查状态，请求 OSI 给出批准或拒绝的答复而非持续沉默，并表示愿意提供澄清或修改。
timeline.point: Follows up on the review status of the ModelGo Zero (MG0-2.0) and ModelGo Attribution (MG-BY-2.0) licenses, asking OSI for an answer — approval or rejection — rather than continued silence, and offering clarifications or revisions if concerns remain.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [3rd Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License (MG0-2.0) AND ModelGo Attribution License (MG-BY-2.0)
timeline.snippet: Explains the ModelGo licenses (MG0-2.0, MG-BY-2.0) are on the agenda for the September 24 Board meeting due to the two-month review cycle and no August meeting; asks the submitter to confirm the final texts on GitHub and invites final comments by September 17, 2026.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 ModelGo 许可证（MG0-2.0、MG-BY-2.0）因两个月审查周期且八月无会议，已列入 9 月 24 日董事会审查议程；请提交者确认 GitHub 上的最终文本，并邀请 2026 年 9 月 17 日前提交最终意见。
timeline.point: Explains the ModelGo licenses (MG0-2.0, MG-BY-2.0) are on the agenda for the September 24 Board meeting due to the two-month review cycle and no August meeting; asks the submitter to confirm the final texts on GitHub and invites final comments by September 17, 2026.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [3rd Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License (MG0-2.0) AND ModelGo Attribution License (MG-BY-2.0)
timeline.snippet: Confirms GitHub repos contain the final texts for MG0-2.0 and MG-BY-2.0, notes university web pages are outdated, and verifies the "Attribution-Open Source" variant is withdrawn.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 GitHub 仓库中的 MG0-2.0 和 MG-BY-2.0 文本为最终版本，指出大学网页已过时，并核实「Attribution-Open Source」变体已撤回。
timeline.point: Confirms GitHub repos contain the final texts for MG0-2.0 and MG-BY-2.0, notes university web pages are outdated, and verifies the "Attribution-Open Source" variant is withdrawn.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [3rd Resubmission] ModelGo Zero License (MG0-2.0) AND ModelGo Attribution License (MG-BY-2.0)
timeline.snippet: Asks how MG-BY-2.0's Section 2.2(a) notice and license-copy conditions are intended to operate when Distribution consists solely of hosted or API-based remote access with no underlying model artifact delivered, and requests steward clarification for downstream users.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 MG-BY-2.0 第 2.2(a) 条在仅以托管或 API 远程访问构成 Distribution、不交付模型制品时应如何适用，请管理者予以澄清。
timeline.point: Asks how MG-BY-2.0's Section 2.2(a) notice and license-copy conditions are intended to operate when Distribution consists solely of hosted or API-based remote access with no underlying model artifact delivered, and requests steward clarification for downstream users.

timeline.snippet: Questions whether a copyright holder can enforce restrictions after applying a license that disclaims the copyright interest needed for standing.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑版权持有人在使用放弃版权利益的许可证后，是否仍有执行限制所需的法律地位。
timeline.point: Questions whether a copyright holder can enforce restrictions after applying a license that disclaims the copyright interest needed for standing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Argues the license mixes public-domain dedication with copyleft, lacks legal review, and may fail because it only grants copyright rights.
timeline.point_zh: 主张该许可把公有领域放弃和 copyleft 混在一起，且未经律师审查，可能只授予版权层面的权利。
timeline.point: Argues the license mixes public-domain dedication with copyleft, lacks legal review, and may fail because it only grants copyright rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: PBZC borrows its dedication text almost verbatim from the Unlicense, repeating that license's contradictory PD-dedication-plus-license combination; the conditional dedication and 'General Public Benefit' provision risk an OSD#6 violation — unconvinced it's OSD-compliant.
timeline.point_zh: PBZC 贡献文本几乎逐字照搬 Unlicense 的矛盾公有领域贡献+许可组合；条件式贡献与'General Public Benefit'恐违反 OSD#6，不认为符合 OSD。
timeline.point: PBZC borrows its dedication text almost verbatim from the Unlicense, repeating that license's contradictory PD-dedication-plus-license combination; the conditional dedication and 'General Public Benefit' provision risk an OSD#6 violation — unconvinced it's OSD-compliant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Argues the combined dedication/license structure is not inherently fatal (as CC0 shows) but the jurisdiction-dependent copyleft likely violates OSD 5, the draft has numerous drafting problems, and its current form is incompatible with the OSD, so it should be rejected absent major redrafting.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 dedication 与许可并存并非必然致命，但按辖区区分 copyleft 恐违反 OSD 5，草案存在诸多起草问题，当前版本与 OSD 不相容，应予拒绝。
timeline.point: Argues the combined dedication/license structure is not inherently fatal (as CC0 shows) but the jurisdiction-dependent copyleft likely violates OSD 5, the draft has numerous drafting problems, and its current form is incompatible with the OSD, so it should be rejected absent major redrafting.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Says they had not seen Lukas’s email and that it captures many of the same issues they raised.
timeline.point_zh: 表示自己当时没看到 Lukas 的邮件，并认为其中涵盖了自己提出的许多相同问题。
timeline.point: Says they had not seen Lukas’s email and that it captures many of the same issues they raised.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that legal review is recommended but not required, so it is not a blocker.
timeline.point_zh: 说明律师审查只是建议而非强制要求，因此不是阻碍。
timeline.point: Clarifies that legal review is recommended but not required, so it is not a blocker.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Says a public-domain dedication plus a backstop license can make sense, but the draft is still counterintuitive because it combines a copyleft license with a public-domain dedication.
timeline.point_zh: 表示公有领域放弃加后备许可本身可以理解，但该草案把 copyleft 许可与公有领域放弃放在一起，仍显得反直觉且有问题。
timeline.point: Says a public-domain dedication plus a backstop license can make sense, but the draft is still counterintuitive because it combines a copyleft license with a public-domain dedication.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Defends the PBZC: its reliance on developer integrity and community pressure mirrors GPL enforcement, and the sharing-back requirement fixes public-domain dedication flaws; 'general public benefit' may work better as a preamble than a condition.
timeline.point_zh: 为 PBZC 辩护：对开发者诚信和社区压力的依赖类似 GPL 执行方式；"general public benefit" 宜作序言而非条件；回馈要求弥补了公有领域奉献的缺陷。
timeline.point: Defends the PBZC: its reliance on developer integrity and community pressure mirrors GPL enforcement, and the sharing-back requirement fixes public-domain dedication flaws; 'general public benefit' may work better as a preamble than a condition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Counters that a public-domain dedication is an explicit relinquishment of rights, so the author cannot later enforce restrictions and it is not a license.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳称公有领域放弃是明确放弃权利，因此作者之后无法再强制限制，它并不是许可证。
timeline.point: Counters that a public-domain dedication is an explicit relinquishment of rights, so the author cannot later enforce restrictions and it is not a license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Says the term "license" may not fit, but maintains that the stated purpose is still to dedicate works to the public domain for public benefit.
timeline.point_zh: 表示“许可证”一词也许不准确，但仍认为其核心目的依然是为了公共利益而将作品奉献到公有领域。
timeline.point: Says the term "license" may not fit, but maintains that the stated purpose is still to dedicate works to the public domain for public benefit.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Says public domain must be unrestricted, so there is no such thing as restricted public domain.
timeline.point_zh: 主张公有领域必须是无约束的，因此不存在带限制的公有领域。
timeline.point: Says public domain must be unrestricted, so there is no such thing as restricted public domain.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Says copyleft also did not exist before the GPL, so the fact that something is new does not make it impossible.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 copyleft 在 GPL 之前也不存在，因此新型许可证并非不可能。
timeline.point: Says copyleft also did not exist before the GPL, so the fact that something is new does not make it impossible.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Apologizes for sounding glib and says there is no reason a new license paradigm cannot be created, starting with creation and then adoption.
timeline.point_zh: 为语气显得轻率致歉，并表示没有理由不能创造新的许可范式，先有创造，再有采用。
timeline.point: Apologizes for sounding glib and says there is no reason a new license paradigm cannot be created, starting with creation and then adoption.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Says OSI is not the place to invent a legal framework for restricted public-domain works and that the proposal is not feasible as constructed.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSI 不是用来发明“受限公有领域”法律框架的地方，并认为该提案按当前结构不可行。
timeline.point: Says OSI is not the place to invent a legal framework for restricted public-domain works and that the proposal is not feasible as constructed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Says public domain is a legal concept that cannot simply be rewritten to fit the draft’s goal.
timeline.point_zh: 表示公有领域是既有的法律概念，不能按草案目标随意重写。
timeline.point: Says public domain is a legal concept that cannot simply be rewritten to fit the draft’s goal.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Observes that public-domain-equivalent licenses should be fungible and many already exist; recounts creating 0BSD and shepherding it through SPDX, GitHub, and OSI approvals, arguing people trust such dedications but merely fear others won't, and the space already sees heavy bikeshedding.
timeline.point_zh: 指出公有领域等效许可证本应可互换且已有很多；讲述自己创建 0BSD 并通过 SPDX、GitHub 与 OSI 审批的经历，认为人们只是担心他人不认可此类声明，该领域已有大量无谓争论。
timeline.point: Observes that public-domain-equivalent licenses should be fungible and many already exist; recounts creating 0BSD and shepherding it through SPDX, GitHub, and OSI approvals, arguing people trust such dedications but merely fear others won't, and the space already sees heavy bikeshedding.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Says OSI is for reviewing near-ready licenses, not for developing new paradigms, and that the idea should be taken to another forum if the goal is to design a restricted public-domain model.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSI 负责审查接近完成的许可证，而不是开发新范式；若目标是设计受限公有领域模型，应去别处讨论。
timeline.point: Says OSI is for reviewing near-ready licenses, not for developing new paradigms, and that the idea should be taken to another forum if the goal is to design a restricted public-domain model.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Officially rescinds the PBZC submission.
timeline.point_zh: 正式撤回 PBZC 提交。
timeline.point: Officially rescinds the PBZC submission.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New License for Consideration - Public Benefit Zero Copyright License v. 2.0
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the rescission and thanks the sender.
timeline.point_zh: 确认已收到撤回通知并表示感谢。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the rescission and thanks the sender.

timeline.snippet: Suggests that if licenses should enumerate full copyright rights, they should use the Berne Convention formulation rather than the US formulation for international consistency.

timeline.subject: [License-review]  Submission for review of Mulan Public License，Version 2

timeline.point: Distinguishes between best practice (using Berne formulation) and minimum requirements for OSI approval, noting many approved licenses enumerate only US rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission for review of Mulan Public License，Version 2
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI should require international licenses to conform to the Berne Convention formulation rather than US copyright law, calling the US-only approach short-sighted.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 应要求国际许可证符合伯尔尼公约表述而非美国版权法，认为仅采用美国法律表述是短视的。

timeline.subject: [License-review]  Submission for review of Mulan Public License，Version 2
timeline.snippet: Notes that a truly comprehensive copyright grant would include verbs from Berne, US, and EU law plus patent rights from multiple jurisdictions, but acknowledges no existing license achieves this.

timeline.point: Notes that a truly comprehensive copyright grant would include verbs from Berne, US, and EU law plus patent rights from multiple jurisdictions, but acknowledges no existing license achieves this.

timeline.subject: [License-review]  Submission for review of Mulan Public License，Version 2
timeline.snippet: Opines that the Mulan PubL should conform to the Berne formulation since it sets minimum protections without excluding additional jurisdictional rights, which would make it suitable for OSI approval if other requirements are met.
