timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Submits the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) — Strong, Weak, and Permissive variants — on behalf of ESA for OSI approval, citing ESA's special legal framework (Member State governing law, arbitration clause) and recommending the 'Special Purpose Licenses' proliferation category.
timeline.point_zh: 代表 ESA 提交 ESA-PL(Strong、Weak、Permissive 三版)供 OSI 审批,理由为 ESA 特殊法律框架(成员国法律管辖、仲裁条款),并建议归入“Special Purpose Licenses”类别。
timeline.point: Submits the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) — Strong, Weak, and Permissive variants — on behalf of ESA for OSI approval, citing ESA's special legal framework (Member State governing law, arbitration clause) and recommending the 'Special Purpose Licenses' proliferation category.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Questions the requirements of paragraphs 4.5 and 7, asking if they are legally mandated and noting they seem like a powerful disincentive for use.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑第4.5段和第7段的要求，询问其是否为法律强制规定，并指出其似乎构成对使用的强大抑制因素。
timeline.point: Questions the requirements of paragraphs 4.5 and 7, asking if they are legally mandated and noting they seem like a powerful disincentive for use.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Critiques paragraph 7 as a revival of a criticized MPL 1.1 provision and argues paragraph 4.5 is an unreasonably burdensome patent reporting requirement.
timeline.point_zh: 批评第7段是备受批评的MPL 1.1条款的复活，并认为第4.5段是不合理繁重的专利报告要求。
timeline.point: Critiques paragraph 7 as a revival of a criticized MPL 1.1 provision and argues paragraph 4.5 is an unreasonably burdensome patent reporting requirement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Asks for clarification on whether section 4.5 applies to all patents or just those covered by the license, and questions if a git repo meets section 4.3.
timeline.point_zh: 请求澄清第4.5节是适用于所有专利还是仅限许可证涵盖的专利，并质疑git仓库是否符合第4.3节。
timeline.point: Asks for clarification on whether section 4.5 applies to all patents or just those covered by the license, and questions if a git repo meets section 4.3.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Defends the ESA-PL's Sec. 4.5 and Sec. 7 as not mandated by EU law but reasonable: patent disclosure ensures transparency, ESA must be notified of infringements, and knowing users should cease infringing uses, with 'knowledge' meaning positive knowledge.
timeline.point_zh: 为 ESA-PL 第 4.5 条和第 7 条辩护,称其并非欧盟法律强制但合理:专利披露确保透明,ESA 须获侵权通知,知情人应停止侵权使用,“知识”指确切知情。
timeline.point: Defends the ESA-PL's Sec. 4.5 and Sec. 7 as not mandated by EU law but reasonable: patent disclosure ensures transparency, ESA must be notified of infringements, and knowing users should cease infringing uses, with 'knowledge' meaning positive knowledge.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Defends section 4.5 as ensuring transparency for relevant patent conflicts and reiterates the necessity of section 7 for notifying the community of third-party claims.
timeline.point_zh: 辩护第4.5节确保相关专利冲突的透明度，并重申第7节对于向社区通报第三方主张的必要性。
timeline.point: Defends section 4.5 as ensuring transparency for relevant patent conflicts and reiterates the necessity of section 7 for notifying the community of third-party claims.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Confirms section 4.5 applies only to software-related patents and states that a git repo without a changelog does not meet the documentation requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 确认第4.5节仅适用于软件相关专利，并指出没有变更日志的git仓库不满足文档要求。
timeline.point: Confirms section 4.5 applies only to software-related patents and states that a git repo without a changelog does not meet the documentation requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Argues that simply providing a git repo link or changelog is less helpful than allowing users to peruse the full history and prefers less prescriptive documentation requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 认为仅提供git仓库链接或变更日志不如让用户查阅完整历史有帮助，倾向于规定性较弱的文档要求。
timeline.point: Argues that simply providing a git repo link or changelog is less helpful than allowing users to peruse the full history and prefers less prescriptive documentation requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Argues a changelog is necessary when distributing snapshots to preserve history and suggests auto-generation can mitigate the burden, questioning if spacecraft deployment counts as distribution.
timeline.point_zh: 认为分发快照时需要变更日志以保留历史，建议自动生成可减轻负担，并质疑航天器部署是否算作分发。
timeline.point: Argues a changelog is necessary when distributing snapshots to preserve history and suggests auto-generation can mitigate the burden, questioning if spacecraft deployment counts as distribution.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Explains that section 7 applies to license rights infringement, not data processed by the software, and confirms 'Patent Claims' are limited to those infringing granted rights.
timeline.point_zh: 解释第7节适用于侵犯许可权利的情况，而非软件处理的数据，并确认“Patent Claims”仅限于侵犯已授予权利者。
timeline.point: Explains that section 7 applies to license rights infringement, not data processed by the software, and confirms 'Patent Claims' are limited to those infringing granted rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Questions why ESA created a new license instead of using the EUPL, specifically asking if the lack of weak/strong variants in the EUPL was the reason.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑ESA为何创建新许可证而不使用EUPL，特别询问是否因EUPL缺乏弱/强变体所致。
timeline.point: Questions why ESA created a new license instead of using the EUPL, specifically asking if the lack of weak/strong variants in the EUPL was the reason.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Explains that the EUPL was rejected because it lacks required arbitration and choice of law clauses, does not fit ESA member states, and lacks weak/permissive variants.
timeline.point_zh: 解释EUPL被否决的原因：缺少所需的仲裁和法律选择条款，不适合ESA成员国，且缺少弱/宽松变体。
timeline.point: Explains that the EUPL was rejected because it lacks required arbitration and choice of law clauses, does not fit ESA member states, and lacks weak/permissive variants.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Counters the defense of the arbitration clause by noting EUPL v1.2 allows supplemental agreements and expresses skepticism about the legal reality of strong copyleft.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳对仲裁条款的辩护，指出EUPL v1.2允许补充协议，并质疑强copyleft的法律现实性。
timeline.point: Counters the defense of the arbitration clause by noting EUPL v1.2 allows supplemental agreements and expresses skepticism about the legal reality of strong copyleft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Notes that absent case law, conservative corporate attorneys will avoid strong copyleft licenses when corporate IP is involved; says ESA's weak-copyleft need is not proliferation grounds for rejection, and asks whether NOSA 1.3 and 2.0 are compatible with ESA-PL.
timeline.point_zh: 指出无判例时企业律师会回避涉及公司知识产权的强 copyleft 许可证;认为 ESA 需要 weak copyleft 不构成以泛滥为由的拒绝理由,并询问 NOSA 1.3 和 2.0 是否与 ESA-PL 兼容。
timeline.point: Notes that absent case law, conservative corporate attorneys will avoid strong copyleft licenses when corporate IP is involved; says ESA's weak-copyleft need is not proliferation grounds for rejection, and asks whether NOSA 1.3 and 2.0 are compatible with ESA-PL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: States that ESA-PL Weak and Permissive are compatible with NOSA 1.3/2.0 and can be combined without practical problems.
timeline.point_zh: 指出ESA-PL Weak和Permissive与NOSA 1.3/2.0兼容，可以组合使用而无实际问题。
timeline.point: States that ESA-PL Weak and Permissive are compatible with NOSA 1.3/2.0 and can be combined without practical problems.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Defends the distinction between strong and weak copyleft, arguing the legal validity of strong copyleft is still supported by prevailing views despite lack of case law.
timeline.point_zh: 为强与弱copyleft的区分辩护，认为尽管缺乏判例法，强copyleft的法律有效性仍得到主流观点支持。
timeline.point: Defends the distinction between strong and weak copyleft, arguing the legal validity of strong copyleft is still supported by prevailing views despite lack of case law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Argues the strong-copyleft question remains legally unsettled: Hellwig v. VMware clarified nothing, the lack of API copyright protection does not resolve it, and relying only on EU law is too bold for a worldwide ecosystem; points to the community 'Linking document'.
timeline.point_zh: 认为强 copyleft 问题法律上仍未定:Hellwig 诉 VMware 未作澄清,API 不受版权保护也无助于解决,仅依赖欧盟法律对全球生态过于冒进;并指向社区的“Linking document”。
timeline.point: Argues the strong-copyleft question remains legally unsettled: Hellwig v. VMware clarified nothing, the lack of API copyright protection does not resolve it, and relying only on EU law is too bold for a worldwide ecosystem; points to the community 'Linking document'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Resubmission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Re-submits the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) v2.3 on behalf of ESA for OSI approval, revised by removing the notice-file display and cease-infringing-use obligations seen as conflicting with OSI principles.
timeline.point_zh: 代表 ESA 重新提交 European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) v2.3 供 OSI 审批，修订删除了被视为与 OSI 原则冲突的声明文件展示及停止侵权使用义务。
timeline.point: Re-submits the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) v2.3 on behalf of ESA for OSI approval, revised by removing the notice-file display and cease-infringing-use obligations seen as conflicting with OSI principles.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Resubmission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Complains that ESA has not engaged with prior review comments, says several remaining provisions still work against ESA’s own interests, and asks whether review should proceed without further responses.
timeline.point_zh: 抱怨 ESA 没有继续回应此前的评审意见，指出若干剩余条款甚至会反噬 ESA 自身利益，并追问在缺少进一步回应的情况下是否应继续推进评审。
timeline.point: Complains that ESA has not engaged with prior review comments, says several remaining provisions still work against ESA’s own interests, and asks whether review should proceed without further responses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Resubmission of the European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) for approval
timeline.snippet: Apologizes that the earlier ESA submission was never acted upon, says the old threads have been reviewed, and reopens the process with additional questions.
timeline.point_zh: 就先前 ESA 提交案长期未获处理致歉，表示已重新阅读旧讨论串，并带着新的问题重新启动评审流程。

timeline.point_zh: 重新提交 European Space Agency Public Licenses (ESA-PL) v2.5 供 OSI 审批，指出 2016 年与 2018 年的两次评审均告停滞，且这些许可证已在欧洲航天业界的开源项目中积极使用。

submissions.name: TOPPERS License

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Legacy approval request submitted Jun 2015; status uncertain. No formal decision recorded.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Requests OSI approval for the TOPPERS License as a legacy submission and invites questions or recommendations.
timeline.point_zh: 请求将 TOPPERS License 作为历史遗留许可证获得 OSI 批准，并欢迎问题和建议。
timeline.point: Requests OSI approval for the TOPPERS License as a legacy submission and invites questions or recommendations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the reporting requirement makes the license non-free because it discriminates against people who cannot contact a specific point.
timeline.point_zh: 主张报告义务使该许可证不自由，因为它歧视无法联系特定联系点的人。
timeline.point: Argues that the reporting requirement makes the license non-free because it discriminates against people who cannot contact a specific point.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Responds that reporting can be done through many channels and asks whether the clause still violates the non-discrimination rule.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称报告可通过多种渠道完成，并询问该条款是否仍违反“不得歧视个人或群体”原则。
timeline.point: Responds that reporting can be done through many channels and asks whether the clause still violates the non-discrimination rule.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Says the clause discriminates against some users and fails if the project disappears, so the license is not open source unless the separate procedure fixes those issues.
timeline.point_zh: 指出该条款会歧视部分用户，而且项目消失后无法履行，因此该许可证不算开源，除非单独程序解决这些问题。
timeline.point: Says the clause discriminates against some users and fails if the project disappears, so the license is not open source unless the separate procedure fixes those issues.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Defends the clause as non-discriminatory and says users can always choose option (a), even if the project later ceases to exist.
timeline.point_zh: 为该条款辩护，称其并非歧视，并表示即使项目日后不存在，用户仍可始终选择方案（a）。
timeline.point: Defends the clause as non-discriminatory and says users can always choose option (a), even if the project later ceases to exist.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the GPL sections are different and notes that optional reporting to an entity can be acceptable in OSS, while asking about the significance of provision (3)(b).
timeline.point_zh: 说明 GPL 条款不同，并指出只要是可选的，向某个实体报告在 OSS 中可以接受，同时就（3）（b）的意义提出疑问。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the GPL sections are different and notes that optional reporting to an entity can be acceptable in OSS, while asking about the significance of provision (3)(b).

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Points out that option (a) is always available, so the groups supposedly affected by (b) can still use the software under a common open-source condition.
timeline.point_zh: 指出方案（a）始终可选，因此所谓受（b）影响的群体仍可在这一常见开源条件下使用软件。
timeline.point: Points out that option (a) is always available, so the groups supposedly affected by (b) can still use the software under a common open-source condition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Explains that GPL source-sharing is different from reporting obligations, and identifies two ways a notification requirement can become non-free.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 GPL 的源码共享与报告义务不同，并指出通知要求可能在两种情况下变成不自由。
timeline.point: Explains that GPL source-sharing is different from reporting obligations, and identifies two ways a notification requirement can become non-free.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Concedes that option (a) is open source, but says a license with non-open-source options is suboptimal and only tolerable for legacy approval.
timeline.point_zh: 承认方案（a）是开源的，但认为包含非开源选项的许可证并不理想，只能作为历史遗留批准勉强接受。
timeline.point: Concedes that option (a) is open source, but says a license with non-open-source options is suboptimal and only tolerable for legacy approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether "either" really means both in condition (3) and asks the submitter to clarify.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑第（3）条中的“either”是否实际上表示“两者都要”，并请提交者澄清。
timeline.point: Questions whether "either" really means both in condition (3) and asks the submitter to clarify.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Says the optional structure is acceptable, notes the disclaimer may be over-broad, but concludes the license otherwise looks free and likely approvable.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这种可选结构可以接受，指出免责声明可能过宽，但总体上该许可证看起来仍是自由的，并可能获批。
timeline.point: Says the optional structure is acceptable, notes the disclaimer may be over-broad, but concludes the license otherwise looks free and likely approvable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Says the wording is awkward and should be replaced for a new license, but for a legacy license a framing note on the OSI page is enough.
timeline.point_zh: 认为措辞别扭，若是新许可证应改写，但作为历史遗留许可证，OSI 页面上的说明即可。
timeline.point: Says the wording is awkward and should be replaced for a new license, but for a legacy license a framing note on the OSI page is enough.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Notes that "either" is confusing and ambiguous, but withdraws the objection because the license is legacy.
timeline.point_zh: 指出“either”令人困惑且含义含糊，但由于这是历史遗留许可证，因此撤回反对意见。
timeline.point: Notes that "either" is confusing and ambiguous, but withdraws the objection because the license is legacy.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Argues that TOPPERS reporting is similar to GPL source obligations and should likewise not count as discrimination, even if circumstances later make reporting difficult.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 TOPPERS 的报告要求与 GPL 源码义务相似，因此即使后来难以履行，也不应被视为歧视。
timeline.point: Argues that TOPPERS reporting is similar to GPL source obligations and should likewise not count as discrimination, even if circumstances later make reporting difficult.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that (a) and (b) are alternative options in section (3) and invites further questions.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清第（3）条中的（a）和（b）是两个可选方案，并欢迎进一步提问。
timeline.point: Clarifies that (a) and (b) are alternative options in section (3) and invites further questions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Says GPL requires simultaneous source offers and notes that mandatory notification requirements have a precedent for being non-open-source, though the issue is moot here because option (a) exists.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 GPL 要求同时提供源码，并说强制通知要求有被视为非开源的先例，不过在这里因存在方案（a）而问题不大。
timeline.point: Says GPL requires simultaneous source offers and notes that mandatory notification requirements have a precedent for being non-open-source, though the issue is moot here because option (a) exists.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Says the ambiguity comes from translation and asks to replace the wording with "one of the following two conditions".
timeline.point_zh: 表示歧义源于翻译问题，并希望将措辞改为“以下两个条件之一”。
timeline.point: Says the ambiguity comes from translation and asks to replace the wording with "one of the following two conditions".

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the point and asks whether there are any further questions or suggestions.
timeline.point_zh: 认可对方的说明，并询问是否还有其他问题或建议。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the point and asks whether there are any further questions or suggestions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Asks how the license applies when no documentation is supplied with the item.
timeline.point_zh: 询问当项目没有附带文档时许可证如何适用。
timeline.point: Asks how the license applies when no documentation is supplied with the item.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Says clause (3) assumes the item is a binary unusable for other software development, and asks what scenarios others are concerned about.
timeline.point_zh: 表示第（3）条假定该项目是无法用于其他软件开发的二进制文件，并询问对方担心哪些场景。
timeline.point: Says clause (3) assumes the item is a binary unusable for other software development, and asks what scenarios others are concerned about.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Announces that the license wording has been changed from "either of" to "at least one of" to reduce confusion and move the approval forward.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布将许可证中的“either of”改为“at least one of”以减少混淆，并推动尽快获批。
timeline.point: Announces that the license wording has been changed from "either of" to "at least one of" to reduce confusion and move the approval forward.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Expresses skepticism, saying the clause and project-specific reference are non-compliant and that condition (b) should be removed.
timeline.point_zh: 表示怀疑，称该条款和项目专属引用不合规，且应删除条件（b）。
timeline.point: Expresses skepticism, saying the clause and project-specific reference are non-compliant and that condition (b) should be removed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Argues that including the license text satisfies (a), says users who can do (b) can also do (a), and asks what concrete problems or distinctions remain.
timeline.point_zh: 主张附上许可证文本即可满足（a），认为能做（b）的用户也能做（a），并询问还存在哪些具体问题或区别。
timeline.point: Argues that including the license text satisfies (a), says users who can do (b) can also do (a), and asks what concrete problems or distinctions remain.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Argues that option (b) can become the only practical choice in embedded scenarios, making the license non-compliant, and says the license should be generic rather than project-specific.
timeline.point_zh: 主张在嵌入式场景中（b）可能成为唯一可行选项，从而使许可证不合规，并表示该许可证应泛化而非只针对某个项目。
timeline.point: Argues that option (b) can become the only practical choice in embedded scenarios, making the license non-compliant, and says the license should be generic rather than project-specific.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the embedded-document concern also applies to BSD-style licenses and whether OSI officially rejects new project-specific licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 询问嵌入式文档问题是否同样适用于 BSD 类许可证，以及 OSI 是否正式拒绝新的项目专属许可证。
timeline.point: Asks whether the embedded-document concern also applies to BSD-style licenses and whether OSI officially rejects new project-specific licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Argues clause (b) is useless and the exemption from the standard notice-preservation route (a) for those complying with (b) does not foster openness and is uncompliant with the OSD, advocating its removal and leaving the matter to the Board.
timeline.point_zh: 认为条款 (b) 无用，给遵守 (b) 者豁免标准声明保留方式 (a) 无助于开放与自由、不符合 OSD，主张予以删除，并认为此事宜交由董事会讨论。
timeline.point: Argues clause (b) is useless and the exemption from the standard notice-preservation route (a) for those complying with (b) does not foster openness and is uncompliant with the OSD, advocating its removal and leaving the matter to the Board.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Defends the license as OSD-compliant, says option (b) is a valid choice for users who do not want to foster openness, and asks how to raise the matter with the board.
timeline.point_zh: 为该许可证的 OSD 合规性辩护，称方案（b）是给不愿推动开放性的用户的有效选择，并询问如何向董事会提出此事。
timeline.point: Defends the license as OSD-compliant, says option (b) is a valid choice for users who do not want to foster openness, and asks how to raise the matter with the board.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Explains that product-specific licensing is a key OSD issue, and describes the mailing list and board process for review and possible drafting help.
timeline.point_zh: 说明“不得针对特定产品”是 OSD 的关键问题，并介绍邮件列表和董事会的审查流程及可能的起草协助。
timeline.point: Explains that product-specific licensing is a key OSD issue, and describes the mailing list and board process for review and possible drafting help.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the reporting destination in (b) does not violate OSD item 8 because it does not restrict use or distribution.
timeline.point_zh: 主张（b）中的报告对象并未违反 OSD 第 8 条，因为它不限制使用或分发。
timeline.point: Argues that the reporting destination in (b) does not violate OSD item 8 because it does not restrict use or distribution.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether any concerns remain and urges the approval vote to happen soon.
timeline.point_zh: 询问是否还有顾虑，并希望尽快就 TOPPERS License 进行批准投票。
timeline.point: Asks whether any concerns remain and urges the approval vote to happen soon.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: States explicit support for approving the TOPPERS License as a legacy license.
timeline.point_zh: 明确表示支持将 TOPPERS License 作为历史遗留许可证予以批准。
timeline.point: States explicit support for approving the TOPPERS License as a legacy license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the other participant’s position without adding a substantive view of its own.
timeline.point_zh: 对对方的立场表示感谢，但没有补充实质观点。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the other participant’s position without adding a substantive view of its own.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Asks for the current approval status and quotes the review process steps to understand what happens next.
timeline.point_zh: 询问当前的审批状态，并列出审查流程步骤以了解后续安排。
timeline.point: Asks for the current approval status and quotes the review process steps to understand what happens next.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Says discussion is essentially finished and that the next step is summarizing the license for a board vote.
timeline.point_zh: 表示讨论基本结束，下一步是整理材料并提交董事会表决。
timeline.point: Says discussion is essentially finished and that the next step is summarizing the license for a board vote.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Agrees with the prior status update, asks when the next board meeting is, and suggests a Kanban board to track license-review status.
timeline.point_zh: 对前面的状态更新表示认同，询问下一次董事会会议时间，并建议用看板跟踪许可证审查状态。
timeline.point: Agrees with the prior status update, asks when the next board meeting is, and suggests a Kanban board to track license-review status.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Flags TOPPERS license condition (4) as problematic: indemnifying upstream 'from any and all causes of action whatsoever' is broader than anything in a known open source license and unclear, and asks whether an official Japanese-language version exists.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 TOPPERS 许可证条件 (4) 有问题：由用户就"任何及一切诉因"向上游赔偿的条款比已知开源许可证都宽泛且含义不清，并询问是否存在官方日文版本。
timeline.point: Flags TOPPERS license condition (4) as problematic: indemnifying upstream 'from any and all causes of action whatsoever' is broader than anything in a known open source license and unclear, and asks whether an official Japanese-language version exists.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the disclaimer language is not, by itself, a barrier to OSI approval and should be reconsidered by TOPPERS.
timeline.point_zh: 主张免责声明措辞本身未必构成 OSI 批准障碍，TOPPERS 应认真再看。
timeline.point: Argues that the disclaimer language is not, by itself, a barrier to OSI approval and should be reconsidered by TOPPERS.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Raises concern that the clause is broader than a simple liability disclaimer and may be a translation problem.
timeline.point_zh: 指出该条款看起来不只是普通责任免责声明，可能存在翻译问题。
timeline.point: Raises concern that the clause is broader than a simple liability disclaimer and may be a translation problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Explains that the clause was meant only as a liability disclaimer and proposes revised wording to make that clear.
timeline.point_zh: 解释该条款本意只是责任免责声明，并提出修改措辞以消除歧义。
timeline.point: Explains that the clause was meant only as a liability disclaimer and proposes revised wording to make that clear.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Confirms the revised wording resolves the issue and recommends approval of the TOPPERS license.
timeline.point_zh: 确认修订措辞已消除顾虑，并建议批准 TOPPERS 许可证。
timeline.point: Confirms the revised wording resolves the issue and recommends approval of the TOPPERS license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Thanks Richard for the guidance and acknowledges the fix.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢对方的建议，并认可该处理方向。
timeline.point: Thanks Richard for the guidance and acknowledges the fix.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Asks how OSI should describe the license if Japanese is authoritative and whether a non-English license process should apply.
timeline.point_zh: 询问若日文才是权威版本，OSI 应如何标注该许可证，以及是否应走非英语许可证流程。
timeline.point: Asks how OSI should describe the license if Japanese is authoritative and whether a non-English license process should apply.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Reports the OSI Board's discussion of the TOPPERS submission and asks the submitter to clarify whether a Japanese-language license governs the project, since approving the English text alone risks confusion and substantive deviation from the unreviewed non-English original.
timeline.point_zh: 转述 OSI 董事会对 TOPPERS 提交案的讨论，要求提交者澄清项目是否由日文版许可证管辖，因为仅批准英文文本恐造成混淆或偏离未经审查的原文。
timeline.point: Reports the OSI Board's discussion of the TOPPERS submission and asks the submitter to clarify whether a Japanese-language license governs the project, since approving the English text alone risks confusion and substantive deviation from the unreviewed non-English original.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: States that both language versions are official and asks what affidavit format and supporting details are needed for International License approval.
timeline.point_zh: 说明英日文版本都属官方版本，并询问国际许可证所需的宣誓书格式及附件信息。
timeline.point: States that both language versions are official and asks what affidavit format and supporting details are needed for International License approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Says a draft affidavit is ready, states the claim that both language versions are official, and asks for confirmation and comments.
timeline.point_zh: 表示已起草宣誓书，声明英日文版本均为官方版本，并请对方确认并提出意见。
timeline.point: Says a draft affidavit is ready, states the claim that both language versions are official, and asks for confirmation and comments.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether a professional translation service could provide a certified translation or otherwise verify the English version against the Japanese original.
timeline.point_zh: 询问是否可用专业翻译服务出具认证译文，或核对英文最新版是否忠实对应日文原文。
timeline.point: Asks whether a professional translation service could provide a certified translation or otherwise verify the English version against the Japanese original.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Argues for relying on a knowledgeable lawyer to validate the translation and asks whether that approach is acceptable.
timeline.point_zh: 主张由熟悉计算机和开源的律师验证译文，并询问这一做法是否可行。
timeline.point: Argues for relying on a knowledgeable lawyer to validate the translation and asks whether that approach is acceptable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Asks for final feedback and says he will submit the official affidavit if there are no objections.
timeline.point_zh: 询问是否还有意见；若无，将提交正式宣誓书。
timeline.point: Asks for final feedback and says he will submit the official affidavit if there are no objections.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: TOPPERS License
timeline.snippet: Prefers a professional translation affidavit and warns that extra translation evidence may still be requested, delaying approval.
timeline.point_zh: 倾向于由专业翻译服务出具宣誓书，并提醒后续可能还会要求额外译文或第二份宣誓书，从而延迟批准。
timeline.point: Prefers a professional translation affidavit and warns that extra translation evidence may still be requested, delaying approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Official Submission: Modified 0BSD License (Maintenance-Required)

timeline.subject: [License-review] Official Submission: Modified 0BSD License (Maintenance-Required)
timeline.snippet: Points out that required review questions remain unanswered — no fixed license text, no using projects, no steward identification, no external approvals or SPDX identifiers, no lawyer review — and asks how the affirmative obligation can bind the recipient.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License Review: Modified 0BSD License (Maintenance-Required)
timeline.snippet: Opposes the 0BSD-derived proposal and asks that it be renamed (e.g. 0ISC); argues copyrights, patents, and trademarks are distinct areas of law, that 0BSD was meant as a simple copyright-only public-domain-equivalent license, and that the perpetual bug-fix 'duty' is more onerous than GPL virality.
timeline.point_zh: 反对该仿 0BSD 的提案并要求改名(如 0ISC);认为版权、专利、商标属不同法律领域,0BSD 本意是仅涉版权的简单许可证,且永久修 bug 义务比 GPL 传染性更苛刻。

timeline.subject: [License-review] Official Submission: Modified 0BSD License (Maintenance-Required)
timeline.snippet: Argues the Maintenance Obligation is largely unenforceable, vague, and contractually ill-conceived, imposing a positive obligation that conflicts with OSD clauses 1 and 2, and concludes the license is not suitable for approval.

============================================================

Copyright (c) <YEAR>, <USERNAME>

Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a
copy of this digital work, to use, copy, modify, merge, and distribute the
work, subject to the following conditions:

1. FLEXIBLE ACCREDITATION: Attribution must be maintained in a dedicated
CREDITS file, project README, or within the work's metadata. This replaces
the requirement for mandatory inline legal notices within every source file
to facilitate interoperability between different technical formats.

2. OPEN CONVERSION: Users are explicitly authorized to decompile,
transpile, or convert archived assets (including proprietary or legacy
binary formats) into human-readable source code. This is recognized as a
necessary process for digital preservation, technical study, and long-term
interoperability.

3. REDISTRIBUTION: Any public fork or redistribution of this work, in its
original or converted form, must retain the original copyright notice and
identify the work as a FARCL-licensed archive to ensure the integrity of
its origin.

4. SOURCE PERSISTENCE: Source code derived from the conversion of assets
under this license shall inherit these same permissions. This ensures that
data recovered from closed formats remains accessible and cannot be
re-restricted under more hardware-limited or proprietary terms.

DISCLAIMER: THIS WORK IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND,
EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF
MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN
NO EVENT SHALL THE AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM,
DAMAGES OR OTHER LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR
OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM, OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE WORK OR THE USE
OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE WORK.

============================================================

Summary of Changes & Clarifications:

- Elimination of Undefined Roles: The term "Archivist" has been removed.
The license now uses standard legal subjects ("Person", "User") and
"Username", which is the de facto identity standard in communities like
GitHub/GitLab.

- Compliance with OSD 6 (No Discrimination): The prohibition of binary
distribution has been removed. The license now grants an explicit
additional right for conversion/decompilation, ensuring it does not
restrict fields of endeavor but empowers preservation.

- Justification over Existing Licenses: Unlike MIT or BSD, the FARCL-1.0
explicitly addresses the legal "grey area" of decompiling End-of-Life (EOL)
formats (like .FLA) for the purpose of source code reconstruction. This
provides a specific legal shield for preservationists that general-purpose
licenses lack.

- Expected Adopters: This license is aimed at the Flashpoint Archive
community, the Software Preservation Network, and developers using tools
like Ruffle or OpenFL to migrate legacy assets into open standards.

I believe this revision is now fully aligned with the Open Source
Definition. I look forward to further discussion.

Best regards,

B4uti4GD

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of Orivex Syscall Note License (OSN-1.0) for OSI Approval
timeline.snippet: Submitting the Orivex Syscall Note License (OSN-1.0), a permissive license designed for Orivex's kernel-facing components such as kernel headers and syscall interface definitions, for OSI approval as fully OSD-compliant.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 Orivex Syscall Note License (OSN-1.0)——面向 Orivex 内核相关组件(内核头文件、syscall 接口定义等)的宽松许可证——供 OSI 审批,称其完全符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Submitting the Orivex Syscall Note License (OSN-1.0), a permissive license designed for Orivex's kernel-facing components such as kernel headers and syscall interface definitions, for OSI approval as fully OSD-compliant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of Orivex Syscall Note License (OSN-1.0) for OSI Approval
timeline.snippet: First reading already surfaces multiple flaws, including a Licensor definition that may discriminate among copyright-holder classes, so approval would be hard at this version.
timeline.point_zh: 初读已发现多处缺陷，包括可能歧视不同类别版权人的模糊 Licensor 定义，此版本很难获得批准。
timeline.point: First reading already surfaces multiple flaws, including a Licensor definition that may discriminate among copyright-holder classes, so approval would be hard at this version.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of Orivex Syscall Note License (OSN-1.0) for OSI Approval
timeline.snippet: Broadly agrees with the prior critique and adds further issues; suggests reusing Linux-syscall-note with a standard license instead of writing a new one.
timeline.point_zh: 基本认同前述批评并补充若干问题；建议复用 Linux-syscall-note 搭配标准许可证，而非另立新许可证。
timeline.point: Broadly agrees with the prior critique and adds further issues; suggests reusing Linux-syscall-note with a standard license instead of writing a new one.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of Orivex Syscall Note License (OSN-1.0) for OSI Approval
timeline.snippet: Agrees with prior commenters and adds concerns: non-binding Section 6 invites misconstruction, the 'as delivered by' patent grant in 3.1 may not reach sublicensees, sublicensing language is confusing, and 7.3 incorporates unknown external trademark terms; not in favor of approving the license.
timeline.point_zh: 同意此前评论者的意见，并提出新问题：无约束力的第6条易致误解、3.1 的 "as delivered by" 专利授予可能不及于再被许可人、再许可条款混乱、7.3 引入未知外部商标条款；不赞成批准该许可证。
timeline.point: Agrees with prior commenters and adds concerns: non-binding Section 6 invites misconstruction, the 'as delivered by' patent grant in 3.1 may not reach sublicensees, sublicensing language is confusing, and 7.3 incorporates unknown external trademark terms; not in favor of approving the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of Orivex Syscall Note License (OSN-1.0) for OSI Approval
timeline.snippet: Finds the contribution section incoherent: Section 5.2's automatic contribution grants conflict with the optional CLA in 5.3. Also notes the submission fails the approval requirements to describe the gap filled, compare with similar approved licenses, and disclose legal review.
timeline.point_zh: 指出贡献条款自相矛盾：5.2 的自动授予与 5.3 的可选 CLA 冲突；并认为提交未满足审批要求——说明填补的空白、与相似已批准许可证比较、披露法律审查情况。
timeline.point: Finds the contribution section incoherent: Section 5.2's automatic contribution grants conflict with the optional CLA in 5.3. Also notes the submission fails the approval requirements to describe the gap filled, compare with similar approved licenses, and disclose legal review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of Orivex Syscall Note License (OSN-1.0) for OSI Approval
timeline.snippet: Requests a response to the unanswered October feedback and asks whether the submitter plans to continue revising the license.
timeline.point_zh: 催促回应十月份尚未答复的评审意见，并询问提交者是否仍打算继续修改该许可证。
timeline.point: Requests a response to the unanswered October feedback and asks whether the submitter plans to continue revising the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission of Orivex Syscall Note License (OSN-1.0) for OSI Approval
timeline.snippet: States that the License Committee will recommend rejection because of unresolved drafting problems and missing supporting material, while leaving open a future resubmission.
timeline.point_zh: 表示许可证委员会将因起草问题未解决且支撑材料不足而建议拒绝，但仍为未来重新提交保留空间。

3D Slicer Contribution and Software License Agreement ("Agreement")

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Requests Legacy Approval of the 3D Slicer license as a Non-Reusable license: a BSD-style license drafted in 2005 by Brigham and Women's Hospital with extra medical-software provisions, in continuous use since 2005.
timeline.point_zh: 申请将 3D Slicer 许可证作为 Non-Reusable 许可证获得 Legacy Approval——2005 年由 BWH 起草的 BSD 风格许可证,附有医疗软件特别条款。
timeline.point: Requests Legacy Approval of the 3D Slicer license as a Non-Reusable license: a BSD-style license drafted in 2005 by Brigham and Women's Hospital with extra medical-software provisions, in continuous use since 2005.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Considers Part B generally approvable but argues Part A is an asymmetric CLA that should not be included in approval; due to difficulty in clearly communicating which parts were approved to the public, recommends OSI decline the license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Part B 大体可批准，但 Part A 是不对称 CLA 不应纳入审批；因公众难以区分被批准部分，建议 OSI 拒绝该许可证。
timeline.point: Considers Part B generally approvable but argues Part A is an asymmetric CLA that should not be included in approval; due to difficulty in clearly communicating which parts were approved to the public, recommends OSI decline the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Points out that Part B.4's "research purposes only" clause edges close to violating OSD #6 (discrimination against field of endeavor), and questions whether Part A.6 constitutes a restriction on other software under OSD #9.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 Part B.4 的「仅限研究用途」条款游走在 OSD 第 6 条（领域歧视）边缘，并质疑 Part A.6 是否构成对其他软件的限制（OSD 第 9 条）。
timeline.point: Points out that Part B.4's "research purposes only" clause edges close to violating OSD #6 (discrimination against field of endeavor), and questions whether Part A.6 constitutes a restriction on other software under OSD #9.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Agrees Part A is a CLA that should be separated from the software license and cannot be approved as-is; but if Part B were separated, no problems remain since clause 4 is a disclaimer, not a field-of-use restriction.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 Part A 是 CLA 应与软件许可证分离、无法按现状批准；但若分离出 Part B 则没有问题，第 4 条属免责声明而非领域限制。
timeline.point: Agrees Part A is a CLA that should be separated from the software license and cannot be approved as-is; but if Part B were separated, no problems remain since clause 4 is a disclaimer, not a field-of-use restriction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the scope of OSI approval must first be defined; considers approving only Part B feasible, but raises the question of whether Part C is part of the license.
timeline.point_zh: 主张需先界定 OSI 审批的对象范围；认为仅审批 Part B 可行，但提出 Part C 是否属于许可证一部分的疑问。
timeline.point: Argues that the scope of OSI approval must first be defined; considers approving only Part B feasible, but raises the question of whether Part C is part of the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Believes that unless the Slicer project separates the two documents itself, the public would mistake Part B approval as also endorsing Part A CLA; OSI has precedent against approving CLAs; Part C is merely a jurisdiction statement with no issues.
timeline.point_zh: 认为除非 Slicer 项目自行拆分两份文件，否则公众会将 Part B 的批准误解为对 Part A CLA 的认可；OSI 有不批准 CLA 的先例；Part C 仅为管辖权声明无问题。
timeline.point: Believes that unless the Slicer project separates the two documents itself, the public would mistake Part B approval as also endorsing Part A CLA; OSI has precedent against approving CLAs; Part C is merely a jurisdiction statement with no issues.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Notes that Apache 2.0 has very similar contribution/CLA language, so including such content in a license is not unprecedented, but the way it has been customized here may be problematic.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 Apache 2.0 亦有类似的贡献者/CLA 条款，将此类内容纳入许可证并非无先例，但此处定制方式可能存在问题。
timeline.point: Notes that Apache 2.0 has very similar contribution/CLA language, so including such content in a license is not unprecedented, but the way it has been customized here may be problematic.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Rebuts the claim that Apache 2.0 is similar to Part A after re-reading Apache, pointing out Apache merely codifies inbound=outbound licensing while Slicer Part A transfers all rights without restriction; concludes the Slicer terms are problematic for OSI approval.
timeline.point_zh: 重读 Apache 2.0 后反驳其与 Part A 相似的说法，指出 Apache 仅是「入站=出站」授权，而 Slicer Part A 是无限制让渡全部权利；认定 Slicer 条款在 OSI 审批语境下存在问题。
timeline.point: Rebuts the claim that Apache 2.0 is similar to Part A after re-reading Apache, pointing out Apache merely codifies inbound=outbound licensing while Slicer Part A transfers all rights without restriction; concludes the Slicer terms are problematic for OSI approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Argues Part B mixes a CLA with a license and that the license is not OSD-compliant: the agreement to comply with all applicable laws could trap users in legal risk; recommends that clause be informational rather than a binding agreement if Part B is split out.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Part B 混合了 CLA 与许可证,且该许可证不符合 OSD:同意遵守一切法律的条款可能使用户陷入法律风险;若拆出 Part B,该条款应仅为提示而非约定。
timeline.point: Argues Part B mixes a CLA with a license and that the license is not OSD-compliant: the agreement to comply with all applicable laws could trap users in legal risk; recommends that clause be informational rather than a binding agreement if Part B is split out.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Agrees with Eric's catch, noting that OSI has precedent against allowing such compliance language because laws differ across jurisdictions and change over time, and such provisions do not belong in licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 认同 Eric 的发现，指出 OSI 有先例不接受此类「遵守法律」措辞，因各地法律不同且会变化，本不应写入许可证。
timeline.point: Agrees with Eric's catch, noting that OSI has precedent against allowing such compliance language because laws differ across jurisdictions and change over time, and such provisions do not belong in licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Adds a further objection: given the many contradictory laws worldwide, requiring compliance with all applicable laws may be practically impossible.
timeline.point_zh: 补充反对理由：鉴于各地法律繁多甚至相互矛盾，要求遵守所有适用法律可能根本无法实现。
timeline.point: Adds a further objection: given the many contradictory laws worldwide, requiring compliance with all applicable laws may be practically impossible.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Defends §15 of AFL/OSL as clarifying what the licensor promises rather than being unnecessary; other licenses' lack of such clarification is their issue. Has moved the response to license-discuss.
timeline.point_zh: 为 AFL/OSL §15 辩护,称其澄清了许可方的承诺而非多余条款,其他许可证缺少此类澄清是它们的问题;已将回复移至 license-discuss。
timeline.point: Defends §15 of AFL/OSL as clarifying what the licensor promises rather than being unnecessary; other licenses' lack of such clarification is their issue. Has moved the response to license-discuss.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Agrees that the clause requiring compliance with all applicable governmental laws constitutes a field of use restriction that OSI has previously found unacceptable.
timeline.point_zh: 同意该「遵守一切适用法律」条款属于 OSI 过去认为不可接受的领域使用限制。
timeline.point: Agrees that the clause requiring compliance with all applicable governmental laws constitutes a field of use restriction that OSI has previously found unacceptable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Questions the licensing language of Part B: Part A grants licenses only to Brigham with sublicense rights, but Part B does not appear to grant sublicenses to contributions, only to "Brigham's rights in the software and data," raising whether that necessarily includes contributor rights.
timeline.point_zh: 对 Part B 的授权措辞存疑：Part A 仅向 Brigham 授予并允许再许可，但 Part B 似乎并未真正向贡献者权利授予再许可，质疑「Brigham 的权利」是否涵盖其获得的贡献者权利。
timeline.point: Questions the licensing language of Part B: Part A grants licenses only to Brigham with sublicense rights, but Part B does not appear to grant sublicenses to contributions, only to "Brigham's rights in the software and data," raising whether that necessarily includes contributor rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Disagrees with Pam's judgment, arguing that obeying "applicable" laws is inherent duty for any licensor or licensee who wants to stay out of jail, and cites AFL 3.0 Section 15 as precedent supporting such clauses.
timeline.point_zh: 不同意 Pam 的判断，主张遵守「适用」法律是任何许可人/被许可人的固有义务，并援引 AFL 3.0 第 15 条作为先例支持此类条款。
timeline.point: Disagrees with Pam's judgment, arguing that obeying "applicable" laws is inherent duty for any licensor or licensee who wants to stay out of jail, and cites AFL 3.0 Section 15 as precedent supporting such clauses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Counters Larry, arguing that if AFL's such clauses are compliant then AFL itself would not be OSD compliant; the core issue is whether the licensor has an infringement claim against the licensee for non-compliance with applicable laws, which the OSD precludes.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 Larry，认为若 AFL 此类条款合规则 AFL 本身也不符合 OSD；核心问题在于被许可人违法时许可人是否拥有侵权索赔权，而 OSD 排除此种可能。
timeline.point: Counters Larry, arguing that if AFL's such clauses are compliant then AFL itself would not be OSD compliant; the core issue is whether the licensor has an infringement claim against the licensee for non-compliance with applicable laws, which the OSD precludes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: From a non-lawyer's perspective, considers AFL Section 15 language very different from the proposed license language and asks Larry to explain why the two are not distinct.
timeline.point_zh: 从非律师角度认为 AFL 第 15 条措辞与拟审批许可证中的措辞差异很大，请 Larry 解释为何不构成区别。
timeline.point: From a non-lawyer's perspective, considers AFL Section 15 language very different from the proposed license language and asks Larry to explain why the two are not distinct.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Points out the key distinction: as an agreement clause in the license, it is a condition whose breach can lead to termination or a copyright infringement claim; also acknowledges that such requirements are surplusage since breaking the law is already illegal.
timeline.point_zh: 指出区别在于：作为许可证中的协议条款，它是可导致终止或侵权索赔的条件；同时认同 Larry 所言此类要求属多余，因违法本身即已违法。
timeline.point: Points out the key distinction: as an agreement clause in the license, it is a condition whose breach can lead to termination or a copyright infringement claim; also acknowledges that such requirements are surplusage since breaking the law is already illegal.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Poses a hypothetical: if in Thailand using AFL 3.0-licensed software to publish a call for a republic, would one be in breach of both the author's copyright and Thailand's lese majeste laws.
timeline.point_zh: 以泰国「冒犯君主罪」为例设问：若在泰国用 AFL 3.0 软件发表共和呼吁，是否既违反作者版权又违反当地法律。
timeline.point: Poses a hypothetical: if in Thailand using AFL 3.0-licensed software to publish a call for a republic, would one be in breach of both the author's copyright and Thailand's lese majeste laws.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Emphasizes that there is no single "the law," is fully convinced such language is unacceptable in OSS licenses, and warns that choice-of-law clauses and consumer protection laws can quickly exacerbate cross-border application problems.
timeline.point_zh: 强调不存在单一的「法律」，并确信此类措辞不可接受于 OSS 许可证，指出法律选择条款与消费者法会使跨国适用问题迅速恶化。
timeline.point: Emphasizes that there is no single "the law," is fully convinced such language is unacceptable in OSS licenses, and warns that choice-of-law clauses and consumer protection laws can quickly exacerbate cross-border application problems.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Rebuts Eric by directing him to read AFL §15 in full: the licensor promises not to interfere with or be responsible for such uses by the licensee.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 Eric,指出应完整阅读 AFL §15——许可方承诺不干涉、亦不对被许可方的使用负责。
timeline.point: Rebuts Eric by directing him to read AFL §15 in full: the licensor promises not to interfere with or be responsible for such uses by the licensee.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Uses U.S. export law as an example: distributing open source software that violates U.S. export laws can result in jail time, regardless of whether it is "open source" or copyright law.
timeline.point_zh: 以美国出口法为例说明：分发违反出口法的开源软件可能入狱，与「开源」或版权法无关。
timeline.point: Uses U.S. export law as an example: distributing open source software that violates U.S. export laws can result in jail time, regardless of whether it is "open source" or copyright law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Interprets "such uses" as referring to "all ways not otherwise restricted or conditioned by this License or by law," and if correct, this would imply the license applies only to legal uses (noting they are not a lawyer).
timeline.point_zh: 将「此类使用」理解为「不受本许可证或法律限制的使用」，若理解正确则意味着许可证仅适用于合法用途（自陈非律师）。
timeline.point: Interprets "such uses" as referring to "all ways not otherwise restricted or conditioned by this License or by law," and if correct, this would imply the license applies only to legal uses (noting they are not a lawyer).

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Argues AFL 3.0 §15 contains the licensor's promise not to interfere with and disclaim copyright claims over unlawful use — a promise, not a condition, appropriate in a unilateral contract where only the licensor makes promises.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 AFL 3.0 §15 是许可人的承诺——不干涉违法使用并放弃版权违约索赔——属于承诺而非条件，在仅由许可人作出承诺的单边合同中是恰当的。
timeline.point: Argues AFL 3.0 §15 contains the licensor's promise not to interfere with and disclaim copyright claims over unlawful use — a promise, not a condition, appropriate in a unilateral contract where only the licensor makes promises.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Counters that nobody can license illegal uses of software, so AFL 3.0 §15 does not confine the license to legal uses; notes to Simon the same presumably applies in Thailand.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称无人能许可软件的违法使用，因此 AFL 3.0 §15 并未把许可限定于合法用途；并向 Simon 指出这在泰国应同样适用。
timeline.point: Counters that nobody can license illegal uses of software, so AFL 3.0 §15 does not confine the license to legal uses; notes to Simon the same presumably applies in Thailand.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies his criticism targets the 3D Slicer License under review, not Rosen's already-approved AFL, and suggests such discussion belongs on license-discuss; reiterates that such law-compliance clauses are unnecessary but not themselves OSD violations.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清其批评针对正在评审的 3D Slicer License 而非 Rosen 已获批的 AFL，并建议此类讨论应转到 license-discuss 列表；重申这类守法条款虽多余但本身并不违反 OSD。
timeline.point: Clarifies his criticism targets the 3D Slicer License under review, not Rosen's already-approved AFL, and suggests such discussion belongs on license-discuss; reiterates that such law-compliance clauses are unnecessary but not themselves OSD violations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Questions the claim that no one can license illegal uses, citing the Berne Convention to illustrate the complexity of cross-border legal application, arguing this international complexity alone should preclude such language, and asking whether OSI has previously rejected licenses for this reason.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑「无人能许可违法使用」的说法，援引伯尔尼公约指出跨国法律适用的复杂性，主张国际化噩梦足以成为不允许此类措辞的理由，并询问 OSI 是否曾因此拒绝过许可证。
timeline.point: Questions the claim that no one can license illegal uses, citing the Berne Convention to illustrate the complexity of cross-border legal application, arguing this international complexity alone should preclude such language, and asking whether OSI has previously rejected licenses for this reason.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Further questions what "governmental laws" means without an international definition or hierarchy, and asks whether a breach could be imported to another jurisdiction via non-copyright laws such as the U.S. Alien Tort Statute or the UK Lungowe v Vedanta precedent.
timeline.point_zh: 追问「政府法律」缺乏国际定义与层级划分，并设问是否能通过美国《外国人侵权法》或英国 Lungowe v Vedanta 先例将违法违约跨司法管辖区引入。
timeline.point: Further questions what "governmental laws" means without an international definition or hierarchy, and asks whether a breach could be imported to another jurisdiction via non-copyright laws such as the U.S. Alien Tort Statute or the UK Lungowe v Vedanta precedent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Distinguishes between the duty to comply with laws and termination of the license for failing to comply; states the latter situation violates OSD #6, and asks Larry to parse the 3D Slicer sentence to explain how it does not constitute a termination condition.
timeline.point_zh: 区分「遵守法律的义务」与「因违法而终止许可」两种情形，指出后者违反 OSD 第 6 条，并请 Larry 解析 3D Slicer 该句为何不构成终止条件。
timeline.point: Distinguishes between the duty to comply with laws and termination of the license for failing to comply; states the latter situation violates OSD #6, and asks Larry to parse the 3D Slicer sentence to explain how it does not constitute a termination condition.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Argues that requiring licensees to "agree" to comply with the law turns the 3D Slicer license into a bilateral contract, and agrees such a requirement goes beyond the OSD — though government, not the licensor, penalizes unlawful use, making the clause surplusage.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 3D Slicer License 要求被许可人"同意"守法，使其成为双边合同，并认同该要求超出了 OSD；不过违法使用本就会受政府处罚，该条款可能是多余的。
timeline.point: Argues that requiring licensees to "agree" to comply with the law turns the 3D Slicer license into a bilateral contract, and agrees such a requirement goes beyond the OSD — though government, not the licensor, penalizes unlawful use, making the clause surplusage.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Argues that even if "agree" makes the 3D Slicer license a bilateral contract, the provision is enforceable and the license contrary to the OSD, treating the licensee's agreement as an enforceable condition; laments that such license debates are a waste of energy.
timeline.point_zh: 认为即使"同意"使 3D Slicer License 成为双边合同，该条款仍可执行且该许可证违反 OSD，被许可人的同意构成可执行的条件；并感叹此类许可证争论是浪费精力。
timeline.point: Argues that even if "agree" makes the 3D Slicer license a bilateral contract, the provision is enforceable and the license contrary to the OSD, treating the licensee's agreement as an enforceable condition; laments that such license debates are a waste of energy.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies the question focuses on whether the 3D Slicer clause is a condition on the copyright grant; if so, the license terminates upon unlawful use, violating OSD #6; asks Larry to explain the legal reasoning behind concluding it is not a condition.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清问题焦点在于 3D Slicer 该句是否构成版权授权的条件；若是则违法时许可终止、违反 OSD 6，请 Larry 解释如何得出「非条件」的法律结论。
timeline.point: Clarifies the question focuses on whether the 3D Slicer clause is a condition on the copyright grant; if so, the license terminates upon unlawful use, violating OSD #6; asks Larry to explain the legal reasoning behind concluding it is not a condition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Forwards the discussion back to license-review, emphasizing the question is specifically about interpreting a clause in the 3D Slicer license pending review, not about Larry's license, and hopes others on the list can contribute input.
timeline.point_zh: 将讨论转回 license-review，强调自己提问针对的是待审批的 3D Slicer 许可证条款解释，而非 Larry 的许可证，希望列表成员参与讨论。
timeline.point: Forwards the discussion back to license-review, emphasizing the question is specifically about interpreting a clause in the 3D Slicer license pending review, not about Larry's license, and hopes others on the list can contribute input.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [License-discuss] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Counters Pam's statement that the two clauses are similar: 3D Slicer's "you further agree" forms a bilateral contract with a reciprocal condition, while AFL/OSL is a unilateral contract with only the licensor making promises; the legal nature of the two is fundamentally different.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 Pam「两条款相似」的说法，指出 3D Slicer 的「you further agree」构成双边合同的条件，而 AFL/OSL 是单方合同中许可人的承诺，二者法律性质根本不同。
timeline.point: Counters Pam's statement that the two clauses are similar: 3D Slicer's "you further agree" forms a bilateral contract with a reciprocal condition, while AFL/OSL is a unilateral contract with only the licensor making promises; the legal nature of the two is fundamentally different.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [License-discuss] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Notes the discussion is about whether the 3D Slicer license violates the OSD, with Larry saying it does; questions whether debating Larry's AFL analysis is worthwhile given AFL is already OSI-approved.
timeline.point_zh: 指出讨论焦点是 3D Slicer 许可证是否违反 OSD,并认为 Larry 的立场是违反;质疑在 AFL 已获 OSI 批准的情况下,其 AFL 分析是否值得辩论。
timeline.point: Notes the discussion is about whether the 3D Slicer license violates the OSD, with Larry saying it does; questions whether debating Larry's AFL analysis is worthwhile given AFL is already OSI-approved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [License-discuss] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Reminds that the license proposer has not yet responded to basic issues such as the bundled CLA, and if they do not respond, the license is dead on arrival regardless.
timeline.point_zh: 提醒许可证提案者尚未回应捆绑 CLA 等基本问题，若仍不回应则该许可证无论如何都将夭折（DOA）。
timeline.point: Reminds that the license proposer has not yet responded to basic issues such as the bundled CLA, and if they do not respond, the license is dead on arrival regardless.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Identifies two major blockers for the 3D Slicer license (bundled CLA and export compliance legal clause), concluding it cannot be approved in its current form.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 3D Slicer 许可证存在两大障碍（捆绑 CLA、出口合规法律条款），认为当前形式无法获批。
timeline.point: Identifies two major blockers for the 3D Slicer license (bundled CLA and export compliance legal clause), concluding it cannot be approved in its current form.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [License-discuss] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether this clause constitutes a restriction on fields of endeavor by limiting the license grant.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑该条款是否通过对许可授权的限制构成了对使用领域的限制。
timeline.point: Questions whether this clause constitutes a restriction on fields of endeavor by limiting the license grant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [License-discuss] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the copyright license grant is fully extensive and merely requires legal compliance, not restricting fields of endeavor.
timeline.point_zh: 主张版权许可授权是全面的，仅需遵守法律，不构成对使用领域的限制。
timeline.point: Argues that the copyright license grant is fully extensive and merely requires legal compliance, not restricting fields of endeavor.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [License-discuss] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Reiterates the earlier point that there is no single copyright license grant.
timeline.point_zh: 重申此前观点，认为不存在单一的版权许可授权。
timeline.point: Reiterates the earlier point that there is no single copyright license grant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Rescinds the request for OSI approval of the 3D Slicer license, explaining the license cannot be changed now (past contributors are gone) and, while not a candidate for approval, it is good for its intended medical use.
timeline.point_zh: 撤回对 3D Slicer 许可证的 OSI 批准请求,称该许可证因历史贡献者缘故无法修改,虽不适合获批,但对其预期的医疗用途是合适的。
timeline.point: Rescinds the request for OSI approval of the 3D Slicer license, explaining the license cannot be changed now (past contributors are gone) and, while not a candidate for approval, it is good for its intended medical use.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: As chair of the license committee, acknowledges receipt of the withdrawal request.
timeline.point_zh: 作为许可证委员会主席确认收到撤回请求。
timeline.point: As chair of the license committee, acknowledges receipt of the withdrawal request.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Expresses understanding and suggests linking from the OSI wiki page to explain the specific issues with the license.
timeline.point_zh: 表示理解，建议在 OSI wiki 页面链接说明该许可证的具体问题。
timeline.point: Expresses understanding and suggests linking from the OSI wiki page to explain the specific issues with the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] request for review of the 3D Slicer License
timeline.snippet: Agrees with the proposed wrap-up and looks forward to adding the wiki link.
timeline.point_zh: 同意该收尾方式，期待添加 wiki 链接。
timeline.point: Agrees with the proposed wrap-up and looks forward to adding the wiki link.

license_texts.text:
License: Ritchey Permissive License v11 (Exhibit A)
Submitted: February 13, 2021, 
http://lists.opensource.org/pipermail/license-review_lists.opensource.org/2021-February/005080.html
Decision date: due no later than the first Board meeting after April 13, 
2021

License Review Committee Recommendation:

/Resolved that it is the opinion of the OSI that the Ritchey Permissive 
License v11 does not conform to the OSD and assure software freedom and 
the license is therefore not approved as an Open Source Initiative 
Certified license./

_Rationale Document_

No one but the license submitter was of the view that the license was 
suitable for approval. The license is poorly drafted and, as a result, 
there are several places where the license can be interpreted in 
different ways. The most heavily discussed license term was that 
permission is only granted for “lawful” purposes. To the extent that the 
statement means that the licensed content cannot be used for certain 
purposes because the activity may be unlawful, (which is the license 
drafter’s view, 
http://lists.opensource.org/pipermail/license-review_lists.opensource.org/2021-February/005085.html) 
the restriction is a violation of OSD 6, “No Discrimination Against 
Fields of Endeavor.”

Some commenters interpreted the reference to “lawful” as referring, not 
to extrinsic law, but to rights granted by the license. In this case, 
the phrase “permission to do anything lawful with the material which 
does not violate this license” cannot be construed. Because copyright is 
an exclusionary right, a statement of what use is permitted is a 
required element of a license. For example, distribution of a 
copyrighted work is not lawful unless permission has been granted, so if 
the license does not expressly state that distribution is allowed, 
distribution will not be “lawful.” Thus, the document might not be 
granting any rights at all.

Another example of ambiguity is that the license drafter claims that the 
license is not a copyleft license; however, it is unclear whether the 
statement “The material must entirely remain solely under this license” 
refers also to derivative works of the licensed “material” or not.

These ambiguities allow for interpretations that do not conform to the 
OSD and assure software freedom.

_Exhibit A_

Subject to the terms of this license, any legal entity who receives 
material licensed under this license is granted royalty-free, perpetual, 
non-exclusive, permission to do anything lawful with the material which 
does not violate this license. Permissions are automatically revoked 
permanently from the legal entity upon breach of this license. The 
material is provided "as is", without implied fitness for any purpose. 
All obligations to the legal entity (including warranties, liabilities, 
representations, obligations, damages, and guarantees) are disclaimed by 
all parties involved (including the authors, rights holders, copyright 
holders, patent holders, and providers of the material). The legal 
entity is responsible for all consequences of sharing the material, and 
all obligations to recipients (including warranties, liabilities, 
representations, obligations, damages, and guarantees). The material 
must entirely remain solely under this license. This license is governed 
by the laws of the province of British Columbia (as they were on April 
21, 2019), and the applicable laws of Canada (as they were on April 21, 
2019). Any legal proceedings related to this license may only occur in 
the courts of British Columbia. The legal entity must be capable of 
being bound to this entire license, and agrees to be. If any portions of 
this license are unenforceable in applicable jurisdictions, this license 
cannot be accepted. The license text is provided under these terms.

2019). Any legal proceedings related to this license may only occur in
the courts of British Columbia. The legal entity must be capable of
