S-FSL v1.3.x: Motivation for a new license

1. The license should not only protect itself but any reference given to 
the authors such as concerning their web presence. It should also 
protect to some extent against re-publishing the software at another 
site with higher page rank possibly at cost just with the intention to 
draw off traffic from the original site (like f.i. already done with 
OpenOffice). It is the right of the user at least to know about the 
primary upstream page in the web.

2. Concerning the incorporation into paid, proprietary or commercial 
software the license should offer a comparable level of protection to 
intellectual property rights as GPL does even for scripts and software 
not being compiled (You actually have to use L-GPL when incorporating 
your compiled sources into any such product. However GPL does not seem 
to give any such protection for code distributed and executed as source 
or by just in time compilation). The license should still be compatible 
with compiled.

3. Note that S-FSL requires some minimal provisions by the distributor 
regarded by the author as de-facto standard and fair use conditions: a 
free core distribution or proactive distribution of patches, updates 
including security updates and fixes to broken functionality to anyone 
who got the core distribution, no undue obstacle in obtaining them, 
secure checksums to verify the downloads. Things quite common in the 
open source sector but not with some proprietary systems: Downloaders of 
Windows can not verify their downloads with publicly trusted tools; in 
order to update OS/2 Warp 4 some 'mean tricks' i.e. insider knowledge 
was necessary before I have published that on my personal blog at 
elstel.org.

4. The license has especially been designed for people who want to 
release their shareware under an OSS-compliant version for the first 
time experimenting to get input from a broader public community. As the 
original authors retain full property rights of their software even 
after incorporating patches (compare it in this point with the SRC M3 
license) they may re-publish it under a different license like BSD or 
GPL at any time. It has been designed for the original authors to retain 
a maximum of intellectual property rights especially and also for those 
who are reluctant to make their software public domain in the first place.

5. By granting a group of developers to work on a new 'branch' other 
people can acquire similar responsibility and rights to work on an 
affiliated project.

6. The license should be compatible with the usage of patents and 
trademarks without unloading that burden to the end user.

7. The license should set a framework to facilitate contributions.

8. Distribution of programs under S-FSL should be facilitated and 
encouraged.

Note that there seems to be no other license which would even 
rudimentarily fulfill these requirements.


Many Thanks for Your Input and Contribution,

Yours Sincerely,
Elmar Stellnberger

license) they may re-publish it under a different license like BSD or
GPL at any time. It has been designed for the original authors to retain
a maximum of intellectual property rights especially and also for those
who are reluctant to make their software public domain in the first place.

5. By distributing patches you do also consent that the original authors may incorporate your patches into future versions of this program. The patched parts of the program and the patches themselves will also become subject to this licensing and may even be used for free in other programs or in the same program under different licensing as soon as you choose to publish any kind of patch; i.e. you need to be ready to share your full intellectual property rights with the original authors whenever you choose to exchange, distribute or publish any kind of patch to this program. Sharing your intellectual property means that both parties - you and the original authors - obtain the full set of rights about your modifications which were initially only associated with you. The propagation of rights extends up to usage rights for patents used in derived works including the transferability of usage rights to child and parent branches; it does however not extend up to trademarks. Trademarks used in derived works may only be used by the original authors to describe the origin of newly incorporated features if they wish to do so.

people can acquire similar responsibility and rights to work on an
affiliated project.

You may choose to develop a different branch of this program any time you want given that your new branch serves a new purpose or is sufficiently different so that the original authors do choose not to re-integrate your branch. Separate branches have another base name and their own versioning scheme. A new branch will work under the same license and have the same rights as the original concerning the incorporation and management of patches giving the original issuers of the branch equivalent rights as the original authors for the scope of their branch. Branched versions do however need to forward and share patches including all associated property rights with their parent branch. Branched versions can not re-publish under a different license or use patches, patents or other intellectual property of the maintainers of the parent branch in a new context unless explicit consent from the maintainers of the parent branch is given. Hence the propagation of rights as described in the previous paragraph does automatically work in upstream direction only. The maintainers of the original product or any of its branches may any time transfer their rights to a new or extended group of people. The new copyright holders can thereupon act as the original authors or issuers of the branch called branch maintainers.
6. The license should be compatible with the usage of patents and
trademarks without unloading that burden to the end user.

7. The term distribution describes shipping an aggregate of software, its documentation and adherent materials. Any distribution which wants to assimilate software under S-FSL needs to take the following minimal provisions: It must be possible to verify the download securely by a publicly available tool and a checksum which is exposed to the broad public. Additional keys may be provided in any kind of way. Security updates and updates against broken functionality must also be available to the public rather than just to a paying customer stock as long as they pertain to software that can either be downloaded or compiled from sources by the public and which pertain to the distribution. Note that updates do not include upgrades to future upstream versions of a program. Available to the public implies here available free of charge apart from connectivity to the internet or a reasonable charge for the reproduction of the data medium and does also pertain to the terms 'public distribution' and 'public distributor'.
7. The license should set a framework to facilitate contributions.

8. Public distributions have the advantage of not having to ship patches proactively to the original authors or copyright holders. This does not prevent the same software including its adherent materials to be additionally available at cost or privately somewhere else as long as public availability remains guaranteed at a reasonable level (f.i. download of the free parts of the distribution within some days.). A public distribution may any time also ship with adherent materials at cost such as documentation, support or additional software as long as it remains available to the public free of charge also without these adherent materials. However there must not be any undue hindrance in obtaining the distribution requiring special knowledge not known by users technically experienced in the field of the public software shipped with the distribution.
8. Distribution of programs under S-FSL should be facilitated and
encouraged.

9. Software under S-FSL that should either be used as or in a component, plug-in or add-on of 'non public' or so called 'additional' software or whenever software under S-FSL is required to run such 'non public' or 'additional' software then S-FSL imposes the restriction that the additional or non public software must also either be made available under an OSS-compliant license and free of charge or that you will need to pay for the software under S-FSL being incorporated. A license may be deemed OSS-compliant if it has been accepted by opensource.org.

rudimentarily fulfill these requirements.

10. If any of the terms stated in this license were not in accordance with local law all other parts of this license should remain valid. license_texts.message_subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
license_texts.text:
S-FSL v1.3.x: Motivation for a new license

1. The license should not only protect itself but any reference given to the authors such as concerning their web presence. The primary motivation to publish some software which should now be released under S-FSL was to attract people to the authors web page so that the ability to remove any such reference would have been a pitfall to the developers and publishers. It should also protect to some extent against re-publishing the software at another site with higher page rank possibly at cost just with the intention to draw off traffic from the original site (like f.i. already done with OpenOffice). It is the right of the user at least to know about the primary upstream page in the web.

2. Concerning the incorporation into paid, proprietary or commercial software the license should offer a comparable level of protection to intellectual property rights as GPL does even for scripts and software not being compiled (You actually have to use L-GPL when incorporating your compiled sources into any such product. However GPL does not seem to give any such protection for code distributed and executed as source or by just in time compilation).

3. Note that S-FSL requires some minimal provisions by the distributor regarded by the author as de-facto standard and fair use conditions: a free core distribution or proactive distribution of patches, updates including security updates and fixes to broken functionality to anyone who got the core distribution, no undue obstacle in obtaining them, secure checksums to verify the downloads. timeline.point_zh: 认为 S-FSL 不自由：要求补丁单独分发却禁止分发修补版本，违反 OSD 第3、4、5条；不变条款与下游限制在开源中行不通，分叉权已写入 OSD。
timeline.point: Argues the S-FSL is non-free because it requires patches to be distributed separately while forbidding distribution of patched versions, violating OSD #3, #4 and #5, and that invariant sections and downstream restrictions cannot work in OSS; the right to fork is written in the OSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Defends S-FSL’s practical author-control approach and says upcoming revisions will improve issues without sacrificing fitness for strict compliance.
timeline.point_zh: 维护 S-FSL 实用的作者控制做法，并称后续版本会改进问题但不为严格合规牺牲实用性。
timeline.point: Defends S-FSL’s practical author-control approach and says upcoming revisions will improve issues without sacrificing fitness for strict compliance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: States that failure to satisfy OSD/DFSG 3 and 5 makes S-FSL unsuitable for Debian main.
timeline.point_zh: 指出若不满足 OSD/DFSG 第 3 和第 5 条，S-FSL 就不适合进入 Debian main。
timeline.point: States that failure to satisfy OSD/DFSG 3 and 5 makes S-FSL unsuitable for Debian main.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Maintains that S-FSL complies with OSD 3 and 5 because it allows derivatives and does not discriminate against groups.
timeline.point_zh: 坚持认为 S-FSL 符合 OSD 第 3 和第 5 条，因为它允许派生作品且不歧视群体。
timeline.point: Maintains that S-FSL complies with OSD 3 and 5 because it allows derivatives and does not discriminate against groups.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Says Debian applies the DFSG rather than OSI approval and that S-FSL remains unfit for Debian main.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 Debian 使用 DFSG 而非 OSI 认证来判断自由软件，并称 S-FSL 仍不适合 Debian main。
timeline.point: Says Debian applies the DFSG rather than OSI approval and that S-FSL remains unfit for Debian main.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Argues that open source need not mean unlimited use outside copyright law and that such a view would harm business-oriented OSS models.
timeline.point_zh: 主张开源并不意味着脱离版权法的无限使用，并认为这种理解会损害面向商业的开源模式。
timeline.point: Argues that open source need not mean unlimited use outside copyright law and that such a view would harm business-oriented OSS models.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Scripting Free Software License, Version 1.3.5 (S-FSL v1.3.5)
timeline.snippet: Challenges the claim that open source sits outside copyright law and explains that copyright generally does not control mere use after lawful receipt.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑开源脱离版权法的说法，并解释合法取得软件后版权通常不能控制单纯使用。
timeline.point: Challenges the claim that open source sits outside copyright law and explains that copyright generally does not control mere use after lawful receipt.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool	Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Submits the Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License, a permissive source-code license modeled on Apache v2 but adding an open-data requirement, intended to keep health data accessible to patients, for OSI review.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License——以 Apache v2 为蓝本的宽松许可证，附加开放健康数据条款——供 OSI 审阅。
timeline.point: Submits the Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License, a permissive source-code license modeled on Apache v2 but adding an open-data requirement, intended to keep health data accessible to patients, for OSI review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Thanks Josh for the review, says the name could maybe be more generic, and asks why the three-year data window is needed.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢 Josh 的审阅，表示名称也许可以更通用，并询问为什么需要三年的数据期限。
timeline.point: Thanks Josh for the review, says the name could maybe be more generic, and asks why the three-year data window is needed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the definition should probably say "or any later version," suggests defining machine-accessible more clearly, and explains that the private-use trigger is intentional.
timeline.point_zh: 认为定义大概应写成“或任何后续版本”，建议更明确地定义 machine-accessible，并说明私人使用也触发条款是有意为之。
timeline.point: Agrees the definition should probably say "or any later version," suggests defining machine-accessible more clearly, and explains that the private-use trigger is intentional.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Questions why OSI approval is being sought at all given the GPLv3 dual-licensing, whether the new license is really more commercially palatable than the GPL, and why the code isn't simply released under GPLv3 now with the new license added later.
timeline.point_zh: 质询既然已采用 GPLv3 双许可为何还需 OSI 批准、新许可证是否真比 GPL 更受商业界欢迎、以及为何不先以 GPLv3 发布代码而日后再加新许可证。
timeline.point: Questions why OSI approval is being sought at all given the GPLv3 dual-licensing, whether the new license is really more commercially palatable than the GPL, and why the code isn't simply released under GPLv3 now with the new license added later.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says a single-license approach is possible, wants to know whether the new license will be more commercially acceptable than GPL, and agrees that releasing under GPL first is a valid fallback.
timeline.point_zh: 表示可以考虑单许可方案，想知道新许可是否会比 GPL 更容易被商业接受，并同意先按 GPL 发布是一个可行的备选方案。
timeline.point: Says a single-license approach is possible, wants to know whether the new license will be more commercially acceptable than GPL, and agrees that releasing under GPL first is a valid fallback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Thanks for the feedback, keeps the Tidepool name as a possible brand, and asks for wording help on the three-year data-access requirement.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢反馈，认为 Tidepool 名称也许可以保留作品牌，并请对方协助修正三年数据访问条款的表述。
timeline.point: Thanks for the feedback, keeps the Tidepool name as a possible brand, and asks for wording help on the three-year data-access requirement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the Open Definition citation should likely say "or any," wants clearer language for machine-accessibility, and says internal or private use should still expose data to patients.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 Open Definition 的引用大概应改成“或任何”，希望对 machine-accessibility 的表述更清晰，并表示内部或私人使用也应让患者能拿到数据。
timeline.point: Agrees the Open Definition citation should likely say "or any," wants clearer language for machine-accessibility, and says internal or private use should still expose data to patients.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Argues that CSV or XML/JSON downloads should count as machine-accessible and warns that requiring more would violate OSD #10.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CSV 或 XML/JSON 下载应算作 machine-accessible，并警告若要求更多会违反 OSD 第 10 条。
timeline.point: Argues that CSV or XML/JSON downloads should count as machine-accessible and warns that requiring more would violate OSD #10.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says the FAQ should not mandate a specific technology, but perhaps should only encourage better APIs and otherwise keep the license technology-neutral.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 FAQ 不应强制具体技术，但也许只需鼓励更好的 API，许可本身应保持技术中立。
timeline.point: Says the FAQ should not mandate a specific technology, but perhaps should only encourage better APIs and otherwise keep the license technology-neutral.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the wording is technology-agnostic enough and thinks changing the FAQ, rather than the license, is probably the better route.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这句话已经足够技术中立，并觉得改 FAQ 而不是改许可，大概是更好的做法。
timeline.point: Agrees the wording is technology-agnostic enough and thinks changing the FAQ, rather than the license, is probably the better route.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Argues the main issue is the breadth of clause 3(C): requiring data openness even for purely private or internal use violates the traditional open source user-privacy principle, and such a license may not legitimately be regardable as Open Source.
timeline.point_zh: 认为核心问题在 3(C) 条款过宽：纯内部使用也须公开数据，违背开源的用户隐私传统原则，此类许可证可能不能被视为真正的开源许可证。
timeline.point: Argues the main issue is the breadth of clause 3(C): requiring data openness even for purely private or internal use violates the traditional open source user-privacy principle, and such a license may not legitimately be regardable as Open Source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Raises multiple concerns: suggests the ECL v2 patent clause to address university worries, notes missing provisions for mid-trial and anonymous research data, argues the open data duty is met once data is handed over, and questions the three-year retention burden and UI design claims.
timeline.point_zh: 提出多项疑虑：建议参考 ECL v2 专利条款，指出缺少试验中期与匿名研究数据的例外，认为数据交付即履行开放义务，并质疑三年保留负担与 UI 设计主张。
timeline.point: Raises multiple concerns: suggests the ECL v2 patent clause to address university worries, notes missing provisions for mid-trial and anonymous research data, argues the open data duty is met once data is handed over, and questions the three-year retention burden and UI design claims.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the license is about data ownership and access, not data-subject privacy, and that privacy only matters in the definition of Open.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清该许可关注的是数据所有权和访问，而不是数据主体隐私；隐私只在 Open 的定义中起作用。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the license is about data ownership and access, not data-subject privacy, and that privacy only matters in the definition of Open.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says the key issue is continual versus one-time data access, not the file format, and recommends focusing on documented, repeated access instead of REST versus CSV.
timeline.point_zh: 认为关键是持续访问还是一次性访问，而不是文件格式；建议关注有文档、可重复访问的数据获取，而不是 REST 对 CSV。
timeline.point: Says the key issue is continual versus one-time data access, not the file format, and recommends focusing on documented, repeated access instead of REST versus CSV.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Criticizes the three-year open data clause as hard to measure, potentially unreasonable, and possibly conflicting with law, and proposes replacing it with a requirement that data remain open to the Data Owner whenever it exists in readable form on the licensee's systems.
timeline.point_zh: 批评三年开放数据条款难以衡量、可能不合理且与法律冲突，建议改为只要数据在许 可人系统上以可读形式存在，Data Owner 即可访问。
timeline.point: Criticizes the three-year open data clause as hard to measure, potentially unreasonable, and possibly conflicting with law, and proposes replacing it with a requirement that data remain open to the Data Owner whenever it exists in readable form on the licensee's systems.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Welcomes the new license's aim and agrees a research exemption is needed and coverage should extend to all personal data, but argues a mere copyright license is a weak tool to compel patient data access, suggesting a trademark/certification brand plus GPL software with private contracts instead.
timeline.point_zh: 欢迎该许可证的目标,同意需要研究豁免且应涵盖所有个人数据,但认为版权许可证难以强制开放患者数据,建议改用商标认证品牌,软件保留 GPL 并以私人合同补充。
timeline.point: Welcomes the new license's aim and agrees a research exemption is needed and coverage should extend to all personal data, but argues a mere copyright license is a weak tool to compel patient data access, suggesting a trademark/certification brand plus GPL software with private contracts instead.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says the health-data goal is confusing, asks how it fits with HIPAA and PII laws, and questions whether such data can really be open.
timeline.point_zh: 认为健康数据目标令人困惑，追问它如何与 HIPAA 和 PII 法规相容，并质疑这类数据是否真的能“开放”。
timeline.point: Says the health-data goal is confusing, asks how it fits with HIPAA and PII laws, and questions whether such data can really be open.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Asks two concrete questions about patient access and research data release, and says Tidewater still needs to figure out how to get there.
timeline.point_zh: 提出两个关于患者访问和研究数据发布的具体问题，并表示 Tidewater 仍需弄清楚如何实现目标。
timeline.point: Asks two concrete questions about patient access and research data release, and says Tidewater still needs to figure out how to get there.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether a license is needed at all since US patients are already entitled to their health data, warns it cannot guarantee the confidentiality HIPAA demands, and argues strict open source principles may be inappropriate for health data on privacy grounds.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑是否根本需要许可——美国患者本就有权获得自身健康数据；警告该许可无法保证HIPAA所要求的保密性；并认为基于隐私考虑，严格的开源原则可能不适合健康数据。
timeline.point: Questions whether a license is needed at all since US patients are already entitled to their health data, warns it cannot guarantee the confidentiality HIPAA demands, and argues strict open source principles may be inappropriate for health data on privacy grounds.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether genetic code or Henrietta Lacks-style data would count as health data, using that example to probe the license’s scope.
timeline.point_zh: 询问基因代码或 Henrietta Lacks 式的数据是否算健康数据，并借此探查许可范围。
timeline.point: Asks whether genetic code or Henrietta Lacks-style data would count as health data, using that example to probe the license’s scope.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says the thread really reduces to two questions: whether the license is open source, and whether it actually achieves Tidepool’s business goal.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这条讨论其实只剩两个问题：该许可是否算开源，以及它是否真的能实现 Tidepool 的业务目标。
timeline.point: Says the thread really reduces to two questions: whether the license is open source, and whether it actually achieves Tidepool’s business goal.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Says those are not purely lawyer questions, but agrees that whether the license achieves Tidepool’s goal is beyond what the list can settle.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这些不只是律师问题，但同意该许可是否实现 Tidepool 目标，已经超出列表能定论的范围。
timeline.point: Says those are not purely lawyer questions, but agrees that whether the license achieves Tidepool’s goal is beyond what the list can settle.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the issue needs policy and licensing experts, and suggests taking the discussion to Creative Commons or EFF as well.
timeline.point_zh: 同意这需要政策和许可专家参与，并建议也把讨论带到 Creative Commons 或 EFF。
timeline.point: Agrees the issue needs policy and licensing experts, and suggests taking the discussion to Creative Commons or EFF as well.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Consolidates responses to review feedback: will simplify the data-access language, keep the license limited to health data, believes it is HIPAA-compliant, will review ECL-2.0 for the patent language, and is considering dropping the dual-license/GPL approach.
timeline.point_zh: 汇总对评审反馈的回应:将简化数据访问条款,保持许可证仅限健康数据,认为其符合 HIPAA,将参考 ECL-2.0 审查专利条款,并考虑放弃双重许可/GPL 方式。
timeline.point: Consolidates responses to review feedback: will simplify the data-access language, keep the license limited to health data, believes it is HIPAA-compliant, will review ECL-2.0 for the patent language, and is considering dropping the dual-license/GPL approach.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward: Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether health data could include software itself, challenges the research-use workaround, and presses for a clearer answer on whether the license is actually open source.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑健康数据是否会把软件本身也包括进去，挑战研究场景下的替代说法，并追问该许可是否真的算开源。
timeline.point: Questions whether health data could include software itself, challenges the research-use workaround, and presses for a clearer answer on whether the license is actually open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that "health data" is not intended to cover software and only the data, not interpreting code, must be made available; reports enterprises reject anything referencing GPL, but will keep GPL references and dual-licensing, engaging only on the concern about offering a new license at all.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 "health data" 不涵盖软件,只要求开放数据而非解读数据的代码;称企业排斥任何提及 GPL 的许可证,但将保留 GPL 引用与双重许可,仅就是否应推出新许可证这一关切作出回应。
timeline.point: Clarifies that "health data" is not intended to cover software and only the data, not interpreting code, must be made available; reports enterprises reject anything referencing GPL, but will keep GPL references and dual-licensing, engaging only on the concern about offering a new license at all.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license	steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Questions why propose a health data license that at best affects only a small number of devices and data, arguing a statute guaranteeing all patients' rights to their own health data would be more effective than a license.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑为何要提出一项至多影响少量设备和数据的健康数据许可证，认为保障所有患者对自身健康数据权利的法律会比许可证更有效。
timeline.point: Questions why propose a health data license that at best affects only a small number of devices and data, arguing a statute guaranteeing all patients' rights to their own health data would be more effective than a license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Argues that licenses are global while laws are regional, and asks whether the license should explicitly require fully informed consent to clarify patient rights.
timeline.point_zh: 主张许可证具有全球性而法律具有地域性，并询问许可证是否应明确要求“充分知情同意”以澄清患者权利。
timeline.point: Argues that licenses are global while laws are regional, and asks whether the license should explicitly require fully informed consent to clarify patient rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for approval by license steward:	Tidepool Open Access to Health Data Software License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that legislation could also secure patient access, but says lawmaking is outside the project’s scope and the proposal aims to combine open-source and open-data licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 承认立法也能保障患者访问数据，但表示立法不在项目能力范围内，而该提案旨在结合开源与开放数据许可。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that legislation could also secure patient access, but says lawmaking is outside the project’s scope and the proposal aims to combine open-source and open-data licensing.

submissions.rejection_reason: Never approved. Health data-specific license with restrictions on data handling that went beyond what OSD allows.

submissions.name: Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Never approved. The modular approach to licensing was seen as overly complex and potentially OSD-noncompliant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source	Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Submits the Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL) draft, pairing GPL-style guaranteed source availability with BSD/MIT-style permissive redistribution; notes it is a draft lacking lawyer review and welcomes comments on wording and legality.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL) 草案,结合 GPL 式源码保障与 BSD/MIT 式宽松条款;说明尚未经律师审阅,欢迎对措辞与合法性的意见。
timeline.point: Submits the Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL) draft, pairing GPL-style guaranteed source availability with BSD/MIT-style permissive redistribution; notes it is a draft lacking lawyer review and welcomes comments on wording and legality.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Suggests looking at the Sleepycat License, which already achieves similar goals and could easily be generalized.
timeline.point_zh: 建议参考 Sleepycat 许可证，该许可证已实现类似目标且易于泛化。
timeline.point: Suggests looking at the Sleepycat License, which already achieves similar goals and could easily be generalized.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Identifies three conflicts between his goals and the suggested license — its DB-only scope, the vague 'nominal fee' for source, and its free-redistribution requirement — and proposes revised terms requiring source availability at no more than distribution cost, asking for feedback.
timeline.point_zh: 指出所荐许可证与其目标的三处冲突:仅限 DB 软件、源码 'nominal fee' 表述含糊、自由再分发要求过强,并提出修订条款,征求反馈。
timeline.point: Identifies three conflicts between his goals and the suggested license — its DB-only scope, the vague 'nominal fee' for source, and its free-redistribution requirement — and proposes revised terms requiring source availability at no more than distribution cost, asking for feedback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Points out that the license violates OSD #1 by allowing charges for source code beyond copying costs, noting it would be acceptable as a proprietary license but not for OSI review.
timeline.point_zh: 指出该许可证违反 OSD 第一条，因为它允许对源代码收取超出复制成本的费用，认为其作为专有许可证尚可但不适合提交给 OSI 审查。
timeline.point: Points out that the license violates OSD #1 by allowing charges for source code beyond copying costs, noting it would be acceptable as a proprietary license but not for OSI review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Defends the MOSL draft as not requiring royalty fees and being neutral on the issue, countering the claim that it violates OSD #1.
timeline.point_zh: 为 MOSL 草案辩护，认为其并未强制收取费用且在此问题上保持中立，反驳了违反 OSD 第一条的说法。
timeline.point: Defends the MOSL draft as not requiring royalty fees and being neutral on the issue, countering the claim that it violates OSD #1.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Insists that the license permits source code charges unrelated to copying costs, which violates OSD #1 and makes the license unworthy of serious consideration.
timeline.point_zh: 坚持认为该许可证允许收取与复制成本无关的源代码费用，违反 OSD 第一条，不值得认真考虑。
timeline.point: Insists that the license permits source code charges unrelated to copying costs, which violates OSD #1 and makes the license unworthy of serious consideration.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies the intent is to create a neutral license usable in both commercial and non-commercial software, where the base license is OSD-compliant even if commercial forks adding extra terms are not.
timeline.point_zh: 阐明其目标是创建一个中立的许可证，适用于商业和非商业软件，基础许可证本身符合 OSD，即使添加额外条款的商业分叉不符合。
timeline.point: Clarifies the intent is to create a neutral license usable in both commercial and non-commercial software, where the base license is OSD-compliant even if commercial forks adding extra terms are not.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Reiterates that the license requires source code at no more than copying cost for binary recipients, and argues that BSD and MIT also permit additional terms to be added, questioning why the same logic would not apply here.
timeline.point_zh: 重申许可证要求以不超过复制成本的价格向二进制接收者提供源代码，并指出 BSD 和 MIT 也允许添加额外条款，质疑为何不同样适用于此处。
timeline.point: Reiterates that the license requires source code at no more than copying cost for binary recipients, and argues that BSD and MIT also permit additional terms to be added, questioning why the same logic would not apply here.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Argues against a license built to be modified: arbitrary additions could leave it no longer open source, and a modifiable license would worsen license proliferation by exploding the number of license combinations lawyers must analyze.
timeline.point_zh: 反对允许任意添加条款的"可修改许可证"：它可能不再是开源，且会加剧许可证泛滥，使需律师分析的许可证组合数量爆炸式增长。
timeline.point: Argues against a license built to be modified: arbitrary additions could leave it no longer open source, and a modifiable license would worsen license proliferation by exploding the number of license combinations lawyers must analyze.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies he wants a license permitting derivative works to be relicensed under a superset of its terms, like BSD and MIT, not a modifiable one; also considers deriving from the Sleepycat license and asks whether renaming it is permissible without owning its copyright.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清想要的并非可修改的许可证，而是如 BSD、MIT 般允许衍生作品以原条款超集再授权的许可证；并考虑基于 Sleepycat 改写，询问不拥有其版权能否改名。
timeline.point: Clarifies he wants a license permitting derivative works to be relicensed under a superset of its terms, like BSD and MIT, not a modifiable one; also considers deriving from the Sleepycat license and asks whether renaming it is permissible without owning its copyright.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Warns that without explicit terms on what derivative works can and cannot add, contradictory terms could be introduced, and notes that Sleepycat is a trademark requiring permission to reference.
timeline.point_zh: 警告若不对衍生作品允许和禁止的条款做出明确规定，可能引入相互矛盾的条款，并指出 Sleepycat 是商标，需获得许可方可引用。
timeline.point: Warns that without explicit terms on what derivative works can and cannot add, contradictory terms could be introduced, and notes that Sleepycat is a trademark requiring permission to reference.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Corrects himself that Sleepycat is now owned by Oracle and dismisses the trademark concern as impractical.
timeline.point_zh: 自我更正 Sleepycat 现归 Oracle 所有，认为商标问题不切实际而放弃。
timeline.point: Corrects himself that Sleepycat is now owned by Oracle and dismisses the trademark concern as impractical.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Expresses enthusiasm for a generic OSI-approved version of the Sleepycat License and asks if there is a current recommendation for creating similar licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 对泛化的 OSI 批准版 Sleepycat 许可证表示支持，并询问目前是否有创建类似许可证的建议。
timeline.point: Expresses enthusiasm for a generic OSI-approved version of the Sleepycat License and asks if there is a current recommendation for creating similar licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Argues that the redistribution conditions inherently prevent contradictory derivative terms, decides to stick with the MOSL name since Oracle would not grant trademark permission, and asks whether copying Sleepycat license text raises copyright concerns.
timeline.point_zh: 主张再分发条件本身可防止衍生作品引入矛盾条款，决定继续使用 MOSL 名称（因 Oracle 不太可能授权商标），并询问复制 Sleepycat 许可证文本是否涉及版权问题。
timeline.point: Argues that the redistribution conditions inherently prevent contradictory derivative terms, decides to stick with the MOSL name since Oracle would not grant trademark permission, and asks whether copying Sleepycat license text raises copyright concerns.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Points out that the license text explicitly states source code must be available at no more than the cost of distribution, refuting the claim that it permits arbitrary charges.
timeline.point_zh: 指出许可证文本明确说明源代码必须以不超过分发成本的价格提供，反驳了其允许任意收费的说法。
timeline.point: Points out that the license text explicitly states source code must be available at no more than the cost of distribution, refuting the claim that it permits arbitrary charges.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Agrees the license wording achieves the stated goals but notes it is not obvious to readers and recommends creating a FAQ to clarify.
timeline.point_zh: 认为许可证措辞确实达到了预期目标，但指出对读者而言不够明确，建议创建常见问题解答页面加以说明。
timeline.point: Agrees the license wording achieves the stated goals but notes it is not obvious to readers and recommends creating a FAQ to clarify.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Asks for clarification on whether the license intends original code to remain under unchanged terms while derivative works must include the original terms plus may add arbitrary additional terms.
timeline.point_zh: 询问许可证是否意图为原始代码保持不变的条款，而衍生作品必须包含原始条款并可添加任意额外条款。
timeline.point: Asks for clarification on whether the license intends original code to remain under unchanged terms while derivative works must include the original terms plus may add arbitrary additional terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Interprets the license as allowing only non-contradictory additional terms in derivative works, not arbitrary terms, such that source code access cannot be denied to recipients.
timeline.point_zh: 将许可证解读为衍生作品仅允许添加不与原始条款矛盾的额外条款而非任意条款，例如不得拒绝接收者获取源代码。
timeline.point: Interprets the license as allowing only non-contradictory additional terms in derivative works, not arbitrary terms, such that source code access cannot be denied to recipients.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Notes that determining whether additional terms contradict the original license is ambiguous and undefined, unlike the GPL which explicitly states "no further restrictions."
timeline.point_zh: 指出判断额外条款是否与原始许可证矛盾存在歧义且未明确定义，不像 GPL 明确规定「不得添加进一步限制」。
timeline.point: Notes that determining whether additional terms contradict the original license is ambiguous and undefined, unlike the GPL which explicitly states "no further restrictions."

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Explains that permissive licenses like BSD do not impose terms on downstream licensees, so derivative works can use any license, using Microsoft's use of BSD code in closed-source Windows as an example.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 BSD 等宽松许可证不对下游许可方施加条款，因此衍生作品可使用任何许可证，以微软在闭源 Windows 中使用 BSD 代码为例。
timeline.point: Explains that permissive licenses like BSD do not impose terms on downstream licensees, so derivative works can use any license, using Microsoft's use of BSD code in closed-source Windows as an example.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Notes that the BSD license does not require source code publication, which is why Microsoft's closed-source use of BSD code does not create a contradiction.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 BSD 许可证不要求发布源代码，因此微软闭源使用 BSD 代码并不构成矛盾。
timeline.point: Notes that the BSD license does not require source code publication, which is why Microsoft's closed-source use of BSD code does not create a contradiction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Bulk] Re: Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Explains that the goal is to ensure additional licensing terms on derivative works do not alter the meaning of the original terms.
timeline.point_zh: 解释其目标是确保衍生作品上的附加许可条款不改变原条款的含义。
timeline.point: Explains that the goal is to ensure additional licensing terms on derivative works do not alter the meaning of the original terms.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Bulk] Re: Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Argues that the previous proposal depended on a 'reasonable conditions' clause that controlled derivative works, which the author intends to remove.
timeline.point_zh: 认为此前提案依赖于控制衍生作品的 'reasonable conditions' 条款,作者有意将其移除。
timeline.point: Argues that the previous proposal depended on a 'reasonable conditions' clause that controlled derivative works, which the author intends to remove.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [Bulk] Re: Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Argues the deleted 'reasonable conditions' clause was a legal loophole allowing arbitrary source-redistribution requirements, and proposes GPL-style wording ('a work based on it') to keep derivative works bound, asking whether that version would work as intended.
timeline.point_zh: 认为被删的"合理条件"条款是允许对源码再分发强加任意要求的法律漏洞；建议改用 GPL 式"基于原作品"表述使衍生作品仍受约束，并询问这样是否可行。
timeline.point: Argues the deleted 'reasonable conditions' clause was a legal loophole allowing arbitrary source-redistribution requirements, and proposes GPL-style wording ('a work based on it') to keep derivative works bound, asking whether that version would work as intended.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Approval : Modular Open-source Software License (MOSL)
timeline.snippet: Contains only a quoted-reply lead-in after cleanup, with no substantive MOSL review comment preserved.
timeline.point_zh: 清洗后只剩引用回复引导语，没有保留实质 MOSL 审查意见。
timeline.point: Contains only a quoted-reply lead-in after cleanup, with no substantive MOSL review comment preserved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Submits a very short public-domain-style license for approval and asks for suggestions.
timeline.point_zh: 提交一个很短、近似公有领域风格的许可证供审批，并请大家提出建议。
timeline.point: Submits a very short public-domain-style license for approval and asks for suggestions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Responds to feedback by revising the license to be more explicit and to permit removing notices, while arguing that existing OSI licenses do not cover that use case.
timeline.point_zh: 回应反馈，对许可证作出更明确的修订并允许修改或移除通知，同时认为现有 OSI 许可证并不覆盖这一用例。
timeline.point: Responds to feedback by revising the license to be more explicit and to permit removing notices, while arguing that existing OSI licenses do not cover that use case.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Questions why the submitter is creating a near-MIT variant and says a new license should first justify the problem it solves.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑为什么要创建一个近似 MIT 的变体，并认为新的许可证应先说明其要解决的问题。
timeline.point: Questions why the submitter is creating a near-MIT variant and says a new license should first justify the problem it solves.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Defends the Svoboda text as materially different because it allows removing notices, which the submitter says existing OSI licenses do not allow.
timeline.point_zh: 为 Svoboda 文本辩护，认为它因为允许移除通知而实质不同，并称现有 OSI 许可证不允许这样做。
timeline.point: Defends the Svoboda text as materially different because it allows removing notices, which the submitter says existing OSI licenses do not allow.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says notice removal is not special, questions the idea of letting users modify the license itself, and asks what problem the new license solves.
timeline.point_zh: 认为移除通知并不特殊，质疑让用户自行修改许可证本身的做法，并再次询问该许可证要解决什么问题。
timeline.point: Says notice removal is not special, questions the idea of letting users modify the license itself, and asks what problem the new license solves.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says the need for a replacement license was already explained before, and warns that removing notices may have unwanted legal consequences.
timeline.point_zh: 表示之前已经说明过替代许可证的需求，并警告移除通知可能带来不想要的法律后果。
timeline.point: Says the need for a replacement license was already explained before, and warns that removing notices may have unwanted legal consequences.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says the goal is to dedicate the work to the public domain in every jurisdiction.
timeline.point_zh: 表示自己的目标是让作品在任何司法辖区都进入公有领域。
timeline.point: Says the goal is to dedicate the work to the public domain in every jurisdiction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Asks why the submitter is not using CC0 instead.
timeline.point_zh: 询问为什么不直接使用 CC0。
timeline.point: Asks why the submitter is not using CC0 instead.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Rejects CC0 because it is not OSI-approved and is too long for the goal.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CC0 既不是 OSI 认可的许可，也太长，不适合该目标。
timeline.point: Rejects CC0 because it is not OSI-approved and is too long for the goal.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Explains that public domain is hard to achieve across jurisdictions and argues CC0 is thorough because it works around that problem.
timeline.point_zh: 解释公有领域在不同法域下难以实现，并认为 CC0 因为周全而能绕开这一问题。
timeline.point: Explains that public domain is hard to achieve across jurisdictions and argues CC0 is thorough because it works around that problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Asks why the Unlicense is not approved.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 Unlicense 为什么没有被批准。
timeline.point: Asks why the Unlicense is not approved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says asking the problem first is insightful and can help people solve their own issue.
timeline.point_zh: 认为先问清问题很有见地，也常能帮助对方自己解决问题。
timeline.point: Says asking the problem first is insightful and can help people solve their own issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Mocks the idea of un-copyrighting and says it would require reversing international copyright law.
timeline.point_zh: 嘲讽“去版权化”的想法，并说这需要逆转国际版权法。
timeline.point: Mocks the idea of un-copyrighting and says it would require reversing international copyright law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Defends CC0 as a thorough but necessarily long attempt to waive copyright worldwide and solve the public-domain problem.
timeline.point_zh: 为 CC0 辩护，认为它篇幅长是因为要尽量在全球范围内放弃版权并解决公有领域问题。
timeline.point: Defends CC0 as a thorough but necessarily long attempt to waive copyright worldwide and solve the public-domain problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Dismisses the request to strip notices as a "crayon license" idea.
timeline.point_zh: 把删除所有标识和声明的要求斥为“蜡笔式许可”。
timeline.point: Dismisses the request to strip notices as a "crayon license" idea.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Argues Unlicense was probably never formally submitted, is not really a license, and is likely doomed for approval.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Unlicense 可能根本没有正式提交，也未必算真正的许可证，获批前景大概率不乐观。
timeline.point: Argues Unlicense was probably never formally submitted, is not really a license, and is likely doomed for approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Agrees that explaining the problem a new license solves should have been required from the beginning.
timeline.point_zh: 同意从一开始就应该要求说明新许可证所解决的问题。
timeline.point: Agrees that explaining the problem a new license solves should have been required from the beginning.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Makes a joking aside that crayons inspire creativity and wonder.
timeline.point_zh: 开玩笑说蜡笔能激发创造力和惊奇感。
timeline.point: Makes a joking aside that crayons inspire creativity and wonder.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the author has read the Open Source FAQ entry on public domain.
timeline.point_zh: 询问对方是否读过开放源代码 FAQ 中关于公有领域的条目。
timeline.point: Asks whether the author has read the Open Source FAQ entry on public domain.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Cancels the submission because it does not achieve the desired result and complains that copyright cannot be undone.
timeline.point_zh: 因许可未能实现预期目标而取消提交，并抱怨版权无法被撤销。
timeline.point: Cancels the submission because it does not achieve the desired result and complains that copyright cannot be undone.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Asks what the author actually wants and suggests existing permissive options instead of wasting time on ultra-short public-domain-style requests.
timeline.point_zh: 追问作者究竟想实现什么，并建议直接选现成的宽松许可，而不是继续折腾超短的类公有领域方案。
timeline.point: Asks what the author actually wants and suggests existing permissive options instead of wasting time on ultra-short public-domain-style requests.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says the goal is not really possible, but notes he is using the MirOS license for full freedom.
timeline.point_zh: 表示这一目标其实做不到，但补充说自己正在使用 MirOS 许可证以获得完全自由。
timeline.point: Says the goal is not really possible, but notes he is using the MirOS license for full freedom.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Argues that a permissive license like MIT or MirOS still gives full freedom without losing rights.
timeline.point_zh: 主张像 MIT 或 MirOS 这样的宽松许可同样能给出完全自由，而且不会让你失去权利。
timeline.point: Argues that a permissive license like MIT or MirOS still gives full freedom without losing rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Svoboda for Approval
timeline.snippet: Says he wants full freedom and notes that he is using the MirOS license.
timeline.point_zh: 表示自己想要完全自由，并说明自己正在使用 MirOS 许可证。
timeline.point: Says he wants full freedom and notes that he is using the MirOS license.

submissions.rejection_reason: Never approved. The license was seen as a vanity project that didn't meet OSD requirements.

submissions.name: Python License Changes
aliases: Python-2.0 Modification Proposal (2011)
PSF Python License Revision

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Proposed changes to the existing Python (PSF/CNRI) license — a modification of python-2-0, not a new license — were never approved; the 2011 discussion wound down with no board decision.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Asks for the current status of the three Python license items.
timeline.point_zh: 询问这三个 Python 许可证事项的当前状态。
timeline.point: Asks for the current status of the three Python license items.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Says the proposed changes looked fine before and still look fine now.
timeline.point_zh: 表示这些拟议修改之前看起来没问题，现在仍然没问题。
timeline.point: Says the proposed changes looked fine before and still look fine now.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the update and says there is no concern.
timeline.point_zh: 确认收到更新，并表示没有问题。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the update and says there is no concern.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Asks for the current status of three pending Python license items.
timeline.point_zh: 询问三个待处理的 Python 许可证事项目前的状态。
timeline.point: Asks for the current status of three pending Python license items.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Says the proposed changes looked fine before and still look fine now.
timeline.point_zh: 表示这些拟议修改之前看起来没问题，现在仍然没问题。
timeline.point: Says the proposed changes looked fine before and still look fine now.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Thanks Karl for the update and says there is no concern.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢 Karl 的更新，并表示没有疑虑。
timeline.point: Thanks Karl for the update and says there is no concern.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Questions why Python needs three licenses and argues that the split will confuse users and worsen license proliferation.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 Python 为何需要三种许可证，并认为这会让用户困惑，也会加剧许可证扩散。
timeline.point: Questions why Python needs three licenses and argues that the split will confuse users and worsen license proliferation.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Explains that the changes are meant to reconcile existing legacy licenses and make Python licensing terminology clearer.
timeline.point_zh: 说明这些变更是为了整合既有旧许可证，并把 Python 许可证的表述变得更明确。
timeline.point: Explains that the changes are meant to reconcile existing legacy licenses and make Python licensing terminology clearer.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Questions why Python still needs multiple licenses and urges the foundation to consolidate under a single existing license.
timeline.point_zh: 询问为什么 Python 仍需要多个许可证，并主张尽量统一到一个现有许可证上。
timeline.point: Questions why Python still needs multiple licenses and urges the foundation to consolidate under a single existing license.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Suggests that only the top-level Python license is operative and the older notices persist mainly because they must be carried forward.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Python 主要只有顶层许可证在起作用，旧许可证更多是因为必须随衍生代码保留。
timeline.point: Suggests that only the top-level Python license is operative and the older notices persist mainly because they must be carried forward.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Argues that stacked permissive notices effectively collapse to the most recent license, while also reiterating his anti-patent view.
timeline.point_zh: 主张层叠的宽松许可证实际上会收敛为最新许可证，同时重申其反专利立场。
timeline.point: Argues that stacked permissive notices effectively collapse to the most recent license, while also reiterating his anti-patent view.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Uses MySQL as an example of how due diligence can expose layered licensing and mistaken assumptions about software ownership.
timeline.point_zh: 以 MySQL 为例，说明尽职调查会暴露层叠许可证，也会纠正对软件所有权的误解。
timeline.point: Uses MySQL as an example of how due diligence can expose layered licensing and mistaken assumptions about software ownership.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Supports the relicensing work as a clarification effort that distinguishes Python distributions and makes the PSF license usable on its own.
timeline.point_zh: 支持这次改动是为了区分不同 Python 分发并让 PSF 许可证可单独使用，而不是为了额外创造新权利。
timeline.point: Supports the relicensing work as a clarification effort that distinguishes Python distributions and makes the PSF license usable on its own.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Explains that a GPL program may contain components under other operative licenses such as Apache, whose patent-litigation termination conditions still apply, and remarks that he likes how defensive patent-termination clauses make patent lawsuits potentially costlier for plaintiffs.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 GPL 程序可能包含适用其他有效许可证（如 Apache）的组件，其专利诉讼终止条款仍然有效，并表示欣赏防御性专利终止条款让专利诉讼对原告代价更高。
timeline.point: Explains that a GPL program may contain components under other operative licenses such as Apache, whose patent-litigation termination conditions still apply, and remarks that he likes how defensive patent-termination clauses make patent lawsuits potentially costlier for plaintiffs.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Suggests CNRI could relicense its older code under 2.1 and asks for an explicit steward-updated clause in Python 2.1.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 CNRI 将旧代码改为可按 2.1 分发，并主张 Python 2.1 应明确允许许可证由维护者更新。
timeline.point: Suggests CNRI could relicense its older code under 2.1 and asks for an explicit steward-updated clause in Python 2.1.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Says CNRI was not clearly a willing contributor and that Guido relied on informal permission to open-source Python.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 CNRI 并非明确愿意贡献者，而 Guido 是依赖非正式许可才将 Python 开源。
timeline.point: Says CNRI was not clearly a willing contributor and that Guido relied on informal permission to open-source Python.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Reviews the three proposed Python licenses, finding them largely OSD-compliant but questioning the OSD-compliance of the 'brief summary' clause 3, which PSF should drop absent legacy pressure; also proposes SPDX naming identifiers.
timeline.point_zh: 审查三项 Python 相关许可证提案,认为基本符合 OSD,但质疑第 3 条 brief summary 要求的 OSD 合规性,并提出 SPDX 命名标识。
timeline.point: Reviews the three proposed Python licenses, finding them largely OSD-compliant but questioning the OSD-compliance of the 'brief summary' clause 3, which PSF should drop absent legacy pressure; also proposes SPDX naming identifiers.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Repeats that prior approvals are not controlling and that CNRI should be asked to remove the clause.
timeline.point_zh: 再次强调过去的批准并不具有约束力，并认为应要求 CNRI 删除该条款。
timeline.point: Repeats that prior approvals are not controlling and that CNRI should be asked to remove the clause.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Argues that the brief-summary clause is OSD-compliant and useful, even if it is somewhat burdensome.
timeline.point_zh: 认为简要总结条款符合 OSD 且有用，尽管它会带来一些负担。
timeline.point: Argues that the brief-summary clause is OSD-compliant and useful, even if it is somewhat burdensome.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Argues the brief-summary clause is OSD-incompatible because it imposes an arbitrary burden on derived-work distributors and can make redistribution effectively too difficult; adds that it defeats its own purpose, since broader access yields better summaries.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该 brief summary 条款不符合 OSD:给衍生作品发布者强加任意负担,可能使再发布实际不可行;且与自身目的相悖,让更多人接触修改才能写出更好的摘要。
timeline.point: Argues the brief-summary clause is OSD-incompatible because it imposes an arbitrary burden on derived-work distributors and can make redistribution effectively too difficult; adds that it defeats its own purpose, since broader access yields better summaries.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Reviews the three proposed Python licenses, finding them largely OSD-compliant but questioning the OSD-compliance of the 'brief summary' clause 3, which PSF should drop absent legacy pressure; also proposes SPDX naming identifiers.
timeline.point_zh: 审查三项 Python 相关许可证提案,认为基本符合 OSD,但质疑第 3 条 brief summary 要求的 OSD 合规性,并提出 SPDX 命名标识。
timeline.point: Reviews the three proposed Python licenses, finding them largely OSD-compliant but questioning the OSD-compliance of the 'brief summary' clause 3, which PSF should drop absent legacy pressure; also proposes SPDX naming identifiers.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Says past approvals do not bind current review, notes that the patch-file analogy is not exact, and endorses asking CNRI to remove the clause.
timeline.point_zh: 指出过去的批准不约束当前审查，补丁文件类比并不完全相同，并支持向 CNRI 争取删除该条款。
timeline.point: Says past approvals do not bind current review, notes that the patch-file analogy is not exact, and endorses asking CNRI to remove the clause.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Argues the brief-summary clause is OSD-incompatible because it imposes an arbitrary burden on derived-work distributors and can make redistribution effectively too difficult; adds that it defeats its own purpose, since broader access yields better summaries.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该 brief summary 条款不符合 OSD:给衍生作品发布者强加任意负担,可能使再发布实际不可行;且与自身目的相悖,让更多人接触修改才能写出更好的摘要。
timeline.point: Argues the brief-summary clause is OSD-incompatible because it imposes an arbitrary burden on derived-work distributors and can make redistribution effectively too difficult; adds that it defeats its own purpose, since broader access yields better summaries.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Asks who defines the 'wants to make the derivative work available' condition and the required summary's nature, questions whether a patch file would satisfy the brief-summary clause, and urges consulting Python community practice, preferring deference to legacy over style.
timeline.point_zh: 追问谁界定"愿意提供衍生作品"条件及摘要的性质,质疑补丁文件能否满足 brief summary 要求,建议参考 Python 社区实际惯例,主张尊重先例甚于文风。
timeline.point: Asks who defines the 'wants to make the derivative work available' condition and the required summary's nature, questions whether a patch file would satisfy the brief-summary clause, and urges consulting Python community practice, preferring deference to legacy over style.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Says the clause is either unnecessary or problematic depending on how PSF interprets 'summary', and asks PSF to respond.
timeline.point_zh: 指出该条款要么多余，要么有问题，取决于 PSF 如何理解“摘要”，并在等 PSF 回复。
timeline.point: Says the clause is either unnecessary or problematic depending on how PSF interprets 'summary', and asks PSF to respond.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Says PSF needs to check CNRI's legacy constraints before deciding how to proceed.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 PSF 需要先弄清 CNRI 的历史约束，再决定下一步怎么做。
timeline.point: Says PSF needs to check CNRI's legacy constraints before deciding how to proceed.

timeline.subject: FOR APPROVAL - Python License Changes
timeline.snippet: Agrees to split the discussion into three threads and notes the board meeting date as a useful deadline.
timeline.point_zh: 同意把讨论拆成三条线程，并指出董事会会议日期可作为时间节点。
timeline.point: Agrees to split the discussion into three threads and notes the board meeting date as a useful deadline.
