timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Summarizes the process: GAP has been submitted, the board will judge it against the current OSD, and the position papers being drafted are based on the OSD as it exists, not as either side wishes it to be.
timeline.point_zh: 总结流程：GAP 已提交，董事会将依据当前 OSD 进行评判，而正在起草的立场文件基于现行 OSD，而非双方期望的修改版本。
timeline.point: Summarizes the process: GAP has been submitted, the board will judge it against the current OSD, and the position papers being drafted are based on the OSD as it exists, not as either side wishes it to be.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: GAP violates OSD #10, #3, and possibly #6; OSI's mission is to promote the existing OSD, established before OSI's founding, so changing the OSD to accommodate attribution provisions would be unwise.
timeline.point_zh: GAP违反OSD #10、#3，可能还有#6；OSI的使命是推广OSI成立前已确立的现行OSD，为署名条款修改OSD并不明智。
timeline.point: GAP violates OSD #10, #3, and possibly #6; OSI's mission is to promote the existing OSD, established before OSI's founding, so changing the OSD to accommodate attribution provisions would be unwise.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Agrees that Mayfield is not closely following the discussion, but notes this is his own problem. Points out that Socialtext's confusion of Exhibit B with GAP is their fault, as the two are completely different, and that clarification is unlikely to change the board's decision.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 Mayfield 没有密切关注讨论，但指出这是他自己的问题。指出 Socialtext 将 Exhibit B 与 GAP 混为一谈是其自身错误，两者完全不同，且澄清不太可能改变董事会的决定。
timeline.point: Agrees that Mayfield is not closely following the discussion, but notes this is his own problem. Points out that Socialtext's confusion of Exhibit B with GAP is their fault, as the two are completely different, and that clarification is unlikely to change the board's decision.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Argues GAP licences violate OSD #3 by imposing runtime behaviour (logo display) rather than mere distribution attribution, warns approval would invite similar constraint licences, and says companies wanting this could bundle a proprietary logo library instead.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 GAP 许可证强制运行时行为(标志展示)而非仅分发时署名,违反 OSD #3,批准将招致类似约束的许可证;想要此效果的公司本可捆绑展示标志的专有库。
timeline.point: Argues GAP licences violate OSD #3 by imposing runtime behaviour (logo display) rather than mere distribution attribution, warns approval would invite similar constraint licences, and says companies wanting this could bundle a proprietary logo library instead.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Argues that GPL Section 2c already imposes runtime display requirements (copyright notice and warranty), making it incorrect to claim GPL has no runtime constraints. Explains why GAP fails OSD #10 while GPL passes.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 GPL 第 2c 条已经要求交互式程序运行时显示版权和免责声明，因此 GPL 也有运行时约束。解释了为何 GAP 违反 OSD #10 而 GPL 不违反。
timeline.point: Argues that GPL Section 2c already imposes runtime display requirements (copyright notice and warranty), making it incorrect to claim GPL has no runtime constraints. Explains why GAP fails OSD #10 while GPL passes.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Asks whether requiring an unalterable displayed logo (as part of the modifiable work) can be declared off-limits without violating OSD #3, provided OSD #10 is circumvented. Questions if a graphical logo is part of the modifiable work.
timeline.point_zh: 询问在规避 OSD #10 的前提下，能否将强制显示的 logo 视为不可修改的行为而不违反 OSD #3。质疑图形 logo 是否属于可修改作品的一部分。
timeline.point: Asks whether requiring an unalterable displayed logo (as part of the modifiable work) can be declared off-limits without violating OSD #3, provided OSD #10 is circumvented. Questions if a graphical logo is part of the modifiable work.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Responds that a required logo display is not part of the modifiable work itself, just as the GPL requires displaying copyright facts that cannot be changed. Notes that previous attribution requirements also did not allow modification of their format.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称强制显示的 logo 不属于可修改作品的一部分，正如 GPL 要求显示不可更改的版权信息一样。指出此前的归属要求也不允许修改其格式。
timeline.point: Responds that a required logo display is not part of the modifiable work itself, just as the GPL requires displaying copyright facts that cannot be changed. Notes that previous attribution requirements also did not allow modification of their format.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Argues the MuleSource Exhibit B badgeware display requirement interferes with usage and creates two classes of users, violating OSD #6 as its authors intended — unlike copyleft, which imposes no usage limits; OSI judges only the open source side.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 MuleSource Exhibit B badgeware 的展示要求干扰使用并制造两类用户,违反 OSD #6 制定本意;copyleft 不限制使用,OSI 只评判开源一侧。
timeline.point: Argues the MuleSource Exhibit B badgeware display requirement interferes with usage and creates two classes of users, violating OSD #6 as its authors intended — unlike copyleft, which imposes no usage limits; OSI judges only the open source side.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Strongly agrees with Rick Moen's statement that OSI only cares about the open source side of licensing and is not in the business of ensuring customer treatment.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈同意 Rick Moen 关于 OSI 只关心许可证的开源方面、而非确保客户待遇的说法。
timeline.point: Strongly agrees with Rick Moen's statement that OSI only cares about the open source side of licensing and is not in the business of ensuring customer treatment.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Clarifies nothing is inherently wrong with mandated display advertising, but SugarCRM's, MuleSource's, and Socialtext's badgeware licences may still fail OSD #6; Socialtext's GAP is also procedurally defective, being a patch rather than a licence.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清强制展示广告的许可证本身并无不妥,但 SugarCRM、MuleSource、Socialtext 的 badgeware 许可证仍可能不符合 OSD #6;且 GAP 只是补丁而非许可证,提交存在程序缺陷。
timeline.point: Clarifies nothing is inherently wrong with mandated display advertising, but SugarCRM's, MuleSource's, and Socialtext's badgeware licences may still fail OSD #6; Socialtext's GAP is also procedurally defective, being a patch rather than a licence.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Concurs that OSD #10 is sufficient to reject MPL 1.1 + GAP as non-compliant, and OSI's process approves or rejects license texts as submitted.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 OSD #10 足以判定 MPL 1.1 + GAP 不合规，且 OSI 流程按提交的文本进行审批。
timeline.point: Concurs that OSD #10 is sufficient to reject MPL 1.1 + GAP as non-compliant, and OSI's process approves or rejects license texts as submitted.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Traces OSD #10's origin to banning mandated click-wrap acceptance technologies and argues the same principle applies now: GAP's mandated attribution technology for derivative works lacks the strongest justification and would not conform to OSD #10.
timeline.point_zh: 追溯 OSD #10 的由来是为禁止强制点击接受技术,主张同理,GAP 对衍生作品强制指定归属技术缺乏最有力依据,且将不符合 OSD #10。
timeline.point: Traces OSD #10's origin to banning mandated click-wrap acceptance technologies and argues the same principle applies now: GAP's mandated attribution technology for derivative works lacks the strongest justification and would not conform to OSD #10.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Thanks Lawrence Rosen for clarifying the history of OSD #10 and for his courage in acknowledging past mistakes, contributing to the community's greater good.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢 Lawrence Rosen 澄清 OSD #10 的历史，并赞扬其承认过去错误的勇气，为社区做出了贡献。
timeline.point: Thanks Lawrence Rosen for clarifying the history of OSD #10 and for his courage in acknowledging past mistakes, contributing to the community's greater good.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Argues OSD #6 bars only outright field-of-use prohibitions, not terms some users find unpalatable, citing GPL and AAL precedent; maintains SocialText's license creates a single class of users and targets no specific field of endeavor.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSD #6 只禁止绝对的领域使用禁令,而非令人不快的条款,并举 GPL 与 AAL 为例;坚持 SocialText 的许可证只产生单一用户类别,未针对特定领域。
timeline.point: Argues OSD #6 bars only outright field-of-use prohibitions, not terms some users find unpalatable, citing GPL and AAL precedent; maintains SocialText's license creates a single class of users and targets no specific field of endeavor.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Dismisses the hypothetical offensive logo argument as irrelevant, noting none of the actual examples involve offensive logos. Questions why people keep debating OSD #6 when all agree OSD #10 already disqualifies GAP.
timeline.point_zh: 认为攻击性 logo 的假设场景无关紧要，因为实际案例中没有出现攻击性 logo。质疑既然大家都同意 OSD #10 已经否决了 GAP，为何还要争论 OSD #6。
timeline.point: Dismisses the hypothetical offensive logo argument as irrelevant, noting none of the actual examples involve offensive logos. Questions why people keep debating OSD #6 when all agree OSD #10 already disqualifies GAP.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that his argument was never about offensive logos, but rather that requiring display of three text phrases is easier to commercially redistribute than requiring display of a commercial logo.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清其论点并非关于攻击性 logo，而是要求显示三段文字比要求显示商业 logo 更容易进行商业再分发。
timeline.point: Clarifies that his argument was never about offensive logos, but rather that requiring display of three text phrases is easier to commercially redistribute than requiring display of a commercial logo.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Points out that GPL Section 2c already does what Rick Moen described — requires some displayed crediting of the original copyright holder while remaining OSD-compliant.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 GPL 第 2c 条已经实现了 Rick Moen 所描述的效果——要求显示原始版权持有者的归属信息，同时保持 OSD 合规。
timeline.point: Points out that GPL Section 2c already does what Rick Moen described — requires some displayed crediting of the original copyright holder while remaining OSD-compliant.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Criticizes Ben Tilly for ignoring OSD #6's posted rationale, asserts that Exhibit B licenses create two classes of users, and maintains that the OSI Board—not the market—decides which licenses are open source.
timeline.point_zh: 批评 Ben Tilly 忽视 OSD #6 的制定理由，主张 Exhibit B 许可证创建了两类用户，并坚持由 OSI 董事会而非市场决定哪些许可证是开源的。
timeline.point: Criticizes Ben Tilly for ignoring OSD #6's posted rationale, asserts that Exhibit B licenses create two classes of users, and maintains that the OSI Board—not the market—decides which licenses are open source.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Thanks Lawrence Rosen for clarifying that OSD #10 was written in response to mandatory click-wrap license interfaces, not AAL.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢 Lawrence Rosen 澄清 OSD #10 是针对强制 click-wrap 许可接口而制定的，而非 AAL。
timeline.point: Thanks Lawrence Rosen for clarifying that OSD #10 was written in response to mandatory click-wrap license interfaces, not AAL.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Explains two reasons for raising OSD #6: (1) expects a future submission similar to GAP but without the OSD #10 flaw, and (2) the most frequent challenge to open source has always been attempts to restrict commercial usage.
timeline.point_zh: 解释提出 OSD #6 的两个原因：(1) 预期未来会有类似 GAP 但无 OSD #10 漏洞的许可证提交；(2) 对开源最频繁的挑战始终是试图限制商业使用的尝试。
timeline.point: Explains two reasons for raising OSD #6: (1) expects a future submission similar to GAP but without the OSD #10 flaw, and (2) the most frequent challenge to open source has always been attempts to restrict commercial usage.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Suggests that only one of the three issues Rick Moen identified with GAP is actually a mistake, leaving it to readers to determine which.
timeline.point_zh: 暗示 Rick Moen 指出的 GAP 三个问题中只有一个真正算错误，留给读者自行判断。
timeline.point: Suggests that only one of the three issues Rick Moen identified with GAP is actually a mistake, leaving it to readers to determine which.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Made minor stylistic changes to Lawrence Rosen's OSD #10 analysis and published it on his wiki, noting that OSD #10 interpretation adds to the position against GAP.
timeline.point_zh: 对 Lawrence Rosen 的 OSD #10 分析做了少量排版修改并发布在自己的 wiki 上，认为这有助于阐明反对 GAP 的立场。
timeline.point: Made minor stylistic changes to Lawrence Rosen's OSD #10 analysis and published it on his wiki, noting that OSD #10 interpretation adds to the position against GAP.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Explains his goal is to build consensus on the most credible arguments against GAP, present even weaker arguments fairly, and describe negative effects on open source if these arguments are dismissed.
timeline.point_zh: 解释其目标是就反对 GAP 的最有说服力的论点建立共识，公正呈现较弱的论点，并描述如果这些论点被驳回对开源的负面影响。
timeline.point: Explains his goal is to build consensus on the most credible arguments against GAP, present even weaker arguments fairly, and describe negative effects on open source if these arguments are dismissed.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Repeats his goal of building consensus on the most credible arguments, presenting even weaker arguments fairly, and describing negative effects on open source if these arguments are dismissed.
timeline.point_zh: 重申其目标是就最有说服力的论点建立共识，公正呈现较弱的论点，并描述如果这些论点被驳回对开源的负面影响。
timeline.point: Repeats his goal of building consensus on the most credible arguments, presenting even weaker arguments fairly, and describing negative effects on open source if these arguments are dismissed.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Maintains OSD #6 permits terms some users dislike unless use is actually forbidden, rebuts the two-classes-of-users claim and asks the critic to identify them, concedes only the mobile-device exclusion (an OSD #10 effect) as a violation, and asks that insults stop.
timeline.point_zh: 坚持 OSD #6 允许不实际禁止使用的不快条款,反驳“两类用户”说法并要求举例,仅承认移动设备排斥(源于 OSD #10)构成违反,并要求停止人身攻击。
timeline.point: Maintains OSD #6 permits terms some users dislike unless use is actually forbidden, rebuts the two-classes-of-users claim and asks the critic to identify them, concedes only the mobile-device exclusion (an OSD #10 effect) as a violation, and asks that insults stop.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Dismisses Ben Tilly's argument as willful ignorance, asserting that granting commercial rights in theory but denying them in practice is exactly what OSD #6 aims to prevent.
timeline.point_zh: 驳斥 Ben Tilly 的论点为故意无视，主张理论授予商业权利但实际否认的做法正是 OSD #6 要防止的。
timeline.point: Dismisses Ben Tilly's argument as willful ignorance, asserting that granting commercial rights in theory but denying them in practice is exactly what OSD #6 aims to prevent.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Jokingly suggests they need to invoke Godwin's Law, referencing a Wikipedia link, as the heated discussion has escalated.
timeline.point_zh: 开玩笑说需要引入「戈德温定律」，附上维基百科链接，暗示讨论已变得过于激烈。
timeline.point: Jokingly suggests they need to invoke Godwin's Law, referencing a Wikipedia link, as the heated discussion has escalated.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: States he was done with the discussion, having sought only to express his view with clarity, not to convince the other party.
timeline.point_zh: 表示讨论已结束，他只是想清楚表达自己的观点，而非说服对方。
timeline.point: States he was done with the discussion, having sought only to express his view with clarity, not to convince the other party.

timeline.subject: [Fwd: FW: For Approval: Generic Attribution Provision]
timeline.snippet: Notes that the thread has wound down, everyone feels their views have been stated, and no one wishes to continue thrashing this dead horse.
timeline.point_zh: 指出讨论已经平息，各方都觉得观点已经表达清楚，没有人愿意继续纠缠这个已无新意的话题。
timeline.point: Notes that the thread has wound down, everyone feels their views have been stated, and no one wishes to continue thrashing this dead horse.

timeline.snippet: Contains no substantive archived body in the Generic Attribution Provision thread.

submissions.rejection_reason: Never approved. Proposed as an add-on attribution requirement that could be attached to any license, raising OSD compliance concerns.

submissions.name: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Never approved. The license included use restrictions related to biosecurity and ethical concerns that violated OSD #6.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Resubmits the Broad Institute Public License (BIPL) for OSI approval after an improper subject header, recapping the May discussion: it is MPL-derived but omits MIT's patent grant, which MIT cannot agree to give.
timeline.point_zh: 因原邮件主题头有误而重新提交 Broad Institute Public License (BIPL) 供 OSI 审批,并回顾五月间的讨论:该许可证源自 MPL 但省去了 MIT 无法授予的专利授权。
timeline.point: Resubmits the Broad Institute Public License (BIPL) for OSI approval after an improper subject header, recapping the May discussion: it is MPL-derived but omits MIT's patent grant, which MIT cannot agree to give.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Challenges the removal of the MPL patent grant: MIT could later claim royalties from users like the Rambus model, asks how this comports with OSD #7, and calls it unfair that contributors must grant patents while MIT, the Initial Developer, does not.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑删除 MPL 专利授权的做法:MIT 可能日后如 Rambus 模式般向用户索取专利费,质问其如何符合 OSD #7,并指出贡献者须授予专利而作为初始开发者的 MIT 却不必,有失公平。
timeline.point: Challenges the removal of the MPL patent grant: MIT could later claim royalties from users like the Rambus model, asks how this comports with OSD #7, and calls it unfair that contributors must grant patents while MIT, the Initial Developer, does not.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Argues that MIT's reluctance to grant patent licenses reflects a broken internal patent system rather than a genuine problem with the MPL, and that modifying the MPL to accommodate this is not the right approach.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 MIT 不愿授予专利许可反映了其内部专利制度的缺陷，而非 MPL 本身的问题，因此修改 MPL 来迁就这一做法并非正确方向。
timeline.point: Argues that MIT's reluctance to grant patent licenses reflects a broken internal patent system rather than a genuine problem with the MPL, and that modifying the MPL to accommodate this is not the right approach.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Asks how to unsubscribe from the mailing list.
timeline.point_zh: 询问如何退出该邮件列表。
timeline.point: Asks how to unsubscribe from the mailing list.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Explains MIT's concern about accidentally including patented algorithms in open-source code, noting they fear unknowingly granting exclusive patent licenses, though he finds this explanation unsatisfactory.
timeline.point_zh: 解释了 MIT 担心在开源代码中意外包含受专利保护的算法，指出他们担心在不知情的情况下授予独占专利许可，但他认为这一解释并不令人满意。
timeline.point: Explains MIT's concern about accidentally including patented algorithms in open-source code, noting they fear unknowingly granting exclusive patent licenses, though he finds this explanation unsatisfactory.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Agrees that MIT's patent licensing system is broken but has no sympathy for MIT, arguing there is an obvious solution that MIT refuses to consider.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 MIT 的专利授权制度存在问题，但对 MIT 毫无同情，认为存在一个显而易见的解决方案而 MIT 拒绝考虑。
timeline.point: Agrees that MIT's patent licensing system is broken but has no sympathy for MIT, arguing there is an obvious solution that MIT refuses to consider.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Proposes that MIT should notify exclusive patent licensees before publishing open-source software, giving them 30 days to review for potential infringement, and argues that if MIT cannot manage its patent portfolio, it has a bigger problem than licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 MIT 在发布开源软件前应通知独占专利被许可方，给予其30天审查潜在侵权的时间，并认为如果 MIT 无法管理其专利组合，则面临的问题远不止授权本身。
timeline.point: Proposes that MIT should notify exclusive patent licensees before publishing open-source software, giving them 30 days to review for potential infringement, and argues that if MIT cannot manage its patent portfolio, it has a bigger problem than licensing.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Argues that patent licensees have no legal obligation to cooperate with MIT's proposed review process, finds the license extremely non-reciprocal and unlikely to be reused, and recommends rejection.
timeline.point_zh: 认为专利被许可方没有法律义务配合 MIT 提出的审查流程，认为该许可证极度缺乏对等性且不太可能被重复使用，建议予以拒绝。
timeline.point: Argues that patent licensees have no legal obligation to cooperate with MIT's proposed review process, finds the license extremely non-reciprocal and unlikely to be reused, and recommends rejection.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Responds for MIT that the BIPL meets every OSI approval factor: no requirement forces the originator to license its own patents, consistent with GPL/BSD/MIT practice; offers to delete all contributor patent grants to remedy the parity concern, noting usability is not an OSI requirement.
timeline.point_zh: 代表 MIT 回应:BIPL 符合 OSI 全部批准标准,OSI 并无要求原创者授权自身专利的规定,且与 GPL/BSD/MIT 等做法一致;若不对等问题是障碍,MIT 愿删除贡献者的专利授权条款,并指出"可用性"并非 OSI 要求。
timeline.point: Responds for MIT that the BIPL meets every OSI approval factor: no requirement forces the originator to license its own patents, consistent with GPL/BSD/MIT practice; offers to delete all contributor patent grants to remedy the parity concern, noting usability is not an OSI requirement.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that OSI tends to be hostile to asymmetrical licenses and reluctant to approve licenses with limited adoption, while noting that some previously approved licenses do offer implicit patent licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 OSI 倾向于排斥不对称的许可证，且不愿批准采用范围有限的许可证，同时指出此前获得批准的部分许可证确实提供了隐含的专利授权。
timeline.point: Clarifies that OSI tends to be hostile to asymmetrical licenses and reluctant to approve licenses with limited adoption, while noting that some previously approved licenses do offer implicit patent licenses.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Warns that previously approved licenses might not pass today due to accumulated experience, and emphasizes concern about license proliferation, preferring not to approve licenses likely used by only a single project.
timeline.point_zh: 警告称由于经验积累，此前获批的许可证如今可能无法通过审批，并强调对许可证泛滥的担忧，倾向于不批准可能仅被单一项目使用的许可证。
timeline.point: Warns that previously approved licenses might not pass today due to accumulated experience, and emphasizes concern about license proliferation, preferring not to approve licenses likely used by only a single project.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Thanks John Cowan for the clarifications and indicates MIT will await the group's decision on the BIPL.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢 Cowan 的澄清，表示 MIT 将等待该小组对 BIPL 的决定。
timeline.point: Thanks John Cowan for the clarifications and indicates MIT will await the group's decision on the BIPL.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Argues deleting the contributor patent grant would be an unfortunate solution: modern licenses contain explicit patent grants, and omitting one makes both the license and MIT's software risky; urges MIT to solve the patent problem as IBM, Sun, and W3C have rather than pass the risk to users.
timeline.point_zh: 主张删除贡献者专利授权是糟糕的解决办法:现代专业许可证均含明确的专利授权,省略将令许可证和 MIT 软件都有风险;敦促 MIT 参照 IBM、Sun 与 W3C 的做法解决专利问题,而非把风险转嫁给用户。
timeline.point: Argues deleting the contributor patent grant would be an unfortunate solution: modern licenses contain explicit patent grants, and omitting one makes both the license and MIT's software risky; urges MIT to solve the patent problem as IBM, Sun, and W3C have rather than pass the risk to users.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies MIT's patent position: it has not knowingly filed patents covering the software, but its exclusive license contracts strip MIT of control over infringement suits, so a broad-based background patent grant is impossible, and MIT will not change this policy for one license.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 MIT 的专利立场:其并未明知地申请覆盖该软件的专利,但独占许可合同使 MIT 无法控制侵权诉讼,故无法作出宽泛的背景专利授权,也不会为这一项许可证改变政策。
timeline.point: Clarifies MIT's patent position: it has not knowingly filed patents covering the software, but its exclusive license contracts strip MIT of control over infringement suits, so a broad-based background patent grant is impossible, and MIT will not change this policy for one license.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether the redaction of patent terms from BIPL would be perceived as deliberate and suspicious by the community, and suggests MIT consider a "patent-neutral" license to avoid the controversy.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 BIPL 中专利条款的删减会被社区视为刻意行为，建议 MIT 采用"专利中立"许可证来避免争议。
timeline.point: Questions whether the redaction of patent terms from BIPL would be perceived as deliberate and suspicious by the community, and suggests MIT consider a "patent-neutral" license to avoid the controversy.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Points out that MIT's phrasing that it has "not announced" it would pursue patent claims is not the same as a binding promise not to pursue them, and recommends adding a proviso to exclude exclusively licensed patents.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 MIT 对专利问题的措辞含糊——未宣布会追究用户并不等同于承诺不追究，建议在许可证中明确排除已独家许可的专利。
timeline.point: Points out that MIT's phrasing that it has "not announced" it would pursue patent claims is not the same as a binding promise not to pursue them, and recommends adding a proviso to exclude exclusively licensed patents.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Explains that MIT needs BIPL because NIH requires grantees to use an open source license, and MIT is willing to adjust patent terms toward "patent neutrality" while also seeking code contributions.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 MIT 需要 BIPL 是因为 NIH 要求受资助者使用开源许可证，MIT 愿意调整专利条款以符合"专利中立"偏好，同时也希望获得回馈代码。
timeline.point: Explains that MIT needs BIPL because NIH requires grantees to use an open source license, and MIT is willing to adjust patent terms toward "patent neutrality" while also seeking code contributions.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Suggests MIT should ask for but not demand code contributions, noting that even GPL and other reciprocal licenses only require distributing patches downstream, not sending them upstream.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 MIT 可以请求但不应强制要求回馈代码，因为连 GPL 等互惠许可证也不要求向上游回馈，强制要求会引发担忧。
timeline.point: Suggests MIT should ask for but not demand code contributions, noting that even GPL and other reciprocal licenses only require distributing patches downstream, not sending them upstream.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: States willingness to run John's proposed patent exclusion clause by MIT's policy committee for review, provided the language is acceptable to OSI.
timeline.point_zh: 表示将把 John 提出的专利排除条款提交给 MIT 政策委员会审核，如果该语言对 OSI 可接受的话。
timeline.point: States willingness to run John's proposed patent exclusion clause by MIT's policy committee for review, provided the language is acceptable to OSI.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Agrees with John's approach: MIT should grant all patent rights it can, while acknowledging it cannot grant rights to patents already exclusively licensed, and the community can accept that uncertainty.
timeline.point_zh: 赞同 John 的方案，即 MIT 应授予所有可授予的专利权利，同时承认无法授予已独家许可的专利，社区能接受这种不确定性。
timeline.point: Agrees with John's approach: MIT should grant all patent rights it can, while acknowledging it cannot grant rights to patents already exclusively licensed, and the community can accept that uncertainty.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Points out that CDDL's definition of "Licensable" already achieves MIT's stated goals—patents exclusively licensed to third parties are not Licensable under CDDL.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 CDDL 许可证的 "Licensable" 定义已经实现了 MIT 的目标——已独家许可的专利不在 CDDL 授权范围内。
timeline.point: Points out that CDDL's definition of "Licensable" already achieves MIT's stated goals—patents exclusively licensed to third parties are not Licensable under CDDL.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Notes that OSL/AFL similarly only grants patent claims "owned or controlled by the Licensor," which is standard language for most modern open source licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSL/AFL 同样只授权许可方"拥有或控制"的专利权利，这是现代开源许可证的常见做法。
timeline.point: Notes that OSL/AFL similarly only grants patent claims "owned or controlled by the Licensor," which is standard language for most modern open source licenses.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Points out that MIT still owns patents even when exclusively licensed to a third party, so under the "owned or controlled" wording, those patents would necessarily have to be granted.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 MIT 仍然拥有已独家许可出去的专利（即使不控制），因此按"拥有或控制"的措辞，这些专利必须被授权。
timeline.point: Points out that MIT still owns patents even when exclusively licensed to a third party, so under the "owned or controlled" wording, those patents would necessarily have to be granted.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Argues MIT should covenant never to assert its patents against open source software, should exclude future exclusive licenses that encumber open source use, and should notify users of known encumbered patents.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 MIT 承诺未来不将专利独家许可出去以阻碍开源使用，并应做出不针对开源软件主张专利的契约，同时对已知受限专利负有通知义务。
timeline.point: Argues MIT should covenant never to assert its patents against open source software, should exclude future exclusive licenses that encumber open source use, and should notify users of known encumbered patents.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Concedes Matthew's point may be correct and notes that changing the wording to exclude exclusively licensed patents would be a simple modification.
timeline.point_zh: 承认 Matthew 的观点可能正确，修改措辞以排除已独家许可的专利是简单的修改。
timeline.point: Concedes Matthew's point may be correct and notes that changing the wording to exclude exclusively licensed patents would be a simple modification.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Explains that CDDL defines "Licensable" as having the right to grant, so once MIT exclusively licenses a patent to a third party, that patent is no longer Licensable.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 CDDL 中 "Licensable" 的定义是"拥有授予的权利"，一旦 MIT 将专利独家许可给第三方，该专利即不可再授权。
timeline.point: Explains that CDDL defines "Licensable" as having the right to grant, so once MIT exclusively licenses a patent to a third party, that patent is no longer Licensable.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Agrees it would be preferable to approve the modified license, as it would remain OSI-compliant while at least mitigating license proliferation concerns.
timeline.point_zh: 同意采用修改后的措辞来批准许可证，这样能确保 OSI 合规并减轻许可证泛滥问题。
timeline.point: Agrees it would be preferable to approve the modified license, as it would remain OSI-compliant while at least mitigating license proliferation concerns.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Confirms that OSL's "owned or controlled" wording differs from CDDL's "having the right to grant" definition, and Andrew's analysis of CDDL is correct.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 OSL 中"拥有或控制"的措辞与 CDDL 中"拥有授予权利"的定义存在区别，Andrew 对 CDDL 的分析是正确的。
timeline.point: Confirms that OSL's "owned or controlled" wording differs from CDDL's "having the right to grant" definition, and Andrew's analysis of CDDL is correct.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Proposes replacement section 2.1 language granting a limited, royalty-free patent license under the Initial Developer's licensable patent claims, superseded by later exclusive licenses, and asks whether the concept is acceptable to OSI.
timeline.point_zh: 提出替换第 2.1 节的措辞:由初始开发者就其可授权专利声明授予有限的免版税专利许可,该授权可被其后的独占许可所取代,并询问该概念能否为 OSI 接受。
timeline.point: Proposes replacement section 2.1 language granting a limited, royalty-free patent license under the Initial Developer's licensable patent claims, superseded by later exclusive licenses, and asks whether the concept is acceptable to OSI.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Provides an online link and attachments to the BIPL license text as additional reference material.
timeline.point_zh: 提供 BIPL 许可证文本的在线链接和附件，作为额外参考资料。
timeline.point: Provides an online link and attachments to the BIPL license text as additional reference material.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Notes that the revised clause still allows MIT to exclusively license patents for revenue purposes, and suggests changing the language to prohibit "knowingly" exclusive licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 指出修订后的条款仍允许 MIT 以获取收入等其他目的独家许可专利，建议改为禁止"明知"下独家许可专利。
timeline.point: Notes that the revised clause still allows MIT to exclusively license patents for revenue purposes, and suggests changing the language to prohibit "knowingly" exclusive licensing.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Broad Institute Public License (BIPL)
timeline.snippet: Indicates willingness to consider the modification suggested by Matthew.
timeline.point_zh: 表示可以考虑 Matthew 提出的修改建议。
timeline.point: Indicates willingness to consider the modification suggested by Matthew.

The TrueCrypt Collective License consists of several distinct licenses, which
are contained in this document (separated by lines consisting of underscores)
and which are, in this sect

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Submits the TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0 for OSI approval, explaining the need for a different-name requirement on derived works, cryptographic-specific disclaimers, and multi-license component handling that existing approved licenses do not provide.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0 供 OSI 审批，说明需要衍生作品改名要求、加密免责声明及多许可证组件机制等现有已批准许可证不具备的特性。
timeline.point: Submits the TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0 for OSI approval, explaining the need for a different-name requirement on derived works, cryptographic-specific disclaimers, and multi-license component handling that existing approved licenses do not provide.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Recommends submitting component licenses separately, making the license reusable through templates, and removing the TrueCrypt advertising requirement as unnecessary and burdensome.
timeline.point_zh: 建议分别提交组件许可证、将许可证模板化以便复用，并删除不必要且负担过重的 TrueCrypt 广告要求。
timeline.point: Recommends submitting component licenses separately, making the license reusable through templates, and removing the TrueCrypt advertising requirement as unnecessary and burdensome.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Explains that TrueCrypt needs approval of the collective license first because separate component approvals would not clarify their relationships, and says E4M text prevents full templating.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 TrueCrypt 需要先整体批准集合许可证，因为单独批准组件无法澄清彼此关系，并说明 E4M 文本不可更改导致无法整体模板化。
timeline.point: Explains that TrueCrypt needs approval of the collective license first because separate component approvals would not clarify their relationships, and says E4M text prevents full templating.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Questions TrueCrypt's need for collective approval by citing SpikeSource's stack model, where a collective work can include separately licensed components with clear disclosure.
timeline.point_zh: 以 SpikeSource 软件栈模式质疑 TrueCrypt 需要整体批准的理由，指出集合产品可包含单独授权组件并作清晰披露。
timeline.point: Questions TrueCrypt's need for collective approval by citing SpikeSource's stack model, where a collective work can include separately licensed components with clear disclosure.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that TrueCrypt could state all code is under OSI-certified licenses, and warns that bundling three licenses obscures each one's role and hurts reuse.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 TrueCrypt 可声明全部代码处于 OSI 认证许可证下，并警告将三种许可证捆成一个会模糊各自作用且不利复用。
timeline.point: Clarifies that TrueCrypt could state all code is under OSI-certified licenses, and warns that bundling three licenses obscures each one's role and hurts reuse.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Argues that merging OSI-certified licenses may create noncompliant interactions, so OSI must approve the compound license and its component-license definition as a whole.
timeline.point_zh: 主张合并 OSI 认证许可证可能产生不合规的相互作用，因此 OSI 必须整体批准该复合许可证及组件许可证定义。
timeline.point: Argues that merging OSI-certified licenses may create noncompliant interactions, so OSI must approve the compound license and its component-license definition as a whole.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Distinguishes TrueCrypt from a product stack by saying users see it as one product, so a superordinate license is needed to prevent component terms from misleading them.
timeline.point_zh: 将 TrueCrypt 与产品集合区分开来，称用户会把它视为单一产品，因此需要上位许可证防止组件条款误导用户。
timeline.point: Distinguishes TrueCrypt from a product stack by saying users see it as one product, so a superordinate license is needed to prevent component terms from misleading them.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Warns that a multi-license package is complex and non-reusable, and recommends either drafting one generic compatible license or submitting component licenses first.
timeline.point_zh: 警告多许可证包复杂且不可复用，建议改写为一个通用兼容许可证，或先分别提交组件许可证。
timeline.point: Warns that a multi-license package is complex and non-reusable, and recommends either drafting one generic compatible license or submitting component licenses first.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Argues TrueCrypt is not unique because major projects also include differently licensed components, and suggests Apache 2.0 plus a README/COPYING file instead.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 TrueCrypt 并不特殊，因为大型项目也包含不同许可证组件，并建议改用 Apache 2.0 加 README/COPYING 说明。
timeline.point: Argues TrueCrypt is not unique because major projects also include differently licensed components, and suggests Apache 2.0 plus a README/COPYING file instead.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Calls the license a very bad solution and urges rejection: it encourages a new type of license proliferation, is too confusing to understand, misuses license terms for trademark protection, and relies on discredited advertising clauses.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证是很糟糕的方案并主张拒绝：它助长新型许可证泛滥、过于晦涩难懂、滥用许可条款实现商标保护，且依赖已名誉扫地的广告条款。
timeline.point: Calls the license a very bad solution and urges rejection: it encourages a new type of license proliferation, is too confusing to understand, misuses license terms for trademark protection, and relies on discredited advertising clauses.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that TrueCrypt need not create a compound license, only state that all code is available under OSI-certified licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 TrueCrypt 不需要创建复合许可证，只需说明所有代码均在 OSI 认证许可证下提供。
timeline.point: Clarifies that TrueCrypt need not create a compound license, only state that all code is available under OSI-certified licenses.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Concedes TCL is complex but insists TrueCrypt cannot use a simpler license and that component approvals matter only as integral parts of the whole TCL.
timeline.point_zh: 承认 TCL 复杂，但坚持 TrueCrypt 不能使用更简单许可证，且组件批准只有作为 TCL 整体组成部分才有意义。
timeline.point: Concedes TCL is complex but insists TrueCrypt cannot use a simpler license and that component approvals matter only as integral parts of the whole TCL.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Asks why TrueCrypt cannot use a less complex existing license and requests a clearer explanation of the problems with existing licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 TrueCrypt 为何不能使用较简单的现有许可证，并要求更清楚说明现有许可证的问题。
timeline.point: Asks why TrueCrypt cannot use a less complex existing license and requests a clearer explanation of the problems with existing licenses.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Explains that TrueCrypt is locked into component licenses and seeks retroactive certification of the combination, but argues separate component approval would be sufficient.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 TrueCrypt 已被组件许可证锁定并试图让组合获得追认认证，但主张分别批准组件许可证已足够。
timeline.point: Explains that TrueCrypt is locked into component licenses and seeks retroactive certification of the combination, but argues separate component approval would be sufficient.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Defends TCL trademark-related restrictions by comparing them to OSI-approved licenses, and says TCL 2.0 simplifies components from six to three and removes SSLeay.
timeline.point_zh: 通过类比 OSI 已批准许可证为 TCL 的商标相关限制辩护，并说明 TCL 2.0 将组件从六个减为三个且移除 SSLeay。
timeline.point: Defends TCL trademark-related restrictions by comparing them to OSI-approved licenses, and says TCL 2.0 simplifies components from six to three and removes SSLeay.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Says OSI can approve licenses but should not certify compatibility among them, and warns TrueCrypt must resolve any GPL or attribution-clause conflicts itself.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSI 可以批准许可证但不应认证许可证之间的兼容性，并警告 TrueCrypt 必须自行解决 GPL 或署名条款冲突。
timeline.point: Says OSI can approve licenses but should not certify compatibility among them, and warns TrueCrypt must resolve any GPL or attribution-clause conflicts itself.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Criticizes TrueCrypt for retaining OpenSSL/SSLeay-style advertising language and says uncertainty about needing it suggests poor understanding of the resulting license terms.
timeline.point_zh: 批评 TrueCrypt 保留 OpenSSL/SSLeay 式广告语言，并认为其不确定是否需要该条款显示对最终许可条款理解不足。
timeline.point: Criticizes TrueCrypt for retaining OpenSSL/SSLeay-style advertising language and says uncertainty about needing it suggests poor understanding of the resulting license terms.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Responds that SSLeay was part of TCL 1.0 but not TCL 2.0, and says TCL 2.0 contains no SSLeay advertising clause.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称 SSLeay 是 TCL 1.0 的一部分而非 TCL 2.0，并表示 TCL 2.0 没有 SSLeay 广告条款。
timeline.point: Responds that SSLeay was part of TCL 1.0 but not TCL 2.0, and says TCL 2.0 contains no SSLeay advertising clause.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that while the SSLeay advertising clause is not explicit, TCL still requires honoring Eric Young's terms when his code is used.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清虽然没有明示 SSLeay 广告条款，但 TCL 仍要求在使用 Eric Young 代码时遵守其条款。
timeline.point: Clarifies that while the SSLeay advertising clause is not explicit, TCL still requires honoring Eric Young's terms when his code is used.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Explains that the Eric Young clause is immutable E4M text and argues it is redundant and unlikely to cause significant problems.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 Eric Young 条款是不可更改的 E4M 文本，并主张它是冗余条款，不太会造成重大问题。
timeline.point: Explains that the Eric Young clause is immutable E4M text and argues it is redundant and unlikely to cause significant problems.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Announces draft 2 adding a clause preventing downstream products from implying that truecrypt.org provides their information, bug reporting, or support.
timeline.point_zh: 公告第二稿新增条款，禁止下游产品暗示 truecrypt.org 提供其信息、错误报告或支持。
timeline.point: Announces draft 2 adding a clause preventing downstream products from implying that truecrypt.org provides their information, bug reporting, or support.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Questions whether the anti-confusion clause is needed, since unfair competition or trademark law may already address the problem.
timeline.point_zh: 询问这项防混淆条款是否有必要，因为不正当竞争法或商标法可能已经能解决该问题。
timeline.point: Questions whether the anti-confusion clause is needed, since unfair competition or trademark law may already address the problem.

timeline.subject: For Approval: TrueCrypt Collective License Version 2.0
timeline.snippet: Argues the clause is still needed because explicit license language is easier to enforce and trademark protection is inconsistent across countries.
timeline.point_zh: 主张该条款仍有必要，因为把要求明确写入许可证更易执行，而且各国对商标的保护并不一致。
timeline.point: Argues the clause is still needed because explicit license language is easier to enforce and trademark protection is inconsistent across countries.

submissions.rejection_reason: Never approved. The license contained unusual restrictions on derivative works and attribution requirements that violated OSD.

submissions.name: MindTree Public License

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Never approved. Company-specific license with restrictions on use.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Submits the MindTree Public License for review, describing it as a custom copyleft license specific to MindTree IP with GPL-like derivative work requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 MindTree 公共许可证供审查，描述其为针对 MindTree 知识产权的自定义 copyleft 许可证，具有类似 GPL 的衍生作品要求。
timeline.point: Submits the MindTree Public License for review, describing it as a custom copyleft license specific to MindTree IP with GPL-like derivative work requirements.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks for more background on the MindTree Public License, questioning its justification, copyleft level, GPL compatibility, and raising drafting concerns including the MPL abbreviation conflict.
timeline.point_zh: 要求提供更多关于 MindTree 公共许可证的背景信息，质疑其存在理由、copyleft 程度、GPL 兼容性，并指出缩写与 MPL 冲突等起草问题。
timeline.point: Asks for more background on the MindTree Public License, questioning its justification, copyleft level, GPL compatibility, and raising drafting concerns including the MPL abbreviation conflict.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Strongly opposes the MindTree Public License, arguing that Section 3's requirement to assign all intellectual property rights in modifications to MindTree is an unwarranted land-grab.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈反对 MindTree 公共许可证，认为第 3 条要求将修改的全部知识产权权利转让给 MindTree 是不正当的圈地行为。
timeline.point: Strongly opposes the MindTree Public License, arguing that Section 3's requirement to assign all intellectual property rights in modifications to MindTree is an unwarranted land-grab.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Points out the MPL abbreviation conflict with Mozilla Public License and flags the clause requiring modifications to be submitted to MindTree as the most troublesome for approval, citing the APSL 1.0 precedent.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 MPL 缩写与 Mozilla 公共许可证冲突，并指出要求将修改提交给 MindTree 的条款是审批中最棘手的问题，援引 APSL 1.0 的前车之鉴。
timeline.point: Points out the MPL abbreviation conflict with Mozilla Public License and flags the clause requiring modifications to be submitted to MindTree as the most troublesome for approval, citing the APSL 1.0 precedent.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees with the previous criticism and adds that uncapped IP indemnification in an open source license is unacceptable, while noting that something similar to the patent disclosure clause has been approved before.
timeline.point_zh: 同意之前的批评，进一步指出开源许可证中的无限知识产权赔偿条款不可接受，但承认类似专利披露条款此前曾获批准。
timeline.point: Agrees with the previous criticism and adds that uncapped IP indemnification in an open source license is unacceptable, while noting that something similar to the patent disclosure clause has been approved before.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that their earlier comment targeted the clause requiring contributors to submit modifications to MindTree for inclusion in the original software, not the API declaration clause.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清其先前评论针对的是要求贡献者向 MindTree 提交修改的条款，而非 API 声明条款。
timeline.point: Clarifies that their earlier comment targeted the clause requiring contributors to submit modifications to MindTree for inclusion in the original software, not the API declaration clause.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Renames the license abbreviation to MTPL to avoid confusion with the Mozilla Public License, and argues no similar OSI-approved license exists; describes its copyleft, copyright assignment, patent restriction, and GPL incompatibility, enabling dual open-source and commercial licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 将缩写改为 MTPL 以避免与 Mozilla Public License 混淆，称无类似的 OSI 认证许可证；说明其 copyleft、版权回转、专利限制及与 GPL 不兼容等特性，可实现开源与商业双重许可。
timeline.point: Renames the license abbreviation to MTPL to avoid confusion with the Mozilla Public License, and argues no similar OSI-approved license exists; describes its copyleft, copyright assignment, patent restriction, and GPL incompatibility, enabling dual open-source and commercial licensing.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Recommends reviewing the OVPL for similar aims, warns that the MTPL is not reusable by others, and expresses skepticism that the mandatory IP assignment to MindTree will pass review.
timeline.point_zh: 建议参考 OVPL，警告 MTPL 不具可复用性，并对强制将第三方修改转让给 MindTree 的要求能否通过审查表示怀疑。
timeline.point: Recommends reviewing the OVPL for similar aims, warns that the MTPL is not reusable by others, and expresses skepticism that the mandatory IP assignment to MindTree will pass review.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Challenges the claim that no existing license is similar, asking which OSI-approved license most closely resembles MTPL even if only vaguely.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑不存在类似许可证的说法，询问哪个 OSI 许可证与 MTPL 最为相似。
timeline.point: Challenges the claim that no existing license is similar, asking which OSI-approved license most closely resembles MTPL even if only vaguely.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether any OSI-approved license has mandatory grant-back provisions as broad as MTPL paragraphs 3 and 4, and whether it is appropriate to demand IP assignment beyond copyright when the license grant is limited to copyright.
timeline.point_zh: 询问是否有 OSI 批准的许可证包含 MTPL 第3、4条如此宽泛的回授条款，以及在许可仅限于版权的情况下要求超出版权范围的 IP 转让是否适当。
timeline.point: Asks whether any OSI-approved license has mandatory grant-back provisions as broad as MTPL paragraphs 3 and 4, and whether it is appropriate to demand IP assignment beyond copyright when the license grant is limited to copyright.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: States no OSI-approved license has comparable grant-back provisions, objects to MTPL's uncapped indemnification, and compares MTPL unfavorably to Sun's non-open-source SCSL.
timeline.point_zh: 指出尚无 OSI 批准的许可证包含类似的回授条款，反对 MTPL 无上限赔偿条款，并将 MTPL 与 Sun 的非开源 SCSL 进行不利比较。
timeline.point: States no OSI-approved license has comparable grant-back provisions, objects to MTPL's uncapped indemnification, and compares MTPL unfavorably to Sun's non-open-source SCSL.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Emphasizes that MTPL requires outright assignment of all IP (not merely a grant-back), meaning authors lose all copyrights and patents while MindTree grants back only a copyright license, not patent licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 强调 MTPL 要求的是全部 IP 的彻底转让（而非仅仅回授），意味着作者丧失所有版权和专利，而 MindTree 仅回授版权许可，不包含专利许可。
timeline.point: Emphasizes that MTPL requires outright assignment of all IP (not merely a grant-back), meaning authors lose all copyrights and patents while MindTree grants back only a copyright license, not patent licenses.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains OVPL avoided IP assignment because it is unfair to authors and legally unenforceable in many jurisdictions, characterizes MTPL as more one-sided, but concedes no specific OSD violation can be identified.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 OVPL 避免 IP 转让因其对作者不公平且在多数法域不可执行，认为 MTPL 更加片面，但承认无法找出其违反的具体 OSD 条款。
timeline.point: Explains OVPL avoided IP assignment because it is unfair to authors and legally unenforceable in many jurisdictions, characterizes MTPL as more one-sided, but concedes no specific OSD violation can be identified.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether copyright assignment is enforceable in a license and whether a court ruling could leave MTPL software violating OSD #3 or #7; strongly dislikes the license though struggles to prove an OSD violation, and suggests clarifying clause 7's wording.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑版权回转能否在许可证中强制执行，法院判决是否会使 MTPL 软件违反 OSD 第 3 或第 7 条；虽强烈不喜欢该许可证却难以证明其违反 OSD，并建议修订第 7 条措辞。
timeline.point: Questions whether copyright assignment is enforceable in a license and whether a court ruling could leave MTPL software violating OSD #3 or #7; strongly dislikes the license though struggles to prove an OSD violation, and suggests clarifying clause 7's wording.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Cites US copyright law (17 USC 204(a)) to explain that any transfer of exclusive copyright rights must be in writing and signed, suggesting MTPL's IP assignment provisions may be legally unworkable.
timeline.point_zh: 引用美国版权法（17 USC 204(a)），指出任何排他性版权转让必须以书面形式由权利人签署，暗示 MTPL 的 IP 转让条款可能在法律上不可行。
timeline.point: Cites US copyright law (17 USC 204(a)) to explain that any transfer of exclusive copyright rights must be in writing and signed, suggesting MTPL's IP assignment provisions may be legally unworkable.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Concludes that the MTPL likely fails OSD #3 because the IP assignment mechanism for granting modification rights would not work for many people, and no alternative mechanism exists.
timeline.point_zh: 得出结论认为 MTPL 可能不满足 OSD #3，因为其 IP 转让机制对许多人无法生效，且不存在替代机制。
timeline.point: Concludes that the MTPL likely fails OSD #3 because the IP assignment mechanism for granting modification rights would not work for many people, and no alternative mechanism exists.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Corrects a citation error, clarifying that the relevant US law is chapter 17 USC (not chapter 7), specifically section 204(a) regarding copyright transfers.
timeline.point_zh: 更正引用错误，明确相关美国法律为《美国法典》第17编（非第7编），特别是关于版权转让的第204(a)条。
timeline.point: Corrects a citation error, clarifying that the relevant US law is chapter 17 USC (not chapter 7), specifically section 204(a) regarding copyright transfers.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Declares the MTPL cannot comply with the OSD, citing the clickwrap acceptance clause as a clear violation of OSD #10, and asserts further violations would be easy to find.
timeline.point_zh: 断言 MTPL 无法满足 OSD，指出点击同意条款明确违反 OSD #10，并表示稍加努力即可发现更多违规。
timeline.point: Declares the MTPL cannot comply with the OSD, citing the clickwrap acceptance clause as a clear violation of OSD #10, and asserts further violations would be easy to find.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Submits a revised version of the MindTree Public License incorporating OSI member feedback, with OSD #7 and OSD #10 issues addressed.
timeline.point_zh: 提交根据 OSI 成员建议修订的 MindTree 公共许可证，已解决 OSD #7 和 OSD #10 的问题。
timeline.point: Submits a revised version of the MindTree Public License incorporating OSI member feedback, with OSD #7 and OSD #10 issues addressed.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Criticizes MTPL as vendor-specific and problematic: automatic application of future versions, redundant copyright assignment, an unworkable patent clause, a jurisdiction clause Indian courts would ignore, and broad 'placing a copy' language covering ASPs and search engines.
timeline.point_zh: 批评 MTPL 具有厂商特定性且问题重重：未来版本自动适用、版权回转多余、专利条款不可行、管辖条款会被印度法院忽略，且“放置副本”的宽泛措辞会涵盖 ASP 和搜索引擎。
timeline.point: Criticizes MTPL as vendor-specific and problematic: automatic application of future versions, redundant copyright assignment, an unworkable patent clause, a jurisdiction clause Indian courts would ignore, and broad 'placing a copy' language covering ASPs and search engines.

timeline.subject: For Approval: MindTree Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies the concerns are drafting issues rather than OSD non-compliance: MTPL's assertion that MindTree owns the software discourages independent developers, and argues the OSD should require licenses not be specific to particular copyright holders to curb license proliferation.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清这些是起草问题而非 OSD 合规问题：MTPL 声称 MindTree 拥有软件会阻碍独立开发者使用；并主张 OSD 应要求许可证不得针对特定版权持有人，以遏制许可证泛滥。
timeline.point: Clarifies the concerns are drafting issues rather than OSD non-compliance: MTPL's assertion that MindTree owns the software discourages independent developers, and argues the OSD should require licenses not be specific to particular copyright holders to curb license proliferation.

submissions.rejection_reason: Never approved. Company-specific license with restrictions on use.

submissions.name: Academic Citing License

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Never approved. The license required citation in academic papers, which goes beyond what copyright licenses can enforce.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Submits the Academic Citing License for OSI approval — the MIT license plus a condition requiring publications produced with the program to cite a specific journal article — noting conflicting opinions on its OSD compatibility.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 Academic Citing License 供 OSI 审批——在 MIT 许可证基础上增加条件:使用该程序产出的出版物须引用特定期刊文章——并指出各方对其是否符合 OSD 意见不一。
timeline.point: Submits the Academic Citing License for OSI approval — the MIT license plus a condition requiring publications produced with the program to cite a specific journal article — noting conflicting opinions on its OSD compatibility.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Points out that the citation condition is a restriction on use of program output, does not conform to the OSD, and suggests using an already-approved license with a citation reminder instead.
timeline.point_zh: 指出引用条件是对程序输出的使用限制，不符合 OSD，建议改用已批准许可证并辅以引用提醒。
timeline.point: Points out that the citation condition is a restriction on use of program output, does not conform to the OSD, and suggests using an already-approved license with a citation reminder instead.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Questions how '(scientific) publications' would be defined and argues the citation requirement restricts use of the program's output — unlike GPL 2(c), which covers only the program — so citation should be requested, not required.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑如何定义'(scientific) publications'，并论证引用要求限制了程序输出的使用——不同于仅约束程序本身的GPL 2(c)——建议请求而非强制引用。
timeline.point: Questions how '(scientific) publications' would be defined and argues the citation requirement restricts use of the program's output — unlike GPL 2(c), which covers only the program — so citation should be requested, not required.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Explains that SourceForge requires software to conform to the OSD and needs OSI approval before it will accept a new license for hosting.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 SourceForge 要求软件符合 OSD，需先获 OSI 批准方可托管。
timeline.point: Explains that SourceForge requires software to conform to the OSD and needs OSI approval before it will accept a new license for hosting.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the citation condition does not restrict fields of endeavor and does not violate the wording or intent of OSD #6.
timeline.point_zh: 辩称引用条件不涉及使用领域限制，认为不违反 OSD #6 的措辞与意图。
timeline.point: Argues that the citation condition does not restrict fields of endeavor and does not violate the wording or intent of OSD #6.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the citation condition applies only to journals used for communication among scientists, and discusses output copyright ownership and traceability.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清引用条件仅针对科学家间交流的期刊，并讨论输出版权归属与可追溯性。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the citation condition applies only to journals used for communication among scientists, and discusses output copyright ownership and traceability.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Thanks David and indicates acceptance of his advice.
timeline.point_zh: 向 David 致谢，表示接受其建议。
timeline.point: Thanks David and indicates acceptance of his advice.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Explains that copyright holders have no right to restrict day-to-day use, considers the citation restriction unenforceable, and advises against including it in the license.
timeline.point_zh: 解释版权持有人无权限制日常使用，认为引用限制不可执行，不建议加入许可证。
timeline.point: Explains that copyright holders have no right to restrict day-to-day use, considers the citation restriction unenforceable, and advises against including it in the license.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Uses Trove database data to show that SourceForge actually hosts a large number of non-OSI-approved and public-domain projects, challenging its stated policy.
timeline.point_zh: 通过 Trove 数据指出 SourceForge 实际托管了大量非 OSI 批准/公共领域项目，质疑其声称的政策。
timeline.point: Uses Trove database data to show that SourceForge actually hosts a large number of non-OSI-approved and public-domain projects, challenging its stated policy.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Corrects the statistics: public-domain projects need not have OSI-approved licenses yet remain open source, and most of the 948 are miscategorized.
timeline.point_zh: 纠正统计：公共领域项目无需 OSI 许可证但仍属开源，且 948 个多为分类错误。
timeline.point: Corrects the statistics: public-domain projects need not have OSI-approved licenses yet remain open source, and most of the 948 are miscategorized.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Considers mandatory citation an indirect demand for recognition, questioning why the normal peer-review process cannot be relied upon.
timeline.point_zh: 认为强制引用相当于间接索取认可，质疑为何不依赖正常的同行评审流程。
timeline.point: Considers mandatory citation an indirect demand for recognition, questioning why the normal peer-review process cannot be relied upon.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Notes that most public-domain projects he audited had upstream copyright issues, and SourceForge refused to conduct a review.
timeline.point_zh: 指出其审核的公共领域项目多存在上游版权问题，SourceForge 拒绝进行审核。
timeline.point: Notes that most public-domain projects he audited had upstream copyright issues, and SourceForge refused to conduct a review.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Challenges Alex on whether he actually conducted a license audit of these projects.
timeline.point_zh: 反问 Alex 是否实际审核过这些项目。
timeline.point: Challenges Alex on whether he actually conducted a license audit of these projects.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Cites a specific example of a public-domain project that was actually an unauthorized derivative work, demonstrating that public-domain labels are frequently misapplied.
timeline.point_zh: 举例说明某公共领域项目实为未经授权的衍生作品，证明公共领域标签常被滥用。
timeline.point: Cites a specific example of a public-domain project that was actually an unauthorized derivative work, demonstrating that public-domain labels are frequently misapplied.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Counters Rick, suggesting the public-domain label may reflect a difference in understanding rather than ignorance.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 Rick，认为公共领域标签也可能只是理解差异而非无知。
timeline.point: Counters Rick, suggesting the public-domain label may reflect a difference in understanding rather than ignorance.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Pushes back by noting he maintains public-domain projects himself, arguing that authors who choose public domain should not be automatically dismissed as uninformed.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳：自己维护公共领域项目，认为不应将选择公共领域的作者一概视为无知。
timeline.point: Pushes back by noting he maintains public-domain projects himself, arguing that authors who choose public domain should not be automatically dismissed as uninformed.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Defends his audit finding that PalmOS packages labeled 'public domain' actually carried upstream copyright encumbrances, and insists that public domain is not a licence.
timeline.point_zh: 重申其对PalmOS软件包的审计发现——标为'public domain'者实有上游版权负担，并坚称public domain并非许可证。
timeline.point: Defends his audit finding that PalmOS packages labeled 'public domain' actually carried upstream copyright encumbrances, and insists that public domain is not a licence.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Argues the case actually shows the public-domain label prompted closer scrutiny, and questions whether public-domain projects are uniquely mislabeled.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该案例反而说明公共领域标签促使了更仔细的审查，质疑是否仅公共领域项目存在误标。
timeline.point: Argues the case actually shows the public-domain label prompted closer scrutiny, and questions whether public-domain projects are uniquely mislabeled.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Emphasizes that his understanding aligns with copyright law and reiterates that public-domain projects constituted the majority of serious licensing problems in his audit.
timeline.point_zh: 强调其理解与版权法一致，重申审核中公共领域项目问题占多数。
timeline.point: Emphasizes that his understanding aligns with copyright law and reiterates that public-domain projects constituted the majority of serious licensing problems in his audit.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Uses CC NonCommercial licenses as a counterexample to challenge the universality of "no restrictions on use" and asks about the exact criteria for OSI approval.
timeline.point_zh: 以 CC 非商业许可证为例质疑"无使用限制"的普遍性，并询问 OSI 批准的确切标准。
timeline.point: Uses CC NonCommercial licenses as a counterexample to challenge the universality of "no restrictions on use" and asks about the exact criteria for OSI approval.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Defends against attacks on his professional competence, explaining that the citation requirement stems from broken attribution practices in environmental sciences.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳对其专业能力的攻击，解释因环境科学领域引用机制失灵才提出该许可证。
timeline.point: Defends against attacks on his professional competence, explaining that the citation requirement stems from broken attribution practices in environmental sciences.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that CC NonCommercial licenses restrict distribution and public performance rather than everyday use, and therefore do not constitute restrictions on use.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 CC 非商业许可证限制的是分发/公开表演而非日常使用，故不构成使用限制。
timeline.point: Clarifies that CC NonCommercial licenses restrict distribution and public performance rather than everyday use, and therefore do not constitute restrictions on use.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Though not a fan of the proposal, asks whether it actually conforms to the OSD.
timeline.point_zh: 虽不赞同该提案，但询问其是否实际上符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Though not a fan of the proposal, asks whether it actually conforms to the OSD.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Expresses sympathy for the submitter, noting he has personally encountered inadequate attribution in computer science.
timeline.point_zh: 表示理解提交者，自己也在计算机科学领域亲历过引用缺失的情况。
timeline.point: Expresses sympathy for the submitter, noting he has personally encountered inadequate attribution in computer science.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: As a composer, challenges the claim that performance is not use.
timeline.point_zh: 以作曲者身份质疑"表演不是使用"的说法。
timeline.point: As a composer, challenges the claim that performance is not use.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Explains that in copyright law, performance refers to public performance, and private use does not constitute a performance.
timeline.point_zh: 解释版权法中表演指公开表演，私人使用不构成表演。
timeline.point: Explains that in copyright law, performance refers to public performance, and private use does not constitute a performance.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that "no restrictions on use" should be understood as "no restrictions on uses not covered by copyright law."
timeline.point_zh: 澄清"无使用限制"应理解为"版权法未涵盖的使用不受限制"。
timeline.point: Clarifies that "no restrictions on use" should be understood as "no restrictions on uses not covered by copyright law."

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Argues by analogy that for software, publishing results of running a program counts as performance and thus use, so imposing conditions on publishing would conflict with the principle of no restrictions on use.
timeline.point_zh: 通过类比论证，运行程序并发布结果属于表演即使用，因此对发布施加条件与禁止限制使用的原则相冲突。
timeline.point: Argues by analogy that for software, publishing results of running a program counts as performance and thus use, so imposing conditions on publishing would conflict with the principle of no restrictions on use.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Hopes someone will explicitly state that the license conforms to the OSD, even if it is not approved.
timeline.point_zh: 希望有人明确判定该许可证符合 OSD，即便不批准。
timeline.point: Hopes someone will explicitly state that the license conforms to the OSD, even if it is not approved.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that restricting performance or publication does constitute a restriction on use.
timeline.point_zh: 承认限制表演/发表确属使用限制。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that restricting performance or publication does constitute a restriction on use.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that under US copyright law performance rights do not extend to the execution of software code.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清美国版权法中的表演权不适用于软件代码的执行。
timeline.point: Clarifies that under US copyright law performance rights do not extend to the execution of software code.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Counters that under the WIPO Copyright Treaty and Berne Convention, software as a literary work does carry public performance rights, and cites external deployment clauses in the OSL and RealNetworks licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳认为根据WIPO版权条约和伯尔尼公约，软件作为文学作品确实享有公开表演权，并引用OSL和RealNetworks许可证中的外部部署条款。
timeline.point: Counters that under the WIPO Copyright Treaty and Berne Convention, software as a literary work does carry public performance rights, and cites external deployment clauses in the OSL and RealNetworks licenses.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Questions what it means to 'perform' a work under OSLv 2.1's clause 1(d) public-performance grant, noting that a licence purporting to regulate something doesn't establish that it does, and comparing the RPSL's external-deployment clause.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑OSLv 2.1第1(d)条'公开表演'许可中'表演'作品的含义，指出许可证声称规制某事并不等于确实如此，并对比RPSL的外部部署条款。
timeline.point: Questions what it means to 'perform' a work under OSLv 2.1's clause 1(d) public-performance grant, noting that a licence purporting to regulate something doesn't establish that it does, and comparing the RPSL's external-deployment clause.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges imprecise wording and clarifies the intended meaning as "no restrictions on uses not reserved by copyright law," illustrating with an example.
timeline.point_zh: 承认表述不精确，澄清应理解为"版权法未保留的使用不受限制"，并举例说明。
timeline.point: Acknowledges imprecise wording and clarifies the intended meaning as "no restrictions on uses not reserved by copyright law," illustrating with an example.

timeline.subject: For Approval: Academic Citing License
timeline.snippet: Explains that OSL clause 1(d) and clause 5 serve different purposes, and asserts confidence that the external deployment conditions are enforceable as contracts.
timeline.point_zh: 解释OSL第1(d)条和第5条服务于不同目的，并确信外部部署条件作为合同是可执行的。
timeline.point: Explains that OSL clause 1(d) and clause 5 serve different purposes, and asserts confidence that the external deployment conditions are enforceable as contracts.
