timeline.snippet: Asks whether a non-binding statement discouraging certain uses, appended to a license imposing no legal restriction, can make it OSD-compliant, and suggests the Board may want to opine on that even though this license is not the best vehicle.
timeline.point_zh: 提出疑问：附加在无法律限制的许可证上的非约束性劝阻声明能否使其符合OSD；虽此许可证并非最佳载体，但建议董事会可就此表态。
timeline.point: Asks whether a non-binding statement discouraging certain uses, appended to a license imposing no legal restriction, can make it OSD-compliant, and suggests the Board may want to opine on that even though this license is not the best vehicle.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Argues that a non-legally binding ethical statement can coexist with OSD compliance, since the mission statement is explicitly marked as non-binding within the binding license and does not restrict use.
timeline.point_zh: 主张非约束性的伦理声明可以与 OSD 合规共存，因为使命宣言在约束性许可证中被明确标记为不具约束力，且不限制使用。
timeline.point: Argues that a non-legally binding ethical statement can coexist with OSD compliance, since the mission statement is explicitly marked as non-binding within the binding license and does not restrict use.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Marks up the license to remove non-operative language, detailing ambiguities in the "context" wording, the redundant commercial-use clarification, and the confusing triple copyright notices; concludes the license offers no benefit over well-accepted permissive licenses even if revised.
timeline.point_zh: 对许可证逐条批注以剔除无操作效力的文字,指出 "context" 措辞、冗余的商业用途表述及三重版权声明等歧义问题;结论是即便修改,该许可证相较广为接受的宽松许可证也无益处。
timeline.point: Marks up the license to remove non-operative language, detailing ambiguities in the "context" wording, the redundant commercial-use clarification, and the confusing triple copyright notices; concludes the license offers no benefit over well-accepted permissive licenses even if revised.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Rebuts the criticism: the copyright notice under the date covers the license's authors, the commercial-use wording is intentional, and the mission statement is expressly non-binding, so a non-binding clause within an otherwise enforceable license does not violate the OSD.
timeline.point_zh: 逐条回应批评:日期下的版权声明针对许可证作者,商业用途表述系有意为之,使命宣言明确不具法律约束力,因此可执行许可证中的非约束性条款并不违反 OSD。
timeline.point: Rebuts the criticism: the copyright notice under the date covers the license's authors, the commercial-use wording is intentional, and the mission statement is expressly non-binding, so a non-binding clause within an otherwise enforceable license does not violate the OSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Reports that the OIN license has been actively adopted by approximately 57 software teams in hackathons and open innovation challenges, with no users reporting confusion about commercial-only usage or the mission statement wording.
timeline.point_zh: 报告 OIN 许可证已被约 57 个软件团队在黑客马拉松和开放创新挑战赛中积极采用，目前没有任何用户反映对仅限商业使用或使命宣言措辞感到困惑。
timeline.point: Reports that the OIN license has been actively adopted by approximately 57 software teams in hackathons and open innovation challenges, with no users reporting confusion about commercial-only usage or the mission statement wording.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Agrees to provide a license-by-license analysis in response to reviewer feedback.
timeline.point_zh: 同意针对审查反馈提供逐许可证分析。
timeline.point: Agrees to provide a license-by-license analysis in response to reviewer feedback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Defends the use of 'OIN' by arguing 'open innovation' is a generic term used since the 1960s, more people know the term than the organization, and no other open source license uses the OIN identifier.
timeline.point_zh: 为使用'OIN'辩护，认为'open innovation'是自 1960 年代以来使用的通用术语，更多人知道这个术语而非该组织，且目前没有其他开源许可证使用 OIN 标识符。
timeline.point: Defends the use of 'OIN' by arguing 'open innovation' is a generic term used since the 1960s, more people know the term than the organization, and no other open source license uses the OIN identifier.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Argues no substantial use case unserved by existing licenses has been shown — Creative Commons already covers non-software and data formats fall outside copyright; the contradictory non-binding mission statement invites abuse and should be moved to a preamble, recitals, or a separate manifesto.
timeline.point_zh: 认为提交者未证明存在现有许可证无法满足的实质用例——非软件领域已有 Creative Commons,数据格式不受版权法保护;自相矛盾的非约束性使命宣言易招致滥用,应移入序言、陈述条款或单独宣言。
timeline.point: Argues no substantial use case unserved by existing licenses has been shown — Creative Commons already covers non-software and data formats fall outside copyright; the contradictory non-binding mission statement invites abuse and should be moved to a preamble, recitals, or a separate manifesto.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Warns that using 'OIN' for the license name creates genuine confusion with the Open Invention Network, which operates primarily in the open source space, and suggests finding an alternative name instead of arguing for the current one.
timeline.point_zh: 警告使用'OIN'作为许可证名称会与主要在开源领域运营的 Open Invention Network 产生真正的混淆，建议花精力寻找替代名称而非为当前名称辩护。
timeline.point: Warns that using 'OIN' for the license name creates genuine confusion with the Open Invention Network, which operates primarily in the open source space, and suggests finding an alternative name instead of arguing for the current one.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Points to a live USPTO trademark registration for 'OIN' by Open Invention Network, LLC, and advises the submitter to consult their lawyer about the trademark conflict.
timeline.point_zh: 指向 Open Invention Network, LLC 持有的'OIN'有效 USPTO 商标注册，建议提交者就商标冲突问题咨询律师。
timeline.point: Points to a live USPTO trademark registration for 'OIN' by Open Invention Network, LLC, and advises the submitter to consult their lawyer about the trademark conflict.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Provides the details of the live trademark registration for 'OIN' held by Open Invention Network, LLC, covering licensing of intellectual property and innovation-related services.
timeline.point_zh: 提供了 Open Invention Network, LLC 持有的'OIN'有效商标注册详细信息，涵盖知识产权许可和创新相关服务。
timeline.point: Provides the details of the live trademark registration for 'OIN' held by Open Invention Network, LLC, covering licensing of intellectual property and innovation-related services.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Argues the license is non-free because it imposes moral obligations on distributors that go far beyond the scope of the licensed work and creates burden on people outside the licensing context.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证是非自由的，因为它对分发者施加了超出被许可工作范围的道德义务，并给许可范围之外的人造成了负担。
timeline.point: Argues the license is non-free because it imposes moral obligations on distributors that go far beyond the scope of the licensed work and creates burden on people outside the licensing context.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Notes the trademark at issue is cancelled and IC42 does not cover relevant services; announces acronym change from OIN to OPNL via a GitHub pull request to avoid conflict.
timeline.point_zh: 指出相关商标已被取消且IC42不涵盖相关服务；宣布通过GitHub PR将缩写从OIN改为OPNL以避免冲突。
timeline.point: Notes the trademark at issue is cancelled and IC42 does not cover relevant services; announces acronym change from OIN to OPNL via a GitHub pull request to avoid conflict.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Argues that difficult wording doesn't violate the OSD and that the non-binding clause prevents cultural conflicts; contends rejecting the license could itself violate OSD clause 6 (No Discrimination Against Fields of Endeavor) and promises a license-by-license analysis soon.
timeline.point_zh: 认为晦涩用词不违反 OSD,非约束性条款可避免文化冲突;主张拒绝该许可证可能违反 OSD 第 6 条(不歧视活动领域),并将很快逐条分析各许可证。
timeline.point: Argues that difficult wording doesn't violate the OSD and that the non-binding clause prevents cultural conflicts; contends rejecting the license could itself violate OSD clause 6 (No Discrimination Against Fields of Endeavor) and promises a license-by-license analysis soon.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Argues the license's morally binding requirements (e.g. promoting 'technology for the betterment of humanity') exceed the scope of the licensed work, fail OSD compliance and the C.D. freeness test, and formally objects to its approval.
timeline.point_zh: 认为许可证中“betterment of humanity”等要求超出被许可工作的范围，不符合 OSD 及 C.D. freeness test，并正式反对其通过。
timeline.point: Argues the license's morally binding requirements (e.g. promoting 'technology for the betterment of humanity') exceed the scope of the licensed work, fail OSD compliance and the C.D. freeness test, and formally objects to its approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Argues that even the OSD itself would not pass a Chinese dissent test and that requiring technology not be intentionally built to harm humanity is a very low moral bar; laments being vetoed before his analysis and announces an upcoming license-by-license analysis.
timeline.point_zh: 认为连 OSD 本身也通不过“中国异见测试”，要求技术并非有意伤害人类已是极低的道德门槛；抱怨分析未发表即遭否决，并预告即将提供逐项许可证分析。
timeline.point: Argues that even the OSD itself would not pass a Chinese dissent test and that requiring technology not be intentionally built to harm humanity is a very low moral bar; laments being vetoed before his analysis and announces an upcoming license-by-license analysis.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Points out that the phrase ‘at goodwill’ is unusual and not found in common usage; asks the submitter to clarify what is intended by that phrase.
timeline.point_zh: 指出‘at goodwill’这一表述不常见且在通用英语中没有使用证据；要求提交者澄清其含义。
timeline.point: Points out that the phrase ‘at goodwill’ is unusual and not found in common usage; asks the submitter to clarify what is intended by that phrase.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Argues that license usage is voluntary, so morality-based arguments should not factor into OSD review; asserts people can judge for themselves whether to accept a mission statement.
timeline.point_zh: 认为许可证使用是自愿的，因此基于道德的论点不应影响OSD审查；主张人们有能力自行判断是否接受使命声明。
timeline.point: Argues that license usage is voluntary, so morality-based arguments should not factor into OSD review; asserts people can judge for themselves whether to accept a mission statement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Explains that ‘goodwill’ is a philosophical term for acting out of personal responsibility; compares to purpose-specific licenses like Apple 2; argues the license is within OSI boundaries.
timeline.point_zh: 解释‘goodwill’是哲学用语，意为基于个人责任行事；与Apple 2等特定用途许可证类比；认为该许可证仍在OSI范围内。
timeline.point: Explains that ‘goodwill’ is a philosophical term for acting out of personal responsibility; compares to purpose-specific licenses like Apple 2; argues the license is within OSI boundaries.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Argues that requiring a moral promise in a license is a behavior requirement bound to honour, which is not permitted in open source; open source is about minimal strings attached, not adding more.
timeline.point_zh: 认为在许可证中要求道德承诺是对行为的约束，违反了开源原则；开源的核心是尽量少的附加条件，而不是增加更多。
timeline.point: Argues that requiring a moral promise in a license is a behavior requirement bound to honour, which is not permitted in open source; open source is about minimal strings attached, not adding more.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Points out that ‘goodwill’ also has a distinct legal meaning, providing a reference link.
timeline.point_zh: 指出‘goodwill’同时具有独立的法律含义，并提供了参考链接。
timeline.point: Points out that ‘goodwill’ also has a distinct legal meaning, providing a reference link.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Counters that the mission statement is not legally binding, emphasizes personal responsibility with no central authority enforcement, and compares it to codes of conduct and other licenses with restrictive clauses.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳称该使命声明不具法律约束力，强调个人责任且无中央权威强制执行，并与行为准则和其他含有约束条款的许可证进行类比。
timeline.point: Counters that the mission statement is not legally binding, emphasizes personal responsibility with no central authority enforcement, and compares it to codes of conduct and other licenses with restrictive clauses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Contains no substantive message body in the archived OIN License approval thread.
timeline.point_zh: 在 OIN License 批准线程中没有可提取的实质邮件正文。
timeline.point: Contains no substantive message body in the archived OIN License approval thread.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that ‘at goodwill’ differs from ‘goodwill’ alone; the ‘at’ modifier changes the meaning and context is implied by the following text.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清‘at goodwill’与单独的‘goodwill’不同；‘at’修饰语改变了含义，上下文由后续内容暗示。
timeline.point: Clarifies that ‘at goodwill’ differs from ‘goodwill’ alone; the ‘at’ modifier changes the meaning and context is implied by the following text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Says the name “OIN License” creates obvious confusion with a well-known existing mark; finds the wording lacks rigor and the license does not fill a clear legal niche from a proliferation standpoint.
timeline.point_zh: 认为“OIN许可证”这一名称与知名现有商标明显混淆；指出措辞缺乏严谨性，许可证在增殖角度未能填补明确的法律空白。
timeline.point: Says the name “OIN License” creates obvious confusion with a well-known existing mark; finds the wording lacks rigor and the license does not fill a clear legal niche from a proliferation standpoint.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Argues ethical restrictions on open source are an oxymoron because only the recipient of software judges ethics, and tells Andrew the license solves no perceived community problem and should be abandoned.
timeline.point_zh: 认为对开源施加道德限制是自相矛盾——只有接受者才能判断道德；该许可未解决社区问题，应当放弃。
timeline.point: Argues ethical restrictions on open source are an oxymoron because only the recipient of software judges ethics, and tells Andrew the license solves no perceived community problem and should be abandoned.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Recommends retracting the license, reworking the wording with legal counsel to address concerns, and resubmitting rather than pushing back on every objection to the wording.
timeline.point_zh: 建议撤回许可证，与法律顾问合作修改措辞以解决关切，然后重新提交，而不是对每一条措辞反对意见都进行反驳。
timeline.point: Recommends retracting the license, reworking the wording with legal counsel to address concerns, and resubmitting rather than pushing back on every objection to the wording.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Defends the license's good-will ethics clause as impossible to centralize or enforce authoritatively, and plans a thorough analysis plus a possible v2 revision addressing reviewers' core concerns.
timeline.point_zh: 捍卫许可中基于善意的道德条款，称其无法被集中化；计划作更深入分析并考虑回应评审关切的 v2 修订版。
timeline.point: Defends the license's good-will ethics clause as impossible to centralize or enforce authoritatively, and plans a thorough analysis plus a possible v2 revision addressing reviewers' core concerns.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Asks Andrew to withdraw the current license version to save everyone’s time, noting that no one supports this version and its chances of approval are slim.
timeline.point_zh: 要求Andrew撤回当前许可证版本以节省大家的时间，指出没有人支持该版本且获批希望渺茫。
timeline.point: Asks Andrew to withdraw the current license version to save everyone’s time, noting that no one supports this version and its chances of approval are slim.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Provides the permanent USPTO TSDR link for the OIN trademark registration record.
timeline.point_zh: 提供了OIN商标注册记录的USPTO TSDR永久链接。
timeline.point: Provides the permanent USPTO TSDR link for the OIN trademark registration record.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: OIN License (Open Innovation License)
timeline.snippet: Withdraws the current license request and announces intention to submit a new request for version 2.0.
timeline.point_zh: 撤回当前许可证申请，并宣布将提交新的2.0版本申请。
timeline.point: Withdraws the current license request and announces intention to submit a new request for version 2.0.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Submits a revised Server Side Public License v2 in lieu of v1.0: Section 13 now excludes Major Components and System Libraries and allows Service Source Code under OSI/FSF approved licenses, addressing feasibility and OSD 9 concerns.
timeline.point_zh: 提交修订版 Server Side Public License v2 取代 v1.0：第13条改为排除 Major Components 与 System Libraries，允许以 OSI/FSF 认可许可证发布 Service Source Code，回应可行性与 OSD 9 疑虑。
timeline.point: Submits a revised Server Side Public License v2 in lieu of v1.0: Section 13 now excludes Major Components and System Libraries and allows Service Source Code under OSI/FSF approved licenses, addressing feasibility and OSD 9 concerns.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Renews the call for OSI to outright reject the SS Public License on procedural grounds, arguing MongoDB's rapid unilateral licensing changes destroyed its credibility, and urges MongoDB to withdraw the submission and return in a year with a community-vetted draft.
timeline.point_zh: 呼吁 OSI 以程序理由彻底否决 SS Public License，认为 MongoDB 仓促单方面改版已丧失公信力，并敦促其撤回提交，一年后再提交经社区充分酝酿的草案。
timeline.point: Renews the call for OSI to outright reject the SS Public License on procedural grounds, arguing MongoDB's rapid unilateral licensing changes destroyed its credibility, and urges MongoDB to withdraw the submission and return in a year with a community-vetted draft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Strongly disagrees with the rejectionist arguments: defends SSPL's right to require the same terms without steward symmetry, notes SSPLv2 responds to feedback, questions whether process lets opponents filibuster indefinitely, and agrees OSI should clarify its process.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈反驳否决派观点：辩护 SSPL 无需许可人对等受约束，指出 SSPLv2 已回应反馈，质疑程序是否容许反对者无限拖延，并认同 OSI 应澄清流程。
timeline.point: Strongly disagrees with the rejectionist arguments: defends SSPL's right to require the same terms without steward symmetry, notes SSPLv2 responds to feedback, questions whether process lets opponents filibuster indefinitely, and agrees OSI should clarify its process.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says Section 13 still lets SSPL restrict unrelated proprietary software, making it a departure from copyleft and a violation of OSD 6 and 9.
timeline.point_zh: 认为第 13 条仍然让 SSPL 限制无关的专有软件，已偏离 copyleft，并违反 OSD 6 和 9。
timeline.point: Says Section 13 still lets SSPL restrict unrelated proprietary software, making it a departure from copyleft and a violation of OSD 6 and 9.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Objects that SSPLv4's upgrade clause creates uncertainty, Clause 13 remains problematic, the as-a-service definition is overbroad and turns on field-of-endeavor value judgments under OSD 6, and the Major Components carve-out may undermine the license; asks whether SSPL relates to the Commons Clause.
timeline.point_zh: 反对 SSPLv4：升级条款带来不确定性，第13条仍有问题，服务定义过宽且涉 OSD 6 领域价值判断，Major Components 例外或破坏许可目的；并问其与 Commons Clause 是否相关。
timeline.point: Objects that SSPLv4's upgrade clause creates uncertainty, Clause 13 remains problematic, the as-a-service definition is overbroad and turns on field-of-endeavor value judgments under OSD 6, and the Major Components carve-out may undermine the license; asks whether SSPL relates to the Commons Clause.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says SSPL is just a license the community can adopt or fork away from, and argues that MongoDB’s for-profit status is not itself a problem.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 只是社区可接受或自行分叉的许可证，并指出 MongoDB 的营利属性本身不是问题。
timeline.point: Says SSPL is just a license the community can adopt or fork away from, and argues that MongoDB’s for-profit status is not itself a problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that open source licenses must treat for-profit and non-profit activity equally; his concern is stewardship — OSI should weigh who the license steward is — and upgrade clauses make trust in the steward critical, as the SSPL v1 situation already shows.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清开源许可证须平等对待营利与非营利活动；他关注的是许可管理人问题——OSI 应考量管理人身份与动机——升级条款使对管理人的信任至关重要，SSPL v1 局面已印证此点。
timeline.point: Clarifies that open source licenses must treat for-profit and non-profit activity equally; his concern is stewardship — OSI should weigh who the license steward is — and upgrade clauses make trust in the steward critical, as the SSPL v1 situation already shows.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Reports that Eliot’s messages are visible in the archive but not reaching his mail server.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 Eliot 的邮件能在归档中看到，但没有送到他的邮件服务器。
timeline.point: Reports that Eliot’s messages are visible in the archive but not reaching his mail server.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says Eliot’s mails are landing in his spam folder.
timeline.point_zh: 说 Eliot 的邮件进了他的垃圾邮件文件夹。
timeline.point: Says Eliot’s mails are landing in his spam folder.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says Eliot’s mail never reaches his server and any filtering is happening upstream.
timeline.point_zh: 说 Eliot 的邮件根本没到他的服务器，如果有过滤也是上游在处理。
timeline.point: Says Eliot’s mail never reaches his server and any filtering is happening upstream.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Shares the archived copy of Eliot Horowitz's revised Server Side Public License v2, pasting the full revised license text and change list for the list's convenience.
timeline.point_zh: 转发 Eliot Horowitz 修订版 Server Side Public License v2 的存档,并贴出完整修订文本及变更清单以供查阅。
timeline.point: Shares the archived copy of Eliot Horowitz's revised Server Side Public License v2, pasting the full revised license text and change list for the list's convenience.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says v2 still has the same problems, because Section 13 is effectively limitless if “Service” is undefined, and calls the effort not in good faith.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 v2 仍有同样问题，因为若不定义“Service”，第 13 条的范围就几乎无限，并指责这不是善意努力。
timeline.point: Says v2 still has the same problems, because Section 13 is effectively limitless if “Service” is undefined, and calls the effort not in good faith.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Explains the archive/mail delivery problem is likely caused by the sender’s DMARC policy and mail provider enforcement.
timeline.point_zh: 解释归档/投递问题很可能是发送方的 DMARC 策略和邮件服务商强制执行所致。
timeline.point: Explains the archive/mail delivery problem is likely caused by the sender’s DMARC policy and mail provider enforcement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Explains that mongodb.com's strict DMARC policy combined with GMail's enforcement is causing the mailing list's rewritten-header messages to be rejected as forgeries, and has advised OSI's list admins to enable a Mailman mitigation.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 mongodb.com 的严格 DMARC 策略叠加 GMail 的执行导致邮件被当作伪造拒收,并已建议 OSI 列表管理员启用 Mailman 缓解方案。
timeline.point: Explains that mongodb.com's strict DMARC policy combined with GMail's enforcement is causing the mailing list's rewritten-header messages to be rejected as forgeries, and has advised OSI's list admins to enable a Mailman mitigation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Concurs with Eric’s criticism of the revised SSPL.
timeline.point_zh: 赞同 Eric 对修订版 SSPL 的批评。
timeline.point: Concurs with Eric’s criticism of the revised SSPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says Deshpande’s comments show ignorance of open source and contempt for the community.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Deshpande 的言论暴露出对开源的无知以及对社区的轻蔑。
timeline.point: Says Deshpande’s comments show ignorance of open source and contempt for the community.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Notes the Commons Clause relationship and quotes a comment that undercuts Deshpande’s own op-ed.
timeline.point_zh: 提到 Commons Clause 的关系，并引用一段对 Deshpande 专栏自我拆台的评论。
timeline.point: Notes the Commons Clause relationship and quotes a comment that undercuts Deshpande’s own op-ed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that Salil Deshpande is not affiliated with MongoDB, defends the SSPL's service copyleft as appropriate to the modern networked context, and asks the list to focus on whether the SSPL conforms to the Open Source Definition.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 Salil Deshpande 与 MongoDB 无关,为 SSPL 的服务端 copyleft 辩护,并要求讨论聚焦于 SSPL 是否符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Clarifies that Salil Deshpande is not affiliated with MongoDB, defends the SSPL's service copyleft as appropriate to the modern networked context, and asks the list to focus on whether the SSPL conforms to the Open Source Definition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Criticizes Section 13's value-based service definitions as impossible to calculate and partly unenforceable, arguing copyleft overreach, but concludes by voting for approval of the SSPL as an experimental license.
timeline.point_zh: 批评 Section 13 基于价值的服务定义无法计算且部分不可执行,构成 copyleft 过度扩张,但最终投票支持 SSPL 作为实验性许可证获批。
timeline.point: Criticizes Section 13's value-based service definitions as impossible to calculate and partly unenforceable, arguing copyleft overreach, but concludes by voting for approval of the SSPL as an experimental license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the wording could require source release for non-derived competing software and needs revision to avoid that reading.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这些措辞可能会把不衍生的竞争软件也卷入源代码义务，需修改措辞以消除这种解读。
timeline.point: Says the wording could require source release for non-derived competing software and needs revision to avoid that reading.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Asks what “service” means in Section 13 and whether SSPL is meant to stop downstream distributors of pre-built binaries.
timeline.point_zh: 询问第 13 条中的“service”究竟是什么意思，以及 SSPL 是否意在阻止下游分发预编译二进制。
timeline.point: Asks what “service” means in Section 13 and whether SSPL is meant to stop downstream distributors of pre-built binaries.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that SSPL Section 13 applies to service use, not distribution, and that it covers running software on behalf of others as a SaaS-style service.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 SSPL 第 13 条只适用于以服务方式使用，而不适用于分发，并且其范围包括代他人运行软件的 SaaS 式服务。
timeline.point: Clarifies that SSPL Section 13 applies to service use, not distribution, and that it covers running software on behalf of others as a SaaS-style service.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues the SSPL aims to protect open source from SaaS-capture rather than drive commercial license sales, that Section 13's trigger is narrower and clearer than AGPL's, and promises revised clarifying language shortly.
timeline.point_zh: 称 SSPL 旨在保护开源软件免受 SaaS 收购威胁而非推动商业授权,Section 13 的触发条件比 AGPL 更窄更清晰,并承诺尽快提出澄清性修订措辞。
timeline.point: Argues the SSPL aims to protect open source from SaaS-capture rather than drive commercial license sales, that Section 13's trigger is narrower and clearer than AGPL's, and promises revised clarifying language shortly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the SSPL is genuinely open source under the OSD, or only effectively open source for most users while failing in the cases it targets.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 SSPL 是否真正符合 OSD 下的开源定义，还是只是对大多数用户近似开源、但在其针对的场景中并不算开源。
timeline.point: Asks whether the SSPL is genuinely open source under the OSD, or only effectively open source for most users while failing in the cases it targets.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that the SSPL would force source disclosure for separate aggregated programs used to run the service, not just for derivative works.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 会要求披露用于运行服务的独立聚合程序源码，而不只是衍生作品。
timeline.point: Argues that the SSPL would force source disclosure for separate aggregated programs used to run the service, not just for derivative works.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Questions why MongoDB distinguishes between self-hosted use and paying a cloud provider to run the same software, and says the distinction makes no business sense.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 MongoDB 为什么要区分自建部署和付费由云服务商代运维同一软件，并认为这种区分在商业上说不通。
timeline.point: Questions why MongoDB distinguishes between self-hosted use and paying a cloud provider to run the same software, and says the distinction makes no business sense.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that MongoDB may be protecting its business, but the license should not be branded open source and the community is free to decline participation.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 MongoDB 可能是在保护其商业模式，但这种许可证不应被称为开源，外界也可以选择不参与。
timeline.point: Argues that MongoDB may be protecting its business, but the license should not be branded open source and the community is free to decline participation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Accuses MongoDB of using the SSPL to bar competitors from offering a service like its proprietary MongoDB Atlas, calls this blatant hypocrisy, states the SSPL is not an open source license, and urges withdrawal of the submission.
timeline.point_zh: 指控 MongoDB 利用 SSPL 阻止竞争对手提供类似其专有 MongoDB Atlas 的服务,称此举是明目张胆的虚伪,SSPL 不是开源许可证,应撤回提交。
timeline.point: Accuses MongoDB of using the SSPL to bar competitors from offering a service like its proprietary MongoDB Atlas, calls this blatant hypocrisy, states the SSPL is not an open source license, and urges withdrawal of the submission.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Assumes the SSPL release is a proprietary-style fork of the still-available AGPLv3 code, and cites Red Hat and Debian dropping MongoDB, Amazon's DocumentDB fork, and users staying on older versions as evidence the community has rejected the relicensing.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 版本是对仍可获取的 AGPLv3 代码的专有式分叉,并以 Red Hat、Debian 弃用 MongoDB、Amazon 推出 DocumentDB 分叉及用户留在旧版本证明社区已否定此次重新授权。
timeline.point: Assumes the SSPL release is a proprietary-style fork of the still-available AGPLv3 code, and cites Red Hat and Debian dropping MongoDB, Amazon's DocumentDB fork, and users staying on older versions as evidence the community has rejected the relicensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that only the license text is under review: intent, off-list clarifications, and project-side statements are immaterial unless made binding parts of the license itself — the list evaluates licensing texts, not projects.
timeline.point_zh: 主张评审只应基于许可证文本本身:意图、澄清及项目方声明除非成为许可证的约束性组成部分,否则无关紧要;评审的是文本而非项目。
timeline.point: Argues that only the license text is under review: intent, off-list clarifications, and project-side statements are immaterial unless made binding parts of the license itself — the list evaluates licensing texts, not projects.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that MongoDB's fork is structurally different from past relicensing cases because ongoing corporate investment will keep it dominant and may help Atlas compete.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 MongoDB 的分支与以往重新授权案例不同，因为持续的公司投入会让它保持优势，甚至可能帮助 Atlas 竞争。
timeline.point: Argues that MongoDB's fork is structurally different from past relicensing cases because ongoing corporate investment will keep it dominant and may help Atlas compete.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges a gap between intent and the Section 13 language in SSPL versions 1 and 2, and proposes a new Section 13 defining "Software As A Service" with two narrower copyleft triggers for the list's review and feedback.
timeline.point_zh: 承认 SSPL v1 与 v2 的 Section 13 与意图存在差距,提出新版 Section 13,定义 "Software As A Service" 并设置两条更窄的 copyleft 触发条件,供列表评审反馈。
timeline.point: Acknowledges a gap between intent and the Section 13 language in SSPL versions 1 and 2, and proposes a new Section 13 defining "Software As A Service" with two narrower copyleft triggers for the list's review and feedback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the revision still wrongly reaches separate programs used alongside the licensed program, and that removing that language would improve compliance.
timeline.point_zh: 认为修订版仍然不当地波及与受许可程序一起使用的独立程序，去掉那段过宽的措辞会更接近合规。
timeline.point: Says the revision still wrongly reaches separate programs used alongside the licensed program, and that removing that language would improve compliance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Reiterates that the SSPL violates OSD #9 by encumbering unrelated programs and that its distribution workaround does not solve the issue.
timeline.point_zh: 重申 SSPL 通过牵连无关程序而违反 OSD 第 9 条，且其绕开“分发”一词的做法并不能解决问题。
timeline.point: Reiterates that the SSPL violates OSD #9 by encumbering unrelated programs and that its distribution workaround does not solve the issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Notes Eliot's refinement is highly responsive to the primary objection to SSPL v1 and v2 and looks like an improvement, but assessing crux changes takes well more than a day; has lost confidence in the body's ability to make rigorous copyleft decisions and has stopped responding.
timeline.point_zh: 称 Eliot 的修改高度回应了对 v1 和 v2 的主要异议,看似改进,但需一天以上方能细评;已对机构严谨裁决新型 copyleft 许可证的能力失去信心,并已停止回应。
timeline.point: Notes Eliot's refinement is highly responsive to the primary objection to SSPL v1 and v2 and looks like an improvement, but assessing crux changes takes well more than a day; has lost confidence in the body's ability to make rigorous copyleft decisions and has stopped responding.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL was never OSD-compliant because its intent conflicts with OSD #6 and #9, so it should not be called open source.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 从未符合 OSD，因为其意图与第 6 条和第 9 条冲突，因此不应被称为开源。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL was never OSD-compliant because its intent conflicts with OSD #6 and #9, so it should not be called open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says SSPL still fails OSD #6 and #9, and that the SaaS wording changes do not matter until those substantive issues are fixed.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 仍然违反 OSD 第 6 条和第 9 条，而 SaaS 表述的修改在解决这些实质问题前只是表面修饰。
timeline.point: Says SSPL still fails OSD #6 and #9, and that the SaaS wording changes do not matter until those substantive issues are fixed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Defends Bruce's right to be heard and notes that the absence of other participants can be read in different ways.
timeline.point_zh: 为 Bruce 有权发言并被倾听辩护，同时指出缺席者的沉默可以有不同解读。
timeline.point: Defends Bruce's right to be heard and notes that the absence of other participants can be read in different ways.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says Bruce should be heard, but reflects on the broader debate by describing competing theories about why many people are absent from the list.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Bruce 应该被听见，同时从更大的讨论角度描述了关于许多人为何缺席该列表的两种相互竞争的解释。
timeline.point: Says Bruce should be heard, but reflects on the broader debate by describing competing theories about why many people are absent from the list.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the approval list matters because few people want to do this work and others rely on the list to get it right.
timeline.point_zh: 认为这个批准列表很重要，因为愿意参与许可证审批的人很少，而其他人都在依赖这里把事情做对。
timeline.point: Says the approval list matters because few people want to do this work and others rely on the list to get it right.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues OSD 6 never banned all discrimination — GPLv2, AGPL, OSL, and MPL all discriminate in terms or effect — so a crisp new rule on copyleft scope is needed and OSD 9 is not it; also questions why MongoDB's status as a business corporation draws repeated criticism.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSD 6 从未禁止一切歧视——GPLv2、AGPL、OSL、MPL 均有歧视——呼吁就 copyleft 范围制定清晰新规,并称 OSD 9 并非其解;质疑 MongoDB 的公司身份屡遭苛责。
timeline.point: Argues OSD 6 never banned all discrimination — GPLv2, AGPL, OSL, and MPL all discriminate in terms or effect — so a crisp new rule on copyleft scope is needed and OSD 9 is not it; also questions why MongoDB's status as a business corporation draws repeated criticism.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues SSPL over-reaches OSD #6 by demanding source code for something other than the licensed program, which AGPL and OSL never did; supports such licenses existing but insists they should not be called Open Source.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 在 OSD #6 上过度扩张,要求提供被许可程序之外程序的源码,不同于 AGPL 与 OSL;不反对此类许可证本身,但坚持不应称为开源。
timeline.point: Argues SSPL over-reaches OSD #6 by demanding source code for something other than the licensed program, which AGPL and OSL never did; supports such licenses existing but insists they should not be called Open Source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Thanks the reviewers for their work and says he remains skeptical about SSPL.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢评审所付出的努力，并表示自己仍然对 SSPL 持怀疑态度。
timeline.point: Thanks the reviewers for their work and says he remains skeptical about SSPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Withdraws the SSPL from OSI consideration, saying the community consensus needed for approval does not currently exist on its copyleft provision; MongoDB will keep offering software under the SSPL and may refine it or develop an alternative license.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布撤回 SSPL 的 OSI 审议,称其 copyleft 条款尚未获得所需社区共识;MongoDB 将继续以 SSPL 授权,并可能改进 SSPL 或开发替代许可证。
timeline.point: Withdraws the SSPL from OSI consideration, saying the community consensus needed for approval does not currently exist on its copyleft provision; MongoDB will keep offering software under the SSPL and may refine it or develop an alternative license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Expresses appreciation for Eliot's clarification and the withdrawal update.
timeline.point_zh: 对 Eliot 的澄清和撤回更新表示感谢。
timeline.point: Expresses appreciation for Eliot's clarification and the withdrawal update.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the SSPL deserved serious consideration, and criticizes the review process as a failure for not giving it that hearing.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 值得认真审议，并批评审查流程未能给予其应有的对待。
timeline.point: Says the SSPL deserved serious consideration, and criticizes the review process as a failure for not giving it that hearing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Says the main objections were about OSD 9, drafting clarity, and legal issues, and asks what a fairer approval process would look like.
timeline.point_zh: 表示主要反对意见集中在 OSD 第 9 条、措辞清晰度和法律问题，并询问更公平的审批流程应如何运作。
timeline.point: Says the main objections were about OSD 9, drafting clarity, and legal issues, and asks what a fairer approval process would look like.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Rejects the claim that SSPL discussion was an endurance race of ad hominem attacks, citing the energetic, serious OSD-conformance debate and Lukas Atkinson's summaries; holds the real question is whether the license conforms to the OSD.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳将 SSPL 讨论称为"人身攻击耐力赛"的说法,援引热烈认真的 OSD 合规讨论与 Lukas Atkinson 的总结;认为真正问题是该许可证是否符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Rejects the claim that SSPL discussion was an endurance race of ad hominem attacks, citing the energetic, serious OSD-conformance debate and Lukas Atkinson's summaries; holds the real question is whether the license conforms to the OSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that the final month of SSPL discussion was not serious enough, that OSI lost perceived impartiality, and that the process needed a fairer hearing.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 最后一个月的讨论不够认真，OSI 失去了公正性的观感，而且整个过程需要更公平的审议。
timeline.point: Argues that the final month of SSPL discussion was not serious enough, that OSI lost perceived impartiality, and that the process needed a fairer hearing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Argues that licenses should be judged on openness and drafting quality, not on the drafter's business model, and that experimentation is acceptable.
timeline.point_zh: 主张应根据自由与开放标准以及起草质量来评价许可证，而不是根据起草者的商业模式，并认为实验性尝试并非坏事。
timeline.point: Argues that licenses should be judged on openness and drafting quality, not on the drafter's business model, and that experimentation is acceptable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 2 (SSPL v2)
timeline.snippet: Observes substantive SSPL discussion had largely died down before the final month, acknowledges most commenters were critical though the license had defenders, and argues OSI never acted as arbiter because MongoDB removed the opportunity by withdrawing.
timeline.point_zh: 指 SSPL 的实质性讨论在最后一月前已基本平息,承认多数评论者持批评态度但也有支持者,并称 OSI 从未充当仲裁者,因 MongoDB 撤回而失去机会。

submissions.rejection_reason: Withdrawn by MongoDB on 2019-03-09 after extensive community opposition. Community consensus did not support approval due to concerns about OSD #9 violation.

submissions.name: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: SSPL's Section 13 extends copyleft to encompass essentially all software used to offer the program as a service, violating OSD #9 (License Must Not Restrict Other Software). Community consensus was that SSPL was not OSD-compliant.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Submitting the Server Side Public License v1 (SSPL), a GPL 3.0-based license adding a Section 13 service-source-sharing provision, for OSI approval on behalf of MongoDB, arguing AGPL failed to incentivize cloud providers to share source code.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 Server Side Public License v1（SSPL）供 OSI 审批：基于 GPL 3.0 新增第 13 条服务源码共享条款，称 AGPL 未能促使云厂商回馈社区。
timeline.point: Submitting the Server Side Public License v1 (SSPL), a GPL 3.0-based license adding a Section 13 service-source-sharing provision, for OSI approval on behalf of MongoDB, arguing AGPL failed to incentivize cloud providers to share source code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Points to MongoDB’s AGPL redline and asks whether MongoDB contacted the Free Software Foundation about whether SSPL-covered software would meet the Free Software Definition.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 MongoDB 提供了与 AGPL 的红线对比，并询问 MongoDB 是否联系 FSF 确认 SSPL 软件是否符合自由软件定义。
timeline.point: Points to MongoDB’s AGPL redline and asks whether MongoDB contacted the Free Software Foundation about whether SSPL-covered software would meet the Free Software Definition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether MongoDB can claim broad copyright over SSPL text given that much of it derives from GPL text whose notice forbids modification.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 MongoDB 能否对 SSPL 文本主张广泛版权，因为其中大量内容源自注明不得修改的 GPL 文本。
timeline.point: Questions whether MongoDB can claim broad copyright over SSPL text given that much of it derives from GPL text whose notice forbids modification.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Notes that SSPL retains GPLv3’s Aggregate paragraph, which may conflict with the new section 13.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 SSPL 保留了 GPLv3 的 Aggregate 段落，而该段可能与新的第 13 条冲突。
timeline.point: Notes that SSPL retains GPLv3’s Aggregate paragraph, which may conflict with the new section 13.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Questions MongoDB replacing FSF stewardship, asks whether SSPL could be offered as an AGPL revision, and raises practical issues around service source code on platforms like AWS.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 MongoDB 取代 FSF 作为许可证管理者，询问是否可作为 AGPL 修订提交，并提出在 AWS 等平台上服务源码的实践问题。
timeline.point: Questions MongoDB replacing FSF stewardship, asks whether SSPL could be offered as an AGPL revision, and raises practical issues around service source code on platforms like AWS.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Views SSPL section 13's conformance with OSD9 as the central policy issue, arguing its copyleft obligation is far broader than AGPLv3's, and flags ambiguous terminology and the loss of GPLv3 compatibility as practical problems.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 第 13 条是否符合 OSD9 是核心政策问题，其 copyleft 范围远超 AGPLv3，且术语含糊、缺失 GPLv3 兼容性条款构成实际隐患。
timeline.point: Views SSPL section 13's conformance with OSD9 as the central policy issue, arguing its copyleft obligation is far broader than AGPLv3's, and flags ambiguous terminology and the loss of GPLv3 compatibility as practical problems.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Raises copyright concerns about modifying FSF license text and argues section 13 may violate OSD 9 and 6 by reaching separately aggregated service software.
timeline.point_zh: 提出修改 FSF 许可证文本的版权疑虑，并认为第 13 条可能因触及单独聚合的服务软件而违反 OSD 9 和 6。
timeline.point: Raises copyright concerns about modifying FSF license text and argues section 13 may violate OSD 9 and 6 by reaching separately aggregated service software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says the GPL copyright issue appears moot after reviewing the FSF FAQ on modifying GPL text.
timeline.point_zh: 查看 FSF 关于修改 GPL 文本的 FAQ 后，认为 GPL 版权问题似乎已无实际争议。
timeline.point: Says the GPL copyright issue appears moot after reviewing the FSF FAQ on modifying GPL text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the OSI should not waste its time reviewing SSPL because MongoDB released it without any public drafting or comment process, and suggests OSI ask MongoDB to withdraw the submission and engage in an open process like copyleft-next's.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSI 不应浪费时间审查 SSPL，因 MongoDB 未经过公开起草与意见程序；建议 OSI 要求 MongoDB 撤回并开展类似 copyleft-next 的公开流程。
timeline.point: Argues the OSI should not waste its time reviewing SSPL because MongoDB released it without any public drafting or comment process, and suggests OSI ask MongoDB to withdraw the submission and engage in an open process like copyleft-next's.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues SSPL perverts copyleft by replacing clear derivativeness boundaries with the vague 'derivation of value' concept, insists a license must be judged on its self-contained text rather than its FAQ, and is totally in favor of outright rejection.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 以含糊的“derivation of value”取代清晰的衍生边界，是对 copyleft 的歪曲；强调许可证必须自足、按文本而非 FAQ 审查，并完全支持直接否决。
timeline.point: Argues SSPL perverts copyleft by replacing clear derivativeness boundaries with the vague 'derivation of value' concept, insists a license must be judged on its self-contained text rather than its FAQ, and is totally in favor of outright rejection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that criticism of SSPL is aimed at the license, not MongoDB or its drafters, while suggesting review may need insulation from authority bias.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清对 SSPL 的批评针对许可证而非 MongoDB 或起草者，并提出审查可能需要避免权威偏见。
timeline.point: Clarifies that criticism of SSPL is aimed at the license, not MongoDB or its drafters, while suggesting review may need insulation from authority bias.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Confirms that OSI was not involved before MongoDB publicly submitted SSPL.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 OSI 在 MongoDB 公开提交 SSPL 之前没有参与。
timeline.point: Confirms that OSI was not involved before MongoDB publicly submitted SSPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says OSI should formally require public drafting prospectively, but is reluctant to apply that unwritten requirement retroactively to SSPL.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSI 应正式要求公开起草流程，但不愿把这种未成文要求追溯适用于 SSPL。
timeline.point: Says OSI should formally require public drafting prospectively, but is reluctant to apply that unwritten requirement retroactively to SSPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether the public license-review mailing list itself satisfies the public process need, noting submitters can respond to drafting and OSD concerns there.
timeline.point_zh: 询问公开的 license-review 邮件列表本身是否已满足公开流程需求，并指出提交者可在此回应起草和 OSD 问题。
timeline.point: Questions whether the public license-review mailing list itself satisfies the public process need, noting submitters can respond to drafting and OSD concerns there.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: States that MongoDB has not yet spoken with the Free Software Foundation but hopes to discuss SSPL with them soon.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 MongoDB 尚未与自由软件基金会沟通，但希望很快就 SSPL 与其讨论。
timeline.point: States that MongoDB has not yet spoken with the Free Software Foundation but hopes to discuss SSPL with them soon.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Points out the license lacks a definition of 'service' and doubts any user can comply on GNU/Linux since components like Linux, GCC, and glibc would all have to be provided under it, then questions MongoDB's actual commercial objectives.
timeline.point_zh: 指出“service”缺乏定义，并质疑用户在 GNU/Linux 上根本无法合规（Linux、GCC、glibc 等都须依该许可证提供），进而质询 MongoDB 的真实商业目标。
timeline.point: Points out the license lacks a definition of 'service' and doubts any user can comply on GNU/Linux since components like Linux, GCC, and glibc would all have to be provided under it, then questions MongoDB's actual commercial objectives.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Defends strongly criticizing MongoDB's conduct in license review, arguing the review process is inherently political and that MongoDB deploys copyleft as a scare tactic to sell proprietary licenses, harming FOSS.
timeline.point_zh: 为在许可证审查中强烈批评 MongoDB 行为辩护，认为审查过程本质上是政治性的，并谴责 MongoDB 将 copyleft 用作推销专有许可证的恐吓手段、损害 FOSS。
timeline.point: Defends strongly criticizing MongoDB's conduct in license review, arguing the review process is inherently political and that MongoDB deploys copyleft as a scare tactic to sell proprietary licenses, harming FOSS.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Corrects the AGPL history by noting OSI archives exist and that AGPLv3 was submitted in January 2008 and approved in March 2008.
timeline.point_zh: 更正 AGPL 历史，指出 OSI 档案存在，且 AGPLv3 于 2008 年 1 月提交、3 月获批。
timeline.point: Corrects the AGPL history by noting OSI archives exist and that AGPLv3 was submitted in January 2008 and approved in March 2008.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that his earlier caution was personal, not a call to suppress harsh comments, while noting that detachment from license authors may still help avoid contextual bias.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清此前的谨慎只是个人顾虑，并非要求压制尖锐评论；同时指出与许可证作者保持距离可能有助于避免背景偏见。
timeline.point: Clarifies that his earlier caution was personal, not a call to suppress harsh comments, while noting that detachment from license authors may still help avoid contextual bias.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says the mailing list is the public process, urges focus on improving SSPL rather than meta-issues, and discloses recusal because MongoDB is a client.
timeline.point_zh: 认为邮件列表就是公开流程，敦促聚焦改进 SSPL 而非元问题，并披露因 MongoDB 是客户而回避审批决定。
timeline.point: Says the mailing list is the public process, urges focus on improving SSPL rather than meta-issues, and discloses recusal because MongoDB is a client.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Defends the SSPL, arguing linking has been superseded by service-based program combination, so copyleft should cover all components that make a service run. Says compatibility with other copyleft licenses would undermine section 13 and denies intent to drive users to commercial licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 为 SSPL 辩护:认为链接已被服务化组合取代,copyleft 应覆盖构成服务的所有组件;称与其他 copyleft 许可证兼容会破坏第 13 条,否认旨在推动用户转向商业许可。
timeline.point: Defends the SSPL, arguing linking has been superseded by service-based program combination, so copyleft should cover all components that make a service run. Says compatibility with other copyleft licenses would undermine section 13 and denies intent to drive users to commercial licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Questions the SSPL's broad "all programs" wording as vague and likely to require judicial interpretation. Argues that giving paying users greater rights than non-paying users violates the OSD and the principle of equality between users.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 SSPL 中“all programs”措辞过于宽泛模糊,恐需法官裁定;认为付费用户获得比非付费用户更多权利,违反 OSD 及用户平等原则。
timeline.point: Questions the SSPL's broad "all programs" wording as vague and likely to require judicial interpretation. Argues that giving paying users greater rights than non-paying users violates the OSD and the principle of equality between users.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether Simon represents MongoDB and requests that the license drafter speak directly.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 Simon 是否代表 MongoDB，并要求许可证起草者直接发言。
timeline.point: Asks whether Simon represents MongoDB and requests that the license drafter speak directly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues OSI license-review's narrow ~60-day OSD evaluation is the wrong forum for deciding copyleft expansion, and asks MongoDB to withdraw, moving that discussion to license-discuss and broader community forums for multi-year consensus.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSI 许可证评审约 60 天的 OSD 评估不适合决定 copyleft 扩展,建议 MongoDB 撤回申请,将讨论移至 license-discuss 及社区论坛以达成多年期共识。
timeline.point: Argues OSI license-review's narrow ~60-day OSD evaluation is the wrong forum for deciding copyleft expansion, and asks MongoDB to withdraw, moving that discussion to license-discuss and broader community forums for multi-year consensus.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that he neither represents MongoDB nor drafted SSPL.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清自己既不代表 MongoDB，也没有起草 SSPL。
timeline.point: Clarifies that he neither represents MongoDB nor drafted SSPL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Supports the request that MongoDB withdraw SSPL and move copyleft expansion discussion elsewhere.
timeline.point_zh: 支持要求 MongoDB 撤回 SSPL，并将 copyleft 扩展讨论移至其他场所。
timeline.point: Supports the request that MongoDB withdraw SSPL and move copyleft expansion discussion elsewhere.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Also supports withdrawing SSPL for broader discussion, though does not suggest a venue.
timeline.point_zh: 也支持撤回 SSPL 以进行更广泛讨论，但未建议具体场所。
timeline.point: Also supports withdrawing SSPL for broader discussion, though does not suggest a venue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the SSPL would be unworkable for distributions, since compiling the software is a service and distributions rely on the GNU toolchain and non-free TCP stacks. Questions MongoDB's AGPL compliance history and suspects it is not upfront about its intentions.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 对发行版难以适用——编译软件即属服务,且发行版依赖 GNU 工具链和非自由 TCP 栈;质疑 MongoDB 的 AGPL 合规历史,并怀疑其未坦诚真实意图。
timeline.point: Argues the SSPL would be unworkable for distributions, since compiling the software is a service and distributions rely on the GNU toolchain and non-free TCP stacks. Questions MongoDB's AGPL compliance history and suspects it is not upfront about its intentions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Warns that SSPL triggers on mere use rather than modification, which may be a major difference from AGPL and a blocker under OSD 6 or Freedom 0.
timeline.point_zh: 警告 SSPL 仅因使用即触发义务而非修改后使用，这可能是相对 AGPL 的重大差异，并可能违反 OSD 第 6 条或自由 0。
timeline.point: Warns that SSPL triggers on mere use rather than modification, which may be a major difference from AGPL and a blocker under OSD 6 or Freedom 0.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Supports moving the issue to a broader public process, arguing that companies should no longer craft one-off FOSS licenses behind closed doors.
timeline.point_zh: 支持将此问题移至更广泛的公开流程，认为公司不应再闭门制定一次性的 FOSS 许可证。
timeline.point: Supports moving the issue to a broader public process, arguing that companies should no longer craft one-off FOSS licenses behind closed doors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Notes precedents where OSI-approved licenses treat network service provision or private modifications as triggering obligations.
timeline.point_zh: 指出已有 OSI 批准许可证将网络服务提供或私下修改作为触发义务的先例。
timeline.point: Notes precedents where OSI-approved licenses treat network service provision or private modifications as triggering obligations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Endorses Bradley Kuhn's criticism and would support asking MongoDB to withdraw for public drafting if he had standing.
timeline.point_zh: 赞同 Bradley Kuhn 的批评，并表示若有资格会支持要求 MongoDB 撤回并进行公开起草。
timeline.point: Endorses Bradley Kuhn's criticism and would support asking MongoDB to withdraw for public drafting if he had standing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Distinguishes OSL and NPOSL from SSPL because they require only original or derivative source, and says OSL already serves server-side needs without SSPL's source-code risk.
timeline.point_zh: 区分 OSL、NPOSL 与 SSPL，因前者只要求原作品或派生作品源码；并称 OSL 已能满足服务端需求且没有 SSPL 的源码风险。
timeline.point: Distinguishes OSL and NPOSL from SSPL because they require only original or derivative source, and says OSL already serves server-side needs without SSPL's source-code risk.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI should only judge OSD compliance, not redefine copyleft, and says SSPL should not use OSI review to bypass the copyleft community.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 只应判断是否符合 OSD，而不应重新定义 copyleft；并称 SSPL 不应借 OSI 审查绕过 copyleft 社区。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI should only judge OSD compliance, not redefine copyleft, and says SSPL should not use OSI review to bypass the copyleft community.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees license-review is a poor forum for soliciting input or revising a license, but argues copyleft belongs to no organization and OSI has a record of legitimizing copyleft expansion. Observes the consensus process lets incumbents and targeted competitors block stronger copyleft licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 license-review 不是征求意见或修订许可证的好渠道;主张 copyleft 不专属任何组织,OSI 曾推动 copyleft 扩展,共识规则让在位者与被针对的竞争者可阻止更强 copyleft 许可证获批。
timeline.point: Agrees license-review is a poor forum for soliciting input or revising a license, but argues copyleft belongs to no organization and OSI has a record of legitimizing copyleft expansion. Observes the consensus process lets incumbents and targeted competitors block stronger copyleft licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Reiterates that OSI's role is only to determine whether a license is open source under the OSD, not to define or extend copyleft.
timeline.point_zh: 重申 OSI 的职责只是根据 OSD 判断许可证是否开源，而不是定义或扩展 copyleft。
timeline.point: Reiterates that OSI's role is only to determine whether a license is open source under the OSD, not to define or extend copyleft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Supports withdrawing the matter from license-review because copyleft limits are too complex for a 60-day mailing-list decision.
timeline.point_zh: 支持将此事撤出 license-review，因为 copyleft 边界过于复杂，不适合在 60 天邮件列表审查中决定。
timeline.point: Supports withdrawing the matter from license-review because copyleft limits are too complex for a 60-day mailing-list decision.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Moderates the discussion by asking participants to focus license-review on SSPL's current OSD compliance and move broader procedural or philosophical issues elsewhere.
timeline.point_zh: 以主持身份要求参与者将 license-review 聚焦于 SSPL 当前是否符合 OSD，并把更广泛的程序或哲学问题移至其他列表。
timeline.point: Moderates the discussion by asking participants to focus license-review on SSPL's current OSD compliance and move broader procedural or philosophical issues elsewhere.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues SSPL v1 is likely unenforceable under US law due to copyright misuse and impossibility, citing Lasercomb and related cases; the Service Source Code clause is designed to sweep in and force disclosure of code beyond the copyrighted work.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL v1 因版权滥用在美国法下很可能不可执行，援引 Lasercomb 等判例；其 Service Source Code 条款旨在囊括并强制披露超出该作品范围的代码。
timeline.point: Argues SSPL v1 is likely unenforceable under US law due to copyright misuse and impossibility, citing Lasercomb and related cases; the Service Source Code clause is designed to sweep in and force disclosure of code beyond the copyrighted work.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees with the copyright-misuse critique of SSPL, adding that the license's essentially unbounded patent grant — reaching everyone and all programs used to offer the service — may also trigger patent misuse.
timeline.point_zh: 赞同对 SSPL 的版权滥用批评，并称该许可证几乎无界的专利授权（覆盖所有人及提供服务所用程序）也可能触发专利滥用。
timeline.point: Agrees with the copyright-misuse critique of SSPL, adding that the license's essentially unbounded patent grant — reaching everyone and all programs used to offer the service — may also trigger patent misuse.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Disagrees that SSPL presents patent misuse, but says the patent license's implied scope is immense and may deter adoption.
timeline.point_zh: 不同意 SSPL 构成专利滥用，但认为其专利许可的隐含范围极大，可能阻碍采用。
timeline.point: Disagrees that SSPL presents patent misuse, but says the patent license's implied scope is immense and may deter adoption.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says OSD-compliant copyleft extensions are welcome on the list, though SSPL is not there yet, and frames OSI as a Free Software organization.
timeline.point_zh: 表示符合 OSD 的 copyleft 扩展可在列表讨论，尽管 SSPL 尚未达到要求，并将 OSI 定位为自由软件组织。
timeline.point: Says OSD-compliant copyleft extensions are welcome on the list, though SSPL is not there yet, and frames OSI as a Free Software organization.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that SSPL inherits AGPLv3's express patent grant and may require a no-charge patent license for Service Source Code, though whether that is a flaw is debatable.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 SSPL 继承 AGPLv3 的明示专利授权，可能要求对 Service Source Code 提供免费专利许可，但这是否为缺陷仍有争议。
timeline.point: Clarifies that SSPL inherits AGPLv3's express patent grant and may require a no-charge patent license for Service Source Code, though whether that is a flaw is debatable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Requests OSI counsel's view on copyright misuse unless SSPL is withdrawn soon, and asks why the drafter is unidentified and absent from discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 要求除非 SSPL 很快撤回，否则需 OSI 律师评估版权滥用问题，并质疑起草者为何未明确身份且未参与讨论。
timeline.point: Requests OSI counsel's view on copyright misuse unless SSPL is withdrawn soon, and asks why the drafter is unidentified and absent from discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the patent grant is express but its Service Source Code scope is massively broad, likely intended as a feature but drafted as a bug.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清专利授权是明示的，但 Service Source Code 定义带来的范围极其宽泛，可能本意是特性却被写成缺陷。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the patent grant is express but its Service Source Code scope is massively broad, likely intended as a feature but drafted as a bug.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Notes that Eliot stated in his initial submission that his lawyer was Heather Meeker.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 Eliot 在初始提交中已说明其律师是 Heather Meeker。
timeline.point: Notes that Eliot stated in his initial submission that his lawyer was Heather Meeker.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL's undefined term 'functionality' is extremely problematic because it could be read to restrict any software with MongoDB-like functionality.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 未定义的“functionality”极有问题，因为可能被解读为限制任何具有 MongoDB 类似功能的软件。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL's undefined term 'functionality' is extremely problematic because it could be read to restrict any software with MongoDB-like functionality.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the protective aim is intentional and legitimate, but says OSD 6 and 9 set limits that SSPL may exceed and may not enforceably cross.
timeline.point_zh: 承认保护开源创作者的目标是有意且正当的，但认为 OSD 第 6、9 条设定了边界，SSPL 可能越界且未必可执行。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the protective aim is intentional and legitimate, but says OSD 6 and 9 set limits that SSPL may exceed and may not enforceably cross.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that contractual language could use the defined term "public performance" to create a public-performance-like obligation for software, despite copyright law not granting that right for software.
timeline.point_zh: 主张可以在合同语言中使用已有的“公开表演”概念，为软件构造类似公开表演的义务，尽管版权法本身未赋予软件这种权利。
timeline.point: Argues that contractual language could use the defined term "public performance" to create a public-performance-like obligation for software, despite copyright law not granting that right for software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Rebuts the copyright-misuse argument: SSPL does not suppress independent implementations of the idea, only competition using Mongo's own code; Lasercomb targeted terms barring competition entirely, and no cases link misuse to the scope of derivative works.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳版权滥用论：SSPL 并未禁止独立实现该构想，仅禁止借 Mongo 自身代码竞争；Lasercomb 针对全面禁止竞争的条款，且无判例将滥用与演绎作品范围挂钩。
timeline.point: Rebuts the copyright-misuse argument: SSPL does not suppress independent implementations of the idea, only competition using Mongo's own code; Lasercomb targeted terms barring competition entirely, and no cases link misuse to the scope of derivative works.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that contract is not necessarily the only legal tool for network copyleft, because later cases blurred the license-contract boundary and adjacent movements use broader approaches.
timeline.point_zh: 主张网络 copyleft 未必只能依赖合同法，因为后续案例模糊了许可证与合同的边界，相关运动也采用了更宽的路径。
timeline.point: Argues that contract is not necessarily the only legal tool for network copyleft, because later cases blurred the license-contract boundary and adjacent movements use broader approaches.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that comments about SSPL are welcome on the thread, while broader procedural or philosophical discussions should move to license-discuss.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清有关 SSPL 的评论仍欢迎在该线程讨论，但更广泛的程序性或哲学性问题应移至 license-discuss。
timeline.point: Clarifies that comments about SSPL are welcome on the thread, while broader procedural or philosophical discussions should move to license-discuss.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Reads the misuse case law differently and argues a court would find misuse: SSPL reaches the service operator's rights in non-derivative software and exists to block otherwise-lawful competition to MongoDB; contract-law alternatives forfeit injunctions and statutory damages.
timeline.point_zh: 对判例作不同解读并称法院会认定滥用：SSPL 触及服务运营者对非演绎软件的权利，旨在阻止对 MongoDB 的合法竞争；改用合同法则会失去禁令与法定赔偿。
timeline.point: Reads the misuse case law differently and argues a court would find misuse: SSPL reaches the service operator's rights in non-derivative software and exists to block otherwise-lawful competition to MongoDB; contract-law alternatives forfeit injunctions and statutory damages.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: States that some people disagree with the claim being discussed, without developing a substantive license position.
timeline.point_zh: 表示有人不同意正在讨论的说法，但未展开具体的许可证立场。
timeline.point: States that some people disagree with the claim being discussed, without developing a substantive license position.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says such disagreement may exist, but should no longer be within OSI's scope.
timeline.point_zh: 表示这种分歧可以存在，但不应再属于 OSI 的范围。
timeline.point: Says such disagreement may exist, but should no longer be within OSI's scope.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI should focus on open source as distinct from free software, rather than treating itself as a free software organization.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 应专注于区别于自由软件的开源定位，而不是把自身视为自由软件组织。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI should focus on open source as distinct from free software, rather than treating itself as a free software organization.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Directs the list to keep license-review focused on reviewing licenses and move other licensing discussions to license-discuss.
timeline.point_zh: 要求 license-review 列表专注于许可证审查，并将其他许可相关讨论移至 license-discuss。
timeline.point: Directs the list to keep license-review focused on reviewing licenses and move other licensing discussions to license-discuss.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether SSPL review should proceed or be deferred, while saying SSPL is personally a bridge too far and should be assessed from an open source perspective.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 SSPL 审查应继续还是延期，同时表示个人认为 SSPL 走得太远，并应从开源视角评估。
timeline.point: Asks whether SSPL review should proceed or be deferred, while saying SSPL is personally a bridge too far and should be assessed from an open source perspective.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says SSPL has obvious problems and that rejection is inevitable unless MongoDB's drafter engages constructively to fix them.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 存在明显问题，除非 MongoDB 起草方建设性地参与修正，否则被拒不可避免。
timeline.point: Says SSPL has obvious problems and that rejection is inevitable unless MongoDB's drafter engages constructively to fix them.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues copyright misuse is a largely theoretical equitable defense, rarely successful outside anticompetitive conduct, and that the SSPL imposes no use restrictions — so misuse concerns are no reason to reject the license.
timeline.point_zh: 主张版权滥用是很少成功的衡平法抗辩，SSPL 不限制软件使用，滥用之虑不应成为否决该许可证的理由。
timeline.point: Argues copyright misuse is a largely theoretical equitable defense, rarely successful outside anticompetitive conduct, and that the SSPL imposes no use restrictions — so misuse concerns are no reason to reject the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL does not violate OSD 6 because its rules are facially the same for all fields, even if different deployment choices trigger different copyleft obligations.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 不违反 OSD 6，因为其规则表面上适用于所有领域，即使不同部署选择会触发不同 copyleft 义务。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL does not violate OSD 6 because its rules are facially the same for all fields, even if different deployment choices trigger different copyleft obligations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that MongoDB did not intend compilation to trigger Section 13 service obligations and will consider clarifying the license.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 MongoDB 无意让编译行为触发第 13 条的服务义务，并会考虑是否需要澄清许可证。
timeline.point: Clarifies that MongoDB did not intend compilation to trigger Section 13 service obligations and will consider clarifying the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL violates OSD 6 and 9 by discriminating against service providers and blocking use of AGPL third-party infrastructure software; urges withdrawal until fixed.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 因歧视服务提供者并阻止使用 AGPL 第三方基础设施软件而违反 OSD 6 和 9，建议在修正前撤回。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL violates OSD 6 and 9 by discriminating against service providers and blocking use of AGPL third-party infrastructure software; urges withdrawal until fixed.
