timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Questions the argument that SSPL prevents otherwise lawful copies, suggesting noncompliance with Section 13 would make the copies unlawful and the reasoning circular.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 SSPL 阻止本来合法复制的说法，认为未遵守第 13 条则复制并不合法，因此该论证可能是循环的。
timeline.point: Questions the argument that SSPL prevents otherwise lawful copies, suggesting noncompliance with Section 13 would make the copies unlawful and the reasoning circular.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether MongoDB had permission to base SSPL on the GPL text, saying the license would be dead on arrival if not.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 MongoDB 是否获准以 GPL 文本为基础起草 SSPL，并表示若没有许可则该许可证根本无法成立。
timeline.point: Asks whether MongoDB had permission to base SSPL on the GPL text, saying the license would be dead on arrival if not.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the SSPL gives different rights to downstream users depending on whether they pay an upstream user, violating OSD 5, and that the license should be withdrawn for a community process including end-users.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 依下游用户是否向上游付费而给予不同权利，违反 OSD 第 5 条，应撤回该许可证并由包括最终用户在内的社区程序重新评估。
timeline.point: Argues the SSPL gives different rights to downstream users depending on whether they pay an upstream user, violating OSD 5, and that the license should be withdrawn for a community process including end-users.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Answers that using GPL text is not an issue because the FSF permits copying its licenses if the preamble is removed.
timeline.point_zh: 回答称使用 GPL 文本不是问题，因为 FSF 允许在删除序言后复制其许可证文本。
timeline.point: Answers that using GPL text is not an issue because the FSF permits copying its licenses if the preamble is removed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL clearly fails OSD 9 and likely OSD 6 because Section 13 reaches non-derivative programs and may be impossible to comply with.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 明显不符合 OSD 9，并可能违反 OSD 6，因为第 13 条触及非衍生程序且实际合规可能不可能。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL clearly fails OSD 9 and likely OSD 6 because Section 13 reaches non-derivative programs and may be impossible to comply with.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees that SSPL fails OSD 6 and 9, while noting that some hypotheticals are mooted by the operating system and system libraries exception.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 SSPL 不符合 OSD 6 和 9，但指出部分假设因操作系统和系统库例外而不成立。
timeline.point: Agrees that SSPL fails OSD 6 and 9, while noting that some hypotheticals are mooted by the operating system and system libraries exception.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that Section 13 requires relicensing build tools under SSPL because system-library exceptions do not apply when those tools themselves are the source-code target.
timeline.point_zh: 主张第 13 条要求将构建工具重新许可为 SSPL，因为当这些工具本身成为源码对象时，系统库例外并不适用。
timeline.point: Argues that Section 13 requires relicensing build tools under SSPL because system-library exceptions do not apply when those tools themselves are the source-code target.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether SSPL section 13 extends to third-party users of composed services — if so it is a copyleft landmine reaching too far; calls it a CC-SA-NC-type license that fails the OSD and challenges anyone to argue it doesn't violate OSD 6 or 9.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 SSPL 第 13 条是否约束组合服务的第三方用户——若是则是 copyleft 地雷；称其为 CC-SA-NC 型许可证、不符合 OSD，并质问谁能论证其不违反 OSD 第 6/9 条。
timeline.point: Questions whether SSPL section 13 extends to third-party users of composed services — if so it is a copyleft landmine reaching too far; calls it a CC-SA-NC-type license that fails the OSD and challenges anyone to argue it doesn't violate OSD 6 or 9.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Recommends the OSI continue evaluating whether SSPL violates the OSD even if withdrawn and state the result clearly, so MongoDB cannot imply open-source status as with CC0; criticizes the silent license switch as bad faith.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 OSI 即使 SSPL 撤回也继续评估其是否违反 OSD 并明确结论，以防 MongoDB 借 CC0 先例暗示其开源；批评其悄然更换许可证并非善意行事。
timeline.point: Recommends the OSI continue evaluating whether SSPL violates the OSD even if withdrawn and state the result clearly, so MongoDB cannot imply open-source status as with CC0; criticizes the silent license switch as bad faith.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Explains that OSI generally does not declare licenses non-open-source and that non-certification or withdrawal does not itself determine OSD conformance.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 OSI 通常不会公开宣称某许可证不是开源，且未认证或撤回本身并不决定其是否符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Explains that OSI generally does not declare licenses non-open-source and that non-certification or withdrawal does not itself determine OSD conformance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Maintains copyright misuse remains an issue because the SSPL intentionally sweeps in vast unrelated works; the right bar is whether the license controls works beyond the copyright grant, and the OSI should not accept a license with such an infirmity.
timeline.point_zh: 坚持版权滥用仍是 SSPL 的问题，因其有意覆盖大量无关作品；正确标准是许可证是否控制版权授予范围之外的作品，OSI 不应接受有此缺陷的许可证。
timeline.point: Maintains copyright misuse remains an issue because the SSPL intentionally sweeps in vast unrelated works; the right bar is whether the license controls works beyond the copyright grant, and the OSI should not accept a license with such an infirmity.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks why critics see a paying-user distinction, arguing SSPL triggers on offering functionality as a service regardless of payment and provides source to everyone free of charge.
timeline.point_zh: 询问批评者为何认为存在付费用户区分，并主张 SSPL 无论是否收费都因作为服务提供功能而触发，且源码免费提供给所有人。
timeline.point: Asks why critics see a paying-user distinction, arguing SSPL triggers on offering functionality as a service regardless of payment and provides source to everyone free of charge.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks why SSPL uses "includes, without limitation" in Section 13, suggesting the examples may be redundant and make the license unnecessarily confusing.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 SSPL 第 13 条为何使用“包括但不限于”措辞，并指出这些示例可能冗余且使许可证不必要地混乱。
timeline.point: Asks why SSPL uses "includes, without limitation" in Section 13, suggesting the examples may be redundant and make the license unnecessarily confusing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether "includes, without limitation" expands Section 13 and says, if so, SSPL gives users different rights based on their business relationship with the service operator.
timeline.point_zh: 询问“包括但不限于”是否扩展第 13 条，并表示若是如此，SSPL 就会根据用户与服务运营者的商业关系赋予不同权利。
timeline.point: Asks whether "includes, without limitation" expands Section 13 and says, if so, SSPL gives users different rights based on their business relationship with the service operator.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues copyright misuse is unsettled outside anticompetitive practices, that claims SSPL is prima facie misuse lack a basis in current case law, and that the SanDisk patent cases are inapposite since cross-licenses are common and enforceable.
timeline.point_zh: 主张版权滥用在反竞争行为之外并无法律定论，称 SSPL 构成滥用的说法缺乏现行判例依据，SanDisk 专利滥用案并不适用，交叉许可普遍且可执行。
timeline.point: Argues copyright misuse is unsettled outside anticompetitive practices, that claims SSPL is prima facie misuse lack a basis in current case law, and that the SanDisk patent cases are inapposite since cross-licenses are common and enforceable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that copyright misuse is secondary to SSPL's OSD conformance and that review should focus on OSD 9, 5, 6, and impracticability rather than enforceability speculation.
timeline.point_zh: 主张版权滥用相对于 SSPL 是否符合 OSD 是次要问题，审查应聚焦 OSD 9、5、6 和履行困难，而非可执行性推测。
timeline.point: Argues that copyright misuse is secondary to SSPL's OSD conformance and that review should focus on OSD 9, 5, 6, and impracticability rather than enforceability speculation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Points readers to a StackExchange answer summarizing the SSPL discussion so far.
timeline.point_zh: 指引读者查看一个 StackExchange 回答，其中总结了目前为止的 SSPL 讨论。
timeline.point: Points readers to a StackExchange answer summarizing the SSPL discussion so far.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Responds to the main objections to SSPL v1, arguing field-of-endeavor differences are de facto rather than de jure, copyleft incompatibility is inherent, Section 13 scope will be clarified, and the copyright misuse theory lacks basis in existing law.
timeline.point_zh: 回应针对 SSPL v1 的主要反对意见：领域差异是事实上的而非法律上的，copyleft 不兼容是固有属性，第 13 条范围将予澄清，版权滥用理论缺乏现行法律依据。
timeline.point: Responds to the main objections to SSPL v1, arguing field-of-endeavor differences are de facto rather than de jure, copyleft incompatibility is inherent, Section 13 scope will be clarified, and the copyright misuse theory lacks basis in existing law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Concludes SSPLv1 conforms to the OSD, arguing copyleft limits are left undefined and OSI should state any additional criteria transparently; holds one substantial reservation about section 13's "offering ... primary purpose" language.
timeline.point_zh: SSPLv1符合OSD,但其copyleft限制未界定,OSI应透明说明额外标准;对第13条“offering ... primary purpose”措辞持重大保留。
timeline.point: Concludes SSPLv1 conforms to the OSD, arguing copyleft limits are left undefined and OSI should state any additional criteria transparently; holds one substantial reservation about section 13's "offering ... primary purpose" language.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that accepting SSPL would create a network-copyleft loophole for restrictions the OSD forbids, so the license should be withdrawn or rejected.
timeline.point_zh: 主张接受 SSPL 会为 OSD 禁止的限制开辟网络 copyleft 漏洞，因此该许可证应撤回或拒绝。
timeline.point: Argues that accepting SSPL would create a network-copyleft loophole for restrictions the OSD forbids, so the license should be withdrawn or rejected.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that SSPL sacrifices important freedoms for a profit-oriented dual-licensing business model and should be denied as not open source.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 SSPL 为以利润为导向的双重许可商业模式牺牲重要自由，因此应被拒绝为非开源。
timeline.point: Argues that SSPL sacrifices important freedoms for a profit-oriented dual-licensing business model and should be denied as not open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that copyleft inherently distinguishes among development choices, and that SSPL-like network distinctions are not the discrimination prohibited by OSD 5 or 6.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 copyleft 本身会区分开发选择，而 SSPL 式的网络区分并不是 OSD 5 或 6 所禁止的歧视。
timeline.point: Argues that copyleft inherently distinguishes among development choices, and that SSPL-like network distinctions are not the discrimination prohibited by OSD 5 or 6.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Agrees that copyleft has always fit awkwardly with OSD 5 and 6, noting GPLv3 also imposes different obligations without being treated as OSD 6 discrimination.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 copyleft 一直与 OSD 5 和 6 尤其是 6 存在张力，并指出 GPLv3 也施加不同义务但未被视为违反 OSD 6。
timeline.point: Agrees that copyleft has always fit awkwardly with OSD 5 and 6, noting GPLv3 also imposes different obligations without being treated as OSD 6 discrimination.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Rebuts the 'network profitleft' critique: there is nothing wrong with profit, and it is licensees, not licensors, who want the network copyleft model; network copyleft is a profitable FOSS business model for underpaid developers, and the software is still FOSS.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 'profitleft' 的批评：盈利无可厚非，需要网络 copyleft 模式的是被许可人而非许可人；这是低薪开发者的盈利性 FOSS 商业模式，软件仍是 FOSS。
timeline.point: Rebuts the 'network profitleft' critique: there is nothing wrong with profit, and it is licensees, not licensors, who want the network copyleft model; network copyleft is a profitable FOSS business model for underpaid developers, and the software is still FOSS.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSD 5 discrimination concerns inherent characteristics or unrelated behaviors, not choices about consuming, distributing, or modifying software.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSD 5 中的歧视针对固有特征或与软件使用无关的行为，而非消费、分发或修改软件的方式选择。
timeline.point: Argues that OSD 5 discrimination concerns inherent characteristics or unrelated behaviors, not choices about consuming, distributing, or modifying software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues copyleft is inherently dual-use and SSPLv1's hybrid of permissive and strengthened copyleft appeals only to business constituencies, not activists; asks whether business-only community support suffices for approval, and questions FSF's stance on private changes.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 copyleft 历来具双重用途，SSPLv1 兼具宽松与强化 copyleft 只迎合商业群体而非活动家；质疑仅获商业界支持是否足以批准，并追问 FSF 对私有修改的立场。
timeline.point: Argues copyleft is inherently dual-use and SSPLv1's hybrid of permissive and strengthened copyleft appeals only to business constituencies, not activists; asks whether business-only community support suffices for approval, and questions FSF's stance on private changes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues that copyleft is not discriminatory in the OSD 5/6 sense, and says SSPL does not appear discriminatory even though the sender does not like it.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 copyleft 并不构成 OSD 5/6 意义上的歧视，并表示虽然不太喜欢 SSPL，但不认为它构成歧视。
timeline.point: Argues that copyleft is not discriminatory in the OSD 5/6 sense, and says SSPL does not appear discriminatory even though the sender does not like it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Reads OSD 5 & 6 as barring only textual preclusion of uses, so SSPL does not violate them; but argues SSPL and LZPL violate OSD 9 by dictating terms to other software that never exercises the granted rights, and suggests a board ruling on OSD 9's scope.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSD 5、6 仅禁止许可证文本排除特定使用，SSPL 并不违反；但主张 SSPL 与 LZPL 向未行使所授权利的其他软件强加条款，违反 OSD 9，建议董事会就此裁定。
timeline.point: Reads OSD 5 & 6 as barring only textual preclusion of uses, so SSPL does not violate them; but argues SSPL and LZPL violate OSD 9 by dictating terms to other software that never exercises the granted rights, and suggests a board ruling on OSD 9's scope.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says OSD 9 is the main problem because SSPL’s Service Source Code requirement is far broader than AGPL’s corresponding-source rule, and the carve-outs probably are not enough for OSI.
timeline.point_zh: 认为核心问题在于 OSD 9，因为 SSPL 对“服务源代码”的要求远宽于 AGPL 的对应源代码义务，而系统库等豁免大概不足以满足 OSI。
timeline.point: Says OSD 9 is the main problem because SSPL’s Service Source Code requirement is far broader than AGPL’s corresponding-source rule, and the carve-outs probably are not enough for OSI.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues OSD 9 cannot tell us where copyleft reach should end, so the OSD-9-based case against SSPL fails; contends SSPL's reach across network linking and service components serves the same rationale as dynamic-linking reach and targets the AGPLv3 'API Loophole'.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSD 9 无法划定 copyleft 界线，以之反对 SSPL 的论据不成立；SSPL 跨网络触及的理据与允许动态链接触及一致，旨在应对 AGPLv3 的 'API Loophole'。
timeline.point: Argues OSD 9 cannot tell us where copyleft reach should end, so the OSD-9-based case against SSPL fails; contends SSPL's reach across network linking and service components serves the same rationale as dynamic-linking reach and targets the AGPLv3 'API Loophole'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says that putting a GPL component into an application means the application must be GPLed or not distributed.
timeline.point_zh: 认为只要把 GPL 组件放进应用，就必须将整个应用改为 GPL 或停止分发。
timeline.point: Says that putting a GPL component into an application means the application must be GPLed or not distributed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Uses GPLv2 as a reductio to argue that OSD 9 cannot mean any restriction on other software, because that reading would wrongly exclude GPLv2.
timeline.point_zh: 以 GPLv2 作反证，说明 OSD 9 不可能被理解为“任何对其他软件的限制都不行”，否则会把 GPLv2 也排除在外。
timeline.point: Uses GPLv2 as a reductio to argue that OSD 9 cannot mean any restriction on other software, because that reading would wrongly exclude GPLv2.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the SS Public License is drafted as a lever for MongoDB's proprietary-relicensing business model, that no one — including MongoDB itself — intends to be bound by it, and that the unfairly rushed evaluation schedule alone justifies rejection on procedural grounds.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SS Public License 是 MongoDB 谋取专有转授权的杠杆,连 MongoDB 自己都不愿受其约束,而仓促的评审流程本身就足以构成程序上的否决理由。
timeline.point: Argues the SS Public License is drafted as a lever for MongoDB's proprietary-relicensing business model, that no one — including MongoDB itself — intends to be bound by it, and that the unfairly rushed evaluation schedule alone justifies rejection on procedural grounds.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues SSPL's radically maximalist source-access provision violates OSD #9 (and likely #5), that MongoDB's stated justification rings hollow given its refusal to be bound itself, and that the OSD applied with substantive intent is adequate to reject the license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 SSPL 极端扩张的源码获取条款违反 OSD #9(可能还有 #5);MongoDB 自己不愿受约束,其理由站不住脚;结合实质意图适用 OSD 即足以否决该许可证。
timeline.point: Argues SSPL's radically maximalist source-access provision violates OSD #9 (and likely #5), that MongoDB's stated justification rings hollow given its refusal to be bound itself, and that the OSD applied with substantive intent is adequate to reject the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues copyleft is a generic tool not tied to FSF's activist ends, defends dual licensing and MongoDB's intent as legitimate precedent, rejects drive-by objections and withdrawal proposals, and explicitly supports SSPLv1 as serving the public good.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 copyleft 是通用工具而非 FSF 特有目标，为双重许可和 MongoDB 的意图辩护，反对撤回提案，并明确支持 SSPLv1，认为其有助于公共利益。
timeline.point: Argues copyleft is a generic tool not tied to FSF's activist ends, defends dual licensing and MongoDB's intent as legitimate precedent, rejects drive-by objections and withdrawal proposals, and explicitly supports SSPLv1 as serving the public good.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues review should apply Debian's tentacles-of-evil test and ignore the proposing party, since SSPLv1 is not licensor-specific and anyone may adopt it. Contends copyleft is merely a tool and OSI never granted FSF exclusive rights to draft copyleft licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 主张评审应套用 Debian 的 tentacles-of-evil 测试、忽略提案方，因 SSPLv1 不限于特定许可人；认为 copyleft 只是工具，OSI 从未授予 FSF 起草 copyleft 许可证的专有权。
timeline.point: Argues review should apply Debian's tentacles-of-evil test and ignore the proposing party, since SSPLv1 is not licensor-specific and anyone may adopt it. Contends copyleft is merely a tool and OSI never granted FSF exclusive rights to draft copyleft licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Rejects the broad OSD 9 reading as a useful frame, but says SSPL still has an enormous OSD 9 problem and stands by that objection.
timeline.point_zh: 认为把争论框进 OSD 9 并无帮助，但仍坚持 SSPL 存在严重的 OSD 9 问题。
timeline.point: Rejects the broad OSD 9 reading as a useful frame, but says SSPL still has an enormous OSD 9 problem and stands by that objection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues using copyleft to exclude competitors who won't release code is its intended function, notes dual licensing predates OSI and prior approvals like Sleepycat, QFPL, and RPL allowed it, and asks why SSPLv1's stronger copyleft is problematic when OSD 9 doesn't say.
timeline.point_zh: 主张以 copyleft 排除不开放代码的竞争者本是其功能，双重许可早于 OSI 且 Sleepycat、QFPL、RPL 均获批，并问 OSD 9 未作规定时 SSPLv1 更强的 copyleft 何以有问题。
timeline.point: Argues using copyleft to exclude competitors who won't release code is its intended function, notes dual licensing predates OSI and prior approvals like Sleepycat, QFPL, and RPL allowed it, and asks why SSPLv1's stronger copyleft is problematic when OSD 9 doesn't say.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says the thread has drifted outside license-review and he prefers not to comment further.
timeline.point_zh: 表示该子线程已偏离 license-review 的范围，因此不再继续评论。
timeline.point: Says the thread has drifted outside license-review and he prefers not to comment further.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Gives an update that MongoDB is reviewing feedback and will issue a revised SSPL and consolidated response.
timeline.point_zh: 通报 MongoDB 正在跟进反馈，并将发布修订版和汇总回应。
timeline.point: Gives an update that MongoDB is reviewing feedback and will issue a revised SSPL and consolidated response.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Argues the open-core framing avoids consensus about whether open core should be encouraged, then asks whether the old “Open Core” blog post is an official OSI position.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 open core 的讨论可避免是否应鼓励该模式的共识问题，并询问那篇“Open Core”旧博文是否代表 OSI 官方立场。
timeline.point: Argues the open-core framing avoids consensus about whether open core should be encouraged, then asks whether the old “Open Core” blog post is an official OSI position.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says the post was on acoliver’s personal blog, not an official board statement, and the “administrator” label looks like a migration artifact.
timeline.point_zh: 说明那篇文章出自 acoliver 的个人博客，不代表董事会官方立场，“administrator” 标签大概是迁移错误。
timeline.point: Says the post was on acoliver’s personal blog, not an official board statement, and the “administrator” label looks like a migration artifact.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Says the page labeling is confusing because the post appears under “From the Board” even though it is still marked as acoliver’s blog.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该页面的标注容易误导，因为它显示在“From the Board”下，但仍标为 acoliver 的博客。
timeline.point: Says the page labeling is confusing because the post appears under “From the Board” even though it is still marked as acoliver’s blog.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Approval: Server Side Public License, Version 1 (SSPL v1)
timeline.snippet: Notes the blog also hosts the OSI annual report and says he would have assumed the post reflected OSI’s position.
timeline.point_zh: 指出该博客还收录了 OSI 年报，因此原本会以为那是 OSI 的立场。
timeline.point: Notes the blog also hosts the OSI annual report and says he would have assumed the post reflected OSI’s position.

submissions.rejection_reason: SSPL's Section 13 extends copyleft to encompass essentially all software used to offer the program as a service, violating OSD #9 (License Must Not Restrict Other Software). Community consensus was that SSPL was not OSD-compliant.

submissions.name: License Zero Reciprocal Public License (Rewrite)

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Rewritten version of L0-R was also effectively withdrawn by the submitter after continued community opposition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal	Public License
timeline.snippet: Posts a revised License Zero Reciprocal Public License (L0-R) text — written from scratch rather than derived from BSD-2-Clause, and dropping the time-limited private-modification allowance after OSD 6 concerns — and asks about the process for reporting the submission to the board.
timeline.point_zh: 发布 License Zero Reciprocal Public License 修订版:从零重写、因 OSD 6 疑虑移除限时私有修改宽限,并询问送审董事会流程。
timeline.point: Posts a revised License Zero Reciprocal Public License (L0-R) text — written from scratch rather than derived from BSD-2-Clause, and dropping the time-limited private-modification allowance after OSD 6 concerns — and asks about the process for reporting the submission to the board.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Praises the rewritten L0-R as beautifully accomplished and OSD conformant. Doubts OSI approval is critical for License Zero's success, noting it would likely be banned by Google regardless.
timeline.point_zh: 赞扬修订后的 L0-R 写得很好且符合 OSD。质疑 OSI 批准对 License Zero 成功的重要性，指出即使获批也可能被 Google 等列入禁止名单。
timeline.point: Praises the rewritten L0-R as beautifully accomplished and OSD conformant. Doubts OSI approval is critical for License Zero's success, noting it would likely be banned by Google regardless.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Admits he still cannot pinpoint where the OSD 6 and OSD 9 boundaries lie, hopes the rewritten text is back within bounds, and stresses that OSI approval remains a key objective for L0-R.
timeline.point_zh: 坦言仍说不清 OSD 6 与 OSD 9 的界限所在,希望重写后的文本已回到边界内,并强调 OSI 批准仍是 L0-R 的重要目标。
timeline.point: Admits he still cannot pinpoint where the OSD 6 and OSD 9 boundaries lie, hopes the rewritten text is back within bounds, and stresses that OSI approval remains a key objective for L0-R.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Frames four difficult policy questions about L0-R — copyleft triggers on private modification, incorporation, and running, and approval of dual-licensing-driven licenses — and asks whether the submitter plans to seek FSF recognition.
timeline.point_zh: 就 L0-R 提出四个棘手政策问题(第 3、4、5 条分别涉私有修改、纳入、运行的 copyleft 触发,及双重许可动机),并询问是否计划寻求 FSF 认可。
timeline.point: Frames four difficult policy questions about L0-R — copyleft triggers on private modification, incorporation, and running, and approval of dual-licensing-driven licenses — and asks whether the submitter plans to seek FSF recognition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues L0-R's clause 5 violates the spirit of OSD 9 by restricting other software merely run with the licensed program, contends GPL/AGPL-style strong copyleft should be the limit, and suggests considering an OSD amendment rather than approval.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 第 5 条因限制仅因运行而相关的其他软件而违背 OSD 9 精神,主张 GPL/AGPL 式强 copyleft 应为极限,建议考虑修订 OSD 而非批准。
timeline.point: Argues L0-R's clause 5 violates the spirit of OSD 9 by restricting other software merely run with the licensed program, contends GPL/AGPL-style strong copyleft should be the limit, and suggests considering an OSD amendment rather than approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Responds to the four policy questions, arguing that limiting copyleft triggers to distribution handicaps copyleft within Open Source, that OSL-3.0 already triggers on unmodified use, and that dual-licensing use does not disqualify a license, as AGPL-3.0 shows.
timeline.point_zh: 回应四个政策问题:主张把 copyleft 触发限于发行会让 Open Source 束缚 copyleft,OSL-3.0 已触发于未修改使用,且双重许可不妨碍资格(如 AGPL-3.0)。
timeline.point: Responds to the four policy questions, arguing that limiting copyleft triggers to distribution handicaps copyleft within Open Source, that OSL-3.0 already triggers on unmodified use, and that dual-licensing use does not disqualify a license, as AGPL-3.0 shows.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Rebuts the OSD 9 'spirit' argument, proposing OSD 9 protects distributors from cross-package restrictions and that share-alike appropriately falls on developer-kind tools, so clause 5's reach is legitimate; favors clarifying the OSD with spelled-out rationale.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 OSD 9“精神”论:主张 OSD 9 旨在保护纯发行渠道免受跨包限制,share-alike 应落在开发者一方,第 5 条触及开发工具正当,并支持修订 OSD 以写明理由。
timeline.point: Rebuts the OSD 9 'spirit' argument, proposing OSD 9 protects distributors from cross-package restrictions and that share-alike appropriately falls on developer-kind tools, so clause 5's reach is legitimate; favors clarifying the OSD with spelled-out rationale.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues L0-R fails OSD 6: the analyze/modify/generate conditions impose absurd use restrictions that would turn passive users unable to relicense into infringers; only derivative-work combinations need such limits, which other language can cover.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 无法通过 OSD 6:analyze/modify/generate 条件构成荒谬的使用限制,令无再许可权的被动用户沦为侵权者;只有衍生作品组合需此限制,且已有其他条款可涵盖。
timeline.point: Argues L0-R fails OSD 6: the analyze/modify/generate conditions impose absurd use restrictions that would turn passive users unable to relicense into infringers; only derivative-work combinations need such limits, which other language can cover.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Raises detailed drafting and legal questions — conspicuousness of the disclaimer under UCC/UCITA, inconsistent copyright/patent grant wording, the 'accusing' clause, 'modification' vs 'extension' — and flags potential OSD 9 problems in the include and analyze/generate conditions.
timeline.point_zh: 就免责声明的醒目性、授予措辞、modification 与 extension 之别等提出起草问题,并指出 include 与 analyze/generate 条款存在潜在 OSD 9 问题。
timeline.point: Raises detailed drafting and legal questions — conspicuousness of the disclaimer under UCC/UCITA, inconsistent copyright/patent grant wording, the 'accusing' clause, 'modification' vs 'extension' — and flags potential OSD 9 problems in the include and analyze/generate conditions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees that simple aggregation should not trigger the license, but combination into a single program should. Would prefer the trigger not be limited to creation of a derivative work, since copyright law is unhelpful there.
timeline.point_zh: 同意简单聚合不应触发许可证，但组合成单一程序应该触发。倾向于触发条件不限于创作衍生作品，因为版权法在此方面不够明确。
timeline.point: Agrees that simple aggregation should not trigger the license, but combination into a single program should. Would prefer the trigger not be limited to creation of a derivative work, since copyright law is unhelpful there.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Provides reference to the UCC requirement of conspicuous notice (UCC 2-316) and notes that UCITA adds safe harbor provisions for visual appearance of text, with an unresolved conflict with the Magnuson-Moss Act.
timeline.point_zh: 提供 UCC 显著性通知要求（UCC 2-316）的参考，并指出 UCITA 为文本外观增加了安全港条款，与 Magnuson-Moss 法案存在未解决的冲突。
timeline.point: Provides reference to the UCC requirement of conspicuous notice (UCC 2-316) and notes that UCITA adds safe harbor provisions for visual appearance of text, with an unresolved conflict with the Magnuson-Moss Act.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Answers McCoy's drafting questions, defending the asterisked disclaimer as conspicuous under UCC 1-201 and MPL-2.0 precedent, explaining the copyright/patent grant wording, and proposing revised patent-termination and 'change' language.
timeline.point_zh: 回应 McCoy 的起草问题:援引 UCC 1-201 与 MPL-2.0 先例辩护星号免责声明的醒目性,解释版权与专利授予措辞,并提出修订后的专利终止条款和改用 change 的设想。
timeline.point: Answers McCoy's drafting questions, defending the asterisked disclaimer as conspicuous under UCC 1-201 and MPL-2.0 precedent, explaining the copyright/patent grant wording, and proposing revised patent-termination and 'change' language.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Proposes revised clause 4 using combine language following GPL 3.0 section 5, asking if this avoids the OSD 9 concerns about simple aggregation.
timeline.point_zh: 提出修订后的第 4 条，采用 GPL 3.0 第 5 节的 combine 措辞，询问这是否避免了关于简单聚合的 OSD 9 担忧。
timeline.point: Proposes revised clause 4 using combine language following GPL 3.0 section 5, asking if this avoids the OSD 9 concerns about simple aggregation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the revised clause 4 language is better. Expresses concern that derivative work might mean textual inclusion, and prefers expert analysis of what constitutes one program over codifying a definition that technology will outgrow.
timeline.point_zh: 同意修订后的第 4 条语言更好。表达对 derivative work 可能意味着文本包含的担忧，倾向于由专家分析什么构成一个程序，而非编入一个技术会超越的定义。
timeline.point: Agrees the revised clause 4 language is better. Expresses concern that derivative work might mean textual inclusion, and prefers expert analysis of what constitutes one program over codifying a definition that technology will outgrow.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues Open Source already expects developers to bear copyleft burdens, so use-based copyleft on developer tools should not disqualify L0-R, and rejects the charge that the license is absurd.
timeline.point_zh: 认为开源本已要求开发者承担 copyleft 负担，开发工具上基于使用的 copyleft 不应使 L0-R 失格，并反驳该许可证“荒谬”之说。
timeline.point: Argues Open Source already expects developers to bear copyleft burdens, so use-based copyleft on developer tools should not disqualify L0-R, and rejects the charge that the license is absurd.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues OSD 6 catches L0-R's use cases, making it non-Open Source. Further argues that even if it met the OSD, OSI certification would be dereliction of duty because the license asks too much -- forcing copyright owners to open source their work merely for using L0-R software.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSD 6 捕获了 L0-R 的使用场景，使其不符合开源。进一步认为即使符合 OSD，OSI 认证也属失职，因为许可证要求过多，迫使版权所有者仅因使用 L0-R 软件就开源其作品。
timeline.point: Argues OSD 6 catches L0-R's use cases, making it non-Open Source. Further argues that even if it met the OSD, OSI certification would be dereliction of duty because the license asks too much -- forcing copyright owners to open source their work merely for using L0-R software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States he has not encountered a court that would compel the owner of a large codebase to GPL it over a de minimis copyleft combination.
timeline.point_zh: 表示尚未遇到会强制大型代码库所有者因微量 copyleft 组合而将其 GPL 化的法院。
timeline.point: States he has not encountered a court that would compel the owner of a large codebase to GPL it over a de minimis copyleft combination.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Makes it a goal to keep derivative work out of L0-R because the term is unclear and will likely remain so. Prefers developers reach the conclusion about ambiguity themselves rather than needing a lawyer.
timeline.point_zh: 将避免在 L0-R 中使用 derivative work 作为目标，因为该术语不明确且可能一直如此。倾向于让开发者自己得出含糊的结论，而非需要律师。
timeline.point: Makes it a goal to keep derivative work out of L0-R because the term is unclear and will likely remain so. Prefers developers reach the conclusion about ambiguity themselves rather than needing a lawyer.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Counters with a rhetorical question: has Bruce met a court that would compel releasing a large proprietary codebase as Open Source after running an L0-R line counter on it?
timeline.point_zh: 反问：Bruce 是否遇到过会强制在对大型专有代码库运行 L0-R 行数统计器后将其开源的法院？
timeline.point: Counters with a rhetorical question: has Bruce met a court that would compel releasing a large proprietary codebase as Open Source after running an L0-R line counter on it?

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Core objection is principled: L0-R asks for too much (dedicating a work to Open Source) for too little (just the right to run a program), and OSI shouldn't endorse such a poor bargain; de minimis is irrelevant since no one is compelled to GPL over trivial combinations.
timeline.point_zh: 核心异议是原则性的：L0-R要价太高（把作品献给开源）而给得太少（仅运行权），OSI不应背书这种糟糕交易；微小组合无关紧要，无人会被迫因微小组合接受GPL。
timeline.point: Core objection is principled: L0-R asks for too much (dedicating a work to Open Source) for too little (just the right to run a program), and OSI shouldn't endorse such a poor bargain; de minimis is irrelevant since no one is compelled to GPL over trivial combinations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that no one is compelled to release code under any copyleft license for any size of combination; specific performance is not a remedy for copyright infringement.
timeline.point_zh: 主张没有任何人因为任何规模的代码组合而被强制以 copyleft 许可证发布代码；特定履行不是版权侵权的救济方式。
timeline.point: Argues that no one is compelled to release code under any copyleft license for any size of combination; specific performance is not a remedy for copyright infringement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the point on copyright but notes that specific performance exists for breach of contract, citing the Artifex v. Hancom case.
timeline.point_zh: 承认版权方面的观点，但指出违约诉讼中存在特定履行救济，并引用 Artifex v. Hancom 案例。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the point on copyright but notes that specific performance exists for breach of contract, citing the Artifex v. Hancom case.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Notes the Hancom/Ghostscript motion to dismiss was denied, but argues infringers face copyright infringement remedies, not court-ordered release of their own code, since GPLv2 never requires licensing a derivative work under it.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 Hancom/Ghostscript 案驳回动议被否，但认为侵权者只会承担版权侵权救济，法院不会强令其开源自己的代码。
timeline.point: Notes the Hancom/Ghostscript motion to dismiss was denied, but argues infringers face copyright infringement remedies, not court-ordered release of their own code, since GPLv2 never requires licensing a derivative work under it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether OSI rejects licenses through cost-benefit analysis, argues his merit arguments for L0-R deserve engagement rather than bare conclusions, and declines to pare it back to a plain GPL-style copyleft.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 OSI 是否以成本效益分析否决许可证，认为其为 L0-R 所作论证应获实质回应，并拒绝将其削减为普通 GPL 式 copyleft。
timeline.point: Asks whether OSI rejects licenses through cost-benefit analysis, argues his merit arguments for L0-R deserve engagement rather than bare conclusions, and declines to pare it back to a plain GPL-style copyleft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues L0-R violates OSD #6 and the first freedom by forcing unrelated programs open source based on use—the "King Midas Touch"—and says such a deal should not be called Open Source.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 以使用为条件强制无关程序开源（“点金术”），违反 OSD #6 与第一自由，不应称之为开源。
timeline.point: Argues L0-R violates OSD #6 and the first freedom by forcing unrelated programs open source based on use—the "King Midas Touch"—and says such a deal should not be called Open Source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks Bruce to explicate how OSD #6 prohibits L0-R, noting difficulty reading that prohibition into the text of #6, while agreeing that the Four Freedoms argument applies.
timeline.point_zh: 请求 Bruce 解释 OSD #6 如何禁止 L0-R，认为难以从 #6 的文本中读出这一禁止，但同意四项自由方面的论点。
timeline.point: Asks Bruce to explicate how OSD #6 prohibits L0-R, noting difficulty reading that prohibition into the text of #6, while agreeing that the Four Freedoms argument applies.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains the OSD reading: condition 5 triggers OSD #6 because analysis/modification/generation are fields of endeavor; OSD #2 overrides #6 for the program itself but not for other programs, so GPL is OK but L0-R is not.
timeline.point_zh: 解释了对 OSD 的解读：条件 5 触发 OSD #6，因为分析/修改/生成属于活动领域；OSD #2 覆盖了 #6 对程序本身的要求但不适用于其他程序，因此 GPL 合规但 L0-R 不合规。
timeline.point: Explains the OSD reading: condition 5 triggers OSD #6 because analysis/modification/generation are fields of endeavor; OSD #2 overrides #6 for the program itself but not for other programs, so GPL is OK but L0-R is not.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States L0-R was designed to promote a dual licensing business model but is not actually open source; developers can achieve the same outcome with proprietary licensing or pro/community versions without L0-R.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 L0-R 旨在促进双重许可商业模式，但实际上不是开源；开发者可以通过专有许可或专业版/社区版实现相同目标，无需 L0-R。
timeline.point: States L0-R was designed to promote a dual licensing business model but is not actually open source; developers can achieve the same outcome with proprietary licensing or pro/community versions without L0-R.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Strongly opposes L0-R condition 5 as flatly infectious and harmful to copyleft, comparing it to the damaging viral characterization the open source community fought against.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈反对 L0-R 条件 5，认为它具有传染性且有害于 copyleft，将其类比为开源社区曾经抵制的破坏性病毒式描述。
timeline.point: Strongly opposes L0-R condition 5 as flatly infectious and harmful to copyleft, comparing it to the damaging viral characterization the open source community fought against.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that OSI waits for the mailing list to reach a stable consensus before evaluating against mission and principle; the forum itself is the committee, and OSI does not offer opinions on licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 OSI 等待邮件列表达成稳定共识后再根据使命和原则进行评估；该论坛本身就是委员会，OSI 不会对许可证发表意见。
timeline.point: Clarifies that OSI waits for the mailing list to reach a stable consensus before evaluating against mission and principle; the forum itself is the committee, and OSI does not offer opinions on licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks for clarification on how field of endeavor works under OSD #6 and whether OSD #2 overrides #6, noting these interpretations should be documented.
timeline.point_zh: 请求澄清 OSD #6 下活动领域的运作方式以及 OSD #2 是否覆盖 #6，认为这些解释应当有文档记录。
timeline.point: Asks for clarification on how field of endeavor works under OSD #6 and whether OSD #2 overrides #6, noting these interpretations should be documented.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Admits that the OSD annotations do not fully stand behind them and that one or two annotations miss the purpose and could be improved.
timeline.point_zh: 承认并不完全支持所有 OSD 注解，认为其中一两个注解偏离了目的，可以改进。
timeline.point: Admits that the OSD annotations do not fully stand behind them and that one or two annotations miss the purpose and could be improved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Thanks Simon for the process pointers, traces his confusion to the outdated /approval page, and asks that someone update it before it misleads another submitter.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢 Simon 的流程指点，说明困惑源于过时的 /approval 页面，请求尽快更新以免误导下一位提交者。
timeline.point: Thanks Simon for the process pointers, traces his confusion to the outdated /approval page, and asks that someone update it before it misleads another submitter.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Tells Kyle the discussion lasted more than the required 30 days, recommends the license not be approved, and suggests trying it with a user community first.
timeline.point_zh: 告诉 Kyle 讨论已超过所需的 30 天，建议不批准该许可证，建议先在用户社区中试行。
timeline.point: Tells Kyle the discussion lasted more than the required 30 days, recommends the license not be approved, and suggests trying it with a user community first.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Corrects a grammatical ambiguity in his prior message about bar admission, clarifying he did not intend to claim he is admitted to the bar.
timeline.point_zh: 纠正了他之前消息中关于律师资格的语法歧义，澄清他并非声称自己拥有律师资格。
timeline.point: Corrects a grammatical ambiguity in his prior message about bar admission, clarifying he did not intend to claim he is admitted to the bar.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Refuses to be run off, commits to answering Bruce's latest OSD reading and reburying "viral license" FUD, and explains he brought L0-R to give his community a definitive answer.
timeline.point_zh: 拒绝被劝退，将回应 Bruce 对 OSD 的最新解读并驳斥“病毒式许可证”FUD，并解释提交 L0-R 是为给社区一个明确答案。
timeline.point: Refuses to be run off, commits to answering Bruce's latest OSD reading and reburying "viral license" FUD, and explains he brought L0-R to give his community a definitive answer.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States the L0-R license is dangerous to users as it purports to take their copyrighted property if they simply run a program, resembling a landmine. Recommends denial.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 许可证对用户有危险，因为它声称如果用户运行程序就会夺取其版权财产，类似于地雷。建议拒绝批准。
timeline.point: States the L0-R license is dangerous to users as it purports to take their copyrighted property if they simply run a program, resembling a landmine. Recommends denial.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies his earlier email was not the step 2 board report but was intended to facilitate community discussion, and suggests Kyle may have assumed the review process is more formal than it actually is.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清他之前的邮件不是第二步董事会报告，而是旨在促进社区讨论，并认为 Kyle 可能假定审查流程比实际更正式。
timeline.point: Clarifies his earlier email was not the step 2 board report but was intended to facilitate community discussion, and suggests Kyle may have assumed the review process is more formal than it actually is.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Notes that L0-R does several things no previously OSI-approved license has done, and that reviewing such a license was never going to be fast or straightforward.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 L0-R 做了几件此前 OSI 批准的许可证从未做过的事情，审查这样的许可证从来不会是快速或简单的。
timeline.point: Notes that L0-R does several things no previously OSI-approved license has done, and that reviewing such a license was never going to be fast or straightforward.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States he expected the review to focus on applying the OSD Definition to the license, not on extraneous concerns about the LicenseZero.com business model which is separate from the license itself.
timeline.point_zh: 表示他期望审查集中在将 OSD 定义应用于许可证，而非关注与许可证无关的 LicenseZero.com 业务模式等无关事项。
timeline.point: States he expected the review to focus on applying the OSD Definition to the license, not on extraneous concerns about the LicenseZero.com business model which is separate from the license itself.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains that acquiring an active user community is important because bad ideas die there, practical use cases replace theoretical ones, and OSI might refuse to consider licenses without a user community to manage workload.
timeline.point_zh: 解释了获取活跃用户社区的重要性：坏想法会在那里消亡，实际用例取代理论假设，OSI 可能拒绝考虑没有用户社区的许可证以管理工作量。
timeline.point: Explains that acquiring an active user community is important because bad ideas die there, practical use cases replace theoretical ones, and OSI might refuse to consider licenses without a user community to manage workload.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues Bruce's reading of OSD 2 and 6 fails on natural readings, textual grounding, and consistency—excluding BSD and GPL as well—and urges treating the OSD as a social contract or amending it explicitly.
timeline.point_zh: 论证 Bruce 对 OSD 2 和 6 的解读违背自然读法、无文本依据且不自洽（连 BSD、GPL 也会被排除），呼吁将 OSD 视为社会契约或公开修订。
timeline.point: Argues Bruce's reading of OSD 2 and 6 fails on natural readings, textual grounding, and consistency—excluding BSD and GPL as well—and urges treating the OSD as a social contract or amending it explicitly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Proposes three specific updates to /approval: clarify the board applies its own judgment beyond the Definition, require mailing list consensus before proceeding, and note the informal nature of the process.
timeline.point_zh: 提出对 /approval 的三项具体更新建议：明确董事会在定义之上运用自身判断，要求邮件列表达成共识后再推进，并注明流程的非正式性质。
timeline.point: Proposes three specific updates to /approval: clarify the board applies its own judgment beyond the Definition, require mailing list consensus before proceeding, and note the informal nature of the process.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the workload concern is fair, notes that requiring a preexisting user base creates a chicken-and-egg problem, and recommends documenting the approval policy and improving the submission format.
timeline.point_zh: 承认工作量关切是合理的，指出要求已有用户基础会形成鸡生蛋问题，建议记录审批政策并改进提交格式。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the workload concern is fair, notes that requiring a preexisting user base creates a chicken-and-egg problem, and recommends documenting the approval policy and improving the submission format.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Recasts the Midas metaphor: proprietary software petrifies permissively licensed code while reciprocal licenses keep it alive; "viral" FUD is fundamentally false; and explains L0-R's 30-day automatic-forgiveness clause.
timeline.point_zh: 重述点金术比喻：专有软件僵化宽松许可的代码，互惠许可证使其保持活力；“病毒式”FUD 根本上是谎言；并解释 L0-R 的 30 天自动宽恕条款。
timeline.point: Recasts the Midas metaphor: proprietary software petrifies permissively licensed code while reciprocal licenses keep it alive; "viral" FUD is fundamentally false; and explains L0-R's 30-day automatic-forgiveness clause.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Rewrite of License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Supplements the submission to note L0-R shares common features with RPL 1.5, including release of private changes, required components, SaaS loophole closure, exception sales, and 30-day cure periods.
timeline.point_zh: 补充说明 L0-R 与 RPL 1.5 有许多共同特征，包括发布私有变更、必需组件、SaaS 漏洞关闭、例外销售和 30 天补救期。
timeline.point: Supplements the submission to note L0-R shares common features with RPL 1.5, including release of private changes, required components, SaaS loophole closure, exception sales, and 30-day cure periods.

submissions.rejection_reason: Rewritten version of L0-R was also effectively withdrawn by the submitter after continued community opposition.

submissions.name: License Zero Reciprocal Public License (L0-R)

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: License Committee recommended rejection. Board chose not to decide because submitter had effectively withdrawn the license from consideration.

  that's probably best.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Submits the License Zero Reciprocal Public License (L0-R), a BSD-2-Clause-based stronger-than-strong copyleft triggered on execution or development, for OSI approval as an Open Source license.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 License Zero Reciprocal Public License (L0-R)——基于 BSD-2-Clause、于执行或开发时触发的强化 copyleft——供 OSI 批准为开源许可证。
timeline.point: Submits the License Zero Reciprocal Public License (L0-R), a BSD-2-Clause-based stronger-than-strong copyleft triggered on execution or development, for OSI approval as an Open Source license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains condition 3's copyleft mechanics: triggering on execution or development, requiring source publication under any OSI-approved terms, softened by a grace period and automatic waiver; invites feedback on compatibility edge cases.
timeline.point_zh: 解释第 3 条的 copyleft 机制：以执行或开发触发、源码须公开且可用任意 OSI 批准条款，辅以宽限期与自动弃权，并就兼容性难点征求意见。
timeline.point: Explains condition 3's copyleft mechanics: triggering on execution or development, requiring source publication under any OSI-approved terms, softened by a grace period and automatic waiver; invites feedback on compatibility edge cases.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: States the wording of condition 3 is entirely baffling from a software developer perspective and does not explain the role of the Agent.
timeline.point_zh: 认为从软件开发者的角度看，条件 3 的措辞完全令人困惑，且未解释 Agent 的角色。
timeline.point: States the wording of condition 3 is entirely baffling from a software developer perspective and does not explain the role of the Agent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the tension between keeping license terms short (BSD-style) and making them self-explanatory, and explains the agent role is to vend alternative licenses that allow what the public license prohibits.
timeline.point_zh: 承认保持许可证条款简短（BSD 风格）与自我解释之间的张力，并解释代理人的角色是销售允许公共许可证所禁止事项的替代许可。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the tension between keeping license terms short (BSD-style) and making them self-explanatory, and explains the agent role is to vend alternative licenses that allow what the public license prohibits.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether a modifier of the software gets to designate their own agent, questioning the assumption of single origin for the software.
timeline.point_zh: 询问修改者是否可以指定自己的代理人，质疑软件单一来源的假设。
timeline.point: Asks whether a modifier of the software gets to designate their own agent, questioning the assumption of single origin for the software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Uncomfortable with L0-R shifting source-publication burdens onto non-technical users, raises compliance and waiver/agent-switching questions, and concludes the license has not minimized legal pondering.
timeline.point_zh: 对 L0-R 将源码公开负担转嫁给非技术用户感到不安，就合规及弃权、代理切换机制提出疑问，认为该许可证并未减少法律困扰。
timeline.point: Uncomfortable with L0-R shifting source-publication burdens onto non-technical users, raises compliance and waiver/agent-switching questions, and concludes the license has not minimized legal pondering.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues L0-R's use-based trigger choice doesn't affect OSD compliance, likens downstream compliance issues to those of BSD-2-Clause and GPL, and offers to replace the agent language with a generic alternative-licenses notice.
timeline.point_zh: 认为使用触发方式的选择不影响 L0-R 符合 OSD,以下游合规问题在 BSD-2-Clause 和 GPL 中同样存在作类比,并提议用通用的替代许可证声明取代代理条款。
timeline.point: Argues L0-R's use-based trigger choice doesn't affect OSD compliance, likens downstream compliance issues to those of BSD-2-Clause and GPL, and offers to replace the agent language with a generic alternative-licenses notice.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Disputes that the user-developer distinction dissolves under L0-R, arguing users typically retain use rights even if the downstream developer is out of compliance, and raises concerns about accidental copyleft triggers for private test code.
timeline.point_zh: 反对 L0-R 下用户与开发者区分消失的说法，认为即使下游开发者不合规，用户通常仍保有使用权，并对私有测试代码的意外 copyleft 触发表示担忧。
timeline.point: Disputes that the user-developer distinction dissolves under L0-R, arguing users typically retain use rights even if the downstream developer is out of compliance, and raises concerns about accidental copyleft triggers for private test code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Defends direct licensing, arguing license conditions apply to users depending on their wording, and says L0-R's hair trigger is by design, with the grace period preventing unwitting infringement and motivating contributions.
timeline.point_zh: 为直接许可模式辩护,称许可条件是否约束用户取决于措辞,并表示 L0-R 的灵敏触发是刻意设计,宽限期可避免无意侵权并激励贡献。
timeline.point: Defends direct licensing, arguing license conditions apply to users depending on their wording, and says L0-R's hair trigger is by design, with the grace period preventing unwitting infringement and motivating contributions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Rejects L0-R's approach as coercing contributions rather than encouraging them, and objects to being forced to distribute compatibility patches for old open-source code.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 是在强迫而非鼓励贡献，反对被迫分发为兼容旧操作系统而做的补丁。
timeline.point: Rejects L0-R's approach as coercing contributions rather than encouraging them, and objects to being forced to distribute compatibility patches for old open-source code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Rejects the 'coercion' charge, arguing L0-R is like prior copyleft licenses that close loopholes, and asserts the real question is whether L0-R meets the Open Source Definition, which he believes it does.
timeline.point_zh: 驳回'强制'的指责,称 L0-R 与以往 copyleft 许可证一样是填补漏洞的交易,认为真正问题在于 L0-R 是否符合开源定义,而他认为符合。
timeline.point: Rejects the 'coercion' charge, arguing L0-R is like prior copyleft licenses that close loopholes, and asserts the real question is whether L0-R meets the Open Source Definition, which he believes it does.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Accuses L0-R of copyright misuse by stripping away the § 117 software adaptation right through onerous conditions, and argues the license extends beyond the copyright bundle into rights people have always had.
timeline.point_zh: 指控 L0-R 构成版权滥用，通过苛刻条件剥夺了第 117 条软件改编权，认为该许可超越了版权范围，侵犯了人们一直拥有的权利。
timeline.point: Accuses L0-R of copyright misuse by stripping away the § 117 software adaptation right through onerous conditions, and argues the license extends beyond the copyright bundle into rights people have always had.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Cites Vernor v. Autodesk to argue L0-R's use restriction stays within copyright law, and argues its rules on freedom 0 protect the central freedoms just as GPL's rules on freedom 3 do.
timeline.point_zh: 引用 Vernor v. Autodesk 案论证 L0-R 的使用限制仍在版权法范围内,并称其对自由 0 的规定如同 GPL 对自由 3 的规定一样保护核心自由。
timeline.point: Cites Vernor v. Autodesk to argue L0-R's use restriction stays within copyright law, and argues its rules on freedom 0 protect the central freedoms just as GPL's rules on freedom 3 do.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues L0-R is a copyright trap that could expose end users to lawsuits, says AGPL dual licensing already covers the use cases, calls it a back-door NC license, and concludes 'nice try, but no cigar.'
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 是让最终用户面临诉讼风险的版权陷阱,称 AGPL 双重许可已覆盖需求,指其为变相 NC 许可证,并附和 John 得出'差得远'的结论。
timeline.point: Argues L0-R is a copyright trap that could expose end users to lawsuits, says AGPL dual licensing already covers the use cases, calls it a back-door NC license, and concludes 'nice try, but no cigar.'

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues Nigel's concerns address business-model advisability rather than OSD compliance, objects to the 'trap' label, distinguishes L0-NC from L0-R, and asks which OSD criteria AGPL meets that L0-R does not.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Nigel 的担忧属于商业模式利弊而非 OSD 合规问题,反对'陷阱'标签,区分 L0-NC 与 L0-R,并反问 AGPL 符合而 L0-R 不符合的 OSD 标准是什么。
timeline.point: Argues Nigel's concerns address business-model advisability rather than OSD compliance, objects to the 'trap' label, distinguishes L0-NC from L0-R, and asks which OSD criteria AGPL meets that L0-R does not.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Criticizes L0-R as a "single origin license" that privileges the original releaser over downstream redistributors, and fails to adequately address code reuse in larger works, cherry-picking, and community creation around modified versions.
timeline.point_zh: 批评 L0-R 是一种「单一来源许可」，偏向原始发布者而忽视下游再分发者，未充分考虑代码在大型项目中的复用、挑选特定文件以及围绕修改版本创建社区的情况。
timeline.point: Criticizes L0-R as a "single origin license" that privileges the original releaser over downstream redistributors, and fails to adequately address code reuse in larger works, cherry-picking, and community creation around modified versions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Questions the meaning of "use in the execution or development" with a compiler example, argues that limiting use of software violates OSD criterion 6, and contends that use-based restrictions are fundamentally different from copyleft conditions on modifications.
timeline.point_zh: 以编译器为例质疑「在执行或开发中的使用」的含义，认为限制软件使用直接违反 OSD 第 6 条，主张基于使用的限制与对修改施加的 copyleft 条件有本质区别。
timeline.point: Questions the meaning of "use in the execution or development" with a compiler example, argues that limiting use of software violates OSD criterion 6, and contends that use-based restrictions are fundamentally different from copyleft conditions on modifications.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains L0-R's terms by analogy to BSD-2-Clause, describes how forks and contributor licensing would work, says he will move alternative-license information out of condition 3, and questions whether OSI would approve BSD-2-Clause today.
timeline.point_zh: 以 BSD-2-Clause 类比解释 L0-R 条款,说明分叉与贡献者许可的运作方式,表示将把替代许可证信息移出条件 3,并质疑 OSI 今天是否还会批准 BSD-2-Clause。
timeline.point: Explains L0-R's terms by analogy to BSD-2-Clause, describes how forks and contributor licensing would work, says he will move alternative-license information out of condition 3, and questions whether OSI would approve BSD-2-Clause today.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues embedding dual-licensing in the license is a radical innovation needing OSD debate, raises problems with immutable agent contact information, recommends removing agent references, and says brevity to the point of incoherency is not an asset.
timeline.point_zh: 认为在许可证中内置双重许可是需辩论是否符合 OSD 的激进创新,质疑固定的代理联系信息,建议删除代理相关内容,并称简洁到难以理解并非优点。
timeline.point: Argues embedding dual-licensing in the license is a radical innovation needing OSD debate, raises problems with immutable agent contact information, recommends removing agent references, and says brevity to the point of incoherency is not an asset.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Outlines abuse scenarios where developers exploit the grace period to trap users into buying commercial licenses or demand audits, notes AGPL cannot do this, and questions when the publishing obligation ends and what counts as 'development'.
timeline.point_zh: 列举开发者利用宽限期迫使用户购买商业许可或索要审计的滥用场景,称 AGPL 不会如此,并质疑发布义务何时终止以及何为'development'。
timeline.point: Outlines abuse scenarios where developers exploit the grace period to trap users into buying commercial licenses or demand audits, notes AGPL cannot do this, and questions when the publishing obligation ends and what counts as 'development'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains the direct-licensing model, argues the automatic waiver is equivalent to ordinary relicensing and asks which OSD criterion bans embedded dual-licensing, and announces a revision to make the agent information generic, calling it a red herring.
timeline.point_zh: 解释直接许可模式,称自动弃权实为普通改许可并追问哪条 OSD 标准禁止内置双重许可,宣布将修订使代理信息通用化,称其为转移视线的红鲱鱼。
timeline.point: Explains the direct-licensing model, argues the automatic waiver is equivalent to ordinary relicensing and asks which OSD criterion bans embedded dual-licensing, and announces a revision to make the agent information generic, calling it a red herring.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues the abuse scenarios are not peculiar to L0-R and could happen under AGPL, points to legal defenses like impossibility and waiver against bad-faith enforcement, and says copyleft trigger ambiguity is inherent, falling on those seeking to avoid sharing code.
timeline.point_zh: 认为滥用场景并非 L0-R 独有、AGPL 亦然,指出面对恶意执法有履行不能和弃权等法律抗辩,并称 copyleft 触发条件的模糊性在所难免,应由逃避共享代码者承担。
timeline.point: Argues the abuse scenarios are not peculiar to L0-R and could happen under AGPL, points to legal defenses like impossibility and waiver against bad-faith enforcement, and says copyleft trigger ambiguity is inherent, falling on those seeking to avoid sharing code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Posts revised L0-R terms moving the copyright, source-code, and alternative-licenses notices out of condition 3 to the top of the license, thanking reviewers for the feedback.
timeline.point_zh: 发布修订后的 L0-R 条款,将版权、源代码和替代许可证声明移出条件 3 置于许可证顶部,并感谢审阅者的反馈。
timeline.point: Posts revised L0-R terms moving the copyright, source-code, and alternative-licenses notices out of condition 3 to the top of the license, thanking reviewers for the feedback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Defends L0-R's use-and-development trigger as intentional technical language, arguing OSD criterion 6 prohibits only noncommercial-use limits, not all use limits, and that nothing in the OSD compels the GPL/AGPL distribution-based approach to copyleft.
timeline.point_zh: 为 L0-R 触发于使用与开发的条款辩护，称其为有意的技术措辞，主张 OSD 第 6 条仅禁止非商业使用限制，且 OSD 并不强制采用 GPL/AGPL 的分发式 copyleft 模式。
timeline.point: Defends L0-R's use-and-development trigger as intentional technical language, arguing OSD criterion 6 prohibits only noncommercial-use limits, not all use limits, and that nothing in the OSD compels the GPL/AGPL distribution-based approach to copyleft.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues L0-R's trigger on use rather than distribution is unique among OSI-approved copyleft licenses and burdens users, and that the author's failure to define "develop" or explain when obligations trigger makes it unfit for OSI approval.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 触发于使用而非分发，在 OSI 已批准的 copyleft 许可证中独一无二，加重用户负担；作者无法定义 develop 或说明义务何时触发，因而不应获批。
timeline.point: Argues L0-R's trigger on use rather than distribution is unique among OSI-approved copyleft licenses and burdens users, and that the author's failure to define "develop" or explain when obligations trigger makes it unfit for OSI approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Defends L0-R's use-based copyleft: argues the infringement scenario is implausible, the use/distribution line was never sharp, and strong copyleft promotes Open Source values without violating the OSD; invites feedback on condition 3's wording.
timeline.point_zh: 为 L0-R 的使用型 copyleft 辩护：称侵权场景难以成立、使用与分发界限本就模糊、强 copyleft 不违反 OSD 并促进开源价值，并征求对第 3 条措辞的反馈。
timeline.point: Defends L0-R's use-based copyleft: argues the infringement scenario is implausible, the use/distribution line was never sharp, and strong copyleft promotes Open Source values without violating the OSD; invites feedback on condition 3's wording.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues the clarification reinforces his view that L0-R violates the OSD and is overreaching: it restricts private use when interacting with software whose source can't be shared, and the JSON license requirement is vague and not OSI-approved.
timeline.point_zh: 认为澄清反而印证其观点：L0-R 违反 OSD 且过度扩张，限制与无法共享源码的软件交互时的私人使用，且 JSON 许可证要求模糊且未经 OSI 批准。
timeline.point: Argues the clarification reinforces his view that L0-R violates the OSD and is overreaching: it restricts private use when interacting with software whose source can't be shared, and the JSON license requirement is vague and not OSI-approved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Corrects Kyle's assumption that OSI approval is purely mechanical OSD application, stating that the Board also evaluates whether licenses further OSI's broader goals.
timeline.point_zh: 纠正 Kyle 关于 OSI 批准纯粹是机械应用 OSD 的假设，指出董事会还会评估许可是否推进 OSI 的更广泛目标。
timeline.point: Corrects Kyle's assumption that OSI approval is purely mechanical OSD application, stating that the Board also evaluates whether licenses further OSI's broader goals.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues L0-R's source-availability terms are inadequate: a paywalled repo would satisfy the license unlike GPL's protections, users fall out of compliance if the source link dies, and asks that safeguards be added to the license text.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 L0-R 的源码可得性条款不足：付费墙仓库即可满足要求（不如 GPL 的保护），源码链接失效会让用户陷入不合规，并要求在许可证文本中加入相关保障。
timeline.point: Argues L0-R's source-availability terms are inadequate: a paywalled repo would satisfy the license unlike GPL's protections, users fall out of compliance if the source link dies, and asks that safeguards be added to the license text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether OSI has unstated policy goals beyond the published OSD criteria, asking where they are documented and what happens when a license meets the Definition but is still not approved.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 OSI 是否有未公开的、超越已发布 OSD 标准的政策目标，询问这些目标记录在何处，以及当许可符合定义但仍未获批准时会怎样。
timeline.point: Questions whether OSI has unstated policy goals beyond the published OSD criteria, asking where they are documented and what happens when a license meets the Definition but is still not approved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Proposes revised condition 3 wording requiring the entire program's source be publicly available free of charge under OSI-approved terms, and offers a clarification exempting unmodified use, addressing the source-availability concerns.
timeline.point_zh: 提出修改第 3 条措辞，要求整个程序的源码以 OSI 批准的条款免费公开可得，并建议澄清豁免未修改的使用，以回应源码可得性方面的担忧。
timeline.point: Proposes revised condition 3 wording requiring the entire program's source be publicly available free of charge under OSI-approved terms, and offers a clarification exempting unmodified use, addressing the source-availability concerns.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Summarizes phone feedback from Bruce Perens on L0-R, stressing licensee compliance load and doubts about use-triggered conditions, and takes away two revisions: make condition 3 more readable and clarify a safe zone of unconditional use.
timeline.point_zh: 总结 Bruce Perens 对 L0-R 的电话反馈：重视被许可人合规负担，对使用触发条件存疑；将修订第 3 条并明确无条件使用的安全区。
timeline.point: Summarizes phone feedback from Bruce Perens on L0-R, stressing licensee compliance load and doubts about use-triggered conditions, and takes away two revisions: make condition 3 more readable and clarify a safe zone of unconditional use.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: Re: For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Forwards Bruce Perens’s off-list reply about the License Zero Reciprocal Public License to the review list because Bruce was not subscribed.
timeline.point_zh: 因 Bruce Perens 未订阅列表，转发其关于 License Zero Reciprocal Public License 的线下回复到审查列表。
timeline.point: Forwards Bruce Perens’s off-list reply about the License Zero Reciprocal Public License to the review list because Bruce was not subscribed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: Re: For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Proposes a revision splitting the use-triggered copyleft conditions into two numbered items keyed to the OSI 'Open Source' definition, clarifying unmodified use is unconditioned, and asks Bruce whether he would oppose the 'development of' clause as field-of-use discrimination.
timeline.point_zh: 提出将 L0-R 使用触发条件拆为两条、直接引用 OSI 的 'Open Source' 定义，并询问 Bruce 是否会以领域歧视为由反对 'development of' 条款。
timeline.point: Proposes a revision splitting the use-triggered copyleft conditions into two numbered items keyed to the OSI 'Open Source' definition, clarifying unmodified use is unconditioned, and asks Bruce whether he would oppose the 'development of' clause as field-of-use discrimination.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Fwd: Re: For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Contains no substantive message content beyond an empty forwarded separator.
timeline.point_zh: 除空转发分隔符外没有实质邮件内容。
timeline.point: Contains no substantive message content beyond an empty forwarded separator.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks what OSI's extra-OSD policy grounds are, and argues that if reciprocity cannot go beyond AGPL while permissive terms evolve, OSD becomes a ratchet against copyleft; contends use-based conditions like L0-R's can conform to the Definition, citing AGPL's tools loophole.
timeline.point_zh: 追问 OSI 除 OSD 外的政策依据；认为若互惠条款不能超越 AGPL，OSD 将成为打压 copyleft 的棘轮，并主张 L0-R 式使用条件可符合 OSD，AGPL 即存工具漏洞。
timeline.point: Asks what OSI's extra-OSD policy grounds are, and argues that if reciprocity cannot go beyond AGPL while permissive terms evolve, OSD becomes a ratchet against copyleft; contends use-based conditions like L0-R's can conform to the Definition, citing AGPL's tools loophole.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Posts a revised L0-R text: removes the alternative-license sales agent and automatic waiver provisions, keys the copyleft triggers to OSI 'Open Source' conformance, and splits the use conditions to clarify that unmodified use never triggers share-alike.
timeline.point_zh: 发布 L0-R 修订版：删除替代许可证销售代理与自动弃权条款，将 copyleft 触发条件改为以 OSI 'Open Source' 定义为准，并拆分使用条件以澄清未修改使用不触发同等共享。
timeline.point: Posts a revised L0-R text: removes the alternative-license sales agent and automatic waiver provisions, keys the copyleft triggers to OSI 'Open Source' conformance, and splits the use conditions to clarify that unmodified use never triggers share-alike.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that the revisions address most concerns but raises practical questions about enforcement: what event starts the time limit, how infringement duration would be determined, and whether there is precedent for time-limited licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 承认修订解决了大部分顾虑，但提出执行方面的实际问题：什么事件启动时间限制、如何确定侵权持续时间，以及是否存在限时许可的先例。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that the revisions address most concerns but raises practical questions about enforcement: what event starts the time limit, how infringement duration would be determined, and whether there is precedent for time-limited licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
