timeline.snippet: Explains that OSI operates like equity jurisdiction: beyond OSD compliance, the Board approves licenses based on what members believe is right and just, and OSD-conformant licenses have no guarantee of approval.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 OSI 如衡平法管辖运作：除 OSD 合规外，董事会基于成员认为正确和公正的标准批准许可，符合定义的许可没有获得批准的保证。
timeline.point: Explains that OSI operates like equity jurisdiction: beyond OSD compliance, the Board approves licenses based on what members believe is right and just, and OSD-conformant licenses have no guarantee of approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Admits the L0-R grace-period language is not up to usual standards of clarity, walks through a compliance failure case and possible clause rewrites, and argues the fuzzy terms favor licensees and remain enforceable.
timeline.point_zh: 承认 L0-R 宽限期条款未达通常清晰标准,分析一个合规失败案例及可能的改写,并认为模糊条款有利于被许可方且仍可执行。
timeline.point: Admits the L0-R grace-period language is not up to usual standards of clarity, walks through a compliance failure case and possible clause rewrites, and argues the fuzzy terms favor licensees and remain enforceable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues OSI's approval process should shield simple users and developers from legal load: no use-coupled responsibilities, no license proliferation without community benefit, no 'crayon licenses' — some OSD-compliant licenses should still not be certified.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 审批应减轻普通用户与开发者的法律负担:不容许与使用耦合的义务、不泛批许可证、不收'蜡笔许可证';部分 OSD 合规许可证也不应认证。
timeline.point: Argues OSI's approval process should shield simple users and developers from legal load: no use-coupled responsibilities, no license proliferation without community benefit, no 'crayon licenses' — some OSD-compliant licenses should still not be certified.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues OSI must publicly state any approval criteria beyond the OSD and act transparently; if L0-R is OSD-conformant it should be approved, and he offers to help refine the Definition or codify approval policies.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 应公开 OSD 之外的审批标准并透明行事;若 L0-R 符合 OSD 即应获批,并表示愿协助完善开源定义或制定审批政策。
timeline.point: Argues OSI must publicly state any approval criteria beyond the OSD and act transparently; if L0-R is OSD-conformant it should be approved, and he offers to help refine the Definition or codify approval policies.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Counters Kyle's characterization as overstated, clarifying that the Board usually discusses rejection reasons publicly and that the proposed concerns are not additions to the OSD but a parallel list of reasonable considerations.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Kyle 的表述言过其实，澄清董事会通常会公开讨论拒绝理由，所提出的关注事项不是对 OSD 的补充，而是一份合理考虑事项的平行清单。
timeline.point: Counters Kyle's characterization as overstated, clarifying that the Board usually discusses rejection reasons publicly and that the proposed concerns are not additions to the OSD but a parallel list of reasonable considerations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Contends L0-R passes Bruce's test because only use with modification triggers conditions, cautions against banning attribution and notice retention, and warns the proposed criteria form an anti-copyleft ratchet favoring permissive licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 通过 Bruce 的测试:仅修改后使用才触发条件;提醒勿禁绝署名与声明保留,并警告该标准会形成偏袒宽松许可证的反 copyleft 棘轮。
timeline.point: Contends L0-R passes Bruce's test because only use with modification triggers conditions, cautions against banning attribution and notice retention, and warns the proposed criteria form an anti-copyleft ratchet favoring permissive licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the perception problem may be worse than the reality, urges OSI to update its public webpages to properly set expectations about the approval process, and suggests building a repository of policy concerns from the license-review archives.
timeline.point_zh: 承认公众认知问题可能比实际情况更严重，敦促 OSI 更新公共网页以正确设定批准流程的期望，并建议从许可审查档案中建立政策关注事项的资料库。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the perception problem may be worse than the reality, urges OSI to update its public webpages to properly set expectations about the approval process, and suggests building a repository of policy concerns from the license-review archives.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether use-based terms are needed when modification-based terms exist, notes technical challenges with DRM and automated optimizers stripping notices, and defends copyleft as protecting developers from exploitation by large companies.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑当已有基于修改的条款时是否还需要基于使用的条款，指出 DRM 和自动化优化器剥离通知的技术挑战，并为 copyleft 辩护，认为其保护开发者免受大公司剥削。
timeline.point: Questions whether use-based terms are needed when modification-based terms exist, notes technical challenges with DRM and automated optimizers stripping notices, and defends copyleft as protecting developers from exploitation by large companies.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Finds L0-R's added clauses confusing: why 'uses' instead of 'use', whether clauses 3 and 4 cover redistribution, and what 'uses with modification' means, offering rephrasings that may expose an OSD conformance issue.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 L0-R 新增条款令人困惑:为何用 uses 而非 use、第 3、4 条是否涵盖再分发、uses with modification 何意,并给出可能暴露 OSD 合规问题的改写。
timeline.point: Finds L0-R's added clauses confusing: why 'uses' instead of 'use', whether clauses 3 and 4 cover redistribution, and what 'uses with modification' means, offering rephrasings that may expose an OSD conformance issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Suggests dropping the unenforceable grace period entirely, but then questions whether the resulting license is just a compact LGPL variant with no practical differentiation worth adding to the OSS ecosystem.
timeline.point_zh: 建议完全删除不可执行的宽限期，但随即质疑结果许可是否只是 LGPL 的紧凑变体，没有值得添加到 OSS 生态系统的实际差异。
timeline.point: Suggests dropping the unenforceable grace period entirely, but then questions whether the resulting license is just a compact LGPL variant with no practical differentiation worth adding to the OSS ecosystem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Takes the 'uses' criticism as well taken, clarifies clauses 3 and 4 imply no distribution requirement, explains how BSD 'use' maps onto copyright acts, and will revise the L0-R wording in light of the feedback.
timeline.point_zh: 接受对 uses 的批评,澄清第 3、4 条并无隐含的再分发要求,解释 BSD 的 use 在版权法上的对应行为,并将据此修订 L0-R 措辞。
timeline.point: Takes the 'uses' criticism as well taken, clarifies clauses 3 and 4 imply no distribution requirement, explains how BSD 'use' maps onto copyright acts, and will revise the L0-R wording in light of the feedback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies the enforceability concern about the grace period and argues L0-R differs materially from LGPL by triggering copyleft in far more situations, such as use as a shared library.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清关于宽限期可执行性的顾虑，论证 L0-R 与 LGPL 有实质性区别，因为在更多场景下触发 copyleft 要求，例如作为共享库使用。
timeline.point: Clarifies the enforceability concern about the grace period and argues L0-R differs materially from LGPL by triggering copyleft in far more situations, such as use as a shared library.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Concisely states that the grace period is infinitely gameable and therefore unenforceable.
timeline.point_zh: 简洁地指出宽限期可以被无限利用，因此不可执行。
timeline.point: Concisely states that the grace period is infinitely gameable and therefore unenforceable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the 'grace period is gameable' concern but indicates he will attempt to address it in drafting, while expressing some disagreement.
timeline.point_zh: 承认'宽限期可被利用'的关切，表示将在起草中尝试处理，但对此持一定保留意见。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the 'grace period is gameable' concern but indicates he will attempt to address it in drafting, while expressing some disagreement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Points out that Kyle's own message essentially articulates the problems with the grace period concept.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 Kyle 自己的回复实际上已经阐明了宽限期概念存在的问题。
timeline.point: Points out that Kyle's own message essentially articulates the problems with the grace period concept.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the reformulated grace period avoids the OSD 6 problem, but flags that the 'Open Source' terminology is confusing and that the 'uses with modifications' and 'part of or in development of' provisions appear to violate OSD 9, urging the author to clarify the license's goals.
timeline.point_zh: 认同宽限期新表述可避免 OSD 6 问题,但指出"Open Source"术语易混淆,"uses with modifications"与"part of or in development of"条款疑似违反 OSD 9。
timeline.point: Agrees the reformulated grace period avoids the OSD 6 problem, but flags that the 'Open Source' terminology is confusing and that the 'uses with modifications' and 'part of or in development of' provisions appear to violate OSD 9, urging the author to clarify the license's goals.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains L0-R's goal as a share-alike license triggered in more situations than AGPL but easier to comply with once triggered, argues use-based conditions can plug copyleft loopholes distribution conditions cannot, and provides examples of compliant and non-compliant uses.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 L0-R 目标是比 AGPL 触发场景更广但触发后更易合规的 share-alike 许可证,主张基于使用的条件可堵住 copyleft 漏洞,并举例说明。
timeline.point: Explains L0-R's goal as a share-alike license triggered in more situations than AGPL but easier to comply with once triggered, argues use-based conditions can plug copyleft loopholes distribution conditions cannot, and provides examples of compliant and non-compliant uses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Observes that the BSD license may function as both a copyright and patent license, noting that 'use' is a patent term of art while 'redistribution' is a copyright matter.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 BSD 许可证可能同时作为版权和专利许可证运作，认为'redistribution'是版权术语而'use'是专利术语。
timeline.point: Observes that the BSD license may function as both a copyright and patent license, noting that 'use' is a patent term of art while 'redistribution' is a copyright matter.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Questions the meaning of L0-R clauses 3 and 4, arguing that mere use of software cannot be open source or not, and that clause 4 effectively restricts fields of endeavor, which conflicts with even the most restrictive OSI-approved licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 L0-R 条款 3 和 4 的含义，认为软件的单纯使用无所谓开源与否，条款 4 实质上限制了应用领域，与即使最严格的 OSI 批准许可证也相矛盾。
timeline.point: Questions the meaning of L0-R clauses 3 and 4, arguing that mere use of software cannot be open source or not, and that clause 4 effectively restricts fields of endeavor, which conflicts with even the most restrictive OSI-approved licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees with Florian that L0-R constitutes a field-of-endeavor restriction, which he sees as a fundamental problem, while noting that such stipulations might be acceptable in exchange for a free-of-charge license.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 Florian 的观点，认为 L0-R 构成了对应用领域的限制，这是一个根本性问题，但同时指出在免费许可的前提下这种条款或许可以接受。
timeline.point: Agrees with Florian that L0-R constitutes a field-of-endeavor restriction, which he sees as a fundamental problem, while noting that such stipulations might be acceptable in exchange for a free-of-charge license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees that software itself, not particular uses, is Open Source, but argues OSD 6 'field of endeavor' covers ends like education rather than means like licensing methodology, and defends that use restrictions on copies are enforceable under copyright law.
timeline.point_zh: 认同开源的是软件本身而非特定用途,但主张 OSD 6 的'field of endeavor'指教育等目的而非授权手段,并认为使用限制在版权法下可执行。
timeline.point: Agrees that software itself, not particular uses, is Open Source, but argues OSD 6 'field of endeavor' covers ends like education rather than means like licensing methodology, and defends that use restrictions on copies are enforceable under copyright law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Apologizes for missing Carlo's earlier reply to Florian and directs him to the relevant message.
timeline.point_zh: 为错过了 Carlo 之前对 Florian 的回复而道歉，并指向相关信息。
timeline.point: Apologizes for missing Carlo's earlier reply to Florian and directs him to the relevant message.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues the community is not requesting more license approvals but is rather frustrated by the proliferation of already-approved licenses. Opposes approving redundant licenses that merely repackage existing ones in simpler language.
timeline.point_zh: 认为社区并非要求更多许可证批准，而是对已批准许可证的泛滥感到沮丧。反对批准只是用更简单语言重新包装现有许可证的冗余许可证。
timeline.point: Argues the community is not requesting more license approvals but is rather frustrated by the proliferation of already-approved licenses. Opposes approving redundant licenses that merely repackage existing ones in simpler language.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Proposes that 'field of endeavor' in OSD refers to activities not involving derivative works, meaning a license can restrict incorporation into software but cannot restrict what the software is used to create.
timeline.point_zh: 提出 OSD 中'应用领域'指不涉及衍生作品创作的活动，即许可证可以限制软件被纳入其他软件，但不能限制软件被用来做什么。
timeline.point: Proposes that 'field of endeavor' in OSD refers to activities not involving derivative works, meaning a license can restrict incorporation into software but cannot restrict what the software is used to create.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that L0-R grants the same broad permissions as BSD-2-Clause and does not restrict use to Open Source only; the conditions merely require that modifications or incorporating software become Open Source within a given time.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 L0-R 授予与 BSD-2-Clause 相同的宽泛许可，并不限制只能与开源软件配合使用；条件仅要求修改或合并的软件在规定时间内成为开源。
timeline.point: Clarifies that L0-R grants the same broad permissions as BSD-2-Clause and does not restrict use to Open Source only; the conditions merely require that modifications or incorporating software become Open Source within a given time.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Cites the Apartheid-era UC Berkeley SPICE license to show that well-meant field-of-endeavor restrictions can end up harming the community, and argues that creating derivative works is a separate copyright right that does not fall under 'use restriction'.
timeline.point_zh: 以种族隔离时期 UC Berkeley 的 SPICE 许可证为例,说明善意的'field of endeavor'限制可能危害社区,并主张创作衍生作品是独立的版权权利,不属于'使用限制'。
timeline.point: Cites the Apartheid-era UC Berkeley SPICE license to show that well-meant field-of-endeavor restrictions can end up harming the community, and argues that creating derivative works is a separate copyright right that does not fall under 'use restriction'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues OSI shouldn't dismiss well-informed community members who dissent on the license-driven meaning of 'open source'; volume-based sentiment measures favor consumers over maintainers, and OSI shouldn't lock out plain-language license variations by policy.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSI 不应轻视对"开源"的许可证含义持异议的资深社区成员；按声量衡量意见只会偏向使用者而忽视维护者，且 OSI 不应以政策排斥简明语言的许可证变体。
timeline.point: Argues OSI shouldn't dismiss well-informed community members who dissent on the license-driven meaning of 'open source'; volume-based sentiment measures favor consumers over maintainers, and OSI shouldn't lock out plain-language license variations by policy.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Declares that restricting mere use is a show-stopper for OSI approval, as it denies freedom zero, which is a foundational precondition of the Open Source Definition.
timeline.point_zh: 认为限制纯粹使用是 OSI 批准的致命障碍，因为这否定了自由零——整个开源定义的基本前提。
timeline.point: Declares that restricting mere use is a show-stopper for OSI approval, as it denies freedom zero, which is a foundational precondition of the Open Source Definition.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that the use restriction is unintentional based on Kyle's responses, but agrees that the wording needs to be changed.
timeline.point_zh: 根据 Kyle 的回复承认使用限制并非有意为之，但同意需要修改措辞。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that the use restriction is unintentional based on Kyle's responses, but agrees that the wording needs to be changed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that unmodified use unrelated to software falls under BSD-2-Clause's general permission, and questions whether Carlo objects to conditions on unmodified use or use with modifications.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清未修改的、与软件无关的使用受 BSD-2-Clause 一般许可保护，并质疑 Carlo 反对的是对未修改使用的限制还是对修改使用的限制。
timeline.point: Clarifies that unmodified use unrelated to software falls under BSD-2-Clause's general permission, and questions whether Carlo objects to conditions on unmodified use or use with modifications.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: States categorically that limiting mere use without distribution is unacceptable in any open source or free software license, regardless of whether the code has been modified.
timeline.point_zh: 断然声明，在任何开源或自由软件许可证中，限制不涉及分发的纯粹使用都是不可接受的，无论代码是否被修改。
timeline.point: States categorically that limiting mere use without distribution is unacceptable in any open source or free software license, regardless of whether the code has been modified.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Poses four fundamental questions about the OSD's distinction between distribution and use conditions, challenging whether confining copyleft to distribution triggers still makes sense given ASP and PaaS industry developments.
timeline.point_zh: 就 OSD 对分发条件和使用条件的区分提出四个根本性问题，质疑在 ASP 和 PaaS 行业发展背景下，将 copyleft 限制于分发触发条件是否仍然合理。
timeline.point: Poses four fundamental questions about the OSD's distinction between distribution and use conditions, challenging whether confining copyleft to distribution triggers still makes sense given ASP and PaaS industry developments.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Presents revised L0-R clauses 3-5 stating patch and component release requirements affirmatively, with a separate grace-period forgiveness mechanism akin to (A)GPL-3.0 section 8, and works through hypotheticals showing patch-succession edge cases.
timeline.point_zh: 提出修改后的 L0-R 第 3-5 条：以肯定式表述补丁与组件的发布要求，并单列类似 (A)GPL-3.0 第 8 条的宽限期宽免机制，附假想案例演示补丁接续等边界情形。
timeline.point: Presents revised L0-R clauses 3-5 stating patch and component release requirements affirmatively, with a separate grace-period forgiveness mechanism akin to (A)GPL-3.0 section 8, and works through hypotheticals showing patch-succession edge cases.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Counters that OSI exists to draw a clear line around Open Source and to say 'no' when appropriate, that developers are not unpaid corporate labor, and that plain-language rewrites end up duplicating the Apache License, harming the developer community.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳称 OSI 的使命是明确划定开源界限并在适当时说"不"，开发者不是企业的无偿劳工；简明语言改写最终只会重复 Apache License，损害开发者社区。
timeline.point: Counters that OSI exists to draw a clear line around Open Source and to say 'no' when appropriate, that developers are not unpaid corporate labor, and that plain-language rewrites end up duplicating the Apache License, harming the developer community.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Discovers that 'use' in L0-R means user-level use rather than redistribution as in BSD, and raises concerns about users unable to fulfill relicensing obligations while distributors escape liability. Notes the grace period practical issue of starting from discovery.
timeline.point_zh: 发现 L0-R 中的'use'指用户层面的使用而非 BSD 中的再分发，提出用户可能无法履行重新许可义务而分发者逃脱责任的担忧，并指出宽限期从发现之日算起的实际问题。
timeline.point: Discovers that 'use' in L0-R means user-level use rather than redistribution as in BSD, and raises concerns about users unable to fulfill relicensing obligations while distributors escape liability. Notes the grace period practical issue of starting from discovery.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether 'software patch' is a useful legal term, noting that modern development practices like pull requests and container layering don't clearly fit the concept of a patch.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑'软件补丁'是否是一个有用的法律术语，指出拉取请求和容器分层等现代开发实践不能明确归入补丁的概念。
timeline.point: Questions whether 'software patch' is a useful legal term, noting that modern development practices like pull requests and container layering don't clearly fit the concept of a patch.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Expresses confusion at Josh's statement that 'use' means copying/redistribution in BSD, since BSD explicitly distinguishes redistribution from use.
timeline.point_zh: 对 Josh 关于 BSD 中'use'等同于复制/再分发的陈述表示困惑，因为 BSD 明确区分了再分发和使用。
timeline.point: Expresses confusion at Josh's statement that 'use' means copying/redistribution in BSD, since BSD explicitly distinguishes redistribution from use.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Defines a software patch as merely one form of expressing a modification, and recommends that the license language should refer to publication of modifications rather than patches.
timeline.point_zh: 将软件补丁定义为表达修改的一种形式，建议许可证语言应使用'修改的发布'而非'补丁'。
timeline.point: Defines a software patch as merely one form of expressing a modification, and recommends that the license language should refer to publication of modifications rather than patches.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains that using unreleased patches beyond the grace period falls outside L0-R's permission, that this risk parallels AGPL's Corresponding Source problem, and rebuts doubts about enforceability, noting later discovery can prove noncompliance.
timeline.point_zh: 解释超过宽限期使用未公开补丁即超出 L0-R 授权范围，该风险与 AGPL 的 Corresponding Source 问题类似，并反驳无法执行的质疑，指出事后证据开示可证明违规。
timeline.point: Explains that using unreleased patches beyond the grace period falls outside L0-R's permission, that this risk parallels AGPL's Corresponding Source problem, and rebuts doubts about enforceability, noting later discovery can prove noncompliance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the concern about 'software patch' terminology and proposes replacing it with 'modification constituting a derivative work under copyright law', or alternatively using 'change' instead of 'modification'.
timeline.point_zh: 承认关于'软件补丁'术语的关切，提议将其替换为'构成版权法下衍生作品的修改'，或用'change'替代'modification'。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the concern about 'software patch' terminology and proposes replacing it with 'modification constituting a derivative work under copyright law', or alternatively using 'change' instead of 'modification'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Criticizes 'Use with any software patch' as a failure of plain-language drafting, noting it misuses 'use', confused Josh, and 'patch' does not cover all the acts L0-R intends to restrict.
timeline.point_zh: 批评'Use with any software patch'是通俗语言起草的失败案例，指出它误用了'use'，混淆了 Josh，且'patch'未涵盖 L0-R 有意限制的所有行为。
timeline.point: Criticizes 'Use with any software patch' as a failure of plain-language drafting, noting it misuses 'use', confused Josh, and 'patch' does not cover all the acts L0-R intends to restrict.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Observes that the revised wording makes it the act of running a modified program, not modification itself, that triggers the license, and questions how this adds simplicity compared to the original language.
timeline.point_zh: 观察到修改后的措辞使得触发许可证的是运行修改后程序的行为而非修改本身，并质疑这相比原始语言如何增加了简洁性。
timeline.point: Observes that the revised wording makes it the act of running a modified program, not modification itself, that triggers the license, and questions how this adds simplicity compared to the original language.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Relays certain developers' views on 'freedom' and 'open source', pleading they be considered and requesting links or copies of the documents; argues developer perception is crucial to OSI's relevance, and recounts the origins of License Zero and L0-R.
timeline.point_zh: 转达某些开发者对“freedom”与“open source”的看法,恳请予以考虑并索要相关文件;认为开发者的认知关乎 OSI 的存亡,并讲述 License Zero 与 L0-R 的由来。
timeline.point: Relays certain developers' views on 'freedom' and 'open source', pleading they be considered and requesting links or copies of the documents; argues developer perception is crucial to OSI's relevance, and recounts the origins of License Zero and L0-R.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that 'use' does not map cleanly to copyright holder exclusive rights, but argues that replacing plain language with precise legal terms like '106 rights' would make the license too enterprise-style and drive away potential licensors.
timeline.point_zh: 承认'use'不能精确映射到版权持有者的专有权利，但主张用'106 权利'等精确法律术语替代通俗语言会使许可证过于企业化，从而赶走潜在的许可方。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that 'use' does not map cleanly to copyright holder exclusive rights, but argues that replacing plain language with precise legal terms like '106 rights' would make the license too enterprise-style and drive away potential licensors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Accepts Bruce's feedback that 'use with any software patch' fails at simple language and reverts to 'use with modification'.
timeline.point_zh: 接受 Bruce 关于'use with any software patch'在通俗语言方面失败的反馈，暂且回退到'use with modification'。
timeline.point: Accepts Bruce's feedback that 'use with any software patch' fails at simple language and reverts to 'use with modification'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Answers that use conditions were excluded from OSD because they were unnecessary and historically backfired. Argues that all desired copyleft effects can be achieved through modification conditions alone, and suggests using permissive exceptions for private development.
timeline.point_zh: 回答说使用条件被排除在 OSD 之外是因为它们不必要且历史上曾适得其反。主张所有期望的 copyleft 效果都可以仅通过修改条件实现，并建议对私人开发使用许可性例外。
timeline.point: Answers that use conditions were excluded from OSD because they were unnecessary and historically backfired. Argues that all desired copyleft effects can be achieved through modification conditions alone, and suggests using permissive exceptions for private development.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues that Open Source has already won in terms of industry pervasiveness, and further increases in adoption beyond smaller enterprises are unlikely; suggests focusing on Open Science and Open Publication instead.
timeline.point_zh: 认为开源在行业渗透方面已经取得了胜利，除小型企业外进一步增加采用的可能性不大；建议将注意力转向开放科学和开放出版。
timeline.point: Argues that Open Source has already won in terms of industry pervasiveness, and further increases in adoption beyond smaller enterprises are unlikely; suggests focusing on Open Science and Open Publication instead.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues 'Open Source won' only a marketing victory, not a values one, with proprietary firms stretching the term's meaning; contends L0-R's succinct copyleft bargain spotlights that gap between marketing victory and values defeat, and can rectify it.
timeline.point_zh: 认为“Open Source won”只是营销层面的胜利而非价值观的胜利,专有厂商不断挪用其含义;主张 L0-R 以简洁的互惠条款凸显并纠正这一落差。
timeline.point: Argues 'Open Source won' only a marketing victory, not a values one, with proprietary firms stretching the term's meaning; contends L0-R's succinct copyleft bargain spotlights that gap between marketing victory and values defeat, and can rectify it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Recommends that Kyle try building copyleft conditions on modification rather than use, with optional private development exceptions, and come back with new license text.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 Kyle 尝试基于修改而非使用来构建 copyleft 条件，并可添加私人开发例外，然后带着新的许可证文本回来讨论。
timeline.point: Recommends that Kyle try building copyleft conditions on modification rather than use, with optional private development exceptions, and come back with new license text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether all use-based conditions are doomed to backfire and argues that OSD 6's field-of-endeavor language cannot reasonably be read to bar conditions on anything but distribution with modifications; asks where that would leave copyleft's power.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑是否所有基于使用的条件都注定适得其反，并主张 OSD 6 的领域限制条文无法被合理解读为仅禁止对修改后分发附加条件；追问这将把 copyleft 置于何地。
timeline.point: Questions whether all use-based conditions are doomed to backfire and argues that OSD 6's field-of-endeavor language cannot reasonably be read to bar conditions on anything but distribution with modifications; asks where that would leave copyleft's power.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Explains the main problem is keeping the legal load on passive users low, citing Berkeley SPICE, and demonstrates that a modify-must-publish requirement can be OSD-compliant when inverted into a permission, so copyleft is not limited to distribution with modifications.
timeline.point_zh: 指出核心问题是降低被动用户的法律负担并以 Berkeley SPICE 为例；演示“修改须发布”要求反转为许可即可符合 OSD，故 copyleft 不限于修改后分发。
timeline.point: Explains the main problem is keeping the legal load on passive users low, citing Berkeley SPICE, and demonstrates that a modify-must-publish requirement can be OSD-compliant when inverted into a permission, so copyleft is not limited to distribution with modifications.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Notes that L0-R remains ambiguous about whether an L0-R-licensed text editor can be used to write non-public content, and states that such ambiguity is a fundamental problem for a license.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 L0-R 仍然模糊不清——无法确定 L0-R 许可的文本编辑器是否可用于编写非公开内容，并认为这种歧义是许可证的根本问题。
timeline.point: Notes that L0-R remains ambiguous about whether an L0-R-licensed text editor can be used to write non-public content, and states that such ambiguity is a fundamental problem for a license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues that permissive licenses are not one-way valves but acts of generosity, notes that industry funded much open source development, and suggests L0-R achieves something similar to CC-BY-SA-NC through a much more complex mechanism.
timeline.point_zh: 认为宽松许可证不是单向阀而是慷慨之举，指出行业资助了大量开源开发，并建议 L0-R 通过更复杂的机制实现了类似于 CC-BY-SA-NC 的效果。
timeline.point: Argues that permissive licenses are not one-way valves but acts of generosity, notes that industry funded much open source development, and suggests L0-R achieves something similar to CC-BY-SA-NC through a much more complex mechanism.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues the norm of using only permissive licenses, not the licenses themselves, creates the one-way valve; industry wants sustainable ways to fund open work, and many developers prefer L0-R with income from selling exceptions over a noncommercial license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为造成单向阀的是只用宽松许可证的惯例而非许可证本身；业界需要可持续的开放工作模式，许多开发者倾向 L0-R 加出售例外收入，而非非商业许可证。
timeline.point: Argues the norm of using only permissive licenses, not the licenses themselves, creates the one-way valve; industry wants sustainable ways to fund open work, and many developers prefer L0-R with income from selling exceptions over a noncommercial license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues OSD 6 as written would also bar existing copyleft licenses unless read oddly and narrowly, so OSI should add and explain the missing words; puzzles over why 'inverting' a use restriction into a permission changes conformance when the legal effect is the same.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSD 6 字面含义若不作牵强的狭义解读会连现有 copyleft 许可证也一并禁止，OSI 应补充并解释条文；困惑于把使用限制“反转”为许可在法律效果相同时为何能改变合规性。
timeline.point: Argues OSD 6 as written would also bar existing copyleft licenses unless read oddly and narrowly, so OSI should add and explain the missing words; puzzles over why 'inverting' a use restriction into a permission changes conformance when the legal effect is the same.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Critiques L0-R for putting the copyleft burden on end users rather than modifiers, noting this differs from GPL which triggers only on distribution.
timeline.point_zh: 批评 L0-R 将 copyleft 义务加在终端用户身上而非修改者身上，指出这与 GPL 仅在分发时触发不同。
timeline.point: Critiques L0-R for putting the copyleft burden on end users rather than modifiers, noting this differs from GPL which triggers only on distribution.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Explains L0-R triggers on use to drive a harder reciprocity bargain than GPL, as AGPL did in closing the ASP loophole, while preserving BSD-2-Clause redistribution conditions for compatibility; notes software is always caveat user and thanks Josh for the questions.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 L0-R 触发于使用是为了像 AGPL 封堵 ASP 漏洞那样实现比 GPL 更强的互惠，同时保留 BSD-2-Clause 再分发条件以兼容分发系统；软件终究是 caveat user，并感谢 Josh 的提问。
timeline.point: Explains L0-R triggers on use to drive a harder reciprocity bargain than GPL, as AGPL did in closing the ASP loophole, while preserving BSD-2-Clause redistribution conditions for compatibility; notes software is always caveat user and thanks Josh for the questions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Explains that OSI approval also serves uncodified goals of software-freedom advocacy and community consensus beyond the OSD, so a license that avoids OSD disqualification can still be rejected by the Board.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 OSI 审批还服务于 OSD 之外的软件自由倡导与社区共识等未成文目标，因此避开 OSD 否决条款的许可证仍可能被董事会拒绝。
timeline.point: Explains that OSI approval also serves uncodified goals of software-freedom advocacy and community consensus beyond the OSD, so a license that avoids OSD disqualification can still be rejected by the Board.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Asks which project will be the first to use L0-R, noting the committee wants confirmed users before approving a license.
timeline.point_zh: 询问哪个项目将是第一个使用 L0-R 的项目，指出委员会希望在批准许可证前有确认的使用者。
timeline.point: Asks which project will be the first to use L0-R, noting the committee wants confirmed users before approving a license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Reiterates that OSI approval is publicly presented as OSD-based and urges transparent acknowledgment of any uncodified policy objectives; wants OSD conformance acknowledged and remains open to revisions to win approval.
timeline.point_zh: 重申 OSI 审批公开宣称基于 OSD，敦促透明承认未成文的政策目标；希望获得 OSD 合规认定，并愿继续修改以争取批准。
timeline.point: Reiterates that OSI approval is publicly presented as OSD-based and urges transparent acknowledgment of any uncodified policy objectives; wants OSD conformance acknowledged and remains open to revisions to win approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Describes L0-R as intended for licensezero.com users, primarily npm packages, and explains the chicken-and-egg problem of needing OSI approval before promoting adoption.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 L0-R 是为 licensezero.com 用户（主要是 npm 包）设计的，并解释了需要先获 OSI 批准才能推广的先有鸡还是先有蛋问题。
timeline.point: Describes L0-R as intended for licensezero.com users, primarily npm packages, and explains the chicken-and-egg problem of needing OSI approval before promoting adoption.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Raises concern about the potential harm of aggressive copyleft on the npm ecosystem, and questions whether OSI has rules against approving a license designed to fuel dual-licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 对激进 copyleft 可能对 npm 生态系统造成的危害表示担忧，并质疑 OSI 是否有规则反对批准旨在推动双重许可模式的许可证。
timeline.point: Raises concern about the potential harm of aggressive copyleft on the npm ecosystem, and questions whether OSI has rules against approving a license designed to fuel dual-licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: States OSI approval must be considered in the context of its mission, not just OSD alone, and asks whether L0-R would be recognized by the FSF as a free software license.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSI 批准必须结合其使命而非仅看 OSD，并询问 L0-R 是否会被 FSF 认定为自由软件许可证。
timeline.point: States OSI approval must be considered in the context of its mission, not just OSD alone, and asks whether L0-R would be recognized by the FSF as a free software license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Points to Artistic License 2.0 as precedent for OSI-approved licenses that support dual-licensing business models, and offers to discuss npm concerns offline.
timeline.point_zh: 以 Artistic License 2.0 为例说明 OSI 已批准的许可证支持双重许可商业模式，并提出线下讨论 npm 相关问题。
timeline.point: Points to Artistic License 2.0 as precedent for OSI-approved licenses that support dual-licensing business models, and offers to discuss npm concerns offline.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Criticizes the license's unexplained use restriction on the South African police and argues coupling use restrictions is form over substance; defends the OSD's simple 'no additional restrictions' wording over reshaping the OSD around the license.
timeline.point_zh: 批评该许可证对南非警察的使用限制缺乏理由说明，指出以奇特方式耦合使用限制是重形式轻实质；为 OSD 简洁的“不附加限制”措辞辩护，反对围绕个别许可证改写 OSD。
timeline.point: Criticizes the license's unexplained use restriction on the South African police and argues coupling use restrictions is form over substance; defends the OSD's simple 'no additional restrictions' wording over reshaping the OSD around the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Warns OSI that uncodified, intentionally vague objectives could shelter concerns contrary to its mission and tax status, and urges more transparency; also disagrees with FSF's narrow copyleft stance, saying copyleft should go no further than his own implementation.
timeline.point_zh: 警告 OSI：未成文且刻意模糊的目标可能为与其宗旨和税务地位相悖的关切提供庇护，呼吁提高透明度；并不同意 FSF 对 copyleft 的狭隘立场，认为 copyleft 不应比自己的实现走得更远。
timeline.point: Warns OSI that uncodified, intentionally vague objectives could shelter concerns contrary to its mission and tax status, and urges more transparency; also disagrees with FSF's narrow copyleft stance, saying copyleft should go no further than his own implementation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Demands that Kyle elaborate on his implication that OSI board members should seek their own legal counsel regarding licensing matters.
timeline.point_zh: 要求 Kyle 详细说明其暗示 OSI 董事会成员应就许可事宜寻求自己法律顾问的含义。
timeline.point: Demands that Kyle elaborate on his implication that OSI board members should seek their own legal counsel regarding licensing matters.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Suggests dismissing the remark as a poor choice of words, characterizing OSI as a non-profit administering a trademark program in a non-arbitrary manner.
timeline.point_zh: 建议将该言论视为措辞不当而不再追究，认为 OSI 是一个以非任意方式管理商标计划的非营利组织。
timeline.point: Suggests dismissing the remark as a poor choice of words, characterizing OSI as a non-profit administering a trademark program in a non-arbitrary manner.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies no accusation was made or intended, describing his comment as standard attorney-client prudence regarding mission, purpose, and tax status of non-profit entities.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清未做也无意做任何指控，说明其言论是关于非营利实体使命、宗旨和税务身份的标准律师审慎意见。
timeline.point: Clarifies no accusation was made or intended, describing his comment as standard attorney-client prudence regarding mission, purpose, and tax status of non-profit entities.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Urges returning to license drafting, noting the main drafting obstacle may be resolved but the license might still lack sufficient merit for OSI certification despite OSD compliance.
timeline.point_zh: 敦促回到许可证起草工作，指出主要起草障碍可能已解决，但许可证可能因缺乏足够价值而无法获得 OSI 认证，尽管符合 OSD。
timeline.point: Urges returning to license drafting, noting the main drafting obstacle may be resolved but the license might still lack sufficient merit for OSI certification despite OSD compliance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Expresses confusion about next steps after learning a draft was deemed OSD-conformant, and considers either accepting that interpretation or rewriting from scratch.
timeline.point_zh: 在得知某个草案被认为符合 OSD 后对下一步感到困惑，考虑接受该解读或从头重写。
timeline.point: Expresses confusion about next steps after learning a draft was deemed OSD-conformant, and considers either accepting that interpretation or rewriting from scratch.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Advises Kyle to adopt the proposed language to resolve the main objection, while cautioning that remaining problems may still prevent board certification.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 Kyle 采用所提议的语言来解决主要异议，同时提醒剩余问题仍可能阻止董事会认证。
timeline.point: Advises Kyle to adopt the proposed language to resolve the main objection, while cautioning that remaining problems may still prevent board certification.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Raises three issues: the discussants may not be reading the same draft; forcing commercial users to pay is not open source but shared-source dual licensing; and the intent appears easily circumvented since a business can modify under BSD without providing source to internal users.
timeline.point_zh: 提出三点问题：双方读的可能不是同一版草案；迫使商业用户付费并非开源而是共享源码双许可；且意图易被规避——企业可在 BSD 下修改而不向内部用户提供源码。
timeline.point: Raises three issues: the discussants may not be reading the same draft; forcing commercial users to pay is not open source but shared-source dual licensing; and the intent appears easily circumvented since a business can modify under BSD without providing source to internal users.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Posts the current L0-R draft with the 'publish' requirement removed in favor of OSD 2's source-availability requirement; will not propose L0-NC since it fails the Definition, and argues dual-licensing intent does not make GPL-style licenses less open source.
timeline.point_zh: 发布移除“publish”要求、改为按 OSD 2 要求源码可得的最新 L0-R 草案；不会提交不满足 OSD 的 L0-NC，并主张双许可意图不会使 GPL 类许可证失去开源属性。
timeline.point: Posts the current L0-R draft with the 'publish' requirement removed in favor of OSD 2's source-availability requirement; will not propose L0-NC since it fails the Definition, and argues dual-licensing intent does not make GPL-style licenses less open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues that incorporating OSD by reference does not work as intended because OSD specifies license behavior rather than being a license itself, and urges writing a stand-alone license.
timeline.point_zh: 认为引用 OSD 不能按预期运作，因为 OSD 规定的是许可证行为而非许可证本身，建议编写独立许可证。
timeline.point: Argues that incorporating OSD by reference does not work as intended because OSD specifies license behavior rather than being a license itself, and urges writing a stand-alone license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues the OSD defines open-source software and addresses more than licenses, so referencing it in L0-R was a reasonable fallback; offers to lock the reference to the OSD 'as originally published' and is drafting that change now.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 OSD 定义的是开源软件而非仅针对许可证，故在 L0-R 中引用 OSD 是合理回退；提出可将引用锁定为“最初发布版”的 OSD，目前正着手修改。
timeline.point: Argues the OSD defines open-source software and addresses more than licenses, so referencing it in L0-R was a reasonable fallback; offers to lock the reference to the OSD 'as originally published' and is drafting that change now.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Explains the OSD's provisions define how a class of licenses behaves rather than being a software license; calls referencing the OSD in the license bad writing since its future text is unknown, and suggests requiring modifications under 'this license' instead.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 OSD 条款规定的是一类许可证的行为而非软件许可证本身；指出在许可证中引用 OSD 是糟糕写法，因 OSD 未来内容不可知，建议改用“本许可证”约束修改版。
timeline.point: Explains the OSD's provisions define how a class of licenses behaves rather than being a software license; calls referencing the OSD in the license bad writing since its future text is unknown, and suggests requiring modifications under 'this license' instead.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Concedes potential slippage between the OSD's 'Open Source' and L0-R's own definition, plans to date-lock the OSD reference, and defends L0-R's stronger copyleft trigger with weaker compliance burdens and an approved-license whitelist to avoid same-license incompatibility.
timeline.point_zh: 承认 OSD 定义的"Open Source"与 L0-R 定义可能漂移,计划锁定 OSD 引用日期,并辩护 L0-R 更强 copyleft 触发、更轻合规负担及许可白名单设计。
timeline.point: Concedes potential slippage between the OSD's 'Open Source' and L0-R's own definition, plans to date-lock the OSD reference, and defends L0-R's stronger copyleft trigger with weaker compliance burdens and an approved-license whitelist to avoid same-license incompatibility.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Warns that referencing a document like the OSD by reference invites judicial ambiguity, and that 'must allow' language dilutes the terms wanted; if the OSD is referenced, backup language like 'no more restrictive than this one' plus separate source-availability terms are needed.
timeline.point_zh: 警告引用 OSD 之类文件会带来司法歧义,"must allow"措辞会稀释想要的条款;若引用 OSD,需"不比本许可证更严格"的兜底措辞及单独的源码可得性条款。
timeline.point: Warns that referencing a document like the OSD by reference invites judicial ambiguity, and that 'must allow' language dilutes the terms wanted; if the OSD is referenced, backup language like 'no more restrictive than this one' plus separate source-availability terms are needed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Argues incorporation by reference is routine in courts and the parol evidence rule keeps readings within the license's four corners; date-locking solves OSD revisions, while 'no more restrictive' offers little clarity.
timeline.point_zh: 认为引用并入在法院中很常见,口头证据规则使解读限于许可证文本之内;锁定日期可解决 OSD 修订问题,而"no more restrictive"缺乏清晰度。
timeline.point: Argues incorporation by reference is routine in courts and the parol evidence rule keeps readings within the license's four corners; date-locking solves OSD revisions, while 'no more restrictive' offers little clarity.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Maintains the license as drafted violates OSD clauses 6 and 9; doubts it will achieve its goals since target companies won't accept its terms, and advises would-be users to adopt a standard eval license and keep 'open source' out of it.
timeline.point_zh: 坚持该许可证草案违反 OSD 第 6 条和第 9 条;怀疑其难以实现目标,因为目标公司不会接受其条款,建议改用标准评估许可证,不要打"开源"旗号。
timeline.point: Maintains the license as drafted violates OSD clauses 6 and 9; doubts it will achieve its goals since target companies won't accept its terms, and advises would-be users to adopt a standard eval license and keep 'open source' out of it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Still puzzled by the OSD 6 concern, asks McCoy for an example of a use outside OSD 9's bounds, and announces a forthcoming more direct L0-R rewrite inspired by Bruce.
timeline.point_zh: 对 OSD 第 6 条的顾虑仍感困惑,请 McCoy 举例说明 OSD 第 9 条的越界使用,并预告受 Bruce 启发的更直接的 L0-R 重写版即将推出。
timeline.point: Still puzzled by the OSD 6 concern, asks McCoy for an example of a use outside OSD 9's bounds, and announces a forthcoming more direct L0-R rewrite inspired by Bruce.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Announces stepping away from the discussion until Tuesday to focus on an FCC filing and personal matters.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布暂停参与讨论直到周二，以便处理 FCC 申请和私人事务。
timeline.point: Announces stepping away from the discussion until Tuesday to focus on an FCC filing and personal matters.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Calls the license's non-compliance with Freedom 0 a show stopper, adding that GPL compatibility is not a big concern personally.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证不满足 Freedom 0 是致命问题,并补充说他本人并不太在意与 GPL 的兼容性。
timeline.point: Calls the license's non-compliance with Freedom 0 a show stopper, adding that GPL compatibility is not a big concern personally.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public	License
timeline.snippet: Argues that incorporating OSD by reference adds unnecessary complexity and devalues the license, and recommends embedding relevant conditions directly in the license text.
timeline.point_zh: 认为引用 OSD 增加了不必要的复杂性并降低了许可证质量，建议将相关条件直接嵌入许可证文本。
timeline.point: Argues that incorporating OSD by reference adds unnecessary complexity and devalues the license, and recommends embedding relevant conditions directly in the license text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Agrees the discussion has become lengthy and promises that the forthcoming revision will address concerns and help refocus the conversation.
timeline.point_zh: 同意讨论已变得冗长，承诺即将发布的修订将解决各方关切并帮助重新聚焦讨论。
timeline.point: Agrees the discussion has become lengthy and promises that the forthcoming revision will address concerns and help refocus the conversation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies the OSD 6 concern relates to time-limited termination applying differently to open vs non-open source, and provides two examples of uses that would violate OSD 9.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 OSD 6 担忧源于限时终止条款对开源与非开源软件的差异化适用，并给出两个违反 OSD 9 的使用示例。
timeline.point: Clarifies the OSD 6 concern relates to time-limited termination applying differently to open vs non-open source, and provides two examples of uses that would violate OSD 9.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Seeks to confirm understanding of the OSD 6 issue regarding differential treatment of open vs non-open source, and proposes revisiting OSD 9 in context of the forthcoming revision.
timeline.point_zh: 试图确认对 OSD 6 关于开源与非开源差异化处理的理解，并建议在即将发布的修订中重新审视 OSD 9。
timeline.point: Seeks to confirm understanding of the OSD 6 issue regarding differential treatment of open vs non-open source, and proposes revisiting OSD 9 in context of the forthcoming revision.

timeline.subject: [License-review] License Zero Reciprocal Public License
timeline.snippet: Notes that the OSI board made no decision on L0-R because the submitter appears to have effectively withdrawn the license.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSI 董事会对 L0-R 未作决定,因为提交者实际上已撤回该许可。
timeline.point: Notes that the OSI board made no decision on L0-R because the submitter appears to have effectively withdrawn the license.

submissions.rejection_reason: License Committee recommended rejection. Board chose not to decide because submitter had effectively withdrawn the license from consideration.

submissions.name: Open Logistics License v1.2

curated_rwp.rejection_reason: Superseded by v1.3 which was approved by OSI. Version 1.2 had issues that were addressed in 1.3.

timeline.snippet: Resubmits the Open Logistics License v1.2, an Apache v2-based license revised per earlier feedback for German-law warranty and liability differences, proposing the special purpose license category.
timeline.point_zh: 重新提交 Open Logistics License v1.2——基于 Apache v2、按德国法调整担保与责任条款的专用许可。
timeline.point: Resubmits the Open Logistics License v1.2, an Apache v2-based license revised per earlier feedback for German-law warranty and liability differences, proposing the special purpose license category.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Announces that comments are forthcoming from the perspective of an Italian lawyer.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布将从意大利律师的角度提供一些评论。
timeline.point: Announces that comments are forthcoming from the perspective of an Italian lawyer.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Questions the implementation of Section 4’s obligation to ensure recipients incorporate provisions; asks what problem it solves since distributing the license itself seems sufficient.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑第4条义务的实施方式；询问该条款旨在解决什么问题，因为分发许可证本身似乎已经足够。
timeline.point: Questions the implementation of Section 4’s obligation to ensure recipients incorporate provisions; asks what problem it solves since distributing the license itself seems sufficient.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Raises concern that the parenthetical “with regard to software components” in Section 4 could be interpreted as preventing reproduction and distribution of non-software components.
timeline.point_zh: 对第4条中“关于软件组件”的括号内容表示担忧，认为可能被解读为禁止复制和分发非软件组件。
timeline.point: Raises concern that the parenthetical “with regard to software components” in Section 4 could be interpreted as preventing reproduction and distribution of non-software components.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Argues that if existing FOSS licenses don’t comply with German law, the solution is to redraft those licenses rather than create a new one; otherwise this is pure license proliferation.
timeline.point_zh: 认为如果现有FOSS许可证不符合德国法律，解决方案是修订那些许可证而非创建新许可证；否则这纯粹是许可证增殖。
timeline.point: Argues that if existing FOSS licenses don’t comply with German law, the solution is to redraft those licenses rather than create a new one; otherwise this is pure license proliferation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Notes that FOSS licenses generally disclaim what local law permits; asks for specific legal references showing German law requires disclaimers to be styled in a particular way.
timeline.point_zh: 指出FOSS许可证通常在法律允许的范围内免责；要求提供具体的法律依据证明德国法律要求免责条款必须以特定方式表述。
timeline.point: Notes that FOSS licenses generally disclaim what local law permits; asks for specific legal references showing German law requires disclaimers to be styled in a particular way.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Argues a special-purpose license for German warranty law is pure license proliferation, asks for evidence of real non-hypothetical harm, and questions why it is named 'Open Logistics License'.
timeline.point_zh: 认为为德国担保法专设许可是纯粹的许可增殖，要求证明真实的损害，并质疑为何命名为“Open Logistics License”。
timeline.point: Argues a special-purpose license for German warranty law is pure license proliferation, asks for evidence of real non-hypothetical harm, and questions why it is named 'Open Logistics License'.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Warns that overly broad liability disclaimers may trigger product liability under consumer protection law, and that German-origin licenses tend to avoid disclaiming intent and gross negligence.
timeline.point_zh: 警告过于宽泛的免责声明可能触发消费者保护法下的产品责任，德国本土许可证通常会避免免除故意和重大过失的责任。
timeline.point: Warns that overly broad liability disclaimers may trigger product liability under consumer protection law, and that German-origin licenses tend to avoid disclaiming intent and gross negligence.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Notes that the submitted license's liability language differs from the EUPL's language, and questions whether the narrower German-law-specific formulation matters for a license meant to be construed under German law.
timeline.point_zh: 指出该许可证的责任条款语言与 EUPL 不同，但认为既然许可证适用德国法律，该标准在德国法律下应该是正确的。
timeline.point: Notes that the submitted license's liability language differs from the EUPL's language, and questions whether the narrower German-law-specific formulation matters for a license meant to be construed under German law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Argues that choice-of-law provisions provide beneficial certainty about applicable law, and questions what would happen if different parts of a codebase were under different national laws.
timeline.point_zh: 主张法律选择条款能提供有益的确定性，并追问如果同一代码库的不同部分适用不同国家法律会怎样。
timeline.point: Argues that choice-of-law provisions provide beneficial certainty about applicable law, and questions what would happen if different parts of a codebase were under different national laws.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Observes that both liability formulations likely translate from German legal concepts, and raises questions about whether consumer protection law already determines applicable law for end users, and whether the Berne Convention already specifies the binding country.
timeline.point_zh: 认为两种责任表述可能都源自德国法律概念的英文翻译，并质疑消费者保护法是否已为终端用户确定适用法律，以及伯尔尼公约是否已规定受约束的国家。
timeline.point: Observes that both liability formulations likely translate from German legal concepts, and raises questions about whether consumer protection law already determines applicable law for end users, and whether the Berne Convention already specifies the binding country.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Strongly opposes choice-of-law clauses in FOSS licenses, arguing they disrupt egalitarian enforcement worldwide and give licensors inappropriate power; criticizes OSI for considering them acceptable.
timeline.point_zh: 强烈反对在 FOSS 许可证中使用法律选择条款，认为它们会破坏全球平等的许可证执行，给许可方不当权力，批评 OSI 接受此类条款。
timeline.point: Strongly opposes choice-of-law clauses in FOSS licenses, arguing they disrupt egalitarian enforcement worldwide and give licensors inappropriate power; criticizes OSI for considering them acceptable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Provides a reference link to the IFOSS Law Book's chapter on German waiver and liability law as a starting point for the discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 提供了 IFOSS 法律手册中关于德国免责与责任章节的链接，作为讨论的参考起点。
timeline.point: Provides a reference link to the IFOSS Law Book's chapter on German waiver and liability law as a starting point for the discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Asks Bradley Kuhn to explain specifically how choice-of-law clauses cause trouble in FOSS licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 要求 Bradley Kuhn 具体解释法律选择条款如何在 FOSS 许可证中造成问题。
timeline.point: Asks Bradley Kuhn to explain specifically how choice-of-law clauses cause trouble in FOSS licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Explains that choice-of-law clauses force cross-jurisdictional enforcement that burdens non-lawyers, risk locking FOSS into unfavorable legal regimes, and questions whether the Open Logistics License intentionally seeks GPL incompatibility like CDDL did.
timeline.point_zh: 解释法律选择条款迫使跨司法管辖区执法，给非法律人士造成负担，且存在将 FOSS 锁定在不利法律体系中的风险，质疑 Open Logistics 许可证是否像 CDDL 那样有意与 GPL 不兼容。
timeline.point: Explains that choice-of-law clauses force cross-jurisdictional enforcement that burdens non-lawyers, risk locking FOSS into unfavorable legal regimes, and questions whether the Open Logistics License intentionally seeks GPL incompatibility like CDDL did.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Defends the choice-of-law provision: courts routinely apply foreign law, certainty beats the roulette wheel of unstated choice of law, and blaming the tool for GPL incompatibilities mistakes a good tool for the problem.
timeline.point_zh: 为法律选择条款辩护：法院常适用外国法，确定性优于未指明法律的轮盘赌；并反驳将 GPL 不兼容归咎于工具本身。
timeline.point: Defends the choice-of-law provision: courts routinely apply foreign law, certainty beats the roulette wheel of unstated choice of law, and blaming the tool for GPL incompatibilities mistakes a good tool for the problem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the IFOSS Law Book reference as valuable and notes the authors are well-regarded.
timeline.point_zh: 认可 IFOSS 法律手册的参考价值，指出其作者享有盛誉。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the IFOSS Law Book reference as valuable and notes the authors are well-regarded.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: As a practitioner, reports that Eclipse removed choice-of-law from EPL-2.0 after 15 years of failing to convince stakeholders of its value, and notes that 95%+ of FOSS uses licenses without choice-of-law, arguing the practical debate is settled.
timeline.point_zh: 以从业者身份指出 Eclipse 在 EPL-2.0 中移除了法律选择条款，15年间未能说服利益相关者其价值，且 95% 以上的 FOSS 使用无法律选择条款的许可证，认为实际辩论已有定论。
timeline.point: As a practitioner, reports that Eclipse removed choice-of-law from EPL-2.0 after 15 years of failing to convince stakeholders of its value, and notes that 95%+ of FOSS uses licenses without choice-of-law, arguing the practical debate is settled.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that choice-of-law is disfavored but expresses frustration that no compelling reason has been provided beyond mere convention.
timeline.point_zh: 承认法律选择条款确实不受欢迎，但表示困惑于至今未获得有说服力的理由，似乎只是约定俗成。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that choice-of-law is disfavored but expresses frustration that no compelling reason has been provided beyond mere convention.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Defends choice-of-law/jurisdiction clauses as fair to licensors, arguing that requiring enforcement in the licensor's jurisdiction protects small licensors from chasing bad actors worldwide, and directly disagrees with Kuhn's blanket rejection.
timeline.point_zh: 为法律选择/管辖权条款辩护，认为要求在许可方所在司法管辖区执法对许可方公平，保护小型许可方无需全球追诉违规者，明确反对 Kuhn 的全盘否定。
timeline.point: Defends choice-of-law/jurisdiction clauses as fair to licensors, arguing that requiring enforcement in the licensor's jurisdiction protects small licensors from chasing bad actors worldwide, and directly disagrees with Kuhn's blanket rejection.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Counters the consumer protection argument by explaining that US law does not generally distinguish consumer from business contracts, argues choice-of-law is neutral between individuals and corporations, and can empower small licensors.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳消费者保护论点，解释美国法律一般不区分消费者与商业合同，认为法律选择条款对个人和企业是中立的，并且可以赋权小型许可方。
timeline.point: Counters the consumer protection argument by explaining that US law does not generally distinguish consumer from business contracts, argues choice-of-law is neutral between individuals and corporations, and can empower small licensors.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Explains that the license is named after its authoring organization, the Open Logistics Foundation, analogous to how EPL comes from Eclipse.
timeline.point_zh: 解释许可证以其创建组织 Open Logistics Foundation 命名，类似于 EPL 来自 Eclipse。
timeline.point: Explains that the license is named after its authoring organization, the Open Logistics Foundation, analogous to how EPL comes from Eclipse.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that Section 4's flow-down clause requires the distributor to guarantee a legal result (that recipients be obligated), which is problematic because the distributor cannot fully control whether that legal effect is achieved.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清第 4 条的传递条款要求分发者保证法律效果（即接收方被约束），这有问题因为分发者无法完全控制该法律效果是否能实现。
timeline.point: Clarifies that Section 4's flow-down clause requires the distributor to guarantee a legal result (that recipients be obligated), which is problematic because the distributor cannot fully control whether that legal effect is achieved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Argues that choice-of-law in public licenses creates confusion when code under different national versions is merged, and that while choice-of-law works for private contracts, public licenses present fundamentally different challenges that make it inadvisable.
timeline.point_zh: 主张公共许可证中的法律选择条款会在不同国家版本代码合并时造成混乱，认为虽然私人合同的法律选择没有问题，但公共许可证面临根本不同的挑战。
timeline.point: Argues that choice-of-law in public licenses creates confusion when code under different national versions is merged, and that while choice-of-law works for private contracts, public licenses present fundamentally different challenges that make it inadvisable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Expresses strong doubt that the Berne Convention covers licensing (as opposed to copyright), and reiterates that choice-of-law provisions are problematic for public licenses, citing Eben Moglen's long-held position.
timeline.point_zh: 对伯尔尼公约是否涵盖许可（而非版权）表示强烈怀疑，重申法律选择条款对公共许可证而言是非常棘手的领域，引用 Eben Moglen 长期以来的观点。
timeline.point: Expresses strong doubt that the Berne Convention covers licensing (as opposed to copyright), and reiterates that choice-of-law provisions are problematic for public licenses, citing Eben Moglen's long-held position.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the parenthetical in the distribution clause is misleading and submits a revised version that clarifies software components must be distributed in Source or Object form.
timeline.point_zh: 承认分发条款中的括号表述有误导性，提交了修改后的版本以明确软件组件须以源代码或目标代码形式分发。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the parenthetical in the distribution clause is misleading and submits a revised version that clarifies software components must be distributed in Source or Object form.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges Carlo's clarification about the Section 4 obligation issue as very helpful.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 Carlo 对第 4 条义务问题的澄清非常有帮助。
timeline.point: Acknowledges Carlo's clarification about the Section 4 obligation issue as very helpful.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that Carlo's explanation about choice-of-law in public licenses versus private contracts clarifies the issue.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 Carlo 关于公共许可证与私人合同中法律选择差异的解释阐明了问题。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that Carlo's explanation about choice-of-law in public licenses versus private contracts clarifies the issue.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Accepts Andreas's proposed revision to the distribution clause as addressing her concern, and requests a revised draft consolidating all changes into a single document.
timeline.point_zh: 接受 Andreas 对分发条款的修改作为对其关切的回应，并要求提交包含所有修改的完整修订草案。
timeline.point: Accepts Andreas's proposed revision to the distribution clause as addressing her concern, and requests a revised draft consolidating all changes into a single document.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Explains the last bullet of Article 4 was meant to flow down Article 4's obligations and offers to amend the provision, asking how it could be formulated more clearly.
timeline.point_zh: 解释第4条最后一项旨在向下传递第4条各项义务，表示可作修订，并询问如何表述更清晰。
timeline.point: Explains the last bullet of Article 4 was meant to flow down Article 4's obligations and offers to amend the provision, asking how it could be formulated more clearly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: States that developer feedback is limited since the license's rationale is purely legal, and requests a developer-oriented FAQ explaining when and why to use this license instead of Apache.
timeline.point_zh: 指出开发者反馈有限，因为许可证的理由完全基于法律解释，并要求提供面向开发者的常见问题解答，说明何时以及为何使用此许可证而非 Apache。
timeline.point: States that developer feedback is limited since the license's rationale is purely legal, and requests a developer-oriented FAQ explaining when and why to use this license instead of Apache.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Endorses the FAQ request and argues that OSI approval should require demonstrating a widespread need beyond the submitting organization's own needs, warning that licenses serving only their author are vanity licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 支持 FAQ 请求，主张 OSI 批准应要求证明许可证服务于超出提交组织自身需求的广泛 FOSS 社区，警告仅为作者自身需求的许可证是虚荣许可证。
timeline.point: Endorses the FAQ request and argues that OSI approval should require demonstrating a widespread need beyond the submitting organization's own needs, warning that licenses serving only their author are vanity licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Suggests reformulating the flow-down clause to follow standard practice: requiring license text inclusion or reference and an appropriate legal notice, citing GPLv3 as an example.
timeline.point_zh: 建议按照标准做法重新表述传递条款：要求随分发包含许可证全文或引用规范在线资源，并附加适当的法律声明，引用 GPLv3 作为范例。
timeline.point: Suggests reformulating the flow-down clause to follow standard practice: requiring license text inclusion or reference and an appropriate legal notice, citing GPLv3 as an example.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.2
timeline.snippet: Thanks for the feedback and announces that an updated version of the license incorporating discussed changes will be shared within the next few days.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢反馈，宣布将在几天内分享包含已讨论修改内容的更新版许可证。
timeline.point: Thanks for the feedback and announces that an updated version of the license incorporating discussed changes will be shared within the next few days.

timeline.point_zh: 提交 CAL——一种面向分布式系统的网络 copyleft 许可证，要求运营者向接收者提供其用户数据副本；在 CAL Beta 1 被拒后重写以回应先前关切。
timeline.point: Submitting the CAL, a new network copyleft license for distributed systems that requires operators to provide recipients with copies of their user data; reworked after CAL Beta 1's rejection to address the prior concerns.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 2)
timeline.snippet: Disagrees with Russell and Bruce's objections to CAL, but suggests that further discussion be moved to the license-discuss list.
timeline.point_zh: 不同意Russell和Bruce对CAL的反对意见，但建议将相关讨论转移到license-discuss列表。
timeline.point: Disagrees with Russell and Bruce's objections to CAL, but suggests that further discussion be moved to the license-discuss list.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 2)
timeline.snippet: Submits Russell and Bruce's objections to CAL Beta 2 to this list in the spirit of full disclosure, but does not recommend reopening those discussions.
timeline.point_zh: 出于全面披露的精神，将Russell和Bruce对CAL Beta 2的反对意见提交至本列表，但不建议重新开启那些讨论。
timeline.point: Submits Russell and Bruce's objections to CAL Beta 2 to this list in the spirit of full disclosure, but does not recommend reopening those discussions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 2)
timeline.snippet: Requests that discussion on whether CAL should be approved take place on the license-review list, since the license has been formally submitted for review.
timeline.point_zh: 要求关于CAL是否应被批准的讨论在license-review列表上进行，因为许可证已正式提交审批。
timeline.point: Requests that discussion on whether CAL should be approved take place on the license-review list, since the license has been formally submitted for review.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 2)
timeline.snippet: Finds the license looking really good overall and endorses the user-data clause as a natural copyleft extension, but asks developer-perspective questions about the Offer and Acceptance language, the technical/legal measures clauses, litigation termination, and choice of jurisdiction.
timeline.point_zh: 总体认为该许可证相当不错，并认可用户数据条款是 copyleft 的自然延伸；但从开发者角度就 Offer and Acceptance 条款、技术与法律措施条款、诉讼终止及管辖法院选择提出疑问。
timeline.point: Finds the license looking really good overall and endorses the user-data clause as a natural copyleft extension, but asks developer-perspective questions about the Offer and Acceptance language, the technical/legal measures clauses, litigation termination, and choice of jurisdiction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 2)
timeline.snippet: Answers the reviewer's questions: the Offer and Acceptance paragraph is enforceability legalese, private use within an organization is unrestricted, there is no government-action exemption need, and litigation termination stays limited to patent and trademark claims.
timeline.point_zh: 解答审查者疑问：Offer and Acceptance 段是关于可执行性的法律用语，组织内部私有使用不受限，无需政府行为豁免，诉讼终止条款仅限于专利与商标索赔。
timeline.point: Answers the reviewer's questions: the Offer and Acceptance paragraph is enforceability legalese, private use within an organization is unrestricted, there is no government-action exemption need, and litigation termination stays limited to patent and trademark claims.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 2)
timeline.snippet: Explains the Offer and Acceptance paragraph in contract-law terms: use of the Work constitutes acceptance and consideration, and IP-law enforcement plus third-party-beneficiary specific performance let recipients enforce the license.
timeline.point_zh: 从合同法角度解释 Offer and Acceptance 段：使用作品即构成承诺与对价，知识产权法执行与第三方受益人的实际履行请求权使接收者也能执行该许可证。
timeline.point: Explains the Offer and Acceptance paragraph in contract-law terms: use of the Work constitutes acceptance and consideration, and IP-law enforcement plus third-party-beneficiary specific performance let recipients enforce the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 2)
timeline.snippet: Accepts VanL's explanations of the 2.2 and 4.2.2 clauses, but raises a new question about Section 5.3: whether warranty suits should also trigger license termination, and confirms understanding of how the jurisdiction clause operates.
timeline.point_zh: 接受VanL对2.2和4.2.2条款的解释，但对5.3条款提出新疑问：保修诉讼是否也应触发许可终止，并确认管辖权条款的运作方式。
timeline.point: Accepts VanL's explanations of the 2.2 and 4.2.2 clauses, but raises a new question about Section 5.3: whether warranty suits should also trigger license termination, and confirms understanding of how the jurisdiction clause operates.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [PAUSE] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 2)
timeline.snippet: Requests pausing the discussion for a few days while the License Committee evaluates testing a different tool for the review process.
timeline.point_zh: 请求暂停讨论几天，以便许可委员会评估在审查流程中测试另一种工具。
timeline.point: Requests pausing the discussion for a few days while the License Committee evaluates testing a different tool for the review process.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 2)
timeline.snippet: Notifies the committee that a new review tool cannot be readied in time for CAL, so discussions will continue via email.
timeline.point_zh: 通知委员会无法及时准备好新工具来审查CAL许可证，将继续使用邮件列表进行讨论。
