timeline.snippet: Details drafting flaws: sections 2.2.1/2.4 circularly reference each other, 2.2.2's "with the exception" wording says the opposite of the intent, 2.3 conflicts with 7.2's non-sublicensability, the Public Performance definitions create ambiguity, and the GDPR reference is unnecessary.
timeline.point_zh: 指出文本多处缺陷：2.2.1 与 2.4 循环引用，2.2.2 措辞与原意相反，2.3 与 7.2 的不可分许可冲突，Public Performance 定义造成歧义，引用 GDPR 并无必要。
timeline.point: Details drafting flaws: sections 2.2.1/2.4 circularly reference each other, 2.2.2's "with the exception" wording says the opposite of the intent, 2.3 conflicts with 7.2's non-sublicensability, the Public Performance definitions create ambiguity, and the GDPR reference is unnecessary.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Agrees with Bruce Perens that the CAL's data portability provision is not analogous to GPLv3's anti-Tivoization clause, because anti-Tivoization relates to the right to modify code while CAL's data provision imposes a burden on non-developer users who only run the software.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 Bruce Perens 的观点，认为 CAL 的数据可携性条款与 GPLv3 的反 Tivoization 条款不类似，因为反 Tivoization 涉及修改代码的权利，而 CAL 的数据条款对仅运行软件的非开发者用户施加了负担。
timeline.point: Agrees with Bruce Perens that the CAL's data portability provision is not analogous to GPLv3's anti-Tivoization clause, because anti-Tivoization relates to the right to modify code while CAL's data provision imposes a burden on non-developer users who only run the software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether CAL intends to impose copyleft on software that merely replicates APIs (like Dalvik) even if written from scratch, and questions whether the license has copyleft effects on software that uses APIs.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 CAL 是否打算对仅复制 API（如 Dalvik）的软件施加 copyleft 要求（即使完全从头编写），并质疑该许可证对使用 API 的软件是否产生 copyleft 效果。
timeline.point: Asks whether CAL intends to impose copyleft on software that merely replicates APIs (like Dalvik) even if written from scratch, and questions whether the license has copyleft effects on software that uses APIs.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Questions how the CAL's "Public Performance" definition would apply under EU law, noting the absence of an equivalent right in EU copyright and wondering how EU courts would interpret it.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 CAL 中 "Public Performance" 定义在欧盟法律下的适用性，指出欧盟版权法中缺乏等效权利，并好奇欧盟法院会如何解读它。
timeline.point: Questions how the CAL's "Public Performance" definition would apply under EU law, noting the absence of an equivalent right in EU copyright and wondering how EU courts would interpret it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Explains that EU law has an equivalent concept called "communication to the public" under WIPO and the EU Copyright Directive, suggesting it could support CAL's public performance right. Advises against jurisdiction-specific terms but recommends referencing WIPO.
timeline.point_zh: 解释欧盟法律在 WIPO 条约和欧盟版权指令下有名为 "向公众传播" 的等效概念，认为它可以支持 CAL 的公开表演权。建议不要添加特定司法管辖区的条款，但推荐引用 WIPO 条约。
timeline.point: Explains that EU law has an equivalent concept called "communication to the public" under WIPO and the EU Copyright Directive, suggesting it could support CAL's public performance right. Advises against jurisdiction-specific terms but recommends referencing WIPO.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Confirms that software replicating APIs would need to be offered under CAL or a Compatible Open Source License, and that merely consuming APIs has no licensing implications under CAL.
timeline.point_zh: 确认复制 API 的软件需要在 CAL 或兼容开源许可证下提供，且仅使用 API 在 CAL 下不产生任何许可影响。
timeline.point: Confirms that software replicating APIs would need to be offered under CAL or a Compatible Open Source License, and that merely consuming APIs has no licensing implications under CAL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Summarizes CAL's architecture as requiring copyleft for API reimplementations and data portability, then asks whether CAL's public performance provision would survive if the Supreme Court rules APIs are not copyrightable.
timeline.point_zh: 将 CAL 的架构总结为要求 API 重新实现适用 copyleft 且数据可携带，然后询问如果最高法院裁定 API 不受版权保护，CAL 的公开表演权条款是否仍然有效。
timeline.point: Summarizes CAL's architecture as requiring copyleft for API reimplementations and data portability, then asks whether CAL's public performance provision would survive if the Supreme Court rules APIs are not copyrightable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Agrees AGPL alternatives are welcome, but argues applying "public performance" to software is uncharted and hazardous: the license never bounds the term, so it adds uncertainty with little practical value; also notes a DRM loophole that, however, is not an OSD violation.
timeline.point_zh: 认同需要 AGPL 的替代品，但认为将"公开表演"用于软件属未知且危险的领域：许可未界定该术语，徒增不确定性而实用价值有限；并指出一个 DRM 漏洞，但非违反 OSD。
timeline.point: Agrees AGPL alternatives are welcome, but argues applying "public performance" to software is uncharted and hazardous: the license never bounds the term, so it adds uncertainty with little practical value; also notes a DRM loophole that, however, is not an OSD violation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Objects that the license's assertion of copyright over APIs is a copyright-maximalist feature the OSI should not approve, warning that approval would hand Oracle lawyers evidence that a significant industry body endorses API copyrightability.
timeline.point_zh: 反对许可对 API 主张版权，称这是 OSI 不应批准的版权最大化特征；并警告一旦获批，Oracle 律师可借其证明重要行业机构支持 API 版权主张。
timeline.point: Objects that the license's assertion of copyright over APIs is a copyright-maximalist feature the OSI should not approve, warning that approval would hand Oracle lawyers evidence that a significant industry body endorses API copyrightability.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the objection is not whether public performance rights for software are legally possible, but that their practical use is untested (with unknown but potentially overly broad outcomes) and that open source communities should not pioneer new restrictive uses of copyright.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清反对意见并非关于软件公开表演权在法律上是否可行，而是其实际应用未经测试（结果未知但可能过于宽泛），且开源社区不应开创版权限制的新用法。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the objection is not whether public performance rights for software are legally possible, but that their practical use is untested (with unknown but potentially overly broad outcomes) and that open source communities should not pioneer new restrictive uses of copyright.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Confirms Pamela's summary of CAL's design, agrees the public performance provision would likely survive even if APIs were ruled non-copyrightable, and notes CAL also uses patent rights as a secondary enforcement mechanism.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 Pamela 对 CAL 设计的总结，同意即使 API 被裁定不受版权保护，公开表演权条款可能仍然有效，并指出 CAL 还将专利权作为辅助执行机制。
timeline.point: Confirms Pamela's summary of CAL's design, agrees the public performance provision would likely survive even if APIs were ruled non-copyrightable, and notes CAL also uses patent rights as a secondary enforcement mechanism.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Major concern: the first submitted license intentionally extends copyleft to API copyright — an "Oracle v. Google copyleft." OSD should reflect free-software policy against restrictive interface copyright; permissive treatment of APIs could be acceptable, copyleft requirements are not.
timeline.point_zh: 重大担忧：首个蓄意将 copyleft 扩展至 API 版权的许可证，即"Oracle v. Google copyleft"。OSD 应体现反对限制性接口版权的自由软件政策；宽松对待 API 可接受，copyleft 要求不可。
timeline.point: Major concern: the first submitted license intentionally extends copyleft to API copyright — an "Oracle v. Google copyleft." OSD should reflect free-software policy against restrictive interface copyright; permissive treatment of APIs could be acceptable, copyleft requirements are not.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Raises an ambiguity in the "Modified Work" definition, questioning whether "Publicly Performing" modifies only the interface clause or is an independent action alongside containing, combining with, and deriving from the Work.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 "Modified Work" 定义中的歧义，质疑 "Publicly Performing" 是仅修饰接口条款，还是与包含、结合、派生等行为并列的独立动作。
timeline.point: Raises an ambiguity in the "Modified Work" definition, questioning whether "Publicly Performing" modifies only the interface clause or is an independent action alongside containing, combining with, and deriving from the Work.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Confirms that under the SAS Institute v. World Programming Ltd. ruling in the EU, APIs are excluded from copyrightability even when using the same vocabulary, structure, and sequence, and notes this is now settled law.
timeline.point_zh: 确认根据欧盟 SAS Institute v. World Programming Ltd. 裁决，API 不具有可版权性，即使使用相同的词汇、结构和顺序，这已是确定法律。
timeline.point: Confirms that under the SAS Institute v. World Programming Ltd. ruling in the EU, APIs are excluded from copyrightability even when using the same vocabulary, structure, and sequence, and notes this is now settled law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Suggests Richard Fontana consider using the Oxford comma to clarify the ambiguous definition of Modified Work in CAL.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 Richard Fontana 考虑使用牛津逗号来澄清 CAL 中 Modified Work 定义的歧义。
timeline.point: Suggests Richard Fontana consider using the Oxford comma to clarify the ambiguous definition of Modified Work in CAL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Follows up on the EU law question, noting that the EU lacks a "public performance" concept and may apply "communication to the public" instead, but this creates further confusion as that concept is in the Infosec Directive rather than the Computer Program Directive.
timeline.point_zh: 跟进欧盟法律问题，指出欧盟缺乏 "public performance" 概念，可能适用 "communication to the public"，但这造成更多混淆，因为该概念在信息社会指令中而非计算机程序指令中。
timeline.point: Follows up on the EU law question, noting that the EU lacks a "public performance" concept and may apply "communication to the public" instead, but this creates further confusion as that concept is in the Infosec Directive rather than the Computer Program Directive.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Objects that the license treats making software interfaces available to the public as an exclusive copyright right, arguing software needs no new exclusive right and the claim could fuel FUD; urges revision to eliminate the public-performance implication.
timeline.point_zh: 反对许可将向公众提供软件接口视为排他性版权权利，认为软件不需要新的排他权利，此举只会助长 FUD；敦促修订以消除公开表演权的暗示。
timeline.point: Objects that the license treats making software interfaces available to the public as an exclusive copyright right, arguing software needs no new exclusive right and the claim could fuel FUD; urges revision to eliminate the public-performance implication.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues that copyright law for software is a shared resource and that the license should not be revised to imply a new exclusive public-performance right for software, since that would create FUD and impact everyone broadly.
timeline.point_zh: 主张软件著作权法是一种共享资源，许可证不应暗示为软件创设新的公开表演专有权，否则会制造不确定性并广泛影响他人。
timeline.point: Argues that copyright law for software is a shared resource and that the license should not be revised to imply a new exclusive public-performance right for software, since that would create FUD and impact everyone broadly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Reproduces Van's justification that software is copyrightable as a literary work, and notes continued confusion since AGPL went to significant lengths to synthesize a public performance right where none existed.
timeline.point_zh: 引用 Van 关于软件作为文学作品受版权保护的论证,并表示仍感困惑,因为 AGPL 曾费力构造出本不存在的公开表演权。
timeline.point: Reproduces Van's justification that software is copyrightable as a literary work, and notes continued confusion since AGPL went to significant lengths to synthesize a public performance right where none existed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Notes only that Van's earlier response was a reply to Bruce's own question about the public-performance right for software.
timeline.point_zh: 仅指出 Van 先前的回复是对 Bruce 关于软件公开表演权提问的回应。
timeline.point: Notes only that Van's earlier response was a reply to Bruce's own question about the public-performance right for software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Restates the unanswered question about whether a public-performance right for software exists under 17 USC 106(4)-(6), and observes that Van only addressed whether software is copyrightable rather than the performance right itself.
timeline.point_zh: 重申关于 17 USC 106(4)-(6) 是否存在软件公开表演权的问题，并指出 Van 仅回答了软件是否可受著作权保护，并未真正回应表演权本身。
timeline.point: Restates the unanswered question about whether a public-performance right for software exists under 17 USC 106(4)-(6), and observes that Van only addressed whether software is copyrightable rather than the performance right itself.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Points list members to a Berkeley law journal article (Sections III.C.6 and III.C.7) that discusses the public-performance-right question.
timeline.point_zh: 向列表成员推荐一篇伯克利法学期刊文章（第 III.C.6 与 III.C.7 节），其中讨论了公开表演权问题。
timeline.point: Points list members to a Berkeley law journal article (Sections III.C.6 and III.C.7) that discusses the public-performance-right question.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Cites Lothar Determann's analysis that executing code does not constitute a public performance under §106(4), and questions whether OSI should approve licenses asserting a public performance right for purposes other than requiring source publication.
timeline.point_zh: 引用 Lothar Determann 的分析:运行代码不构成 §106(4) 的公开表演,并质疑 OSI 是否应批准为源代码发布之外目的主张公开表演权的许可证。
timeline.point: Cites Lothar Determann's analysis that executing code does not constitute a public performance under §106(4), and questions whether OSI should approve licenses asserting a public performance right for purposes other than requiring source publication.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Notes for what it's worth that the license author thanks Bruce Perens for technical contributions, and cites a law journal article whose Sections III.C.6 & III.C.7 discuss the public performance question.
timeline.point_zh: 指出许可证作者在致谢中感谢 Bruce Perens 的技术贡献,并引用一篇法学期刊文章,其第 III.C.6 与 III.C.7 节讨论了公开表演权问题。
timeline.point: Notes for what it's worth that the license author thanks Bruce Perens for technical contributions, and cites a law journal article whose Sections III.C.6 & III.C.7 discuss the public performance question.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that his contribution to the cited article concerned technical details like ephemeral copies in a processor, not legal analysis, and adds a wry personal remark.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清自己在所引文章中仅负责处理器中临时副本等技术细节而非法律分析，并附一句个人感慨。
timeline.point: Clarifies that his contribution to the cited article concerned technical details like ephemeral copies in a processor, not legal analysis, and adds a wry personal remark.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Asks which OSD clause CAL's public performance provision actually fails, arguing it exercises no rights beyond copyright law and makes more software open source, and objects that the OSI approval process has become unpredictable.
timeline.point_zh: 质问 CAL 公开表演条款究竟违反 OSD 哪一条,认为其未超出版权法且能增加开源软件,并批评 OSI 审批过程难以预测。
timeline.point: Asks which OSD clause CAL's public performance provision actually fails, arguing it exercises no rights beyond copyright law and makes more software open source, and objects that the OSI approval process has become unpredictable.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Defends OSI's flexibility: it deliberately weighs the Open Source community's interest rather than mechanically applying pseudo-law, and would lose legitimacy if it stopped doing so.
timeline.point_zh: 为 OSI 的灵活性辩护：其刻意权衡开源社区利益而非机械套用伪法律，若不再如此便会失去社区信任。
timeline.point: Defends OSI's flexibility: it deliberately weighs the Open Source community's interest rather than mechanically applying pseudo-law, and would lose legitimacy if it stopped doing so.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues that public-performance terms are inherently use restrictions incompatible with OSD #6, because allowing use in some contexts but not others constitutes a field-of-endeavor restriction.
timeline.point_zh: 主张公开表演条款本质上是使用限制，与 OSD 第 6 条不相容，因为允许在某些情境使用而禁止在其他情境使用即构成领域歧视。
timeline.point: Argues that public-performance terms are inherently use restrictions incompatible with OSD #6, because allowing use in some contexts but not others constitutes a field-of-endeavor restriction.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Disputes that the CAL exercises only copyright rights, arguing the data-sharing terms are contractual compulsions going far beyond traditional open-source obligations.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 CAL 仅行使著作权的主张，认为数据共享条款属于合同性强制，远超传统开源许可证的义务范围。
timeline.point: Disputes that the CAL exercises only copyright rights, arguing the data-sharing terms are contractual compulsions going far beyond traditional open-source obligations.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Updates the CAL draft with a Combined Work Exception so it can function like MPL's per-file licensing or the LGPL, and clarifies the anti-DMCA clause, automatic reinstatement clause, and GDPR-alignment provision in response to feedback.
timeline.point_zh: 修订 CAL 草案,新增“Combined Work Exception”使其可按 MPL 每文件或 LGPL 方式运作,并回应反馈澄清反 DMCA 条款、自动恢复条款及对接 GDPR 条款的原意。
timeline.point: Updates the CAL draft with a Combined Work Exception so it can function like MPL's per-file licensing or the LGPL, and clarifies the anti-DMCA clause, automatic reinstatement clause, and GDPR-alignment provision in response to feedback.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues CAL forces source distribution and license restrictions on independent API re-implementers, violating OSD 5 and 6 (and the spirit of OSD 9) and software freedom; also questions what publicly performing an API could even mean.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CAL 强制 API 独立重实现者发布源码并限制许可证选择,违反 OSD 5、6 及 OSD 9 精神和软件自由,并质疑“公开表演”API 的含义。
timeline.point: Argues CAL forces source distribution and license restrictions on independent API re-implementers, violating OSD 5 and 6 (and the spirit of OSD 9) and software freedom; also questions what publicly performing an API could even mean.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues CAL's copyright reach is no different from the GPL's if APIs are copyrightable, and its copyleft effect mirrors the AGPL/GPL; asks where the boundary and tipping point for network copyleft lie, and worries how the public performance right will be interpreted outside the US.
timeline.point_zh: 认为若 API 受版权保护，CAL 的覆盖范围与 GPL 无异，copyleft 效应也与 AGPL/GPL 相同；追问网络 copyleft 的边界与临界点何在，并担忧公开表演权在美国之外如何解释。
timeline.point: Argues CAL's copyright reach is no different from the GPL's if APIs are copyrightable, and its copyleft effect mirrors the AGPL/GPL; asks where the boundary and tipping point for network copyleft lie, and worries how the public performance right will be interpreted outside the US.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues network-copyright proposals like the CAL change the fundamental deal of Open Source and that approving them is a slippery slope to worse licenses; warns OSI should guard its imprimatur rather than approve a license unlikely to be used except by Van's customer.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CAL 等网络版权许可改变了开源的根本约定，批准将招致更多更差许可的滑坡；警告 OSI 应守护自身公信力，不应因危害有限而批准。
timeline.point: Argues network-copyright proposals like the CAL change the fundamental deal of Open Source and that approving them is a slippery slope to worse licenses; warns OSI should guard its imprimatur rather than approve a license unlikely to be used except by Van's customer.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues that Oracle v. Google has already fundamentally changed open-source law (making API re-implementations derivative works) and that the CAL merely reflects the legal reality that makes such licenses necessary.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 Oracle v. Google 已根本性改变开源法律（使 API 再实现成为演绎作品），CAL 只是反映了使此类许可证成为必要的法律现实。
timeline.point: Argues that Oracle v. Google has already fundamentally changed open-source law (making API re-implementations derivative works) and that the CAL merely reflects the legal reality that makes such licenses necessary.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Cautions Van not to concede the API-copyright fight prematurely by pushing for OSI approval, since only one court decision exists and the Supreme Court has not yet ruled.
timeline.point_zh: 告诫 Van 不要在 API 著作权之争尚未定论时就推动 OSI 批准，目前仅有一项法院判决，最高法院态度未明，提前批准无异于不战而降。
timeline.point: Cautions Van not to concede the API-copyright fight prematurely by pushing for OSI approval, since only one court decision exists and the Supreme Court has not yet ruled.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues the CAL's API-plus-public-performance approach is needed because AGPL's network hook is ambiguous and ineffective, whereas public performance is intelligible, has analogous case law, and rests on reserved copyright rights.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 CAL 采用 API 加公开表演的方式是必要的，因为 AGPL 的网络钩子模糊且效果有限，而公开表演概念清晰、有类推判例并扎根于著作权保留权利。
timeline.point: Argues the CAL's API-plus-public-performance approach is needed because AGPL's network hook is ambiguous and ineffective, whereas public performance is intelligible, has analogous case law, and rests on reserved copyright rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Sarcastically remarks that lawyers all agree with each other, so courts would be unnecessary — mocking the certainty of the legal analysis offered.
timeline.point_zh: 讽刺地表示律师们彼此总能达成一致，因而无需法院裁决——以此调侃对方法律分析的确信态度。
timeline.point: Sarcastically remarks that lawyers all agree with each other, so courts would be unnecessary — mocking the certainty of the legal analysis offered.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Asks Van why a public-performance right is necessary at all, given the risk of extending copyleft beyond current and Supreme-Court-set boundaries.
timeline.point_zh: 质问 Van 既然存在扩大 copyleft 范围乃至超出最高法院未来划定边界的风险，为何仍需引入公开表演权。
timeline.point: Asks Van why a public-performance right is necessary at all, given the risk of extending copyleft beyond current and Supreme-Court-set boundaries.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues software does not 'perform' a work under US copyright law by interoperating over a network, and that CAL's new exclusive right over making interfaces publicly available is contrary to FOSS interests and impedes interoperability; OSI should weigh the implications of endorsing such a right.
timeline.point_zh: 认为软件互操作不构成美国版权法上的'表演'，CAL 新增的公开接口专有权不利自由开源软件、妨碍互操作，OSI 应审慎考虑背书此类权利的影响。
timeline.point: Argues software does not 'perform' a work under US copyright law by interoperating over a network, and that CAL's new exclusive right over making interfaces publicly available is contrary to FOSS interests and impedes interoperability; OSI should weigh the implications of endorsing such a right.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues the FSF would disavow extending GPL copyleft to API copyright, and states his current view that no FOSS license should extend copyleft to interfaces — future licenses should clarify the opposite.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 FSF 会否定将 GPL copyleft 扩展至 API 著作权的解释，并认为任何 FOSS 许可证都不应将 copyleft 延伸至接口，未来许可证反而应明确排除。
timeline.point: Argues the FSF would disavow extending GPL copyleft to API copyright, and states his current view that no FOSS license should extend copyleft to interfaces — future licenses should clarify the opposite.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that software as a literary work carries a public-performance right under 17 USC 106(4), but maintains the narrower point that making an interface available or interoperating is not a statutory "performance".
timeline.point_zh: 承认软件作为文字作品依 17 USC 106(4) 确实附带公开表演权，但坚持更狭窄的观点：提供接口或互操作并不属于著作权法意义上的"表演"。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that software as a literary work carries a public-performance right under 17 USC 106(4), but maintains the narrower point that making an interface available or interoperating is not a statutory "performance".

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Defends the CAL's public performance provision, citing 17 U.S.C. § 101 and the Lehman task-force report to argue that network-transmitted APIs make the work perceptible within existing copyright doctrine, and that the license is inventing nothing new.
timeline.point_zh: 援引 17 U.S.C. §101 与 Lehman 报告为 CAL 的公开表演条款辩护，称经网络传输的 API 使作品'可感知'、未超出既有版权理论，许可证并无新造内容。
timeline.point: Defends the CAL's public performance provision, citing 17 U.S.C. § 101 and the Lehman task-force report to argue that network-transmitted APIs make the work perceptible within existing copyright doctrine, and that the license is inventing nothing new.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Agrees with Pamela's assumption but predicts OSI will reject it, adding that the rejection should be unsurprising to anyone experienced enough to submit a license given the community's opposition to expanding copyright restrictions.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 Pamela 的假设，但预言 OSI 会拒绝该主张；并认为鉴于开源社区反对扩大软件著作权限制的立场，这一结果对任何有经验的提交者都不应意外。
timeline.point: Agrees with Pamela's assumption but predicts OSI will reject it, adding that the rejection should be unsurprising to anyone experienced enough to submit a license given the community's opposition to expanding copyright restrictions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Takes exception to the blanket policy against network copyleft, arguing SaaS vendors are today's proprietary vendors and new copyleft licenses are as warranted as the GPL was; still concedes the CAL oversteps and rejection is justified, hoping a scaled-down version can be approved eventually.
timeline.point_zh: 反对全盘否定网络 copyleft 的立场，认为 SaaS 厂商如昔日专有软件商、新 copyleft 有其必要；但承认 CAL 确有越界、拒绝有理，期望日后批准缩减版。
timeline.point: Takes exception to the blanket policy against network copyleft, arguing SaaS vendors are today's proprietary vendors and new copyleft licenses are as warranted as the GPL was; still concedes the CAL oversteps and rejection is justified, hoping a scaled-down version can be approved eventually.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Counters Henrik by arguing most of the community would be fine if OSI stopped approving new licenses, citing FSF's sparing license portfolio as an uncriticized model.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 Henrik，认为社区大多数人并不介意 OSI 停止批准新许可证，并以 FSF 仅维护少量许可证且鲜受批评作为例证。
timeline.point: Counters Henrik by arguing most of the community would be fine if OSI stopped approving new licenses, citing FSF's sparing license portfolio as an uncriticized model.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Sections 2.2.2 and 2.3 are unintelligible generalizations of GPLv3 language, and the GDPR-specific provision violates OSD 6 by granting special permission only to GDPR-bound parties; make the section non-specific to any legal regime.
timeline.point_zh: 2.2.2与2.3节是对GPLv3语言的费解泛化，GDPR专门条款只给受GDPR约束方特殊许可，明显违反OSD 6；应改为不针对任何特定法律制度。
timeline.point: Sections 2.2.2 and 2.3 are unintelligible generalizations of GPLv3 language, and the GDPR-specific provision violates OSD 6 by granting special permission only to GDPR-bound parties; make the section non-specific to any legal regime.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Presses Van to respond, sharing Bruce's concern that CAL Section 2.3 falls outside the scope of open-source licenses and rejecting the analogy to anti-Tivoization.
timeline.point_zh: 敦促 Van 回应，表示认同 Bruce 的担忧——CAL 第 2.3 条超出开源许可证范畴，并拒绝接受其与反 Tivoization 相类比的论证。
timeline.point: Presses Van to respond, sharing Bruce's concern that CAL Section 2.3 falls outside the scope of open-source licenses and rejecting the analogy to anti-Tivoization.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Responds to review concerns: makes 2.2.2 language parallel, simplifies 2.3, explains its GPLv3 anti-TPM parallels, clarifies the GDPR clause streamlines compliance rather than granting special permission, and considers deleting interpretive 7.1.1 as more confusing than helpful.
timeline.point_zh: 回应审查意见：统一 2.2.2 措辞、简化 2.3，说明其与 GPLv3 反技术措施条款的对应，澄清 GDPR 条款旨在衔接执行机制而非特殊豁免，并考虑删除解释性的 7.1.1。
timeline.point: Responds to review concerns: makes 2.2.2 language parallel, simplifies 2.3, explains its GPLv3 anti-TPM parallels, clarifies the GDPR clause streamlines compliance rather than granting special permission, and considers deleting interpretive 7.1.1 as more confusing than helpful.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Defends CAL 2.3(c) as an anti-Tivoization measure for cryptographically authenticated distributed systems, and argues 2.3(b)'s User Data clause follows from Freedom 0 — data portability is necessary to run the program as one wishes.
timeline.point_zh: 为 CAL 2.3(c) 辩护，称其为针对加密认证分布式系统的反 Tivoization 条款；并论证 2.3(b) 用户数据条款源于自由之零——数据可移植性是实现"任意目的运行程序"的必要条件。
timeline.point: Defends CAL 2.3(c) as an anti-Tivoization measure for cryptographically authenticated distributed systems, and argues 2.3(b)'s User Data clause follows from Freedom 0 — data portability is necessary to run the program as one wishes.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues the Modified Work definition should strike 'an interface' so the source-code obligation triggers only for works publicly performing an interface; questions the GDPR compliance clause, suggesting removal or clarification if privacy laws could conflict with sections 2.3(a)-(b).
timeline.point_zh: 认为 Modified Work 定义应删去 'an interface'，源码义务仅在涉及 Public Performance 接口时触发；质疑 GDPR 合规条款，若隐私法可能与 2.3(a)、 冲突，建议删除或澄清。
timeline.point: Argues the Modified Work definition should strike 'an interface' so the source-code obligation triggers only for works publicly performing an interface; questions the GDPR compliance clause, suggesting removal or clarification if privacy laws could conflict with sections 2.3(a)-(b).

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Apologizes for slow engagement and accepts Pam's fix, proposing to swap "an interface" for "elements of" while asking whether wording is still needed to indicate the entire original work need not be present in a modified work.
timeline.point_zh: 为回复迟缓致歉，接受 Pam 的修改建议，拟将"an interface"改为"elements of"，同时询问是否仍需措辞表明修改作品中不必包含原作品的全部。
timeline.point: Apologizes for slow engagement and accepts Pam's fix, proposing to swap "an interface" for "elements of" while asking whether wording is still needed to indicate the entire original work need not be present in a modified work.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Rejects Van's Freedom-0 rationale for data portability, arguing data-handover obligations belong in law rather than open-source licenses and that the "unable to run unless" framing invites endless absurd requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 Van 以自由之零论证数据可移植性的逻辑，认为数据移交义务应属法律而非开源许可证范畴，并以"除非……否则无法运行"的框架会引出无数荒谬要求作为反讽。
timeline.point: Rejects Van's Freedom-0 rationale for data portability, arguing data-handover obligations belong in law rather than open-source licenses and that the "unable to run unless" framing invites endless absurd requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Agrees that "elements of" works as a replacement for "an interface" in the Modified Work definition and is not narrowing.
timeline.point_zh: 同意以"elements of"替代"an interface"用于 Modified Work 定义，且认为该措辞不会收窄范围。
timeline.point: Agrees that "elements of" works as a replacement for "an interface" in the Modified Work definition and is not narrowing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Asks Van why a public-performance trigger is necessary given its unpredictable non-US application and risk of expanding copyright scope, and suggests using a GPLv3-style "propagate" trigger as a less expansive alternative.
timeline.point_zh: 质问 Van 鉴于公开表演概念在美国以外适用不可预测且有扩大著作权范围之嫌，为何仍需采用；建议改用 GPLv3 式的"propagate"触发机制作为更不具扩张性的替代方案。
timeline.point: Asks Van why a public-performance trigger is necessary given its unpredictable non-US application and risk of expanding copyright scope, and suggests using a GPLv3-style "propagate" trigger as a less expansive alternative.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Defends the CAL's use of 'public performance' over GPLv3's 'propagate' with five counterarguments: explicitness about network action, an in-license defined term, patent hooks in addition to copyright, reuse of established terminology, and the 7.1.2 carve-out limiting scope to IP rights.
timeline.point_zh: 为 CAL 使用 'public performance' 而非 GPLv3 的 'propagate' 辩护：显式界定网络行为、以许可证内定义术语支撑、兼具专利抓手、沿用既有术语，且 7.1.2 将范围限于知识产权。
timeline.point: Defends the CAL's use of 'public performance' over GPLv3's 'propagate' with five counterarguments: explicitness about network action, an in-license defined term, patent hooks in addition to copyright, reuse of established terminology, and the 7.1.2 carve-out limiting scope to IP rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the CAL can only be fully effective when issued patents cover portions of the work using it, given Van's statement that patents are one enforcement hook.
timeline.point_zh: 鉴于 Van 称专利为执法钩子之一，询问 CAL 是否只有在相关作品存在已授权专利时才能完全生效。
timeline.point: Asks whether the CAL can only be fully effective when issued patents cover portions of the work using it, given Van's statement that patents are one enforcement hook.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Explains that the CAL operates through three alternative hooks — copyright, patent, and contract — and that using patent verbs keeps enforcement consistent even without issued patents, because software's functional and expressive aspects are intertwined.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 CAL 通过著作权、专利与合同三种并行机制发挥作用，采用专利性动词可在无已授权专利时仍保持执法一致性，因为软件的功能性与表达性彼此交织。
timeline.point: Explains that the CAL operates through three alternative hooks — copyright, patent, and contract — and that using patent verbs keeps enforcement consistent even without issued patents, because software's functional and expressive aspects are intertwined.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Poses a hypothetical about a CAL-licensed website storefront to ask whether the license would trigger source-code disclosure obligations when a user orders a gift for a third party (their daughter).
timeline.point_zh: 提出一个使用 CAL 授权的网站商店假设，询问当用户为第三方（其女儿）订购礼物时，许可证是否会触发源代码披露义务。
timeline.point: Poses a hypothetical about a CAL-licensed website storefront to ask whether the license would trigger source-code disclosure obligations when a user orders a gift for a third party (their daughter).

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Confirms that a CAL-licensed website operator must provide both the application source code and the user's order data, correcting whose User Data applies, and notes this mirrors how AGPL web apps like OwnCloud and ProcessMaker handle source availability in practice.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 CAL 授权的网站运营者须提供源码和用户的订单数据，并澄清 User Data 归属，指出这类似于 OwnCloud、ProcessMaker 等 AGPL 应用的实际做法。
timeline.point: Confirms that a CAL-licensed website operator must provide both the application source code and the user's order data, correcting whose User Data applies, and notes this mirrors how AGPL web apps like OwnCloud and ProcessMaker handle source availability in practice.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Presses for specifics about blockchain use, asking via an Anna/Betty hypothetical what Betty must disclose to Anna, and flags concern that the Source Code definition appears to include cryptographic keys used to process user data.
timeline.point_zh: 针对区块链使用场景追问细节，通过 Anna/Betty 假设询问 Betty 必须向 Anna 披露什么，并指出源代码定义似乎涵盖了用于处理用户数据的加密密钥。
timeline.point: Presses for specifics about blockchain use, asking via an Anna/Betty hypothetical what Betty must disclose to Anna, and flags concern that the Source Code definition appears to include cryptographic keys used to process user data.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Asks for confirmation that the license does not bind the copyright holder, arguing that the CAL's apparent secret-key disclosure requirement would destroy blockchain trust and is therefore impractical for licensees.
timeline.point_zh: 请求确认许可证不约束著作权人，并指出 CAL 似乎要求的密钥披露义务会破坏区块链信任，因此对被许可方而言不可行。
timeline.point: Asks for confirmation that the license does not bind the copyright holder, arguing that the CAL's apparent secret-key disclosure requirement would destroy blockchain trust and is therefore impractical for licensees.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Walks through a blockchain scenario showing the CAL obligates a Recipient to return only the User Data the requester itself provided — not derivative data or encryption keys — and defends the Source Code definition's key language as analogous to GPLv3's corresponding-source requirement.
timeline.point_zh: 通过区块链示例说明 CAL 下 Recipient 只需返还请求方自己提供的 User Data，无需交付衍生数据或密钥，并将 Source Code 定义类比为 GPLv3 的完整对应源代码要求。
timeline.point: Walks through a blockchain scenario showing the CAL obligates a Recipient to return only the User Data the requester itself provided — not derivative data or encryption keys — and defends the Source Code definition's key language as analogous to GPLv3's corresponding-source requirement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Asserts that the CAL is compatible with blockchain use and grants no party a privileged position, referring back to a prior answer for clarification.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 CAL 与区块链使用兼容，且不赋予任何一方特权地位，并指引参见之前的回答以澄清问题。
timeline.point: Asserts that the CAL is compatible with blockchain use and grants no party a privileged position, referring back to a prior answer for clarification.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Questions whether the CAL's cryptographic-keys and user-data language is sufficiently selective, arguing the Source Code definition arguably requires providing keys needed to process user data, and asks how obligations apply when blockchain participants perform the work to one another.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 CAL 中 cryptographic keys 与 user data 的措辞不够精确，认为 Source Code 定义可能被解读为要求交出处理用户数据所需的密钥，并追问区块链各方互相 perform 时的义务范围。
timeline.point: Questions whether the CAL's cryptographic-keys and user-data language is sufficiently selective, arguing the Source Code definition arguably requires providing keys needed to process user data, and asks how obligations apply when blockchain participants perform the work to one another.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Rebuts the blockchain hypo: a Recipient owes source code and their own User Data, never another party's keys or modified data; denies any 'data hoarder' privilege in the license and says the keys provision is being misread by selectively recombining the sentence.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳区块链假设：Recipient 只需提供源代码及其自己的 User Data，而非他人密钥或修改后的数据；否认许可中存在“数据囤积者”特权，并称对方在断章取义重拼句子。
timeline.point: Rebuts the blockchain hypo: a Recipient owes source code and their own User Data, never another party's keys or modified data; denies any 'data hoarder' privilege in the license and says the keys provision is being misread by selectively recombining the sentence.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the CAL's data-release terms violate FSF Freedom Zero and the OSD by restricting the user's ability to run the program for any purpose, and notes additional objections to the license.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 CAL 的数据披露条款违反了 FSF 自由之零和 OSD，限制了用户为任意目的运行程序的自由，并指出对该许可证的其他反对意见。
timeline.point: Argues that the CAL's data-release terms violate FSF Freedom Zero and the OSD by restricting the user's ability to run the program for any purpose, and notes additional objections to the license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues the CAL's data-disclosure terms target centralized operators despite Holochain's decentralization, and that multiple competent attorneys find the license unclear or unlawful, so courts and developers won't read it as the drafter does.
timeline.point_zh: 认为CAL的数据披露条款针对中心化运营者，与Holochain的去中心化定位相悖；多位胜任律师认为该许可不清晰或违法，法院和开发者不会按起草者意图解读。
timeline.point: Argues the CAL's data-disclosure terms target centralized operators despite Holochain's decentralization, and that multiple competent attorneys find the license unclear or unlawful, so courts and developers won't read it as the drafter does.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Defends the CAL as continuing the Free Software tradition of countering centralization — here of data hoarding — arguing it does not restrict Freedom Zero, and summarizes its effect: anyone the software is made available to must receive the license, the source code, and their own data.
timeline.point_zh: 将 CAL 定位为自由软件传统的延续——以对抗数据“囤积”的中心化——辩称其不限制 Freedom Zero，并概括：向他人提供软件时须一并交付许可证、源代码和该用户自己的数据。
timeline.point: Defends the CAL as continuing the Free Software tradition of countering centralization — here of data hoarding — arguing it does not restrict Freedom Zero, and summarizes its effect: anyone the software is made available to must receive the license, the source code, and their own data.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the CAL arbitrarily redefines FSF Software Freedom to include data rights, doing so at the expense of others' classical Freedom Zero, and illustrates with a reductio about adding hardware rights.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 CAL 武断地将 FSF 软件自由重新定义为包含数据权利，并以此牺牲他人经典意义下的自由之零，同时以添加硬件权利的归谬法加以说明。
timeline.point: Argues that the CAL arbitrarily redefines FSF Software Freedom to include data rights, doing so at the expense of others' classical Freedom Zero, and illustrates with a reductio about adding hardware rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Objects that the CAL is unsympathetic to ordinary developers, arguing it is harder to parse than the GPL even with attorney assistance, and rewrites the summary from a non-expert user's perspective to highlight the compliance burden.
timeline.point_zh: 反对称 CAL 对普通开发者缺乏同理心，认为即便有律师协助也比 GPL 更难理解，并以非专家用户视角重写摘要以凸显合规负担。
timeline.point: Objects that the CAL is unsympathetic to ordinary developers, arguing it is harder to parse than the GPL even with attorney assistance, and rewrites the summary from a non-expert user's perspective to highlight the compliance burden.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Defends the CAL as enabling user Freedom within the Free Software tradition, states he has asked the FSF to review it, and frames the core question for the board as whether open source may include licenses that impose data-access duties on operators.
timeline.point_zh: 为 CAL 辩护，称其在自由软件传统内赋予用户自由，表示已邀请 FSF 审阅，并将核心问题归纳为：开源是否可涵盖对运营者施加数据访问义务的许可证。
timeline.point: Defends the CAL as enabling user Freedom within the Free Software tradition, states he has asked the FSF to review it, and frames the core question for the board as whether open source may include licenses that impose data-access duties on operators.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues the CAL enables vendor lock-in because modified forms of user data need not be returned, states he is disinclined to extend copyleft further, and says Bruce's concern remains unaddressed: operators may owe data the software makes very difficult to extract.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CAL 因不要求返还修改后的数据而助长厂商锁定，表示不愿再扩展 copyleft，并指出 Bruce 的担忧未被回应：软件难以导出数据时运营者仍须履行返还义务。
timeline.point: Argues the CAL enables vendor lock-in because modified forms of user data need not be returned, states he is disinclined to extend copyleft further, and says Bruce's concern remains unaddressed: operators may owe data the software makes very difficult to extract.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the CAL enforces portability only for data that is input/output of the software in which the user has an ownership or possessory interest, distinguishing the denoised-photos case from the blockchain-block case.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 CAL 仅对作为软件输入/输出且用户对其享有所有权或占有利益的数据强制可携，并区分了去噪照片的情形与区块链区块的情形。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the CAL enforces portability only for data that is input/output of the software in which the user has an ownership or possessory interest, distinguishing the denoised-photos case from the blockchain-block case.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Treats Bruce's prior message as overstatement and notes that GPL compliance still has debated corner cases, countering the claim that the GPL is uncomplicated.
timeline.point_zh: 将 Bruce 之前的邮件视为夸张表述，并指出 GPL 合规仍存在争议性的边缘案例，以此反驳 GPL 毫不复杂的说法。
timeline.point: Treats Bruce's prior message as overstatement and notes that GPL compliance still has debated corner cases, countering the claim that the GPL is uncomplicated.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Asks how an operator distinguishes ownership interest from a mere license to use when returning data, raising edge cases like community property, and argues the CAL is problematic for everyone but the original developer because hard-to-access data makes good-faith compliance difficult.
timeline.point_zh: 追问运营者如何区分所有权利益与单纯的使用许可，并提出夫妻共同财产等边界情形；认为 CAL 除原作者外对所有人都成问题，数据难以访问使善意合规也很困难。
timeline.point: Asks how an operator distinguishes ownership interest from a mere license to use when returning data, raising edge cases like community property, and argues the CAL is problematic for everyone but the original developer because hard-to-access data makes good-faith compliance difficult.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Rejects the sarcasm charge, insists the prior message realistically depicted impossible compliance for non-experts, and argues the GPL has a confident non-lawyer community whereas the CAL does not, nor does it comply with either existing definition of Free Software/Open Source.
timeline.point_zh: 否认嘲讽指控，坚称之前的邮件真实描绘了非专家面临的不可实现合规，并指出 GPL 拥有自信的非律师社区而 CAL 没有，且 CAL 不符合现有任一定义。
timeline.point: Rejects the sarcasm charge, insists the prior message realistically depicted impossible compliance for non-experts, and argues the GPL has a confident non-lawyer community whereas the CAL does not, nor does it comply with either existing definition of Free Software/Open Source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Explains that in practice data requests amount to downloading one's own uploads, that claimants must demonstrate lawful interest for more, that a spouse is not a Recipient, and that difficult access does not excuse non-compliance, mostly applicable in the SaaS context.
timeline.point_zh: 解释实践中数据请求通常等同于下载本人上传的内容，索取更多需证明合法利益，配偶并非接收者，且访问困难不免除合规义务，该条款主要适用于 SaaS 场景。
timeline.point: Explains that in practice data requests amount to downloading one's own uploads, that claimants must demonstrate lawful interest for more, that a spouse is not a Recipient, and that difficult access does not excuse non-compliance, mostly applicable in the SaaS context.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Reiterates the one-sentence CAL summary, enumerates the three points of fundamental disagreement with Bruce, and suggests the debate has reached an impasse of competing beliefs.
timeline.point_zh: 重申 CAL 的一句式概括，列举与 Bruce 的三项根本分歧，并指出讨论已陷入信念之争的僵局。
timeline.point: Reiterates the one-sentence CAL summary, enumerates the three points of fundamental disagreement with Bruce, and suggests the debate has reached an impasse of competing beliefs.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Concedes Holochain compliance might be satisfied by distributing the blockchain, but argues the CAL offers no guarantee of the technical and legal compliance burden for other software, and objects that difficult-to-access data would not excuse non-compliance.
timeline.point_zh: 承认 Holochain 或可通过分发整条区块链满足合规，但认为 CAL 无法保证其他软件的合规技术与法律负担，并反对“数据难以提取不能免除合规”的立场。
timeline.point: Concedes Holochain compliance might be satisfied by distributing the blockchain, but argues the CAL offers no guarantee of the technical and legal compliance burden for other software, and objects that difficult-to-access data would not excuse non-compliance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues that Holochain and similar peer-to-peer users are themselves providing network services and cannot afford legal help, so the CAL's summary wrongly assumes a SaaS operator context.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 Holochain 及类似的点对点用户本身即在提供网络服务且无力承担法律咨询，因此 CAL 的概括错误地假定了 SaaS 运营者场景。
timeline.point: Argues that Holochain and similar peer-to-peer users are themselves providing network services and cannot afford legal help, so the CAL's summary wrongly assumes a SaaS operator context.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Counters that the discussion is not circular because Freedom Zero and peer-to-peer impacts have just been raised, and reaffirms that lawyers disagree on public performance, that data lockdown is core to Free Software, and that the CAL is too complex for non-lawyers.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳讨论并非原地打转，因为自由之零与点对点影响刚刚提出，并重申律师对公开表演存在分歧、数据封锁是自由软件核心、CAL 对非律师过于复杂。
timeline.point: Counters that the discussion is not circular because Freedom Zero and peer-to-peer impacts have just been raised, and reaffirms that lawyers disagree on public performance, that data lockdown is core to Free Software, and that the CAL is too complex for non-lawyers.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Expresses his vote against approval of the CAL, arguing the public-performance grant has little relevance to ordinary program execution and that the license's application to data is troubling because data itself is not copyrightable and should be free.
timeline.point_zh: 明确表示对 CAL 投反对票：public performance 授权与通常的程序执行关系不大，且该许可证适用于数据令人不安，因为数据本身不受版权保护、本应自由。
timeline.point: Expresses his vote against approval of the CAL, arguing the public-performance grant has little relevance to ordinary program execution and that the license's application to data is troubling because data itself is not copyrightable and should be free.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Corrects his earlier citations to OSL 3.0 §§1(d) and 1(e) while reiterating his vote against CAL approval.
timeline.point_zh: 更正前文引用为 OSL 3.0 §§1(d) 和 1(e)，同时重申对 CAL 的反对立场。
timeline.point: Corrects his earlier citations to OSL 3.0 §§1(d) and 1(e) while reiterating his vote against CAL approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Responds that the CAL has an explicit defined term tying public performance to API availability, and that data portability does not depend on the copyrightability of data; hopes the board will disagree with Larry's concerns.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称 CAL 有明确定义将公开表演与 API 可用性挂钩，且数据可携性不取决于数据是否受著作权保护；希望董事会与 Larry 的担忧意见相左。
timeline.point: Responds that the CAL has an explicit defined term tying public performance to API availability, and that data portability does not depend on the copyrightability of data; hopes the board will disagree with Larry's concerns.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Counters Bruce's framing by arguing that while the "right" to commit crimes is not core to the OSD, using FOSS licensing to prevent crimes is also a very bad idea.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 Bruce 的论调，主张虽然"犯罪的权利"并非 OSD 核心，但利用 FOSS 许可证来阻止犯罪同样是极糟的主意。
timeline.point: Counters Bruce's framing by arguing that while the "right" to commit crimes is not core to the OSD, using FOSS licensing to prevent crimes is also a very bad idea.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges John Cowan's point that virtues in excess become vices, while gently noting that the same things in moderation can benefit all.
timeline.point_zh: 认可 John Cowan 关于美德走向极端即成恶习的观点，同时委婉指出同样的事物适度时亦能造福众人。
timeline.point: Acknowledges John Cowan's point that virtues in excess become vices, while gently noting that the same things in moderation can benefit all.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: As an OSI director, acknowledges that Bruce's opinions have been noted.
timeline.point_zh: 作为 OSI 董事，表示 Bruce 的意见已获知悉。
timeline.point: As an OSI director, acknowledges that Bruce's opinions have been noted.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Objects to the complexity complaint against the CAL, presenting readability data showing it scores close to (A)GPLv3, and argues no principled complexity line separates it from the GPL family — if the board would reject on that basis, it should say so explicitly.
timeline.point_zh: 反驳 CAL 过于复杂的批评，援引可读性数据称其与 (A)GPLv3 相当，认为在复杂度上无法与 GPL 家族划出原则性界线，并要求董事会若以此为拒批理由应明示。
timeline.point: Objects to the complexity complaint against the CAL, presenting readability data showing it scores close to (A)GPLv3, and argues no principled complexity line separates it from the GPL family — if the board would reject on that basis, it should say so explicitly.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Recommends the Eric Frank Russell story John Cowan cited, providing an online archive link.
timeline.point_zh: 推荐 John Cowan 引用的 Eric Frank Russell 故事，并提供在线存档链接。
timeline.point: Recommends the Eric Frank Russell story John Cowan cited, providing an online archive link.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Agrees with Luis that licenses should be judged on fidelity to freedom standards and drafting quality rather than the drafter's business model, and that complexity justifies rejection only when it creates ambiguity; asks whether Freedom Zero is explicitly part of the OSD.
timeline.point_zh: 附议 Luis：应依据对自由标准的忠诚度和起草质量评估许可证，起草者的商业模式不应纳入考量；只有造成歧义的复杂度才可拒批，并追问 Freedom Zero 是否为 OSD 的一部分。
timeline.point: Agrees with Luis that licenses should be judged on fidelity to freedom standards and drafting quality rather than the drafter's business model, and that complexity justifies rejection only when it creates ambiguity; asks whether Freedom Zero is explicitly part of the OSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Complains that VanL ignored the hard-to-access-data example, questions whether a mere license confers possessory interest enabling broad CC-BY-style data demands, and concludes the CAL is unworkable for most operators.
timeline.point_zh: 抱怨 VanL 忽视了难以提取数据的例子，质疑单凭许可是否即赋予占有利益从而使广泛的 CC-BY 式数据索取成立，并断言 CAL 对大多数运营者不可行。
timeline.point: Complains that VanL ignored the hard-to-access-data example, questions whether a mere license confers possessory interest enabling broad CC-BY-style data demands, and concludes the CAL is unworkable for most operators.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that an operator must provide source code and a person's user data even without built-in export functionality, likening the effort to producing complete corresponding source, and rejects the 'give me everything' hypothetical because mere availability does not make someone a licensee.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清运营者即使软件没有导出功能也必须提供源代码和用户数据，并将其比作完整对应源代码义务；同时否定“把我拥有的数据都给我”的假设，因为仅可获得并不构成被许可人。
timeline.point: Clarifies that an operator must provide source code and a person's user data even without built-in export functionality, likening the effort to producing complete corresponding source, and rejects the 'give me everything' hypothetical because mere availability does not make someone a licensee.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Finds the CAL's User Data scoping well-justified and arguably a net positive for software freedom, but citing the License Zero rejection as OSD precedent and agreeing the topic is a can of worms, ultimately declines to take a firm position either way.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 CAL 对 User Data 的限定合理且可能是软件自由的净贡献，但援引 License Zero 被拒的先例并称该议题是“一罐蠕虫”，最终未表明坚定立场。
timeline.point: Finds the CAL's User Data scoping well-justified and arguably a net positive for software freedom, but citing the License Zero rejection as OSD precedent and agreeing the topic is a can of worms, ultimately declines to take a firm position either way.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the OSD cannot mechanically disallow every pernicious term (Bitkeeper logging, NASA public-domain restrictions, open-hardware copyright creep) without becoming unbounded, illustrating the limits of a purely textual OSD interpretation.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSD 无法在文本上机械地禁止所有有害条款（如 Bitkeeper 日志、NASA 公共领域限制、开放硬件著作权蔓延），否则将无限膨胀，以此说明纯文本解释的局限。
timeline.point: Argues that the OSD cannot mechanically disallow every pernicious term (Bitkeeper logging, NASA public-domain restrictions, open-hardware copyright creep) without becoming unbounded, illustrating the limits of a purely textual OSD interpretation.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues the OSD works well as a short constitution and that OSI may legitimately rely on community consensus (or its absence) to justify decisions, rather than endlessly expanding the OSD.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSD 作为简短宪法运作良好，OSI 可依据社区共识（或其缺失）来证成决定，而无须无限扩展 OSD。
timeline.point: Argues the OSD works well as a short constitution and that OSI may legitimately rely on community consensus (or its absence) to justify decisions, rather than endlessly expanding the OSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Corrects the claim that License Zero was rejected, distinguishing hostile reception leading to withdrawal from formal OSI rejection, while allowing that significant past hostile receptions do carry some significance.
timeline.point_zh: 纠正 License Zero 遭拒的说法，区分导致撤回的敌意反响与 OSI 正式拒绝，同时承认重大的过往敌意反响确具一定意义。
timeline.point: Corrects the claim that License Zero was rejected, distinguishing hostile reception leading to withdrawal from formal OSI rejection, while allowing that significant past hostile receptions do carry some significance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Agrees with Henrik, clarifying that his point was only to illustrate that a fully mechanical interpretation of the OSD is not realistic.
timeline.point_zh: 同意 Henrik 的观点，澄清自己仅旨在说明对 OSD 的完全机械化解释并不现实。
timeline.point: Agrees with Henrik, clarifying that his point was only to illustrate that a fully mechanical interpretation of the OSD is not realistic.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Provides a checkpoint summary of the CAL debate, framing two substantive issues — whether data portability fits software freedom and the OSD, and whether the public-performance mechanism is effective and OSD-compliant — and lists each argument alongside the response to it.
timeline.point_zh: 提供 CAL 讨论的阶段性总结，归纳两大实质争议——数据可携带性能否纳入软件自由与 OSD，public performance 机制是否有效且合规——并逐条列出论点与回应。
timeline.point: Provides a checkpoint summary of the CAL debate, framing two substantive issues — whether data portability fits software freedom and the OSD, and whether the public-performance mechanism is effective and OSD-compliant — and lists each argument alongside the response to it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that the CAL is not analogous to License Zero: it does not require publishing all outputs, only ensures operators cannot withhold a user's own data. Argues retrieving one's own data (e.g., compiled binaries) should be an explicit software freedom.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 CAL 不同于 License Zero：它不要求公开所有输出，只确保运营者不能扣留用户自己的数据。主张获取自己数据（如编译产物）的权利应成为明确的软件自由。
timeline.point: Clarifies that the CAL is not analogous to License Zero: it does not require publishing all outputs, only ensures operators cannot withhold a user's own data. Argues retrieving one's own data (e.g., compiled binaries) should be an explicit software freedom.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues that the CAL's special GDPR provision in Section 7.1.1 is facially non-compliant with OSD 5/6 because it grants different treatment to a specific class of licensees.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 CAL 第 7.1.1 条对 GDPR 的特殊规定表面上违反 OSD 5/6，因为它对某一类被许可人给予了区别对待。
timeline.point: Argues that the CAL's special GDPR provision in Section 7.1.1 is facially non-compliant with OSD 5/6 because it grants different treatment to a specific class of licensees.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: States willingness to remove Section 7.1.1 (the GDPR provision) if it is the only remaining issue for approval.
timeline.point_zh: 表示如果第 7.1.1 条（GDPR 条款）是批准的唯一障碍，愿意将其删除。
timeline.point: States willingness to remove Section 7.1.1 (the GDPR provision) if it is the only remaining issue for approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Reiterates his objections: 'performance' misleadingly misrepresents how the industry uses APIs, and no license should burden a data receiver with returning data; his GDPR reference concerned statutory confidentiality of personal data, not ownership or licensing rights.
timeline.point_zh: 重申反对意见：“performance”一词对 API 的描述具有误导性，且许可证不应给数据接收方增加返还数据的负担；其 GDPR 引用指的是个人数据的法定保密义务，而非所有权或许可问题。
timeline.point: Reiterates his objections: 'performance' misleadingly misrepresents how the industry uses APIs, and no license should burden a data receiver with returning data; his GDPR reference concerned statutory confidentiality of personal data, not ownership or licensing rights.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Defends the public-performance hook by invoking §101's 'publicly' clause and analogizing API responses to dramatic display, offers patent use/sale/offer rights as an independent secondary hook, and argues data-return duties reflect real operator refusals, not mere normative preference.
timeline.point_zh: 援引 §101 公开表演条款并以 API 响应类比戏剧展示为 public performance 辩护，另提出专利权利作为独立的次级依据，并称数据返还义务反映运营者拒绝返还的现实。
timeline.point: Defends the public-performance hook by invoking §101's 'publicly' clause and analogizing API responses to dramatic display, offers patent use/sale/offer rights as an independent secondary hook, and argues data-return duties reflect real operator refusals, not mere normative preference.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Objects that the CAL's use of copyright terms-of-art like 'perform' and 'display' is misleading — the intended concept is executing an API over a network — and questions the data-return burden; stresses the objections concern terminology, not patent law.
timeline.point_zh: 反对 CAL 使用 'perform'、'display' 等版权术语，认为易生误导——本意是在网络上执行 API——并质疑数据返还负担；强调异议在于术语而非专利法。
timeline.point: Objects that the CAL's use of copyright terms-of-art like 'perform' and 'display' is misleading — the intended concept is executing an API over a network — and questions the data-return burden; stresses the objections concern terminology, not patent law.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues VanL understated the copyleft-scope problem: requiring from-scratch reimplementations of APIs to be open source is a novel and objectionable concept regardless of the public-performance mechanism.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 VanL 低估了 copyleft 范围问题：要求从零实现的 API 也须开源是全新且具争议的概念，无论通过何种机制实现都站不住脚。
timeline.point: Argues VanL understated the copyleft-scope problem: requiring from-scratch reimplementations of APIs to be open source is a novel and objectionable concept regardless of the public-performance mechanism.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues the crux is whether the license protects the freedom of the user or the operator, and that the hoped-for progress on user data requires broadening the traditional user-operator focus; endorses consistency with past review decisions.
timeline.point_zh: 认为核心问题在于许可证保护的是用户还是运营者的自由，要实现用户数据方面的进展须拓宽传统的用户-运营者视角；并主张评审过程应与过往决定保持一致。
timeline.point: Argues the crux is whether the license protects the freedom of the user or the operator, and that the hoped-for progress on user data requires broadening the traditional user-operator focus; endorses consistency with past review decisions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues the core issue is policy, not prematurity: extending copyleft to APIs is inconsistent with software freedom even where APIs are copyrightable; licenses should instead apply maximally permissive terms to APIs.
timeline.point_zh: 主张核心问题是政策而非时机：即便 API 可受版权保护，对其施加 copyleft 也违背软件自由；许可证应对 API 适用最大限度的宽松条款。
timeline.point: Argues the core issue is policy, not prematurity: extending copyleft to APIs is inconsistent with software freedom even where APIs are copyrightable; licenses should instead apply maximally permissive terms to APIs.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Objects separately to the CAL's Public Performance concept, which expands software licensing beyond current practice, and to its assertion of API copyrightability, which is unsettled and could affect Oracle v Google; the primary opposition is on policy grounds.
timeline.point_zh: 分别反对 CAL 的 Public Performance 概念（将软件许可扩展到现行惯例之外）及其对 API 版权性的主张（尚无定论且可能影响 Oracle v Google）；主要基于政策理由反对。
timeline.point: Objects separately to the CAL's Public Performance concept, which expands software licensing beyond current practice, and to its assertion of API copyrightability, which is unsettled and could affect Oracle v Google; the primary opposition is on policy grounds.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Speculates that if API copyright were enforced broadly, FSF could fairly demand GPL compliance from proprietary software using readline; nonetheless argues OSI should not be the first to strike.
timeline.point_zh: 推测若广泛执行 API 版权，FSF 理可要求使用 readline 的专有软件遵循 GPL；但认为 OSI 不应率先发难。
timeline.point: Speculates that if API copyright were enforced broadly, FSF could fairly demand GPL compliance from proprietary software using readline; nonetheless argues OSI should not be the first to strike.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues the term of art 'public performance' encompasses more than critics assume, citing legislative history (H.R. Rep. 94-1476), Miller v. Facebook, and legal scholarship to support that running software can constitute a public performance.
timeline.point_zh: 论证 "public performance" 这一法律术语涵盖软件运行,援引立法历史、Miller v. Facebook 判例和法学论文支持这一立场。
timeline.point: Argues the term of art 'public performance' encompasses more than critics assume, citing legislative history (H.R. Rep. 94-1476), Miller v. Facebook, and legal scholarship to support that running software can constitute a public performance.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Separates the API question from the public performance issue, arguing the Oracle v. Google precedent is unavoidable, that API copyright is better addressed explicitly than left uncertain, and that patent law independently supports the same points.
timeline.point_zh: 区分 API 问题与 public performance 问题,主张 Oracle v. Google 先例不可避免,应显式处理 API 版权,专利法亦支持相同观点。
timeline.point: Separates the API question from the public performance issue, arguing the Oracle v. Google precedent is unavoidable, that API copyright is better addressed explicitly than left uncertain, and that patent law independently supports the same points.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Posts the License Review Committee's recommendation: the Cryptographic Autonomy License does not conform to the OSD and is not approved, with rationale on the GDPR-specific provision and the 'public performance' mechanism, plus open questions for community discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 发布许可证审查委员会建议:Cryptographic Autonomy License 不符合 OSD、不予批准,并列出理由及待社区讨论的开放问题。
timeline.point: Posts the License Review Committee's recommendation: the Cryptographic Autonomy License does not conform to the OSD and is not approved, with rationale on the GDPR-specific provision and the 'public performance' mechanism, plus open questions for community discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Welcomes the committee's effort but notes the irony that insufficient discussion is cited when the chair previously signaled him to stop; urges more board participation on the list.
timeline.point_zh: 肯定委员会的努力，但指出讽刺之处：委员会以「讨论不足」为由，而主席此前却示意其停止讨论；呼吁 OSI 董事会更多参与邮件列表讨论。
timeline.point: Welcomes the committee's effort but notes the irony that insufficient discussion is cited when the chair previously signaled him to stop; urges more board participation on the list.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Responds that repetition by one person does not establish consensus; more diversity of opinion is needed, and restructuring will take time.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称单人反复陈述不能形成共识，需要更多元的观点，重组需要时间。
timeline.point: Responds that repetition by one person does not establish consensus; more diversity of opinion is needed, and restructuring will take time.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Thanks the committee, commits to resubmitting a revised CAL, and asks for clarification on what elicit further discussion obligates of the submitter.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢委员会，承诺将提交修订版 CAL，并询问「推动进一步讨论」对提交者意味着何种具体义务。
timeline.point: Thanks the committee, commits to resubmitting a revised CAL, and asks for clarification on what elicit further discussion obligates of the submitter.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Explains elicit further discussion meant the submitter could catalyze conversation if interested in resubmission; personally wanted more allies and reasoned debate on whether strong copyleft enhances or harms software freedom.
timeline.point_zh: 解释「推动讨论」是指若提交者有意重新提交可发起对话；个人希望看到更多盟友和理性辩论，探讨强 copyleft 究竟促进还是损害软件自由。
timeline.point: Explains elicit further discussion meant the submitter could catalyze conversation if interested in resubmission; personally wanted more allies and reasoned debate on whether strong copyleft enhances or harms software freedom.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues copyleft is being misused: the CAL includes a use restriction outside the scope Stallman and the FSF intended for copyleft, so the result should not be called copyleft at all.
timeline.point_zh: 指出「copyleft」一词被误用：CAL 包含使用限制，超出了 Stallman 和 FSF 所界定的 copyleft 范围，因此其结果不应称为 copyleft。
timeline.point: Argues copyleft is being misused: the CAL includes a use restriction outside the scope Stallman and the FSF intended for copyleft, so the result should not be called copyleft at all.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Thanks the committee for the summary, noting it brings everyone up to date on the license's issues.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢委员会的总结，认为它让大家了解了该许可证的问题所在。
timeline.point: Thanks the committee for the summary, noting it brings everyone up to date on the license's issues.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Endorses the non-approval decision and praises the committee's clear, timely explanation as a step forward for OSI's license review process.
timeline.point_zh: 支持不予批准的决定，并称赞委员会清晰、及时的说明是 OSI 许可证审查流程的一大进步。
timeline.point: Endorses the non-approval decision and praises the committee's clear, timely explanation as a step forward for OSI's license review process.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Suggests OSI publish decision summaries as web pages to serve as future reference, guidance for submitters, and explanation for the community.
timeline.point_zh: 建议 OSI 将决议摘要发布为网页，作为未来参考、提交者指引和社区说明。
timeline.point: Suggests OSI publish decision summaries as web pages to serve as future reference, guidance for submitters, and explanation for the community.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues the mailing list suppresses agreement and limits participation; recommends structured tools (issue tracker/VCS) and notes the CAL already had sufficient recorded objections.
timeline.point_zh: 指出邮件列表压抑了赞同表达并限制了参与；建议改用结构化工具（议题追踪/VCS），并称 CAL 已有足够的实质性反对意见。
timeline.point: Argues the mailing list suppresses agreement and limits participation; recommends structured tools (issue tracker/VCS) and notes the CAL already had sufficient recorded objections.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Interprets elicit further discussion as advice to discuss the open points before rewriting the license, since their verdict is unclear.
timeline.point_zh: 将「推动进一步讨论」理解为建议在重写许可证前先讨论这些悬而未决的问题。
timeline.point: Interprets elicit further discussion as advice to discuss the open points before rewriting the license, since their verdict is unclear.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Offers to try out a prototype of a structured tool for license review if one is built.
timeline.point_zh: 表示若有人搭建结构化审查工具的原型，愿意试用。
timeline.point: Offers to try out a prototype of a structured tool for license review if one is built.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Pushes back on the 'public performance' objection, noting the Affero family synthesizes a similar right and prior OSI approvals trigger on it, but argues applying copyright or copyleft to APIs would be a disaster and the data-portability trigger is out of scope for an OSI-approved license.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑对 "public performance" 的反对,指 Affero 系列已有类似权利,但认为将版权/著佐权扩展至 API 是灾难,数据可携义务超出 OSI 批准许可证的范围。
timeline.point: Pushes back on the 'public performance' objection, noting the Affero family synthesizes a similar right and prior OSI approvals trigger on it, but argues applying copyright or copyleft to APIs would be a disaster and the data-portability trigger is out of scope for an OSI-approved license.
