timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues license approval should be based on software freedom and OSD compliance — not popular vote — and should be a good deal for the community, noting some recent submissions seemed hostile to it.
timeline.point_zh: 主张许可证批准应基于软件自由和 OSD 合规而非投票，且须对开发者与用户社区有利；指出近期部分提交似乎对社区不友好。
timeline.point: Argues license approval should be based on software freedom and OSD compliance — not popular vote — and should be a good deal for the community, noting some recent submissions seemed hostile to it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Brings the CAL discussion to this list as requested, questioning the 'public performance' objection since accepted licenses contain a synthetic equivalent, while arguing API copyright would be a disaster for Open Source and the data-portability trigger is out of scope for OSI approval.
timeline.point_zh: 应要求将 CAL 讨论转至此列表,质疑对 "public performance" 的反对,但认为 API 版权是开放源的灾难,数据可携义务超出 OSI 批准范围。
timeline.point: Brings the CAL discussion to this list as requested, questioning the 'public performance' objection since accepted licenses contain a synthetic equivalent, while arguing API copyright would be a disaster for Open Source and the data-portability trigger is out of scope for OSI approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Notes the previous message was intended for license-discuss and has been reposted there; directs replies away from this thread.
timeline.point_zh: 指出前一条消息本应发到 license-discuss，已在该列表重新发布，请勿在此话题回复。
timeline.point: Notes the previous message was intended for license-discuss and has been reposted there; directs replies away from this thread.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues silence cannot signal agreement and the goal is reasoned consensus; defends the need for OSI to explain its decisions so submitters know what to change.
timeline.point_zh: 指出沉默不等于赞同，目标是带理由的共识；辩护 OSI 必须解释决策理由，以便提交者知道需要修改什么。
timeline.point: Argues silence cannot signal agreement and the goal is reasoned consensus; defends the need for OSI to explain its decisions so submitters know what to change.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Compares OSI criticism to film criticism: many critics, few do the work; argues +1 votes and lurking are not substantive participation — only reasoned discussion proves a thoughtful opinion.
timeline.point_zh: 将 OSI 的批评比作电影批评：批评者众多，实干者寥寥；主张点赞和潜水不算实质性参与，唯有带理由的讨论才能证明观点。
timeline.point: Compares OSI criticism to film criticism: many critics, few do the work; argues +1 votes and lurking are not substantive participation — only reasoned discussion proves a thoughtful opinion.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Praises Pam, the committee, and the board for a serious CAL summary that advances healthier OSI discussion, while noting some disagreement.
timeline.point_zh: 赞扬 Pam、委员会和董事会对 CAL 作出严肃总结，推动更健康的 OSI 讨论，同时表示并非完全同意。
timeline.point: Praises Pam, the committee, and the board for a serious CAL summary that advances healthier OSI discussion, while noting some disagreement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Responds to the Pixar/criticism analogy with literary quotations from Samuel Johnson and Wolcott Gibbs on the relationship between critics and creators.
timeline.point_zh: 用塞缪尔·约翰逊和沃尔科特·吉布斯的文学名言回应关于「批评者与创作者」的类比。
timeline.point: Responds to the Pixar/criticism analogy with literary quotations from Samuel Johnson and Wolcott Gibbs on the relationship between critics and creators.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Asks how regulating a software 'public performance' differs from applying copyright to APIs, questioning the human-readable interface distinction; argues data portability by commercial providers is a matter for government regulation, not software licensing.
timeline.point_zh: 质问规范软件 "public performance" 与 API 版权有何区别,主张商业服务商的数据可携性应属政府监管范畴,与软件许可无关。
timeline.point: Asks how regulating a software 'public performance' differs from applying copyright to APIs, questioning the human-readable interface distinction; argues data portability by commercial providers is a matter for government regulation, not software licensing.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues there is no public performance of software and asks whether running software over SSH on another server counts as use on one’s own computer.
timeline.point_zh: 认为软件不存在 public performance，并询问通过 SSH 在他人服务器运行程序是否算在自己的计算机上使用。
timeline.point: Argues there is no public performance of software and asks whether running software over SSH on another server counts as use on one’s own computer.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues executing software is not a 'public performance' and that the burden of justifying that controversial legal theory falls on those promoting CAL-style licenses; extending exclusive rights across interfaces would dangerously expand software vendors' control.
timeline.point_zh: 主张运行软件不属于“公开表演”，举证责任在推行 CAL 类许可证的一方；将专有权扩展到接口会危险地扩大软件厂商的控制。
timeline.point: Argues executing software is not a 'public performance' and that the burden of justifying that controversial legal theory falls on those promoting CAL-style licenses; extending exclusive rights across interfaces would dangerously expand software vendors' control.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Insists that non-performed works have no public performance right and says proponents of the theory bear the burden of persuasion.
timeline.point_zh: 坚持认为非表演性作品没有 public performance 权利，并表示该理论的支持者负有说服责任。
timeline.point: Insists that non-performed works have no public performance right and says proponents of the theory bear the burden of persuasion.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues that remote access is a core problem for copyleft and points to remote desktop use as an example that undermines copyleft assumptions.
timeline.point_zh: 认为远程访问是 copyleft 的核心问题，并以远程桌面使用为例说明其削弱 copyleft 假设。
timeline.point: Argues that remote access is a core problem for copyleft and points to remote desktop use as an example that undermines copyleft assumptions.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Cites WIPO Copyright Treaty Article 4 (computer programs protected as literary works) and Article 8 (authors' exclusive right of communication to the public, including making available on demand), along with Berne Convention provisions.
timeline.point_zh: 援引 WIPO 版权条约第 4 条（计算机程序按文学作品保护）与第 8 条（向公众传播权，含按需提供）及 Berne 公约相关条款。
timeline.point: Cites WIPO Copyright Treaty Article 4 (computer programs protected as literary works) and Article 8 (authors' exclusive right of communication to the public, including making available on demand), along with Berne Convention provisions.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Responds that statutes and treaties do not settle the issue by themselves because courts give legal text its operative meaning.
timeline.point_zh: 回应称法规和条约文本本身不能解决问题，因为法律文本的实际含义取决于法院解释。
timeline.point: Responds that statutes and treaties do not settle the issue by themselves because courts give legal text its operative meaning.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] [License-review] For Approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: Argues the burden of justifying the software 'performance right' lies with CAL's proponents; believes CAL should be rejected by OSI and FSF, the AGPL re-evaluated, and any public-performance or interface exclusive-rights theory rendered unenforceable.
timeline.point_zh: 主张软件“表演权”理论的举证责任在 CAL 推动者；认为 OSI 与 FSF 应拒绝 CAL、重审 AGPL，任何表演权或接口专有权理论都应被否定。

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission: CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Proposes that CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible be approved as a legacy OSI license and that CNRI-Python be marked Superseded or Voluntarily Retired, noting the new variant differs mainly by being made GPL-compatible.
timeline.point_zh: 提议将 CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible 作为遗留 OSI 许可证获批，并将 CNRI-Python 标记为“已被取代”或“自愿退役”，指出新变体主要区别在于实现了 GPL 兼容。
timeline.point: Proposes that CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible be approved as a legacy OSI license and that CNRI-Python be marked Superseded or Voluntarily Retired, noting the new variant differs mainly by being made GPL-compatible.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission: CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the fact that the CNRI license is written as a clickwrap agreement makes it problematic to approve.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 CNRI 许可证以点击包装协议形式撰写这一事实是否会导致其难以获批。
timeline.point: Asks whether the fact that the CNRI license is written as a clickwrap agreement makes it problematic to approve.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission: CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Analyzes the CNRI clickwrap clause, noting OSD 10 was added specifically to bar clickwrap-style requirements, while observing other OSI-approved licenses have similar usewrap language.
timeline.point_zh: 分析 CNRI 点击包装条款，指出 OSD 10 正是为禁止此类点击包装要求而增设，同时指出其他已批准的 OSI 许可证也有类似的使用即同意条款。
timeline.point: Analyzes the CNRI clickwrap clause, noting OSD 10 was added specifically to bar clickwrap-style requirements, while observing other OSI-approved licenses have similar usewrap language.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission: CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Clarifies he does not believe the clickwrap/usewrap clause here actually violates OSD 10, though it is debatable, and assumes the click language was just careless drafting with no real click mechanism in Python.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清他认为此处的点击包装/使用即同意条款并不违反 OSD 10（尽管可辩论），并假设点击措辞只是草率撰写，Python 实际并无点击机制。
timeline.point: Clarifies he does not believe the clickwrap/usewrap clause here actually violates OSD 10, though it is debatable, and assumes the click language was just careless drafting with no real click mechanism in Python.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission: CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Argues the clause does not violate OSD 10 because the clickwrap is stated in the alternative ("or by copying"), so agreement is possible with or without a GUI, providing the OSD 10 historical context.
timeline.point_zh: 主张该条款不违反 OSD 10，因为点击包装以选择式表述（“或通过复制……”），无论是否有 GUI 都可表示同意，并提供了 OSD 10 的历史背景。
timeline.point: Argues the clause does not violate OSD 10 because the clickwrap is stated in the alternative ("or by copying"), so agreement is possible with or without a GUI, providing the OSD 10 historical context.

timeline.snippet: Proposes opening a license-review thread to move toward a decision after noting no objections to Python-2.0.1.
timeline.point_zh: 在注意到对 Python-2.0.1 无异议后，提议开启 license-review 邮件列表讨论以推进决策。
timeline.point: Proposes opening a license-review thread to move toward a decision after noting no objections to Python-2.0.1.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Python-2.0.1 and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Explains OSI generally only reacts to formal submission requests, implying inaction is due to lack of prior requests.
timeline.point_zh: 解释 OSI 通常只响应正式提交请求，暗示此前未批准是由于无人请求。
timeline.point: Explains OSI generally only reacts to formal submission requests, implying inaction is due to lack of prior requests.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Python-2.0.1 and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Advises submitting Python-2.0.1 for approval and suggests retiring Python-2.0 simultaneously, noting process requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 建议提交 Python-2.0.1 供批准，并提议同时让 Python-2.0 自愿退役，同时指出流程要求。
timeline.point: Advises submitting Python-2.0.1 for approval and suggests retiring Python-2.0 simultaneously, noting process requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Python-2.0.1 and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Reports that PSF's executive director agreed to his submitting both Python licenses provided she is Cc'd, and announces that two separate license-review threads have been opened for Python-2.0.1 and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible.
timeline.point_zh: 报告已获 PSF 执行主管同意（需抄送她）提交这两个许可证，并宣布已为 Python-2.0.1 和 CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible 在 license-review 分别开启讨论串。
timeline.point: Reports that PSF's executive director agreed to his submitting both Python licenses provided she is Cc'd, and announces that two separate license-review threads have been opened for Python-2.0.1 and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] Python-2.0.1 and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Finds that the Python-2.0 text on the OSI site and SPDX is a copy-paste error mixing in a CNRI 1.6b1 draft never used in any public Python release, and concludes it is reasonable to submit the current Python license for approval.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSI 网站与 SPDX 上的 Python-2.0 许可证文本是复制粘贴错误，混入了从未公开发布的 CNRI 1.6b1 草案，并认为提交现行 Python 许可证审批是合理的。
timeline.point: Finds that the Python-2.0 text on the OSI site and SPDX is a copy-paste error mixing in a CNRI 1.6b1 draft never used in any public Python release, and concludes it is reasonable to submit the current Python license for approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission: Python-2.0.1
timeline.snippet: Proposes legacy approval for Python-2.0.1, asks to mark Python-2.0 as superseded or retired, and says the same should apply to CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible.
timeline.point_zh: 提议将 Python-2.0.1 作为 legacy 许可证批准，并建议把 Python-2.0 标为 superseded 或 retired，同时主张 CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible 也应同样处理。
timeline.point: Proposes legacy approval for Python-2.0.1, asks to mark Python-2.0 as superseded or retired, and says the same should apply to CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission: Python-2.0.1
timeline.snippet: Notes the attached file appears to be the Python 2.0 license rather than 2.0.1 and that OSI does not approve license components; asks the submitter to work with Python to clarify which licenses need approval and how they differ, since current materials are insufficient for an intelligent analysis.
timeline.point_zh: 指出附件疑似 Python 2.0 而非 2.0.1，且 OSI 不审批许可证的组成部分；请提交者与 Python 方澄清究竟需审批哪些许可证及其差异，因为现有材料不足以做出明智分析。
timeline.point: Notes the attached file appears to be the Python 2.0 license rather than 2.0.1 and that OSI does not approve license components; asks the submitter to work with Python to clarify which licenses need approval and how they differ, since current materials are insufficient for an intelligent analysis.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission: Python-2.0.1
timeline.snippet: Argues OSI already approved the multi-part Python-2.0 in the same form, so approving Python-2.0.1 warrants an exception; explains the key difference is the GPL-compatible CNRI portion, and notes PSF lacks resources, so he is pursuing approval with Deb's agreement.
timeline.point_zh: 主张 OSI 此前已按同一多部分结构批准 Python-2.0，故批准 Python-2.0.1 可作例外；关键差异是 CNRI 部分实现 GPL 兼容，且 PSF 缺乏资源，他经 Deb 同意代为推进。
timeline.point: Argues OSI already approved the multi-part Python-2.0 in the same form, so approving Python-2.0.1 warrants an exception; explains the key difference is the GPL-compatible CNRI portion, and notes PSF lacks resources, so he is pursuing approval with Deb's agreement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Submission: Python-2.0.1
timeline.snippet: Suggests splitting the request into separate submissions because the current materials do not fit OSI’s normal approval structure.
timeline.point_zh: 建议把请求拆成多个独立提交，因为当前材料不符合 OSI 的常规审批结构。
timeline.point: Suggests splitting the request into separate submissions because the current materials do not fit OSI’s normal approval structure.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Requests OSI review of Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible as a set, noting that the current Python license's lack of OSI approval creates unnecessary dilemmas, and cites FSF, Fedora, and Debian acceptance in support of approval.
timeline.point_zh: 请求 OSI 一并审查 Python-2.0.1、PSF-2.0 与 CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible，指出 Python 现行许可证未获批造成不必要的两难，并援引 FSF、Fedora、Debian 的认可支持批准。
timeline.point: Requests OSI review of Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible as a set, noting that the current Python license's lack of OSI approval creates unnecessary dilemmas, and cites FSF, Fedora, and Debian acceptance in support of approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Notes that Max Mehl previously submitted Python-2.0.1 and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible earlier this year with the PSF's blessing.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 Max Mehl 今年早些时候已在 PSF 支持下提交了 Python-2.0.1 和 CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible。
timeline.point: Notes that Max Mehl previously submitted Python-2.0.1 and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible earlier this year with the PSF's blessing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges prior submissions by Max and emphasizes the need to include PSF-2.0 in the review as it is used standalone.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 Max 之前的提交，并强调审查需包含 PSF-2.0，因其被独立使用。
timeline.point: Acknowledges prior submissions by Max and emphasizes the need to include PSF-2.0 in the review as it is used standalone.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Requests that submitter send separate emails for each license to facilitate management and notes the submission process page.
timeline.point_zh: 要求提交者为每个许可单独发送邮件以便于管理，并提及了提交流程页面。
timeline.point: Requests that submitter send separate emails for each license to facilitate management and notes the submission process page.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Announces Board approval of CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible and Python-2.0.1 as Legacy, superseding prior versions, and seeks clarity on PSF-2.0 status.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布董事会已批准 CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible 和 Python-2.0.1 为 Legacy 许可，取代旧版本，并就 PSF-2.0 的状态寻求澄清。
timeline.point: Announces Board approval of CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible and Python-2.0.1 as Legacy, superseding prior versions, and seeks clarity on PSF-2.0 status.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that Python-2.0 and PSF-2.0 are distinct licenses to correct previous assumptions in the thread.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 Python-2.0 和 PSF-2.0 是不同的许可，以更正此前讨论中的假设。
timeline.point: Clarifies that Python-2.0 and PSF-2.0 are distinct licenses to correct previous assumptions in the thread.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: States the Board voted to retire Python-2.0 and approve Python-2.0.1 as requested, and asks PSF to confirm if a different outcome is desired.
timeline.point_zh: 声明董事会已按请求投票表决退役 Python-2.0 并批准 Python-2.0.1，并请 PSF 确认是否期望不同的结果。
timeline.point: States the Board voted to retire Python-2.0 and approve Python-2.0.1 as requested, and asks PSF to confirm if a different outcome is desired.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Shares LicenseAtlas, a review tracker built from archives covering timelines and board votes, to help the community check history and follow the process.
timeline.point_zh: 介绍基于档案构建的 LicenseAtlas 审查追踪工具，涵盖时间线和董事会投票记录，以帮助社区查询历史并跟进审查流程。
timeline.point: Shares LicenseAtlas, a review tracker built from archives covering timelines and board votes, to help the community check history and follow the process.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Finds the provided information useful, noting it clarifies that the original discussion around the Python licenses occurred in 2011.
timeline.point_zh: 认为所提供的信息很有用,指出它澄清了围绕 Python 许可证的原始讨论发生在 2011 年。
timeline.point: Finds the provided information useful, noting it clarifies that the original discussion around the Python licenses occurred in 2011.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Welcomes the board decision approving Python-2.0.1 and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible, sees Nico's request as mostly covered by it, and offers to assist with approving PSF-2.0 as well, explaining why it was left out of his original request.
timeline.point_zh: 欢迎董事会批准 Python-2.0.1 与 CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible 的决定，认为已涵盖 Nico 的大部分诉求，并愿意协助推动 PSF-2.0 的批准。
timeline.point: Welcomes the board decision approving Python-2.0.1 and CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible, sees Nico's request as mostly covered by it, and offers to assist with approving PSF-2.0 as well, explaining why it was left out of his original request.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Notes that OSI typically only reviews licenses if a submitter or steward requests it.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 OSI 通常仅在提交者或管理者提出请求时才会审查许可证。
timeline.point: Notes that OSI typically only reviews licenses if a submitter or steward requests it.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Supports OSI review of PSF-2.0 due to its widespread use in the Python ecosystem and general acceptance as open source.
timeline.point_zh: 支持对 PSF-2.0 进行 OSI 审查，因其广泛应用于 Python 生态系统且被普遍接受为开源。
timeline.point: Supports OSI review of PSF-2.0 due to its widespread use in the Python ecosystem and general acceptance as open source.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Python licenses: Python-2.0.1, PSF-2.0, CNRI-Python-GPL-Compatible
timeline.snippet: Provides historical board minutes indicating previous PSF license submissions were likely dropped or unresolved.
timeline.point_zh: 提供历史董事会会议记录，表明此前的 PSF 许可证提交很可能被搁置或未获解决。
timeline.point: Provides historical board minutes indicating previous PSF license submissions were likely dropped or unresolved.

license_texts.title: COMMON DEVELOPMENT AND DISTRIBUTION LICENSE (CDDL)
license_texts.message_subject: [License-review] Legacy license suggestion: CDDL 1.1
license_texts.text:
COMMON DEVELOPMENT AND DISTRIBUTION LICENSE (CDDL)
Version 1.1

1. Definitions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Legacy license suggestion: CDDL 1.1
timeline.snippet: Proposes adding CDDL 1.1 via the legacy license process, noting it is nearly identical to CDDL 1.0 with Oracle as steward, a new patent-settlement clause 6.3, and a California venue notice; believes it complies with the OSC including OSD 3, 5, 6, and 9.
timeline.point_zh: 建议通过旧版许可证流程收录 CDDL 1.1，指出其与 CDDL 1.0 几乎相同，并认为其符合 OSC（含 OSD 3、5、6、9）。
timeline.point: Proposes adding CDDL 1.1 via the legacy license process, noting it is nearly identical to CDDL 1.0 with Oracle as steward, a new patent-settlement clause 6.3, and a California venue notice; believes it complies with the OSC including OSD 3, 5, 6, and 9.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Legacy license suggestion: CDDL 1.1
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the CDDL 1.1 changes (patent, lost profits, venue) raise any OSD-compliance issues he may be missing, noting OSI has previously treated choice-of-venue clauses as non-OSD-violating.
timeline.point_zh: 询问 CDDL 1.1 的修改（专利、利润损失、管辖地）是否存在他未曾注意到的 OSD 合规问题，并指出 OSI 此前认定管辖地条款并不违反 OSD。
timeline.point: Asks whether the CDDL 1.1 changes (patent, lost profits, venue) raise any OSD-compliance issues he may be missing, noting OSI has previously treated choice-of-venue clauses as non-OSD-violating.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Legacy license suggestion: CDDL 1.1
timeline.snippet: Would consider the license OSD compliant, but flags that the OSI should not update CDDL 1.0 to CDDL 1.1 on its 'popular and widely used or with strong communities' list, which rests on outdated, politicized assumptions and should be retired or made objective.
timeline.point_zh: 认为该许可证符合 OSD，但指出 OSI 不应在其“流行且广泛使用”列表中将 CDDL 1.0 更新为 CDDL 1.1，该列表基于过时且政治化的判断，应废止或改为客观标准。
timeline.point: Would consider the license OSD compliant, but flags that the OSI should not update CDDL 1.0 to CDDL 1.1 on its 'popular and widely used or with strong communities' list, which rests on outdated, politicized assumptions and should be retired or made objective.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Legacy license suggestion: CDDL 1.1
timeline.snippet: Notes that nuanced license tagging is planned but unimplemented; observes CDDL 1.1 is encountered in legacy projects but not popular for new ones, and proposes a new tag for older licenses that are common but not recommended for new use.
timeline.point_zh: 指出更细致的许可证标签计划尚未实施；观察到 CDDL 1.1 在旧项目中常见但不适用于新项目，并建议新增一种针对“常见但不推荐新项目使用”的旧许可证标签。
timeline.point: Notes that nuanced license tagging is planned but unimplemented; observes CDDL 1.1 is encountered in legacy projects but not popular for new ones, and proposes a new tag for older licenses that are common but not recommended for new use.

board_vote.motion_text: Josh moves to approve the CDDL1.1 license in the legacy category

timeline.subject: [License-review] Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License Approval
timeline.snippet: Submits the Los Alamos National Lab BSD Variant License (proposed identifier BSD-3-Clause-LANL), a LANL-flavored BSD-3 akin to BSD-3-Clause-LBNL, for approval via the legacy path, noting it is already widely used at LANL.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 Los Alamos National Lab BSD Variant License(拟用标识 BSD-3-Clause-LANL),走旧版路径申请 OSI 审批。
timeline.point: Submits the Los Alamos National Lab BSD Variant License (proposed identifier BSD-3-Clause-LANL), a LANL-flavored BSD-3 akin to BSD-3-Clause-LBNL, for approval via the legacy path, noting it is already widely used at LANL.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License Approval
timeline.snippet: Supports approving the LANL BSD-3 Variant as a legacy non-reusable license, finding no OSD conflicts, but flags a concern about potential surge of similar entity-specific licenses resurfacing.
timeline.point_zh: 支持批准 LANL BSD-3 变体作为遗留非可重用许可证，认为其不违反 OSD，但担忧类似机构特定许可证可能大量涌现。
timeline.point: Supports approving the LANL BSD-3 Variant as a legacy non-reusable license, finding no OSD conflicts, but flags a concern about potential surge of similar entity-specific licenses resurfacing.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License Approval
timeline.snippet: Addresses the concern about a potential surge of non-reusable licenses by suggesting a categorization solution on the website.
timeline.point_zh: 针对大量非可重用许可证可能涌现的担忧，建议通过网站分类来解决，让用户知道它们是开源的，同时让开发者知道不应直接使用。
timeline.point: Addresses the concern about a potential surge of non-reusable licenses by suggesting a categorization solution on the website.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License Approval
timeline.snippet: Asks if any further action is needed regarding the license approval process.
timeline.point_zh: 询问是否需要就许可证审批流程采取进一步行动。
timeline.point: Asks if any further action is needed regarding the license approval process.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License Approval
timeline.snippet: Asks for a timeline on the approval, noting it is blocking a PR to release a package.
timeline.point_zh: 询问审批时间表，说明该审批阻塞了软件包发布的 PR。
timeline.point: Asks for a timeline on the approval, noting it is blocking a PR to release a package.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License Approval
timeline.snippet: Explains the 60-day review process and informs that the LANL BSD-3 Variant will be reviewed by the Board on September 20, 2024.
timeline.point_zh: 说明 60 天审查流程，告知 LANL BSD-3 变体许可证将于 2024 年 9 月 20 日由董事会审查。
timeline.point: Explains the 60-day review process and informs that the LANL BSD-3 Variant will be reviewed by the Board on September 20, 2024.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License Approval
timeline.snippet: License Committee recommends approving the Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License as an OSI Certified license in the Non-Reusable category; the Board will vote on September 20.
timeline.point_zh: 许可证委员会建议以 Non-Reusable 类别批准 Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License 为 OSI 认证许可证，董事会定于9月20日投票。
timeline.point: License Committee recommends approving the Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License as an OSI Certified license in the Non-Reusable category; the Board will vote on September 20.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License Approval
timeline.snippet: Announces that the OSI Board approved the LANL BSD-3 Variant License at the September 20, 2024 meeting.
timeline.point_zh: 通报 OSI 董事会在 2024 年 9 月 20 日会议上批准了 LANL BSD-3 变体许可证。
timeline.point: Announces that the OSI Board approved the LANL BSD-3 Variant License at the September 20, 2024 meeting.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License Approval
timeline.snippet: Notifies the list that the LANL BSD-3 Variant license page is now live on opensource.org.
timeline.point_zh: 通知邮件列表 LANL BSD-3 变体许可证页面已在 opensource.org 上线。
timeline.point: Notifies the list that the LANL BSD-3 Variant license page is now live on opensource.org.

board_vote.motion_text: That the Los Alamos National Labs BSD-3 Variant License be approved as an Open Source Initiative Certified license in the Non-Reusable category of licenses

submissions.name: CMU License
aliases: MIT-CMU license for Python Pillow

board_vote.motion_text: That the MIT-CMU License be approved as an Open Source Initiative Certified license in the Redundant with More Popular category of licenses

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] MIT-CMU license for Python Pillow
timeline.snippet: Requests adding the legacy MIT-CMU license to the OSI approved list so that Python Pillow can update its license from HPND to MIT-CMU, which the project considers more historically accurate.
timeline.point_zh: 请求将传统的 MIT-CMU 许可证添加到 OSI 批准列表，以便 Python Pillow 从 HPND 更换为项目认为更准确的 MIT-CMU 许可证。
timeline.point: Requests adding the legacy MIT-CMU license to the OSI approved list so that Python Pillow can update its license from HPND to MIT-CMU, which the project considers more historically accurate.

timeline.subject: [License-review] MIT-CMU license for Python Pillow
timeline.snippet: Votes in favor of approving MIT-CMU as clearly open source, suggests listing it as an MIT variant, and proposes a broader review of MIT variants for the OSI website.
timeline.point_zh: 投票支持批准 MIT-CMU 为明确的开源许可证，建议将其列为 MIT 变体，并提议对 OSI 网站上的 MIT 变体进行更广泛审查。
timeline.point: Votes in favor of approving MIT-CMU as clearly open source, suggests listing it as an MIT variant, and proposes a broader review of MIT variants for the OSI website.

timeline.subject: [License-review] MIT-CMU license for Python Pillow
timeline.snippet: Supports adding MIT-CMU as approved per SPDX definition, but disagrees it is merely an MIT variant, viewing it and MIT as separate members of a large family of old FOSS licences.
timeline.point_zh: 支持按 SPDX 定义将 MIT-CMU 作为已批准许可证添加，但不同意它仅是 MIT 变体，认为它和 MIT 同属一个大型老牌 FOSS 许可证家族。
timeline.point: Supports adding MIT-CMU as approved per SPDX definition, but disagrees it is merely an MIT variant, viewing it and MIT as separate members of a large family of old FOSS licences.

timeline.subject: [License-review] MIT-CMU license for Python Pillow
timeline.snippet: Clarifies that OSI license approval is done by the Board, not by informal mailing list consensus, and notes that adding a TROVE classifier is beyond the scope of the license-review list.
timeline.point_zh: 澄清 OSI 许可证审批由董事会进行而非邮件列表非正式共识，并指出添加 TROVE 分类器超出许可审查列表的范围。
timeline.point: Clarifies that OSI license approval is done by the Board, not by informal mailing list consensus, and notes that adding a TROVE classifier is beyond the scope of the license-review list.

timeline.subject: [License-review] MIT-CMU license for Python Pillow
timeline.snippet: Thanks the respondents for their input, acknowledges the distinction between board and mailing list approval, and asks whether this constitutes a formal board request.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢回复者的反馈，认可董事会审批与邮件列表审批的区别，并询问此邮件是否构成正式的董事会请求。
timeline.point: Thanks the respondents for their input, acknowledges the distinction between board and mailing list approval, and asks whether this constitutes a formal board request.

timeline.subject: [License-review] MIT-CMU license for Python Pillow
timeline.snippet: License Committee recommends approving the MIT-CMU License as an OSI Certified license in the Redundant with More Popular category; the Board will vote on September 20, and comments are invited.
timeline.point_zh: 许可证委员会建议在 Redundant with More Popular 类别下批准 MIT-CMU License 为 OSI 认证许可证；董事会将于 9 月 20 日表决，欢迎提出意见。
timeline.point: License Committee recommends approving the MIT-CMU License as an OSI Certified license in the Redundant with More Popular category; the Board will vote on September 20, and comments are invited.

timeline.subject: [License-review] MIT-CMU license for Python Pillow
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that the MIT-CMU license page is now available on opensource.org.
timeline.point_zh: 确认 MIT-CMU 许可证页面现已上线 opensource.org。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that the MIT-CMU license page is now available on opensource.org.

board_vote.motion_text: That the MIT-CMU License be approved as an Open Source Initiative Certified license in the Redundant with More Popular category of licenses

timeline.subject: [License-review] [new license] Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0
timeline.snippet: Submits the Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0 for OSI approval on behalf of the OpenJS Foundation and the Blue Oak Council, citing its plain language and strong patent grant, its comparison to MIT/Apache-2.0, and its wide use in the npm ecosystem.
timeline.point_zh: 代表 OpenJS 基金会和 Blue Oak Council 提交 Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0 供 OSI 审批，理由是其语言浅显、专利授权强，可与 MIT/Apache-2.0 类比，且在 npm 生态中广泛使用。
timeline.point: Submits the Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0 for OSI approval on behalf of the OpenJS Foundation and the Blue Oak Council, citing its plain language and strong patent grant, its comparison to MIT/Apache-2.0, and its wide use in the npm ecosystem.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [new license] Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0
timeline.snippet: Concedes the Blue Oak license is probably OSD-compliant and should be approved, but raises concerns: it is silent on moral rights and copyright notices, and its patent grant is so broad that companies should avoid contributing to Blue Oak-covered software.
timeline.point_zh: 承认 Blue Oak 许可证大概率符合 OSD、应予批准，但提出顾虑：其对精神权利与版权声明保持沉默，且专利授权过宽，公司应避免向 Blue Oak 许可的软件贡献代码。
timeline.point: Concedes the Blue Oak license is probably OSD-compliant and should be approved, but raises concerns: it is silent on moral rights and copyright notices, and its patent grant is so broad that companies should avoid contributing to Blue Oak-covered software.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [new license] Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0
timeline.snippet: Personally would not recommend the Blue Oak license for trading legal certainty for layman's terms, but sees no reason it should not be approved since it meets the OSD; argues moral rights are largely orthogonal to the license text.
timeline.point_zh: 个人不推荐 Blue Oak 许可证，认为其以牺牲法律确定性换取通俗措辞，但认为其符合 OSD、没有理由不予批准；并主张精神权利与许可证文本基本无关。
timeline.point: Personally would not recommend the Blue Oak license for trading legal certainty for layman's terms, but sees no reason it should not be approved since it meets the OSD; argues moral rights are largely orthogonal to the license text.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [new license] Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0
timeline.snippet: Questions whether the license's non-traditional simple language (acceptance, 'rules', 'contributor', the notice cure mechanism) creates more problems than it solves, but concludes it cannot be construed to violate the OSD or the non-OSD requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑该许可证非传统的简明语言(接受、"规则"、"贡献者"、通知补救机制)是否弊大于利,但结论是其不会被解释为违反 OSD 或不满足非 OSD 要求。
timeline.point: Questions whether the license's non-traditional simple language (acceptance, 'rules', 'contributor', the notice cure mechanism) creates more problems than it solves, but concludes it cannot be construed to violate the OSD or the non-OSD requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-review] [new license] Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0
timeline.snippet: Consolidates the three Blue Oak 1.0.0 reviews, listing endorsements of approval, and defends the license: notice preservation is unnecessary for a modern license, the broad patent grant is appropriate, and its common-sense concision is more robust than over-specified licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 汇总三份 Blue Oak 1.0.0 评审意见并列出支持批准的观点,同时为许可证辩护:通知保留对现代许可证无必要,宽泛的专利授权是恰当的,其简明常识性风格比过度规定的许可证更稳健。

License: Unicode License v3 (Exhibit A)
Submitted: August 23, 2023, 
http://lists.opensource.org/pipermail/license-review_lists.opensource.org/2023-August/005404.html 

Decision date: due no later than the first Board meeting after October 
23, 2023

License Review Committee Recommendation:

Resolved that it is the opinion of the OSI that the Unicode License be 
approved as an Open Source Initiative Certified license in the Special 
Purpose category of licenses.

The previous version of the license, Unicode, Inc. License Agreement – 
Data Files and Software, available at 
https://opensource.org/license/unicode-inc-license-agreement-data-files-and-software/, 
will be marked as superseded.

Rationale Document

Notes: This is a revision of the OSI-approved “Unicode, Inc. License 
Agreement – Data Files and Software,” a permissive license. The license 
submitter summarized the changes as follows:

1. The “Copyright and Permission Notice” has been moved to the top of 
the license, to make clear that the “Notice to User” must be reproduced 
with any distribution of software or data licensed under the license, 
per the permission section.
2. The copyright notice has been genericized so as to not be specific to 
the Unicode Consortium or the recited years (which themselves are out of 
date).
3. The “All rights reserved” statement has been removed, as it is no 
longer required under Berne and is also misleading given the permissive 
nature of the license.
4. The references to links to Unicode’s website have been removed, to 
genericize the license and also make the license not dependent upon an 
external source for its defined terms (and also prevent defined terms 
from leading to dead links or modified links that could be altered in a 
way contrary to the OSD).
5. The recitation of “Unicode” data files and “Unicode” software has 
been removed to genericize the license for use by entities other than 
Unicode.
6. The defined terms “Data Files” and “Software” have been genericized 
to apply to any data files or software to which the license is applied.

None of the changes affect the rights granted. No one objected to 
approval of the license. The licensor also asked that the previous 
version of the license be marked as superseded.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.3 (was v1.2)
timeline.snippet: Submits the updated Open Logistics License v1.3 with an adapted name, corrected parentheses in article 4, and a deleted paragraph deemed unnecessary.
timeline.point_zh: 提交更新的Open物流许可证1.3版本，包括修改的名称、第4条中修正的括号，以及删除了被认为不必要的段落。
timeline.point: Submits the updated Open Logistics License v1.3 with an adapted name, corrected parentheses in article 4, and a deleted paragraph deemed unnecessary.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.3 (was v1.2)
timeline.snippet: Asks whether the submitter is still working on explaining why this license is needed instead of using APL2.
timeline.point_zh: 询问提交者是否仍在准备解释为何需要该许可证而非使用APL2。
timeline.point: Asks whether the submitter is still working on explaining why this license is needed instead of using APL2.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.3 (was v1.2)
timeline.snippet: Presses for a FAQ explaining why the license is needed before voting, warning that his vote will be “no” without one; questions why German developers would need a new license.
timeline.point_zh: 要求在投票前提供常见问题解答以说明许可证的必要性，警告否则将投反对票；质疑德国开发者为何需要新许可证。
timeline.point: Presses for a FAQ explaining why the license is needed before voting, warning that his vote will be “no” without one; questions why German developers would need a new license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.3 (was v1.2)
timeline.snippet: Questions whether the submitter is refusing to provide a justification for why this license is needed.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑提交者是否在拒绝提供该许可证必要性的说明。
timeline.point: Questions whether the submitter is refusing to provide a justification for why this license is needed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.3 (was v1.2)
timeline.snippet: Explains that European companies new to open source benefit from a license compatible with both open source criteria and local law, since some clauses in established licenses are not permitted in Germany.
timeline.point_zh: 解释称新接触开源的欧洲公司受益于同时符合开源标准和本地法律的许可证，因为一些现行许可证中的条款在德国不被允许。
timeline.point: Explains that European companies new to open source benefit from a license compatible with both open source criteria and local law, since some clauses in established licenses are not permitted in Germany.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.3 (was v1.2)
timeline.snippet: Announces the License Committee’s recommendation to the OSI Board to approve the Open Logistics License version 1.3; notes the Board will vote next.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布许可证委员会向OSI董事会推荐批准Open物流许可证1.3版本；指出董事会接下来将进行投票。
timeline.point: Announces the License Committee’s recommendation to the OSI Board to approve the Open Logistics License version 1.3; notes the Board will vote next.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Approval: Open Logistics License v1.3 (was v1.2)
timeline.snippet: Thanks Andreas and expresses that the process was a pleasure.
timeline.point_zh: 感谢Andreas，表示这一过程非常愉快。
timeline.point: Thanks Andreas and expresses that the process was a pleasure.

submissions.name: JAM License
aliases: Legacy Approval, Licnese of Jam

timeline.subject: [License-review] Legacy Approval, Licnese of Jam
timeline.snippet: Asks for legacy OSI approval of the Jam license, a short permissive notice requiring retention of the copyright notice and clearly marked modifications, needed to build the Argyll Color Management System.
timeline.point_zh: 请求 OSI 对 Jam 许可证进行历史性批准,该简短宽松许可证要求保留版权声明并明确标注修改,构建 Argyll 色彩管理系统时需要它。
timeline.point: Asks for legacy OSI approval of the Jam license, a short permissive notice requiring retention of the copyright notice and clearly marked modifications, needed to build the Argyll Color Management System.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Legacy Approval, Licnese of Jam
timeline.snippet: Reports that the Jam License has been in use for at least 21 years, with the oldest release dating back that far, though the freely available version appears discontinued.
timeline.point_zh: 报告Jam许可证已使用至少21年，最古老的发行版可追溯到那时，但免费版本似乎已停止维护。
timeline.point: Reports that the Jam License has been in use for at least 21 years, with the oldest release dating back that far, though the freely available version appears discontinued.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Legacy Approval, Licnese of Jam
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges that Jam is packaged for Fedora and accepted by Debian as DFSG-conformant, arguing this strengthens the case for granting legacy approval.
timeline.point_zh: 确认Jam已打包在Fedora中且被Debian接受为符合DFSG标准，认为这增强了授予遗留批准的理由。
timeline.point: Acknowledges that Jam is packaged for Fedora and accepted by Debian as DFSG-conformant, arguing this strengthens the case for granting legacy approval.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Legacy Approval, Licnese of Jam
timeline.snippet: Explains that Fedora includes Jam based on the interpretation that 'use' combined with the requirement to mark modifications implicitly grants modification permission.
timeline.point_zh: 解释Fedora包含Jam是基于这样的理解：使用一词结合标记修改的要求隐含地授予了修改许可。
timeline.point: Explains that Fedora includes Jam based on the interpretation that 'use' combined with the requirement to mark modifications implicitly grants modification permission.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Legacy Approval, Licnese of Jam
timeline.snippet: Argues that approving the Jam License because someone asked is sufficient rationale, and that OSI should not proactively search for legacy licenses to approve.
timeline.point_zh: 主张因为有人请求就批准Jam许可证已经足够，OSI不应主动搜寻遗留许可证来批准。
timeline.point: Argues that approving the Jam License because someone asked is sufficient rationale, and that OSI should not proactively search for legacy licenses to approve.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Legacy Approval, Licnese of Jam
timeline.snippet: Recommends approving the Jam License as legacy/non-reusable, noting the consensus that it is treated as open source despite some poor wording issues.
timeline.point_zh: 建议将Jam许可证作为遗留/不可重用类别批准，指出尽管措辞欠佳但社区共识是将其视为开源。
timeline.point: Recommends approving the Jam License as legacy/non-reusable, noting the consensus that it is treated as open source despite some poor wording issues.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Legacy Approval, Licnese of Jam
timeline.snippet: Notes that the Jam License is not on the SPDX License List, reports that a new license request has been filed, and offers to provide a short identifier for the OSI website.
timeline.point_zh: 指出Jam许可证目前不在SPDX许可证列表上，报告已提交新的许可证申请，并表示将很快提供简短标识符。
timeline.point: Notes that the Jam License is not on the SPDX License List, reports that a new license request has been filed, and offers to provide a short identifier for the OSI website.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: Zope Public License v2.1
timeline.snippet: Requests legacy approval of Zope Public License version 2.1, explaining ZPL 2.0's references to Zope Corporation are outdated since copyrights were assigned to the Zope Foundation and all code has used ZPL 2.1 for over a decade.
timeline.point_zh: 请求追溯批准 Zope Public License 2.1：ZPL 2.0 中对 Zope Corporation 的引用已过时，版权已转让给 Zope 基金会，且所有代码十多年前已改用 ZPL 2.1。
timeline.point: Requests legacy approval of Zope Public License version 2.1, explaining ZPL 2.0's references to Zope Corporation are outdated since copyrights were assigned to the Zope Foundation and all code has used ZPL 2.1 for over a decade.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: Zope Public License v2.1
timeline.snippet: Questions whether ZPL 2.1 belongs in the legacy process or should instead be categorized like ZPL 2.0, since it is still actively used.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑 ZPL 2.1 是否应走历史遗留审批流程，还是应像 ZPL 2.0 那样分类，因为它仍在被积极使用。
timeline.point: Questions whether ZPL 2.1 belongs in the legacy process or should instead be categorized like ZPL 2.0, since it is still actively used.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: Zope Public License v2.1
timeline.snippet: Explains that legacy is a procedural path rather than a category, and says upgraded licenses like ZPL 2.1 may deserve a separate process when changes are legally minor.
timeline.point_zh: 解释说“历史遗留”是一种程序路径而非许可证类别，并认为像 ZPL 2.1 这种法律改动很小的升级版许可证或许应有单独流程。
timeline.point: Explains that legacy is a procedural path rather than a category, and says upgraded licenses like ZPL 2.1 may deserve a separate process when changes are legally minor.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: Zope Public License v2.1
timeline.snippet: Supports prompt approval of ZPL 2.1, says ZPL 2.0 should be marked superseded, and recommends categorizing 2.1 as redundant with more popular licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 支持尽快批准 ZPL 2.1，认为 ZPL 2.0 应标记为已被取代，并建议把 2.1 归类为与更流行许可证重复的许可证。
timeline.point: Supports prompt approval of ZPL 2.1, says ZPL 2.0 should be marked superseded, and recommends categorizing 2.1 as redundant with more popular licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: Zope Public License v2.1
timeline.snippet: Expresses support for the proposed approval and categorization of ZPL 2.1.
timeline.point_zh: 表示支持对 ZPL 2.1 的拟议批准及其分类方式。
timeline.point: Expresses support for the proposed approval and categorization of ZPL 2.1.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: Zope Public License v2.1
timeline.snippet: Announces that the OSI Board approved ZPL 2.1 and placed it in the redundant-licenses category, while moving ZPL 2.0 to superseded licenses.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布 OSI 董事会已批准 ZPL 2.1，并将其归入“与更流行许可证重复”类别，同时把 ZPL 2.0 移至“已被取代许可证”类别。
timeline.point: Announces that the OSI Board approved ZPL 2.1 and placed it in the redundant-licenses category, while moving ZPL 2.0 to superseded licenses.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For Legacy Approval: Zope Public License v2.1
timeline.snippet: Questions why the OSI site lists ZPL 2.1 under non-reusable licenses instead of the approved redundant-licenses category.
timeline.point_zh: 询问为何 OSI 网站把 ZPL 2.1 列在“不可复用许可证”下，而不是已批准的“与更流行许可证重复”类别。
timeline.point: Questions why the OSI site lists ZPL 2.1 under non-reusable licenses instead of the approved redundant-licenses category.

Resolved that it is the opinion of the OSI that the MIT No Attribution 
License be approved as an Open Source Initiative Approved license in the 
Other/Miscellaneous category of licenses.


Rationale Document


The license is the same language as the MIT License except that the 
attribution requirement of the MIT License in its second paragraph is 
removed. The license was discussed on both the License-Discuss list and 
the License-Review list and no one raised a substantive objection to its 
approval. There was some discussion whether the license was actually in 
use, but this is not a basis for rejection that the OSI has applied in 
the past (and the OSI has historically approved newly drafted licenses 
not yet in use).

0-clause BSD License is in the same category. Both licenses have the 
same modification to their origin license, which is to remove the 
requirement that the copyright notice and permission notice be included

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Legacy Approval of MIT No Attribution License
timeline.snippet: Submits the MIT No Attribution License (MIT-0) for OSI approval, describing it as a MIT variant with the attribution clause removed, used by Amazon and Airtable for sample and documentation code.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 MIT 无署名许可证（MIT-0）申请 OSI 审批，将其描述为移除署名条款的 MIT 变体，被 Amazon 和 Airtable 用于示例和文档代码。
timeline.point: Submits the MIT No Attribution License (MIT-0) for OSI approval, describing it as a MIT variant with the attribution clause removed, used by Amazon and Airtable for sample and documentation code.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Legacy Approval of MIT No Attribution License
timeline.snippet: Expresses support for approving the MIT No Attribution License based on previous discussion.
timeline.point_zh: 基于先前讨论，支持批准 MIT 无署名许可证。
timeline.point: Expresses support for approving the MIT No Attribution License based on previous discussion.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Legacy Approval of MIT No Attribution License
timeline.snippet: Expresses support for approving the MIT No Attribution License.
timeline.point_zh: 支持批准 MIT 无署名许可证。
timeline.point: Expresses support for approving the MIT No Attribution License.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Legacy Approval of MIT No Attribution License
timeline.snippet: License Committee recommends the OSI approve the MIT No Attribution License (MIT-0) in the Other/Miscellaneous category, noting no substantive objections were raised and it parallels the 0-clause BSD License.
timeline.point_zh: 许可证委员会建议 OSI 在 Other/Miscellaneous 类别下批准 MIT No Attribution License (MIT-0)，指出无人提出实质性反对，且其与 0-clause BSD License 类似。
timeline.point: License Committee recommends the OSI approve the MIT No Attribution License (MIT-0) in the Other/Miscellaneous category, noting no substantive objections were raised and it parallels the 0-clause BSD License.

timeline.point: Announces that the OSI Board approved the MIT No Attribution License at its August 14, 2020 meeting.

submissions.name: The Unlicense
aliases: Request for legacy approval: The Unlicense

timeline.subject: OSI API submission record: The Unlicense
timeline.snippet: (OSI API records Steffen Jaeckel as the submitter of The Unlicense. The public mailing-list archive does not expose a concrete submission message for this event.)
timeline.point: (OSI API records Steffen Jaeckel as the submitter of The Unlicense. The public mailing-list archive does not expose a concrete submission message for this event.)
timeline.point_zh: （OSI API 记录 Steffen Jaeckel 为 The Unlicense 的提交者；公开邮件归档没有暴露这一事件的具体提交邮件。）

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for legacy approval: The Unlicense
timeline.snippet: Presents The Unlicense, a 10-year-old public-domain dedication used by over 133,000 GitHub repositories to dedicate code in jurisdictions lacking a public-domain concept, and proposes the 'Popular and Widely-Used or With Strong Communities' category.
timeline.point_zh: 介绍 The Unlicense:问世十年,用于在没有公有领域概念的司法辖区将代码奉献给公有领域,GitHub 已有逾 13.3 万仓库使用;建议归入“流行且广泛使用或社区强大”类别。
timeline.point: Presents The Unlicense, a 10-year-old public-domain dedication used by over 133,000 GitHub repositories to dedicate code in jurisdictions lacking a public-domain concept, and proposes the 'Popular and Widely-Used or With Strong Communities' category.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for legacy approval: The Unlicense
timeline.snippet: Questions the criticism that the Unlicense is legally inferior to CC0 for software, noting it does not expressly disclaim patents and its MIT-style second-paragraph grant of 'use' and 'sell' could suffice for an express or implied patent license.
timeline.point_zh: 质疑“The Unlicense 在软件领域法律效力不及 CC0”的批评,指出其未明示放弃专利,第二段的 MIT 式授权中 “use” 和 “sell” 措辞可构成明示或默示专利许可。
timeline.point: Questions the criticism that the Unlicense is legally inferior to CC0 for software, noting it does not expressly disclaim patents and its MIT-style second-paragraph grant of 'use' and 'sell' could suffice for an express or implied patent license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for legacy approval: The Unlicense
timeline.snippet: Notes the Unlicense's 'use' and 'sell' wording covers two of the five patent verbs in 35 USC § 271, and that other countries' patent statutes similarly capture at least making and selling.
timeline.point_zh: 指出 The Unlicense 的 “use” 和 “sell” 措辞涵盖 35 USC § 271 五项专利动词中的两项,其他国家专利法也至少涵盖制造与销售行为。
timeline.point: Notes the Unlicense's 'use' and 'sell' wording covers two of the five patent verbs in 35 USC § 271, and that other countries' patent statutes similarly capture at least making and selling.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for legacy approval: The Unlicense
timeline.snippet: Asks European lawyers to support the pro-approval view and suggests courts outside the US would still try to interpret the Unlicense consistently with the author’s intent.
timeline.point_zh: 希望欧洲律师也支持批准的看法，并认为美国以外的法院仍会尽量按照作者意图来解释 Unlicense。
timeline.point: Asks European lawyers to support the pro-approval view and suggests courts outside the US would still try to interpret the Unlicense consistently with the author’s intent.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for legacy approval: The Unlicense
timeline.snippet: Argues the second paragraph already functions as a broad license grant, and that despite naive public-domain wording a court would likely interpret the document consistently with the OSD.
timeline.point_zh: 认为第二段本身就是广泛的许可授予；尽管公共领域表述较天真，但法院很可能会按符合 OSD 的方式解释该文本。
timeline.point: Argues the second paragraph already functions as a broad license grant, and that despite naive public-domain wording a court would likely interpret the document consistently with the OSD.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for legacy approval: The Unlicense
timeline.snippet: Relays the License Committee's recommendation to approve the Unlicense as an OSI Approved license in the Special Purpose category rather than the requested popular/widely-used category, with the Board expected to take it up on June 12.
timeline.point_zh: 转达许可证委员会建议:将 The Unlicense 作为 OSI 批准许可证列入 Special Purpose 类别(而非申请的流行/广泛使用类别),董事会预计 6 月 12 日审议。
timeline.point: Relays the License Committee's recommendation to approve the Unlicense as an OSI Approved license in the Special Purpose category rather than the requested popular/widely-used category, with the Board expected to take it up on June 12.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for legacy approval: The Unlicense
timeline.snippet: Announces that the Board approved the Unlicense as an OSI Approved License on June 12, 2020.
timeline.point_zh: 宣布董事会已于 2020 年 6 月 12 日将 Unlicense 批准为 OSI 认可许可证。
timeline.point: Announces that the Board approved the Unlicense as an OSI Approved License on June 12, 2020.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Legacy Approval of PHP License 3.01
timeline.snippet: Submits a formal request to review and list PHP License 3.01 on behalf of PHP internals, noting the 3.01 modification was never added to OSI's approved license list, and categorizes it under the non-reusable licenses proliferation category.
timeline.point_zh: 代表 PHP internals 正式请求审查并列入 PHP License 3.01，指出 3.01 的修改从未被加入 OSI 批准列表，并将其归入不可再用许可证扩散类别。
timeline.point: Submits a formal request to review and list PHP License 3.01 on behalf of PHP internals, noting the 3.01 modification was never added to OSI's approved license list, and categorizes it under the non-reusable licenses proliferation category.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Legacy Approval of PHP License 3.01
timeline.snippet: Says trademark language can justify naming restrictions, but asks whether a non-registered mark can do that and whether the license should be deprecated if approved.
timeline.point_zh: 表示商标措辞也许能支持命名限制，但质疑未注册商标是否真能如此，并询问若获批是否应将 3.0 版本弃用。
timeline.point: Says trademark language can justify naming restrictions, but asks whether a non-registered mark can do that and whether the license should be deprecated if approved.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Legacy Approval of PHP License 3.01
timeline.snippet: Argues the naming concerns are non-issues since PCI Hot Plug and Penultimate Hop Popping are not PHP derivatives, and maintains the PHP License should still be considered a non-reusable license because its clauses cannot be enforced when applied to other projects.
timeline.point_zh: 认为命名方面的担忧并非问题，因为 PCI Hot Plug 等并非 PHP 衍生物，并主张 PHP License 应保持不可再用许可证定位，因其条款对其他项目无法执行。
timeline.point: Argues the naming concerns are non-issues since PCI Hot Plug and Penultimate Hop Popping are not PHP derivatives, and maintains the PHP License should still be considered a non-reusable license because its clauses cannot be enforced when applied to other projects.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Legacy Approval of PHP License 3.01
timeline.snippet: States that the PHP team already treats the license as deprecated and offers to formalize that if needed.
timeline.point_zh: 表示 PHP 团队早已将该许可证视为废弃，并愿意在需要时补办正式声明。
timeline.point: States that the PHP team already treats the license as deprecated and offers to formalize that if needed.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Legacy Approval of PHP License 3.01
timeline.snippet: Asks for an example of URL placeholders in a license and explains that the cited URL changes are old and were never resubmitted by oversight.
timeline.point_zh: 询问是否有许可证中 URL 占位符的例子，并说明相关 URL 早已变更，3.01 未提交只是疏忽。
timeline.point: Asks for an example of URL placeholders in a license and explains that the cited URL changes are old and were never resubmitted by oversight.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Legacy Approval of PHP License 3.01
timeline.snippet: Says the project may pursue that idea later, but for now wants legacy approval of the existing license after more than 14 years of use.
timeline.point_zh: 表示以后可能会考虑该建议，但当前重点是为已使用 14 年以上的现有许可证争取 legacy 批准。
timeline.point: Says the project may pursue that idea later, but for now wants legacy approval of the existing license after more than 14 years of use.

timeline.subject: [License-review] Request for Legacy Approval of PHP License 3.01
timeline.snippet: Acknowledges the approval and says it will be reported back to the PHP development team.
timeline.point_zh: 表示收到批准消息，并会转告 PHP 开发团队。
timeline.point: Acknowledges the approval and says it will be reported back to the PHP development team.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New legacy license for approval: BSD-1-Clause
timeline.snippet: Submits the BSD-1-Clause license variant discovered in the FreeBSD code tree for approval, noting it is a further simplification of the traditional BSD license that preserves its original wording.
timeline.point_zh: 提交 FreeBSD 代码树中发现的 BSD-1-Clause 许可证变体申请批准，该许可证是传统 BSD 的进一步简化，保留了原始 BSD 的措辞形式。
timeline.point: Submits the BSD-1-Clause license variant discovered in the FreeBSD code tree for approval, noting it is a further simplification of the traditional BSD license that preserves its original wording.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New legacy license for approval: BSD-1-Clause
timeline.snippet: Considers BSD-1-Clause an obvious case for approval, noting it differs from 2-Clause BSD only by omitting the binary distribution documentation requirement.
timeline.point_zh: 认为 BSD-1-Clause 应当显然被批准，因为与 2-Clause BSD 相比仅省略了二进制分发的文档要求。
timeline.point: Considers BSD-1-Clause an obvious case for approval, noting it differs from 2-Clause BSD only by omitting the binary distribution documentation requirement.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New legacy license for approval: BSD-1-Clause
timeline.snippet: Agrees with approving BSD-1-Clause, particularly given that this is a legacy approval request.
timeline.point_zh: 同意批准 BSD-1-Clause，特别是考虑到这是一个遗留许可证的批准请求。
timeline.point: Agrees with approving BSD-1-Clause, particularly given that this is a legacy approval request.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New legacy license for approval: BSD-1-Clause
timeline.snippet: Supports approving BSD-1-Clause as a legacy approval with obvious origin and appropriate naming.
timeline.point_zh: 支持批准 BSD-1-Clause，认为这是遗留批准、来源明确、命名恰当。
timeline.point: Supports approving BSD-1-Clause as a legacy approval with obvious origin and appropriate naming.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New legacy license for approval: BSD-1-Clause
timeline.snippet: Opposes approving BSD-1-Clause, arguing code should be relicensed under a standard BSD license and that proliferation of nearly identical licenses hinders software freedom.
timeline.point_zh: 反对批准 BSD-1-Clause，主张应将代码重新许可为标准 BSD 许可证并推动减少许可证数量，因为近似许可证的泛滥阻碍了软件自由的推广。
timeline.point: Opposes approving BSD-1-Clause, arguing code should be relicensed under a standard BSD license and that proliferation of nearly identical licenses hinders software freedom.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New legacy license for approval: BSD-1-Clause
timeline.snippet: Explains that legacy approval is needed because original authors are unreachable and the company has changed hands; also counters the relicensing argument by noting you cannot force people to adopt a specific license.
timeline.point_zh: 说明申请遗留批准的原因是原始作者已失联且公司多次易手，无法修改许可证；同时反驳了重新许可的建议，认为不能强迫人们使用特定许可证。
timeline.point: Explains that legacy approval is needed because original authors are unreachable and the company has changed hands; also counters the relicensing argument by noting you cannot force people to adopt a specific license.

timeline.subject: [License-review] New legacy license for approval: BSD-1-Clause
timeline.snippet: Recommends on behalf of the License Committee that the OSI approve the BSD 1 Clause License in the 'Other/Miscellaneous' category, changing 'Berkeley Software Design, Inc.' to '[Name of Organization]', with no objections expressed.
timeline.point_zh: 代表许可证委员会建议 OSI 在"其他/杂项"类别批准 BSD 1 Clause License,将"Berkeley Software Design, Inc."改为"[Name of Organization]",无任何反对意见。

timeline.snippet: Expresses agreement with the BSD-1-Clause license approval recommendation.

timeline.subject: OSI API submission record: Cryptographic Autonomy License
timeline.snippet: (OSI API records Van Lindberg as the submitter of Cryptographic Autonomy License. The public mailing-list archive does not expose a concrete submission message for this event.)
timeline.point: (OSI API records Van Lindberg as the submitter of Cryptographic Autonomy License. The public mailing-list archive does not expose a concrete submission message for this event.)
timeline.point_zh: （OSI API 记录 Van Lindberg 为 Cryptographic Autonomy License 的提交者；公开邮件归档没有暴露这一事件的具体提交邮件。）

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 4)
timeline.snippet: Withdraws CAL Beta 3 and substitutes Beta 4, whose primary change tightens the definition of 'User Data' to data necessary for substantially identical use in an equivalent context, with minor changes to the prevailing-party and termination provisions.
timeline.point_zh: 撤回 CAL Beta 3 并以 Beta 4 取代,主要修改是收紧 "User Data" 的定义至等效使用所必需的数据,并对胜诉方认定与终止条款作小幅修改。
timeline.point: Withdraws CAL Beta 3 and substitutes Beta 4, whose primary change tightens the definition of 'User Data' to data necessary for substantially identical use in an equivalent context, with minor changes to the prevailing-party and termination provisions.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 4)
timeline.snippet: Supports CAL's OSI approval, believing CAL better protects end user freedoms than other copyleft licenses, and looks forward to dual-licensing future projects under CAL in standard web application contexts.
timeline.point_zh: 支持CAL的OSI审批，认为CAL在保护终端用户自由方面优于其他copyleft许可证，期待未来在标准web应用项目中采用CAL双重许可。
timeline.point: Supports CAL's OSI approval, believing CAL better protects end user freedoms than other copyleft licenses, and looks forward to dual-licensing future projects under CAL in standard web application contexts.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 4)
timeline.snippet: Argues that WordPress does not comply with CAL 4.2, because non-admin users cannot access various stored interaction data (voting, forms, file uploads, etc.), and merely copying HTML page content is insufficient to meet data accessibility requirements.
timeline.point_zh: 论证WordPress不符合CAL 4.2条款，因为非管理员用户无法访问其存储的各种交互数据（投票、表单、文件上传等），仅能复制HTML页面内容不足以满足数据可访问性要求。
timeline.point: Argues that WordPress does not comply with CAL 4.2, because non-admin users cannot access various stored interaction data (voting, forms, file uploads, etc.), and merely copying HTML page content is insufficient to meet data accessibility requirements.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 4)
timeline.snippet: Argues that OSI should explicitly list all evaluation criteria in its license approval guidelines (such as legal soundness, business model, existing usage, FSF recognition) rather than relying on unwritten standards.
timeline.point_zh: 主张OSI应在许可证审批指南中明确列出所有评估因素（如法律健全性、商业模式、现有使用情况、FSF认可等），而非仅依赖未明文规定的标准。
timeline.point: Argues that OSI should explicitly list all evaluation criteria in its license approval guidelines (such as legal soundness, business model, existing usage, FSF recognition) rather than relying on unwritten standards.

timeline.subject: [License-review] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 4)
timeline.snippet: Confirms that a written opinion on CAL will be completed promptly.
timeline.point_zh: 确认将尽快完成关于CAL的书面意见。
timeline.point: Confirms that a written opinion on CAL will be completed promptly.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 4)
timeline.snippet: Moves the CAL discussion to license-discuss because the license had already been approved.
timeline.point_zh: 因 CAL 已获批准，将相关讨论转到 license-discuss。
timeline.point: Moves the CAL discussion to license-discuss because the license had already been approved.

timeline.subject: [License-discuss] For approval: The Cryptographic Autonomy License (Beta 4)
timeline.snippet: Expresses frustration that CAL compliance concerns were overlooked by the board, noting that these concerns had been raised earlier but not taken seriously.
timeline.point_zh: 表达对CAL合规性问题被董事会忽视的不满，指出自己曾提出过相关担忧但未获重视。
timeline.point: Expresses frustration that CAL compliance concerns were overlooked by the board, noting that these concerns had been raised earlier but not taken seriously.

board_vote.motion_text: CAL beta 4: Resolved that it is the opinion of the OSI that the Cryptographic Autonomy License Beta 4 be approved for the Uncategorized Licenses category
board_vote.discussion: The Board discussed the additional emails sent after the License Committee made its recommendation to the Board and found that they did not raise issues not previously considered.

From: Carlo Piana <carlo at piana.eu>

I have one observation and one criticism.

The observation is that this looks like a couple of licenses like the
BSD+patents. While arguably the text is more streamlined and modern,
building on the experience in licensing that we have accrued since the BSD
times, I wonder if there is such desperate need for yet another license.
Except perhaps one in Chinese.

The criticism is founded on a long debated issue about whether
multi-language licenses are a good idea. As you know, GNU GPL family
decided that the only ever authoritative version is the English one, and I
tend to agree with the rationale underneath. It is tremendously difficult
to exactly match the same meaning across multiple languages, and my
experience in dissecting legal instruments of the EU -- limiting to those
few languages I am reasonably confident perusing -- is that it is very
difficult to find a single meaning. Often one should find it comparing
different versions and with the help of the recitals, and yet it is very
difficult to reach a final point.

Moreover, you state in your introduction that the rule is (roughly)
"either is normative". But that rule is nowhere expressed in the license
itself. I am afraid this would then be totally left to the local court, in
case. Yet, a license lives not only in court, but also in the current
interpretation of those using it, who would not have the benefit of a third
party picking up one version or the other.

Frankly, I see little merit in creating confusion by using two languages
on equal footing. On the other hand, the fact that the license is
non-copyleft reduces the concerns on possible negative consequences.

I wonder if those concerns have also been tackled in your legal analysis,
and what the answer were, in case.

I totally love the name of the license.

From: "McCoy Smith" <mccoy at lexpan.law> <mccoy at lexpan.law>

A few comments on this submission; sorry I didn’t get comments in on prior
iterations:

This looks like a variant on Apache, so my initial question on this was
why not translate Apache into Chinese, and have that be the authoritative
version?  However, there are some substantive differences here with Apache,
so that proposition would not make sense if the goal is to achieve some
improvements or variants to canonical Apache, as well as to have an
authoritative native Chinese language license.  The substantive differences
do raise questions in my mind though (note that some of these may be the
result of translation from Chinese to English, so perhaps some clarity in
the English-translated submission is required rather than changes to the
license text itself):

“Software means the program and related documents which are comprised of
those Contribution and licensed under this License.”

The grammar, in English, of this definition is awkward.  It probably
should say:

“’Software’ means the program and related documents which comprise all
Contributions licensed under this License.”

Also:

“Affiliates means entities that control, or are controlled by, or are
under common control with a party to this License, ‘control’ means direct
or indirect ownership of at least fifty percent (50%) of the voting power,
capital or other securities of controlled or commonly controlled entity.”

I think you may not want use the term “party” here, as it would apply both
to the entity/person giving the grant (licensor), and the entities/persons
receiving the grant (licensee).  This looks like it is styled to be a “bare
license” (vs a contract), in which case use of “party” here could be
construed as an effort to make binding obligations that go in both ways (vs
having all terms merely be conditions upon the grant of the licenses).  If
your intent is to have this be interpreted as a contract, for which both
parties (licensor and licensee) are agreeing to obligations, you might want
to clarify what is the binding obligation of the licensee (entity receiving
the grant) to the licensor (entity giving the grant), particularly what
obligations you believe Affiliates of the licensee should be bound to.

And:

“2. Grant of Patent License

*** where such patent license is only limited to the patent claims owned
or controlled by such Contributor now or in future which will be
necessarily infringed by its Contribution alone, or by combination of the
Contribution with the Software to which the Contribution was contributed,
excluding of any patent claims solely be infringed by your or others’
modification or other combinations.”

The grammar, in English, of the last part of that statement is awkward.
I’d suggest you just use the language straight out of, e.g., Eclipse:

“The patent license shall not apply to any other combinations which
include the Contribution.”

In addition:

“If you or your Affiliates directly or indirectly (including through an
agent, patent licensee or assignee), institute patent litigation (including
a cross claim or counterclaim in a litigation) or other patent enforcement
activities against any individual or entity by alleging that the Software
or any Contribution in it infringes patents, then any patent license
granted to you under this License for the Software shall terminate as of
the date such litigation or activity is filed or taken.”

The parenthetical here is potentially highly problematic, as it doesn’t
limit what sort of “agent,” “patent licensee” or “assignee” to which it
applies.  I think you intend here to indicate an “agent, patent licensee or
assignee” *which has been granted the right to institute patent litigation
using a Contributor’s patent that is claimed to be infringed by the
Software.*  If that is the case, it should be made clear. Otherwise, it –
as written – would cover a non-exclusive licensee of a general corporate
patent cross-license who asserts a patent claim against the Software based
on a patent that that non-exclusive licensee developed independent of the
Contributor.  The same would apply to “agent” and “assignee” (although in
that case, an agent for any purpose might be potentially implicated).  If
you did intend the defensive suspension claim to be that broad in scope, I
don’t think it violates the OSD, but it likely means that many entities
will not wish to use the license, as any contractual relation it enters
into with other entities that could be characterized as agency or
assignment (or the granting of any sort of patent license) means that their
continued use of software is at risk based on independent actions of those
parties using their own patents.

The Software and Contribution in it are provided without warranties of any

limited to any direct, or indirect, special or consequential damages
arising from your use or inability to use the Software or the Contribution
in it, no matter how it’s caused or based on which legal theory, even if
advised of the possibility of such damages.”

Since you’re already using red to highlight the “Language” clause, I’d
suggest you might want to do that for the “Disclaimer of Warranty and
Limitation of Liability,” as (at least in the USA), making such disclaimers

https://mjlr.org/2015/09/19/out-of-sight-out-of-mind-hidden-disclaimers-and-ucc-%C2%A7-2-316s-conspicuousness-requirement/
)
